  2. Har chunk ke shuru mein 'From: John, Subject: Q3 budget' likh do aur phir embed karo (text ko numbers mein badalna). Tab chunk ke numbers mein John aur Q3 budget dono ki pehchaan aa jati hai.
  3. Metadata filters se seedha bol sakte ho 'sirf sender = John wale emails dikhao'. Isse search ka daayra chhota aur sahi ho jata hai.
🔀 Flowchart: John ke email ka answer nahi milta
Question: John ne Q3 budget ke bare mein kya kaha?
↓
Problem: John ka naam sirf header mein hai, embed hui body mein nahi
↓
Sender, date, subject ko metadata ki tarah store karo
↓
Har chunk ke aage jodo: From: John, Subject: Q3 budget
↓
Kya question mein sender ka naam hai?
HaanMetadata filter lagao: sender equals John
NahiNormal semantic search
↓
John ke email ka chunk mil jata hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Har chunk mein zyada text aur clean rakhne ke liye zyada metadata.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Embedding se pehle har chunk ke aage header fields (sender, subject, date) jodo.
  • Unhe metadata ki tarah store karo aur sender ke hisaab se filter karo.
  • Hybrid search use karo taaki exact names keyword se match hon.
Aur gehra
  • Query time par entity extraction se 'John' ko filter mein badal sakte ho; ambiguity (do Johns) ke liye disambiguation chahiye.
  • Contextual chunk headers sasta hote hain aur aksar recall badhate hain; name-based query set par test karo.
75

RAG English questions ke liye chalta hai lekin same English documents par Spanish ke liye fail ho jata hai. Aap kya karoge?

Q119

Chhota jawab: Multilingual embedding model use karo, ya queries translate karo, aur cross-language retrieval test karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Search index sirf English samajhta hai, isliye Spanish question par kuch nahi milta. Aisa model use karo jo dono languages samajhta ho.

Aise samjhoYeh aisa hai jaise library mein sab kitabein English mein catalogue hui hain aur tum Spanish mein dhoondh rahe ho. Catalogue ki language match nahi karti to kuch nahi milta.
Pehle yeh samjhoembedding model text ko numbers mein badalta hai. Agar wo sirf English seekha hai to Spanish ke numbers English documents ke numbers ke paas nahi aate, isliye search fail hoti hai. Multilingual model sab bhashaon ko ek hi 'meaning ki jagah' mein rakhta hai.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Multilingual embeddings aise models hain jo alag-alag bhasha ke text ko same meaning space mein rakhte hain. Isse Spanish sawal English document se match ho jata hai.
  2. Ya pehle Spanish sawal ko English mein translate karke search karo, kyunki documents English mein hain. Seedha aur kaam chalau tareeka hai.
  3. Jawab user ki apni bhasha (Spanish) mein do, taaki use samajhne mein dikkat na ho.
🔀 Flowchart: English chalta hai, Spanish fail
English question sahi, same documents par Spanish fail
↓
Wajah: embedding model shayad English-only hai
↓
Kya multilingual embedding model use kar sakte ho?
HaanMultilingual embeddings lagao
NahiQuery ko pehle English mein translate karo
↓
Search chalao: question aur document ab paas aate hain
↓
Answer user ki language mein do
↓
Spanish users ko bhi sahi answer
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Translation latency badhati hai aur nuance kho sakti hai; multilingual models ko re-indexing chahiye.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Multilingual embedding model par switch karo taaki same-meaning text languages ke across paas aaye.
  • Ya search se pehle query ko English mein translate karo.
  • LLM se user ki language mein answer dilwao.
Aur gehra
  • Har language ke liye evaluation sets banao; English-only metrics aksar quality gaps chhupa dete hain.
  • Embedding model badalne ka matlab poora corpus versioned index swap ke saath re-embed karna.
76

Ek single clause do 512-token chunks mein toot gaya aur LLM ek condition miss kar gaya. Aap kya karoge?

Q122

Chhota jawab: Overlap, structure-aware ya semantic chunking, aur parent-child retrieval use karo taaki clauses poore rahein.

Aasan shabdon mein

Ek rule do pieces ke beech aadha kat gaya, isliye model ne sirf aadha dekha. Natural boundaries par split karo aur thoda overlap rakho.

Aise samjhoYeh kitab ke page ko beech se kaatne jaisa hai: ek vaakya do page par bant gaya. Thoda overlap rakhna aisa hai jaise pichhle page ki aakhri line agle page par bhi chhaap dena.
Pehle yeh samjhoclause ek condition wala vaakya hota hai, jaise 'refund tabhi milega jab 7 din ke andar maanga jaye'. Agar chunk ki kinaar par ye aadha kat gaya to model ko aadhi shart hi dikhti hai.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Overlap matlab agle chunk mein pichle chunk ka kuch hissa dobara rakhna. Isse beech mein toot ne wali clause (condition wali line) dono chunks mein poori dikhti hai.
  2. Sirf 512 tokens (text ke chhote tukde) par kaatne ki jagah sentence, section ya matlab ke hisab se todo. Jaise kitab ko page ke beech nahi, chapter ke hisab se todna.
  3. Parent-child retrieval mein chhota tukda (child) match karne ke liye hota hai, aur wapas poora clause (parent) model ko diya jata hai. Isse search tez aur context poora rehta hai.
  4. Contracts mein clause number ke hisab se chunk banao, taaki har clause apne aap mein poora rahe.
🔀 Flowchart: Clause do chunks mein toot gaya
Ek clause do 512-token chunks mein toot gaya
↓
LLM ne ek condition miss kar di
↓
Chunks ke beech overlap add karo
↓
Fixed size ki jagah sentences ya sections se chunk karo
↓
Kya yeh contract hai?
HaanClause number ke hisab se chunk karo
NahiParent-child: chhota piece match, poora clause return
↓
Poora clause LLM tak pahunchta hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Overlap aur bade parents index size aur token cost badhate hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Fixed token counts ke bajay sentence ya section boundaries par split karo.
  • Overlap jodo taaki edge content dono chunks mein aaye.
  • Parent-child use karo: chhote chunks search karo, bada parent return karo.
Aur gehra
  • Legal ya policy text ke liye clause ya section ke hisaab se chunk karo aur har chunk ke saath headings rakho.
  • Chunk size aur overlap ko defaults ke bajay evaluation set par tune karo; rules of thumb corpus ke hisaab se alag hote hain.
77

"Policy A aur Policy B mein kya difference hai?" LLM dono ko mix kar deta hai. Aap kya karoge?

Q124

Chhota jawab: Har policy ko alag se retrieve karo, sources label karo, phir ek structured step mein compare karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Model ne do policies ko mila diya. Har ek ko alag se laao, label lagao, phir side by side compare karo.

Aise samjhoYeh do bachchon ki report card ek hi page par chhapne jaisa hai, to sab ulat-palat ho jata hai. Dono ko alag folder mein rakho aur naam likh do.
Pehle yeh samjhoek hi search mein Policy A aur B ke tukde mile-jule aa jaate hain, aur model unhe ek hi policy samajh leta hai. Isliye har policy ke liye alag search aur alag label zaroori hai.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Comparison intent detect karna matlab pehchanna ki user do cheezon ka fark pooch raha hai. Tab system ko alag tareeke se kaam karna padta hai.
  2. Policy A aur B ke liye alag-alag search karo, aur context mein 'Policy A:' aur 'Policy B:' ke label lagao. Isse model dono ko mix nahi karta.
  3. Model se side-by-side table maango. Table mein dono ke points saamne-saamne aate hain, to galti kam hoti hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Policy A vs Policy B ka mix-up
Question: Policy A aur B mein kya difference hai?
↓
Kya comparison intent detect hua?
HaanHar policy ke liye alag se retrieve karo
NahiNormal ek search (yahi galti thi)
↓
Context ko label karo: Policy A: ... Policy B: ...
↓
LLM se side-by-side table maango
↓
Dono policies saaf alag, mix nahi
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Question mein do entities detect karo.
  • Policy name ya ID se filtered alag retrievals chalao.
  • Context ko labelled blocks mein do: Policy A, Policy B.
  • Citations ke saath differences ki table maango; trade-off hai do retrievals aur lamba prompt.
Aur gehra
  • Entity-aware decomposition comparison questions ke liye general pattern hai; teen ya zyada items ko loop se handle karo.
  • Yahan metadata filters semantic similarity se behtar hain, kyunki dono policies text mein kaafi milti-julti hain.
78

"Reset my password" us FAQ se match nahi karta jisme "credential recovery" likha hai. Aap kya karoge?

Q128

Chhota jawab: Vocabulary mismatch ko embeddings, synonyms, query expansion ya hybrid search se fix karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Customer bolta hai reset password, page mein likha hai credential recovery. Meaning same, words alag, isliye search ko meaning samajhna padega.

Aise samjhoDukaan mein tum bolte ho 'paani ki bottle' aur dukaandaar ke board par 'jal pay' likha hai, to woh samajh nahi paata. Dono ke naam jaanne wala dukaandaar hi sahi cheez dega.
Pehle yeh samjholexical mismatch matlab dono ka matlab same hai par shabd alag hain, to exact shabd wali search chuk jati hai. HyDE mein model ek kalpanik jawab likhta hai aur us jawab ke shabdon se search hoti hai, jo document ki bhasha se zyada milta hai.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Hybrid search mein keyword search (exact shabd) aur meaning search dono saath chalte hain, taaki 'reset password' aur 'credential recovery' dono se match ban sake.
  2. Query expansion mein sawal ke saath uske synonyms (same matlab wale shabd) bhi jod dete hain, jaise password ke saath credential.
  3. HyDE mein model pehle ek kalpanik jawab likhta hai aur us jawab se search karta hai. Jawab ki bhasha document se zyada milti hai.
  4. FAQ index karte waqt khud synonym tags laga do, taaki log kisi bhi shabd se pooch lein to FAQ mil jaye.
🔀 Flowchart: Reset password vs credential recovery
User: Reset my password. FAQ mein likha hai: credential recovery
↓
Yeh lexical mismatch hai: matlab same, words alag
↓
Hybrid search lagao (keyword plus meaning)
↓
Query expansion: synonyms ke saath search karo
↓
HyDE: pehle ek kalpanik answer likho, usse search karo
↓
FAQ index karte waqt synonym tags add karo
↓
FAQ mil jata hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Expansion noise jod sakta hai; embeddings rare jargon miss kar sakte hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Semantic embeddings meaning match karte hain, exact words nahi.
  • Query expansion ya synonym lists alternate terms jodti hain.
  • Hybrid search meaning ko exact terms ke liye keyword ke saath jodta hai.
Aur gehra
  • Synonym maps banane ke liye failed searches ke query logs mine karo; ye sasta aur targeted hai.
  • Index time par documents ko plain-language aliases ya titles ke saath rewrite karne par vichar karo.
79

"Dusre option ke bare mein kya?" jaisa follow-up kuch kaam ka result nahi deta. Aap kya karoge?

Q134

Chhota jawab: Retrieval se pehle chat history ka use karke follow-ups ko standalone queries mein rewrite karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Search ko sirf 'aur doosre option ke baare mein?' dikhta hai, bina context ke. Pehle ki baatcheet jodo taaki matlab bane.

Aise samjhoYeh aisa hai jaise tum dukaandaar se bolo 'aur dusra wala?' aur usko pata hi nahi pichhli baat kya thi. Poora sawal yaad dilana padega.
Pehle yeh samjhosearch engine sirf us line ko dekhta hai jo tumne abhi likhi, pichli baat use yaad nahi hoti. Isliye 'dusra option' ko pichli baat jodkar poora sawal bana dete hain, tab search ko samajh aata hai.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Conversation history rakho, yaani pichli baatein yaad rakho. Bina uske 'dusra option' ka matlab hi samajh nahi aata.
  2. Retrieve karne se pehle follow-up ko poora, akela samajh aane wala sawal bana do, jaise 'Premium plan, yaani dusre option, ke refund rules kya hain?'. Tab search ko pata hota hai kya dhoondhna hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Follow-up: dusre option ke bare mein?
User: Dusre option ke bare mein kya?
↓
Search engine sirf last sentence dekhta hai, jiska akele mein matlab nahi
↓
Conversation history rakho
↓
Follow-up ko standalone question mein rewrite karo
↓
Rewrite: Premium plan, refunds ke regarding, dusre option?
↓
Ab search ko poora question milta hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Ek extra model call, aur kharab rewrite meaning badal deta hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • LLM se history plus naye message ko standalone question mein condense karwao.
  • Usi rewritten question se search karo.
  • Cost limit karne ke liye sirf recent turns rakho.
Aur gehra
  • Original aur rewritten queries log karo; rewrite errors aksar ek hidden failure hote hain.
  • Entities aur options ke references ko explicitly resolve karo, shayad stored conversation state use karke.
80

Vector search ka recall high hai lekin answers phir bhi poor hain. Aap kya karoge?

S6

Chhota jawab: High recall ke saath poor answers matlab noise hai: rerank karo, context kam karo, aur retrieval aur generation ko alag evaluate karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Sahi kitaab mil gayi thi, par pachaas kitaabein pakda di gayi. Sirf best kuch hi rakho taaki model confuse na ho.

Aise samjhoYeh aisa hai jaise library mein sahi kitab shelf par thi aur tum 50 kitabein uthakar le aaye. Padhne wala itne kaagzon mein sahi line miss kar deta hai, isliye kaam ki kitabein upar rakho.
Pehle yeh samjhoRecall@20 95% matlab sahi document top 20 mein 95 baar tha. Par jawab sirf 70 baar sahi hai, kyunki model ko 20 tukde diye aur beech mein faltu text (noise) bhi tha. Interview line ka matlab: recall batata hai sahi jawab available tha, precision batati hai ki upar ke tukde kaam ke the ya nahi.
🔀 Flowchart: Recall high, answers phir bhi poor
Recall@20 95%, answer accuracy 70%
↓
Sahi doc mil raha hai, lekin LLM tak bahut noise pahunchta hai
↓
Re-ranking add karo, taaki top par precision badhe
↓
Retrieval aur generation ko alag evaluate karo
↓
Kya answer ab bhi galat hai?
HaanDekho LLM ne context use kiya ya nahi
NahiAccuracy theek hai
↓
Recall plus precision, dono sahi
Query -> Vector search -> Top 50 -> Reranker -> Top 5 -> LLM
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Reranking latency badhata hai; context kaatne se evidence drop hone ka risk hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Recall@20 sirf itna batata hai ki evidence list mein hai, yeh nahi ki uske aas-paas kitna noise hai.
  • Reranker add karo aur LLM ko bheje jaane wale top-k ko kam karo.
  • Sirf recall nahi, precision aur faithfulness bhi measure karo.
Aur gehra
  • Evaluations alag karo: retriever ke liye retrieval metrics, generator ke liye groundedness aur correctness.
  • Test karo ki model ko sirf gold chunk dene se answers theek hote hain ya nahi; agar haan, toh problem noise hai.
81

Users IBM-TS-98342 jaise product IDs search karte hain aur vector search fail ho jata hai. Aap kya karoge?

S7

Chhota jawab: Product IDs ko exact match chahiye: keyword search (BM25) ya ID filters lagao, aur hybrid fusion use karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Embeddings meaning samajhte hain, exact codes nahi. IBM-TS-98342 jaise code ke liye exact text search karo.

Aise samjhoYeh aisa hai jaise tum train number 12951 poochho aur dukaandaar bole 'woh tez wali train'. Exact number ke liye exact match chahiye, andaaza kaam nahi karta.
Pehle yeh samjhoproduct ID jaise IBM-TS-98342 ka koi matlab nahi hota, wo bas ek exact code hai, isliye exact shabd wali search (BM25) chahiye. Interview line ka matlab: meaning wali search aur exact shabd wali search alag problems solve karti hain, isliye dono saath use karte hain. Flowchart mein dono search chalti hain, phir unke results merge aur re-rank hote hain.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Hybrid search mein identifiers (jaise IBM-TS-98342) ke liye BM25 (exact shabd match karne wala search) aur matlab ke liye vectors use hote hain. Vector search code jaise IDs par kamzor hota hai.
  2. Reciprocal Rank Fusion ek tareeka hai jo do alag search ki lists ko ek mein milata hai. Phir re-rank karke sabse achhe results upar rakhte hain.
🔀 Flowchart: Product ID par vector search fail
User search karta hai: IBM-TS-98342
↓
Embeddings meaning pakadte hain, exact strings nahi
↓
Kya query exact ID ya code hai?
HaanBM25 (keyword matching) se dhoondho
NahiVector search (meaning) se dhoondho
↓
Dono ke results ko RRF se merge karo
↓
Merged list ko re-rank karo
↓
Exact ID aur meaning, dono wale answers mil jate hain
              Query
             /     \
        BM25         Vector
          |             |
       Results       Results
            \         /
              Fusion
                 |
             Reranker
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Do indexes maintain aur tune karne padte hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Embeddings meaning pakadte hain; codes mein meaning nahi hota, isliye near matches galat hote hain.
  • IDs ke liye keyword search (BM25) ya exact-match field use karo.
  • Hybrid search keyword aur vector scores ko blend karta hai.
Aur gehra
  • Router mein regex se ID patterns detect karo aur unhe exact lookup pe bhejo, vectors skip karo.
  • Tokenisation matter karta hai: analysers configure karo taaki hyphenated codes poore rahein.
82

RAG answer sabse relevant document ko ignore kar deta hai. Aap kya karoge?

S8

Chhota jawab: Mila par ignore hua: context order fix karo, noise kam karo, aur model ko sources use aur cite karne ka instruction do.

Aasan shabdon mein

Best page model ko di gayi thi par use nahi hui. Use achhi jagah rakho aur model ko bolo ki use kare.

Aise samjhoYeh aisa hai jaise teacher ne best notes table par rakhe aur student ne beech ke kisi aur page se copy kar diya. Notes ko sahi jagah rakho aur student ko bolo ki wahin se likhe.
Pehle yeh samjhojab sabse achha document jawab mein use nahi hota to pehle dekho ki wo search mein aaya bhi ya nahi, phir dekho ki model ne use padha ya nahi. Sabse pehle jahan galti pehli baar hui wo jagah theek karo.
🔀 Flowchart: Sabse relevant doc ignore hua: debug
RAG ne sabse relevant document ignore kar diya
↓
Asli retrieved chunks dekho, sirf final answer nahi
↓
Usual causes: embeddings, chunking, metadata, reranking, order, duplicates, stale index
↓
Kya retrieval stage mein problem hai?
HaanPehle retrieval fix karo
NahiPhir generation fix karo
↓
Sabse pehle toote stage ko fix karo
↓
Relevant document answer mein use hota hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Strict prompts se refusals ho sakte hain jab evidence thin ho.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Key chunks ko pehle ya aakhir mein rakho, beech mein dafn mat karo.
  • Reranking se distracting chunks kam karo.
  • Model ko instruct karo ki sirf context se answer de aur cite kare.
Aur gehra
  • Check karo ki model ke paas conflicting ya zyada prominent text tha jo sahi chunk pe haavi ho gaya.
  • Answer se pehle context se quotes maango, taaki grounding force ho.
83

Parent-child chunking kya hai, aur chhote chunks se search karke bade context se answer kyun dete hain?

S12

Chhota jawab: Precision ke liye chhote child chunks search karo, context ke liye bada parent return karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Chhote pieces question se achhe match karte hain; unke aas-paas ka bada page poori kahani deta hai. Chhota search karo, bada se answer do.

Aise samjhoYeh index se pehle sahi pata dhoondhne jaisa hai. Chhota entry sahi page batata hai, phir poora chapter padhne ko milta hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Parent-child chunking
User ka question aaya
↓
Chhote child chunks se match karo: precise search
↓
Matching child apne parent ki taraf point karta hai
↓
Parent (bada chunk) fetch karo
↓
Parent LLM ko bhejo
↓
Precise match aur kaafi context, dono
Document
  '-- Parent chunk (full section)
        |-- Child 1  <- embedded and searched
        |-- Child 2
        '-- Child 3
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Bade prompts zyada cost karte hain aur noise add kar sakte hain; parent-child storage chahiye.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Documents ko chhote child chunks aur bade parent sections mein split karo.
  • Children ko embed aur search karo.
  • Hit milne par parent (ya neighbours) fetch karo aur use LLM ko bhejo.
Aur gehra
  • Ek hi parent ke kai children ko deduplicate karo taaki ek parent baar-baar na bheja jaye.
  • Evaluation data se child size ko retrieval precision ke liye aur parent size ko answer context ke liye tune karo.
84

RAG system ko evaluate kaise karte ho?

S14

Chhota jawab: Labelled question set par retrieval (sahi chunks mile ya nahi) aur generation (answer un chunks ke hisaab se sach hai ya nahi) ko alag alag score karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Do cheezein check karo: sahi pages mile ya nahi, aur model ne unse sahi answer diya ya nahi. Jaise return policy ka page top 5 me hai to retrieval pass; par ShopBot 30 days bole jabki page me 14 hai, to generation fail.

Aise samjhoYeh exam ke do hisse jaisa hai: pehle dekho ki student ko sahi kitab mili ya nahi, phir dekho ki usne usse sahi jawab likha ya nahi.
Pehle yeh samjhoRecall@K, Precision@K, MRR, NDCG sab ye naapte hain ki sahi documents search mein kitne upar aaye. Faithfulness ya groundedness matlab jawab diye hue documents par based hai ya nahi. Relevance matlab jawab sawal se jude hai ya nahi. Correctness matlab sahi hai ya nahi. Failure rate matlab kitni baar system toota.
🔀 Flowchart: RAG ko evaluate kaise karte hain
Naya RAG system bana, kaisa hai?
↓
Ise do hisson mein baanto
↓
Kya humne sahi evidence dhoondha?
HaanRetrieval metrics se naapo (recall, precision)
NahiRetrieval fix karo
↓
Kya evidence ko achhe se use kiya?
HaanAnswer quality aur faithfulness naapo
NahiPrompt aur generation fix karo
↓
Dono hisse alag naape, kamzor hissa pata chalta hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Labelling mehenga hai; LLM judges saste hain par biased ho sakte hain aur calibration chahiye.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Retrieval metrics: Recall@K (sahi chunk top K me hai?), Precision@K (K me kitne kaam ke hain), MRR (pehla sahi chunk kitna upar hai), NDCG (poori ranking ki quality).
  • Generation metrics: faithfulness (answer context se supported hai), correctness, completeness.
  • Real queries se golden set banao; human review ya aise LLM judges use karo jinhe human labels se check kiya ho.
Aur gehra
  • Failures alag karo: low recall ho to chunking ya search theek karo; recall accha par answers kharab ho to prompt ya model theek karo.
  • Ragas ya LangSmith evals jaise tools se faithfulness aur relevance scoring automate karo.
85

Aap embedding model badalte ho. Kya karna padega?

S64

Chhota jawab: Sab kuch re-embed karo, index rebuild karo, models kabhi mix mat karo, aur blue-green plus evaluation se swap karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Naye aur purane models alag bhasha bolte hain, isliye poora catalogue dobara likhna padega. Switch karne se pehle safely karo.

Aise samjhoYeh poori library ka catalogue naye system mein dobara likhne jaisa hai, kyunki purani aur nayi bhasha mix nahi hoti. Pehle naya catalogue side mein banao, achhe se test karo, phir switch karo.
Pehle yeh samjhohar embedding model text ko apne tareeke ke numbers mein badalta hai, isliye alag model ke numbers aapas mein nahi milte. Isliye poora data naye model se dobara badalna padta hai. Interview line ka matlab: ye data ka bada shift hai, sirf ek chhoti setting badalna nahi. Cost = total tokens gunaa per-token price.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Alag models ke embeddings (text ke numbers) aapas mein comparable nahi hote, jaise do alag naap ke paimane. Isliye poori collection ko naye model se dobara embed karna padta hai.
  2. Blue-green matlab naya index purane ke bagal mein banao aur purana chalta rehne do. Isse service rukti nahi.
  3. Dono par golden set (sahi jawab wale sawal) chalao, results compare karo, aur naya behtar ho to hi traffic switch karo.
  4. Rollback ready rakho, yaani agar naya kharab nikle to turant purane par laut sako.
  5. Cost ka andaza chunks ki sankhya ko price per token se guna karke lagao, taaki bill ka pehle se pata ho.
🔀 Flowchart: Embedding model badalna
Naya embedding model better quality ka promise karta hai
↓
Alag models ke embeddings comparable nahi hote
↓
Naya index purane ke bagal mein banao (blue-green)
↓
Dono par golden set chalao aur compare karo
↓
Kya naya model behtar nikla?
HaanTraffic naye par switch karo, rollback ready rakho
NahiPurane par hi raho
↓
Poori collection dobara embed, cost pehle estimate karo
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Alag models ke embeddings comparable nahi hote; queries aur documents ko same model use karna hoga.
  • Poore corpus ko naye index mein re-embed karo.
  • Golden set pe purana versus naya evaluate karo.
  • Traffic tabhi switch karo jab woh pass ho jaye; rollback rakho.
Aur gehra
  • Blue-green indexes chalao: naya parallel mein banao, compare karo, phir cut over karo, aur purana rollback ke liye rakho.
  • Re-embedding ka cost aur time estimate karo; bade corpora ko batching aur rate-limit handling chahiye.
86

Bot ek source cite karta hai, lekin source mein woh baat likhi nahi hai. Aap kya karoge?

S66

Chhota jawab: Citations verify karo: claims ko retrieved passages se jodo, support automatically check karo, aur exact quotes dikhao.

Aasan shabdon mein

Bot ne ek source ka naam liya jo yeh baat kehta hi nahi. Link dikhane se pehle har claim ko source text se check karo.

Aise samjhoYeh project report mein bina padhe kitab ka naam likhne jaisa hai. Teacher pakad leti hai ki us kitab mein yeh line hai hi nahi.
Pehle yeh samjhocitation bot ka diya hua source hai. Kabhi bot galat source ka naam de deta hai. Isliye model se exact line aur chunk ka id maango aur code se check karo ki wo line wahan sach mein hai. Entailment check dekhta hai ki wo line claim ko sach mein support karti hai. Interview line ka matlab: citation ek vaada hai, use dikhane se pehle khud verify karo.
🔀 Flowchart: Citation mein baat likhi nahi hai
Bot ne source cite kiya, par source mein claim nahi hai
↓
Model se exact supporting sentence aur chunk id maango
↓
Code mein check karo: quote chunk mein exist karta hai?
↓
Kya entailment ya LLM check bolta hai ki claim quote se supported hai?
HaanClaim rakho
NahiHata do ya unverified flag karo
↓
Citation par click karo to claim mil jata hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Verification mein ek extra model call lagti hai aur woh unsupported par sach statements ko hata bhi sakti hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Model se sirf diye gaye context ke chunk IDs cite karwao.
  • Ek check chalao ki cited text claim ko support karta hai ya nahi.
  • Sirf title nahi, quoted passage aur link dikhao.
Aur gehra
  • Citation precision (cited source claim ko support karta hai) aur recall (kitne claims cited hain) measure karo.
  • High-risk claims ke liye extractive quotes prefer karo; abstractive summaries drift karti hain.
87

Scanned PDFs aur images mein important facts hain. Aap kya karoge?

S67

Chhota jawab: Ingestion pe OCR ya vision parsing chalao, quality check karo, aur original image ke links rakho.

Aasan shabdon mein

Scanned files pictures hoti hain, text nahi. Pehle unhe text mein convert karo, jaise purani diary ko type karna.

Aise samjhoYeh purani handwritten diary ko typed copy mein badalne jaisa hai. Tab hi computer usme se baat dhoondh sakta hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoscanned PDF asal mein ek photo hoti hai, computer use akshar ki tarah nahi padhta. OCR use text mein badalta hai. OCR confidence matlab OCR ko apne padhne par kitna bharosa hai, kam ho to insaan check kare.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. OCR ek technology hai jo scanned photo ke akshar ko text mein badalti hai. Ise ingestion (data load karne) ke time chalao, ya vision-language model (jo image samajhta hai) use karo.
  2. OCR ka confidence score save karo, aur kam score wale pages ko insaan se review karwao, kyunki OCR dhundhle akshar galat padh sakta hai.
  3. Page ki image bhi rakho taaki insaan asli source dekh kar jawab check kar sake.
  4. Chart aur diagram ke liye LLM se likhwa kar description store karo, taaki search unhe text ki tarah dhoondh sake.
🔀 Flowchart: Scanned PDFs aur images ki knowledge
Aadhi knowledge scanned forms aur screenshots mein hai
↓
Ingestion par OCR (ya vision-language model) chalao
↓
OCR confidence record karo
↓
Kya confidence low hai?
HaanPage review ke liye bhejo
NahiAage index karo
↓
Page image rakho, charts ka LLM description store karo
↓
Scanned facts searchable, human check kar sakta hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

OCR scale pe slow aur costly hai; errors answers mein bhi aa jaati hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • OCR scanned images ko text mein badalta hai; vision models layouts aur screenshots bhi padh sakte hain.
  • Output ko clean up karo aur verify karo; handwriting aur low quality scans mein errors zyada hoti hain.
  • Text ko page references ke saath chunk aur index karo.
Aur gehra
  • Quality ke hisaab se route karo: pehle sasta OCR, mushkil pages ke liye vision model, critical ke liye human review.
  • Confidence scores store karo aur retrieval mein low-confidence text ko flag karo.
88

RAG kab use NAHI karna chahiye?

S69

Chhota jawab: RAG skip karo jab data chhota, static, structured ho, ya sirf tool, rule ya fine-tune chahiye.

Aasan shabdon mein

RAG hamesha zaroori nahi hai. Agar answer ek simple fact ya calculation hai, toh direct lookup use karo.

Aise samjhoYeh aisa hai jaise paas ki dukaan jaane ke liye train book karna. Kabhi paidal ya seedha raasta hi sahi hota hai.
Pehle yeh samjho'hathoda' wala muhavra: jiske paas sirf hathoda ho use har cheez keel dikhti hai. Interview line ka matlab: RAG har problem ka ilaaj nahi, sirf wahan lagao jahan jaankari bina structure ki ho aur badalti rehti ho.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Agar jawab saaf database mein hai to RAG ki jagah SQL (database se poochne ki bhasha) ya API use karo. Seedha aur exact jawab milta hai.
  2. Agar kaam style ya format ka hai, jaankari ka nahi, to behtar prompt ya fine-tuning kaafi hai. RAG naye facts laane ke liye hota hai.
  3. Agar jaankari chhoti aur fixed hai to use seedha prompt mein daal do. Search system banane ki zaroorat nahi.
  4. Agar exact calculation chahiye to tool (jaise calculator) use karo. RAG se hisaab nahi hota.
🔀 Flowchart: RAG kab use NAHI karna
Ek problem hai, kya RAG lagana hai?
↓
Kya answer clean database mein hai?
HaanSQL ya API use karo
NahiAage dekho
↓
Kya task style ya format ka hai, facts ka nahi?
HaanBetter prompt ya fine-tuning
NahiAage dekho
↓
Kya knowledge chhoti aur fixed hai, ya exact calculation chahiye?
HaanSeedha prompt mein daalo, ya tool use karo
NahiUnstructured, badalti knowledge
↓
RAG sirf wahan jahan knowledge unstructured aur badalti hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

RAG latency, cost aur failure points badhata hai; tabhi use karo jab faayda ho.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Chhota, stable knowledge seedha prompt mein ja sakta hai.
  • Structured questions SQL ya APIs ke liye theek hain.
  • Style ya behaviour changes fine-tuning ke liye hain, retrieval ke liye nahi.
Aur gehra
  • Knowledge size, change rate, citations ki zaroorat aur access control se decide karo; yeh jab high hon toh RAG ke favour mein hain.
  • Chhote corpora ke liye long-context prompting RAG ki jagah le sakti hai, par per-call token cost zyada hota hai.

Agents: Answer dene se Kaam karne tak

89

Agent decisions kaise leta hai, aur ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) kaise kaam karta hai?

Q137

Chhota jawab: ReAct Thought, Action, Observation ka loop chalata hai jab tak model final answer na de sake.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agent sochta hai, tool se kuch karta hai, result padhta hai, aur repeat karta hai, jaise captain field adjust karta rehta hai.

Aise samjhoYeh cricket mein captain jaisa hai: pehle sochta hai, phir field badalta hai, phir dekhta hai kya hua, aur phir agla step leta hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoReAct ka matlab hai pehle sochna (Thought), phir kaam karna (Action), phir result dekhna (Observation). Sirf sochte rehne se kuch nahi hota aur bina soche kaam karna random hota hai. Isme har step likha hua dikhta hai, isliye galti dhoondhna (debugging) aasan hota hai.
🔀 Flowchart: ReAct loop: Thought, Action, Observation
User: mera order kahan hai?
↓
Thought: mujhe order status chahiye
↓
Action: order-status tool call karo
↓
Observation: tool ka result padho
↓
Kya answer dene ke liye kaafi info hai?
HaanFinal answer do
NahiWapas Thought par jao
↓
Final answer, loop se nikla
Thought -> Action -> Observation
   ^                      |
   '----- repeat until done -----> Final answer
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Grounded aur flexible, lekin har loop latency aur cost badhata hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Thought: model reason karta hai ki kya chahiye.
  • Action: arguments ke saath tool call karta hai.
  • Observation: tool ka result context mein jodta hai; loop khatam hone tak chalta hai.
Aur gehra
  • Loops rokne ke liye max iteration count aur budget set karo; repeated identical actions detect karo.
  • Tool errors clear messages return karein taaki model recover kar sake.
90

Agent ko long-term memory kaise dete hain?

Q138

Chhota jawab: Long-term memory ka matlab hai facts ko context window ke bahar save karna, phir zaroorat par retrieve karna.

Aasan shabdon mein

Short-term memory tumhari desk hai, long-term memory filing cabinet. Agent important facts save karta hai aur baad mein dhoondhta hai.

Aise samjhoShort-term memory tumhari desk hai. Long-term memory tumhari filing cabinet hai.
Pehle yeh samjhosession matlab ek baar ki baatcheet. Naye session mein model ko pichla kuch yaad nahi hota, isliye zaroori baatein vector database mein save karke agle session mein prompt mein jod dete hain (inject). Override matlab nayi baat purani ko hata de.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Short-term memory matlab abhi ki baatcheet jo context window (model ek baar mein kitna padh sakta hai) mein hoti hai. Sliding window (sirf haal ki baatein rakhna) aur summary se use chhota rakho.
  2. Long-term memory mein zaroori facts vector database mein save hote hain. Agle session mein kaam ke facts nikaal kar prompt mein daal do, jaise purana customer yaad rakhna.
  3. Purane facts par expiry lagao, aur naye facts ko purano ko override karne do. Isse agent purani, badal chuki baatein nahi dohrata.
🔀 Flowchart: Agent ki long-term memory
Naya session, ShopBot ko purani baatein yaad rakhni hain
↓
Short-term: context window mein conversation, sliding window plus summary
↓
Important facts vector database mein store karo
↓
Agle session mein relevant facts retrieve karo aur prompt mein inject karo
↓
Kya naya fact purane se conflict karta hai?
HaanNaya override kare, purane par expiry
NahiRakh lo
↓
Agent ko user ki baatein yaad rehti hain
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Stale ya galat memories gumrah kar sakti hain; storage se privacy concerns badhte hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Summaries ya facts ko database ya vector store mein store karo.
  • Naye session ke shuru mein relevant memories retrieve karo.
  • Write policy decide karti hai ki kya save karne layak hai.
Aur gehra
  • Episodic, semantic aur profile memory ko alag retention rules ke saath alag rakho.
  • Users ko view, edit aur delete controls do; retention limits jaise privacy aur compliance rules lagao.
91

Agent dynamic API calling kaise karta hai?

Q139

Chhota jawab: Agent ko schemas ke saath described tools do; model ek chunta hai, tumhara code use validate aur execute karta hai.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agent doosre software se kaam karwata hai, jaise waiter order slip pass karta hai. Slip sahi format mein honi chahiye.

Aise samjhoYeh restaurant mein waiter jaisa hai jo tumhara order kitchen tak pahunchata hai. Woh sahi chit (format) deta hai, aur paisa ya chaabi menu par nahi likhta.
Pehle yeh samjhoagent ko har tool ka naam, kaam aur zaroori jaankari (parameters) padhne ko milti hai. Wo JSON mein likhta hai kaun sa tool kin values (arguments) ke saath chalana hai, aur tumhara code pehle jaanchta (validate) hai tab chalata hai. Write action wo kaam hai jo kuch badal deta hai, jaise order cancel karna. Credentials code ya surakshit jagah rakho, prompt mein nahi.
🔀 Flowchart: Agent dynamic API call kaise karta hai
Agent ko user ka kaam mila
↓
Har tool ka description padhta hai: name, purpose, parameters
↓
Model structured JSON deta hai: kaun sa tool, kaun se arguments
↓
Kya tumhare code ne call validate kar li?
HaanTool run karo
NahiReject karo aur error wapas bhejo
↓
Result model ko wapas jata hai
↓
Model agla step decide karta hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Zyada tools selection mushkil banate hain aur risk badhate hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Har tool ko naam, purpose aur JSON schema ke saath describe karo.
  • Model tool call output karta hai; tumhara code use chalata hai, model nahi.
  • Agle step ke liye results model ko wapas do.
Aur gehra
  • Arguments ko schema ke against validate karo aur authorisation code mein enforce karo; model-generated parameters par kabhi bharosa mat karo.
  • Least privilege, scoped credentials use karo aur secrets ko kabhi prompts mein mat daalo.
92

LLM agents ki main limitations kya hain?

Q141

Chhota jawab: Agents errors compound karte hain, hallucinate karte hain, context kho dete hain, zyada cost karte hain aur test karna mushkil hai; scope narrow rakho.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agents chhoti galtiyan karte hain jo kayi steps mein jud jaati hain, Chinese whispers ki tarah. ShopBot ek order number galat padh sakta hai aur phir galat order refund kar sakta hai.

Aise samjhoYeh chinese whispers khel jaisa hai: har step par thodi galti hoti hai aur aakhir tak baat bilkul badal jati hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoagent ek kaam mein kai chhote steps leta hai. Har step mein thodi galti ka chance hota hai, aur wo galti aage ke steps ko bhi kharab karti jaati hai. Isliye lambe kaam mein limits aur safety zaroori hain.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Hallucination ka matlab model ka confidently galat ya banaya hua jawab dena. Agent kai steps karta hai, to ek step ki galti agle steps mein badhti jaati hai (compound), jaise delivery mein pehla address galat ho to poori route galat ho jaata hai.
  2. Context limit matlab model ek baar mein sirf limited text yaad rakh sakta hai. Lambi baat mein purani cheezein bhool jaata hai, jaise dukaandaar ko purana hisaab yaad na rahe.
  3. Agent har kaam ke liye model ko kai baar call karta hai, isliye paisa zyada lagta hai aur jawab der se aata hai (latency). Ek sawal ke liye 20 baar phone karne jaisa hai.
  4. Tool use matlab agent ka search, calculator ya API jaise outside tools chalana. Kabhi wo galat tool chun leta hai ya galat input deta hai, isliye bharosa kam ho jaata hai.
  5. Prompt injection matlab koi attacker text mein chhupa ke agent ko galat order de deta hai, jaise nakli chitthi se guard ko darwaza kholne bol dena. Isse agent apne asli kaam ke khilaf chal sakta hai.
  6. State matlab agent abhi kahan tak pahuncha, kya ho chuka, kya baaki hai. Ise sahi se sambhalna mushkil hai, khaaskar jab kaam lamba ho ya beech mein ruk jaaye.
🔀 Flowchart: Agent ki limitations kahan se aati hain
Agent ko lamba multi-step task diya
↓
Har step mein model call: cost aur latency badhti hai
↓
Model kabhi hallucinate karta ya galat tool chunta hai
↓
Chhoti galti agle steps mein compound (badhti) jaati hai
↓
Context limit se purani baatein bhool jaata hai
↓
Isliye guardrails, limits aur security (prompt injection se bachav) zaroori
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Zyada guardrails aur checks safety badhate hain lekin latency aur cost jodte hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Errors compound hote hain: agar har step 95% sahi hai, to 10-step task sirf lagbhag 60% baar sahi hota hai.
  • Doosri limits: hallucination, limited context window, slow aur mehenge loops, prompt injection aur weak long-term planning.
  • Mitigate karo short plans, har step ke baad validation, risky actions ke liye human approval aur strict tool permissions se.
Aur gehra
  • Reliability ko per-step success rates ka product maano. Chains chhoti karo, checkpoints jodo aur jahan possible ho deterministic steps prefer karo.
  • Non-determinism se bugs reproduce karna mushkil hota hai. Full traces log karo, model versions pin karo aur failing runs replay karo.
93

Future mein agents kaun se breakthroughs achieve kar sakte hain?

Q143

Chhota jawab: Lambi memory, behtar planning, tool aur robot use, aur agent teams aayenge, lekin reliability hi asli gate hai.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agents mein shayad behtar memory aayegi, woh robots ke saath kaam karenge aur teams banayenge, jaise phones calls se camera tak pahunche. ShopBot kisi din poora return handle kar sakta hai, pickup samet.

Aise samjhoYeh mobile phone ke safar jaisa hai: pehle sirf call, phir camera, phir sab kuch. Agents bhi step by step aur powerful honge.
Pehle yeh samjhoaaj ke agents ko ek baatchit ke baad sab bhool jaata hai aur wo akele kaam karte hain. Future ki ummeed hai ki wo lambe time tak yaad rakhein, apne se behtar ho sakein aur teams mein kaam karein.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Persistent memory matlab agent ko mahino tak purani baatein yaad rahein, jaise purana dukaandaar jo har customer ki pasand jaanta hai.
  2. Agents sirf screen par nahi, robots ke through asli duniya mein cheezein uthaye, rakhe ya saaf kare.
  3. Alag alag kaam mein expert agents ki team milkar kaam karein, jaise hospital mein doctor, nurse aur pharmacist.
  4. Self-improving agent apni galtiyon se seekh kar khud behtar hota jaaye.
  5. Agent bahut saare steps wala kaam bahut jaldi, kam time mein nipta de.
🔀 Flowchart: Agents ke future breakthroughs
Aaj ke agents: short memory, ek akela, dheere
↓
Persistent memory: mahino tak yaad rakhna
↓
Specialised agents ki teams milke kaam karein
↓
Self-improving agents aur bahut tez multi-step runs
↓
Physical world mein kaam karne wale robots bhi
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Likely directions: persistent memory, stronger planning aur reasoning, computer use, robotics aur cooperating agent teams.
  • Tools aur agent-to-agent baat ke liye standard protocols se parts swap karna aasaan hoga.
  • Behtar verification aur evaluation tay karenge ki kaun se tasks bina human ke safely chal sakte hain.
  • Caveat: yeh trends hain, guarantees nahi. Predictions ko savdhani se lo.
Aur gehra
  • Change ke liye design karo: model, tools aur memory ko interfaces ke peeche rakho, taaki capabilities badhne par swap kar sako.
  • Autonomy trust se tez badhegi. Evals, audit logs aur permission systems mein invest karo, kyunki yeh har model generation mein kaam aate hain.
94

Reactive aur deliberative agent designs mein kya farq hai, aur kab kaunsa use karoge?

Q145

Chhota jawab: Reactive fixed rules par turant act karta hai; deliberative pehle plan karta hai. Task complexity aur latency needs ke hisaab se chuno.

Aasan shabdon mein

Reactive agent rule ke hisaab se turant jawab deta hai. Deliberative pehle sochta aur plan karta hai. ShopBot ka opening hours batana reactive hai; complex return plan karna deliberative hai.

Aise samjhoYeh cricket mein ek ball par turant shot khelne aur poori innings ki plan banane jaisa hai. Dono ki zarurat padti hai.
Pehle yeh samjhosimple sawal (jaise 'order kahan hai') ke liye turant rule kaafi hai. Mushkil kaam ke liye pehle plan chahiye. Interview mein seedha bolo: 'Asli systems mein dono ka mix hota hai. Aasan cases ke liye fast rules, mushkil cases ke liye planning.'
🔀 Flowchart: Reactive vs deliberative
ShopBot ko ek request mili
↓
Common aur simple case hai?
HaanReactive: fast rule se turant jawab
NahiDeliberative: pehle plan banao, phir kaam karo
↓
Reactive: tez lekin naye cases mein kamzor
↓
Deliberative: dheema lekin mushkil cases handle karta hai
↓
Real systems dono mix karte hain
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Planning quality world model par depend karti hai, jo stale ya galat ho sakta hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Reactive: input ko seedha action se map karta hai. Fast, cheap, predictable, lekin multi-step goals mein kamzor.
  • Deliberative: situation ka model banata hai, plan karta hai, phir act karta hai. Complex goals handle karta hai, lekin slow aur costly hai.
  • Hybrid designs simple ya urgent cases ke liye reactive layer aur hard cases ke liye planner use karte hain.
Aur gehra
  • Complexity ke hisaab se route karo: pehle cheap rules ya chhote models, planning par tabhi escalate karo jab zaroorat ho. Isse latency aur cost control mein rehte hain.
  • Deliberation naye failure modes laata hai: plan drift, over-thinking, aur purani state par bane plans. Step limits ke saath re-planning jodo.
95

"John ke saath 2 PM ki meeting schedule karo aur use Slack par notify karo." Agent Slack bhool jata hai. Aap kya karoge?

Q152

Chhota jawab: Poore task ko checklist ki tarah plan karo aur khatam karne se pehle har sub-goal verify karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agent ne meeting book kar di par Slack message bhool gaya, jaise shopping list ka sirf ek item khareed kar ghar chale jana. Done bolne se pehle use har item tick karna chahiye.

Aise samjhoYeh aisa hai jaise tum shopping list se sirf ek cheez khareed ke laut aao aur baaki bhool jao. Poori list tick karke hi ghar jana chahiye.
Pehle yeh samjhoagent ne ek tool chalaya (meeting book hui), aur use laga kaam poora. Fix: shuru mein hi poori request ko todo-list banao, aur 'done' kehne se pehle dekho ki list ke saare items tick hue ya nahi. Interview mein bolo: 'Main pehle saaf plan likhunga aur aakhri tool ke result par nahi, balki checklist dekh kar bolunga ki kaam poora hua.'
🔀 Flowchart: Slack bhoolne ka fix
Request: John ke saath 2 PM meeting + Slack notify
↓
Bug: meeting schedule hui, agent ne 'done' bol diya
↓
Request ko checklist mein todo: schedule, notify
↓
Har step ka status track karo
↓
Checklist ke sab items complete hain?
HaanAb 'done' bolo
NahiBacha hua step (Slack) karo
↓
Completion checklist se verify, last tool result se nahi
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Extra planning aur checking steps thodi latency badhate hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Cause: agent pehli successful tool call ke baad ruk gaya aur use done maan liya.
  • Fix: request ko sub-goals mein todo (meeting book karo, Slack par notify karo) aur har ek ko track karo.
  • Reply se pehle ek final check jodo jo results ko original request se compare kare.
Aur gehra
  • Plan ko explicit state banao, jaise checklist object, taaki completion code mein check ho aur model ke judgement par na chhoda jaye.
  • Ek completion verifier jodo, alag pass ya rule, jo confirm kare ki har zaroori side effect sach mein hua.
96

Agent hamesha loop mein fasa rehta hai: search karo, kuch nahi mila, phir search karo. Aap kya karoge?

Q154

Chhota jawab: Loops ko step limits, repeat detection, failure ke baad strategy change, aur clean exit se roko.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agent baar baar wahi cheez search karta hai aur kuch nahi milta, jaise ek hi block ke chakkar lagana. Hamein use rokna chahiye aur doosra tarika try karna chahiye, ya bolna chahiye ki nahi mila.

Aise samjhoJaise Google Maps mein galat gali mein ghus kar tum baar-baar wahi chakkar lagate ho. Ek limit tay karo ki 5 chakkar ke baad ruk ke rasta pucho.
Pehle yeh samjhoiteration matlab ek chakkar. Cap matlab upar ki hadd. Arguments matlab tool ko diye gaye inputs (jaise search ka text). Budget matlab itna time ya paisa hi kharch karne ki ijaazat.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Iteration cap matlab maximum steps tay kar do, jaise 5 se 10. Uske baad agent ruk jaaye, taaki wo hamesha na chalta rahe.
  2. Agar agent wahi tool wahi arguments (inputs) ke saath dobara chalaye, to samjho wo atka hai aur use rok do. Jaise wahi dukaan baar baar jaake wahi cheez maangna.
  3. Time aur paise ki limit lagao, jaise taxi ka meter ek hadd se upar na jaane de.
  4. Rukne par jo mila wo adhura jawab de do ya user se madad maango, khaali haath mat lautao.
🔀 Flowchart: Search loop se bahar nikalna
Agent ne search kiya, kuch nahi mila
↓
Wahi search dobara chala diya
↓
Same tool same arguments pehle bhi chale?
HaanDuplicate detect hua: ruk jao
NahiAgle step par badho
↓
Iteration cap ya time/cost budget khatam?
HaanRok do
NahiLoop jaari rakho
↓
Partial answer do ya user se pucho
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Tight limits runaway cost rokte hain, lekin un tasks ko kaat sakte hain jinhe zyada steps chahiye.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Max iteration count, token budget aur time limit set karo.
  • Repeats detect karo: same arguments ke saath same tool call block ya flag hona chahiye.
  • Failure ke baad strategy badlo: query rewrite karo, doosra tool try karo, ya user se poocho.
Aur gehra
  • Limits ko orchestrator code mein enforce karo, prompt mein nahi, kyunki model par bharosa nahi kar sakte ki woh khud ruk jayega.
  • 'Already tried' history ko context mein wapas feed karo taaki model dekh sake kya fail hua, aur alag approach maango.
97

"Team ke liye pizza order karo." Agent galat jagah se order kar deta hai. Aap kya karoge?

Q156

Chhota jawab: Memory me saved preference dekho, jo unclear ho to kisi bhi purchase se pehle ek chhota sawaal poochho, aur ensure karo ki order confirm, cancel ya fix ho sake.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agent ne pizza place guess kiya aur paise kharch kar diye. Behtar agent pichle orders dekhta hai, aur clear answer na mile to payment se pehle poochta hai, "Usual place, Domino's se order karun?" Agar galat order chala gaya ho, to use jaldi cancel ya refund karke user ko batana chahiye.

Aise samjhoEk samajhdar assistant boss se kehta hai: 'Sir, Mario's se 3 pizza, Rs 1,800, theek hai?' Sab kuch nahi puchta, bas paisa lagne se pehle ek baar confirm karta hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoagent ko har cheez nahi puchni chahiye, nahi to user pareshan hoga. Jahan paisa ya bada nuksaan (high stakes) ho wahi puchho. Interview mein bolo: 'Na bahut kam sawal, na bahut zyada. Jahan risk bada hai wahi puchho, baaki memory se yaad rakho.'
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Risk ke hisaab se kaam ko baanto. Paisa kharch hone wala kaam hai, to action se pehle user se poochho.
  2. Bahut saare sawal mat poochho, bas 2 se 3 sabse zaroori (jaise kitne log, kaunsi jagah, budget).
  3. Memory mein jo pasand pehle se saved hai (jaise favourite pizza place) use kaam mein lo.
  4. Propose and confirm matlab agent pehle poora plan bataye (kahan se, kitna, kitne ka) aur user ki haan ke baad hi order kare.
🔀 Flowchart: Pizza order mein clarification
Request: Team ke liye pizza order karo
↓
Paisa kharch hoga?
HaanRisk high: pehle pucho
NahiSeedha aage badho
↓
Memory se stored preferences uthao
↓
Sirf 2 se 3 sabse important sawaal pucho
↓
Propose karo: Mario's, 3 large pizzas, Rs 1,800
↓
Confirm milne par hi order
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Zyada sawaal user ko pareshan karte hain, isliye tabhi poochho jab choice unclear ya costly ho, aur low-risk steps par safe default se kaam karo.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Abhi fix: galat order cancel ya refund karo agar provider allow kare, aur user ko batao kya hua.
  • Roko: chunne se pehle memory dekho (pichle orders, team favourites, saved places).
  • Jo action paise kharch kare ya undo na ho sake, uske liye confirmation step lagao, jisme place, items aur price dikhe.
Aur gehra
  • Order placement ko high-risk tool maano: call chalne se pehle human approval lo (jaise LangGraph interrupt).
  • Tool ko spending limit aur idempotency key do, taaki retries se double orders na bane.
98

"London ki flight book karo" aur agent New York se book kar deta hai (default). Aap kya karoge?

Q160

Chhota jawab: Important parameters ko chupchap default mat karo; stored preferences use karo, confirm karo, aur assumptions batao.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agent ne New York se book kar diya kyunki use pata nahi tha aap kahan ho. Use aapki saved preference use karni chahiye ya poochna chahiye, jaise chaiwala jo aapka order jaanta hai.

Aise samjhoJaise tumhara regular chaiwala jaanta hai ki tum kam cheeni wali chai peete ho. Pehli baar pooch liya, ab har baar yaad rakhta hai.
Pehle yeh samjho'default' matlab jab user ne kuch bataya nahi to agent ka apni marzi ka chuna hua option. Ye bug hai kyunki user ke sheher ka andaza galat tha.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. User ki profile save karo, jaise ghar ka sheher, pasandida airline, seat. Phir agent default galat nahi lega.
  2. Jo pata nahi wo ek baar poochho, phir yaad rakho, baar baar pareshan mat karo.
  3. Paise dene (payment) se pehle user se confirm karwa lo, taaki galat booking na ho.
🔀 Flowchart: Galat default shehar ka fix
Request: London ki flight book karo
↓
Bug: agent ne default New York se book kar di
↓
User profile store karo: home city, airline, seat
↓
Profile mein ye detail pehle se hai?
HaanSeedha use karo
NahiEk baar pucho aur yaad rakho
↓
Pay karne se pehle confirm karo
↓
Sahi shehar se booking
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Confirmations ek step badhate hain, lekin galat booking ki cost kahin zyada hoti hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Cause: ek missing required parameter ko guess ya default se bhar diya gaya.
  • Fix: home airport ke liye user profile ya memory padho, aur agar nahi hai toh poocho.
  • Pay karne se pehle confirmation summary dikhao (from, to, date, price).
Aur gehra
  • Required parameters ko tool schema mein explicit banao, koi hidden defaults nahi, taaki missing values par sawal poocha jaye.
  • Preferences ek governed profile se aani chahiye jisme user control ho, aur unhe maan lene ki jagah wapas dikhana chahiye.
99

Tool #1 sahi tha lekin agent tool #3 chun leta hai. Debug kaise karoge?

Q162

Chhota jawab: Traces se tool choice debug karo: descriptions, overlap, prompt check karo, aur evals aur constraints jodo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agent ne galat tool uthaya, jaise helper screwdriver ki jagah spanner le aaye. Hum check karke pata lagate hain ki usne kya dekha aur kyun chuna.

Aise samjhoJaise tumne 'screwdriver' maanga aur helper 'spanner' le aaya kyunki dono ke label mein 'tightening' likha tha. Label saaf likho aur dekho helper ne kyun aisa socha.
Pehle yeh samjhomodel tool ko uske likhe hue description padhkar chunta hai. Agar do tools ke description milte-julte hon, to wo ulajh jaata hai. Isliye descriptions alag aur saaf likho, aur dekho model ne kya socha aur kyun galat chuna (log).
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Agar do tools ke description milte julte hain, to model confuse ho jaata hai. Descriptions ko alag aur saaf karo.
  2. Description mein tool kab use karna hai uske examples daalo, jaise dukaan ke board par likha ho kis cheez ke liye hai.
  3. Model ne kya socha aur kaunsa tool kyun chuna, ye log karo, taaki galti ki wajah dikh jaaye.
  4. Har tool ko alag alag sample sawalon ke saath test karo, taaki pata chale kaunsa tool kab galat chunta hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Galat tool chunne ka debug
Tool #1 sahi tha, agent ne tool #3 chun liya
↓
Model ki reasoning aur tool choice log karo
↓
Tool descriptions overlap karti hain?
HaanDescriptions alag aur saaf banao
NahiAur kaaran dhundo
↓
Descriptions mein usage examples add karo
↓
Har tool ko sample queries se alag test karo
↓
Sahi tool ka chunav
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Tool routing rules control badhate hain lekin flexibility kam karte hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Trace padho: prompt, tool list aur descriptions, aur model ka bataya hua reason.
  • Aam causes: vague ya overlapping descriptions, bahut zyada tools, aur misleading examples.
  • Descriptions ko sharp karke, har step ka tool set kam karke aur examples jodkar fix karo.
Aur gehra
  • Ek tool-selection eval set banao jisme har query ke liye expected tool ho, aur accuracy aur confusion pairs measure karo taaki dikhe kaun se tools takra rahe hain.
  • Choice space chhota karo: relevant tools dynamically retrieve karo, ya sub-agent se split karo taaki har ek ko kuch hi tools dikhein.
100

Agent banana chahiye ya deterministic workflow?

S16

Chhota jawab: Fixed steps ke liye deterministic workflow use karo; agent tabhi use karo jab path unpredictable ho.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agar steps hamesha same hain, jaise chai banana, to fixed recipe use karo, robot chef nahi. ShopBot ko order status check karne ke liye fixed flow chahiye.

Aise samjhoChai banane ke liye robot chef nahi chahiye, ek fixed recipe kaafi hai. Chef tab chahiye jab har din menu badalta ho.
Pehle yeh samjhoAgent ka matlab dekho (Observe, Reason, Act): result dekho, soch kar faisla karo, kaam karo, phir dobara dekho. Ye mehnga aur kam predictable hai. Workflow sasta aur test karne mein aasan hai. Interview mein bolo: 'Jahan steps fixed hon wahan workflow, aur jahan sach mein har baar naya faisla chahiye wahi agent.'
🔀 Flowchart: Agent ya workflow chunna
Naya ShopBot feature banana hai
↓
Steps pehle se fixed aur predictable hain?
HaanDeterministic workflow banao
NahiAage dekho
↓
Dynamic decision-making genuinely zaroori hai?
HaanAgent banao
NahiWorkflow hi kaafi hai
↓
Agent sirf isliye mat lo ki advanced lagta hai
↓
Jahan possible ho workflow, zaroorat par agent
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Agents flexible hain lekin slow, mehenge aur reliable banana mushkil.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Workflow: code mein predefined steps, predictable, sasta, fast aur test karne mein aasan.
  • Agent: model dynamically steps aur tools chunta hai; open-ended, variable tasks ke liye zaroori.
  • Sabse simple option se shuru karo aur autonomy tabhi add karo jab fixed rules fail hon.
Aur gehra
  • Default mein workflows rakho jisme specific nodes par LLM calls hon. Isse cost, latency aur testability bounded rehti hai.
  • Agents wahan use karo jahan steps ki ginti aur order sach mein badalte hain, step limits, budgets aur risky tools par approvals ke saath.
101

Agent infinite loop mein fas jata hai. Aap kya karoge?

S17

Chhota jawab: Infinite loops ko iteration caps, repeat detection, budgets aur graceful exit se roko.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agent wahi step hamesha repeat karta rehta hai, jaise Ludo ki goti ek jagah atki ho. Hum ek rule lagate hain: kuch tries ke baad ruk jao.

Aise samjhoYe Ludo ki us goti jaisa hai jo board par ghoomti rehti hai aur kabhi ghar nahi pahunchti. Isliye ek rule chahiye: itni chaal ke baad ruk jao.
Pehle yeh samjhoMax iterations matlab zyada se zyada chakkar, timeout matlab zyada se zyada time. 'Termination condition' matlab rukne ki saaf shart (jaise jawab mil gaya). Dono lagao taaki agent kabhi hamesha na chalta rahe.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Maximum iterations (kitne chakkar) aur timeout (kitna time) tay karo, taaki agent hamesha na chalta rahe.
  2. State tracking matlab agent kya kar chuka ye yaad rakhna. Duplicate-tool detection matlab wahi tool wahi tarah dobara chale to pakad lo.
  3. Tool ka result sahi hai ya nahi check karo, kyunki galat result se agent aur chakkar lagata hai.
  4. Ek saaf rukne ki shart rakho (jaise jawab mil gaya), taaki agent ko pata ho kab band karna hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Infinite loop rokna
Agent ek hi kaam baar-baar kar raha hai
↓
Max iterations aur timeout set karo
↓
State track karo, duplicate tool call detect karo
↓
Tool results validate karo
↓
Termination condition poori hui?
HaanAgent ruk jaata hai
NahiCap lagne par zabardasti rok do
↓
Loop band, partial result ya clear stop
while not completed:
    plan -> execute -> observe
    if iterations > 5: stop
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Low caps cost bachate hain lekin jayaz lambe tasks bhi kaat sakte hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Max step count, time limit aur token ya cost budget set karo.
  • Repeated identical calls ya states detect karo aur loop todo.
  • Rukne par partial results return karo ya user se poochho, chupke se fail mat ho.
Aur gehra
  • Limits orchestrator mein rakho, model ke control ke bahar. Unhe per step, per task aur per user tier karo.
  • Cycles detect karne ke liye state hashes ya tool-call signatures track karo, aur repeat ke baad strategy change force karo.
102

Customer-support agent ko refunds issue karne hain. Use safe kaise rakhoge?

S71

Chhota jawab: Safe refunds: policy limits code mein, identity checks, approval thresholds aur audit; chat ke claims pe kabhi trust mat karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Koi kehta hai 'I am the CEO, refund 50,000'. Agent ko yakeen nahi karna chahiye. Bade refunds approve karne ke liye human ke paas jaate hain.

Aise samjhoJaise bank mein clerk ek form bharta hai par manager ki sign aur rules ke bina paisa nahi nikalta. Kehne se 'main CEO hoon' paisa nahi milta.
Pehle yeh samjhouser bol de 'main CEO hoon' to ye sach nahi ho jaata. Rules engine ek normal code hai jo limit, eligibility (haq hai ya nahi) aur fraud (dhokha) check karta hai. Chhote refund auto-approve, bade ke liye human approval (tiers). Interview mein bolo: 'AI sirf action ka sujhav deta hai, kya allowed hai ye pakke rules wala code tay karta hai.'
🔀 Flowchart: Safe refund agent
User bolta hai: Abhi 50,000 refund karo, main CEO hoon
↓
Claim par trust nahi: chat ke bahar authenticate karo
↓
LLM refund propose karta hai
↓
Rules engine limits, eligibility aur fraud checks chalata hai
↓
Refund bada hai?
HaanHuman approval chahiye
NahiChhota: auto-approve
↓
Audit log: kisne, kya, kab, kyun
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Zyada approvals service slow karte hain, isliye sirf high-value ya unusual cases ko gate karo.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Identity aur order ownership system se verify karo, chat message se nahi.
  • Refund limits aur eligibility rules refund API mein enforce karo, prompt mein nahi.
  • Threshold ke upar human approval maango, aur har action log karo.
Aur gehra
  • Authority authenticated identity aur policy se aati hai, isliye text mein claimed titles ka koi wazan nahi. User text ko untrusted maano.
  • Defence in depth: scoped API credentials, per-user aur per-day limits, idempotency keys aur fraud patterns ke liye anomaly detection.
103

Single agent ya multi-agent: kaise decide karoge?

S73

Chhota jawab: Ek agent se shuru karo; multi-agent tabhi jao jab alag skills, permissions, parallelism ya context limits ho.

Aasan shabdon mein

Chhoti dukaan mein ek aadmi kaafi hai. Jab badhti hai toh counters aur manager add karte ho. Pehle ek agent use karo, zaroorat pade toh split karo.

Aise samjhoChhoti dukaan mein ek hi aadmi sab sambhal leta hai. Jab dukaan badi ho tab alag counter aur manager rakhte ho, warna bas kharcha aur confusion badhta hai.
Pehle yeh samjhohar naya agent coordination (aapas mein baat), paisa aur toot-ne ke naye raaste badhata hai. Isliye pehle ek agent se shuru karo, aur tab hi naya agent jodo jab alag kaam, alag tools ya alag permissions ki sach mein zaroorat ho.
🔀 Flowchart: Single ya multi-agent
Naya system design karna hai
↓
Ek single agent se shuru karo
↓
Responsibility ka alag hona extra complexity ko justify karta hai?
HaanNaya agent add karo
NahiSingle agent hi rakho
↓
Har naya agent coordination aur cost badhata hai
↓
Agents tab, jab separation ka fayda saaf ho
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Multi-agent cost, latency aur coordination failures badhata hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Single agent simpler, sasta aur debug karne mein aasan hai. Pehle yahi try karo.
  • Multi-agent tab jao jab tasks ko alag tools ya permissions chahiye, parallel kaam ho, ya context bahut bada ho jaye.
  • Confusion se bachne ke liye roles aur ek coordinator define karo.
Aur gehra
  • Strong single-agent baseline benchmark karo. Multi-agent tabhi lo jab metrics itne improve hon ki added complexity cover ho jaye.
  • Valid reasons: security isolation, specialised prompts aur tools, parallel speedup, independent evaluation.

Frameworks: AI Apps ke liye LEGO Sets

104

LangChain ke core components kya hain? Yeh perception, memory, planning aur tool use ko kaise support karta hai?

Q167

Chhota jawab: LangChain mein models, prompts, retrievers, tools aur agents ke parts hain; loaders aur retrievers perception sambhalte hain, LangGraph state aur checkpoints memory sambhalte hain, agent loop planning karta hai aur tools action lete hain.

Aasan shabdon mein

LangChain ready-made parts ka ek box hai, LEGO ki tarah, AI apps banane ke liye. ShopBot customer ka message aur documents padhta hai (perception), chat yaad rakhta hai (memory), agent agla step tay karta hai (planning) aur order-search tool call karta hai (tool use).

Aise samjhoJaise LEGO ka box jisme alag-alag blocks hain. Har block ka ek kaam hai aur unhe jodkar tum apna AI robot banate ho.
Pehle yeh samjho'Perception' matlab agent ko input samajhna, 'planning' matlab soch kar steps banana. LangChain ke parts (model, memory, tools, chains) in sab kaam mein madad karte hain.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Models matlab LLMs (text samajhne wale) aur chat models. Prompt template ek bhara-hua-form jaisa hai jisme sirf naye blanks bharne hote hain.
  2. Chain matlab kai steps jo ek ke baad ek jode hote hain, jaise assembly line.
  3. Memory baatchit ki purani baatein yaad rakhti hai, taaki agent context na bhoole.
  4. Tools (search, calculator jaise) kaam karte hain aur agent decide karta hai kaunsa tool kab chalana hai.
  5. Document loader files padhta hai, splitter unhe chhote tukdon mein baantta hai, vector store un tukdon ko meaning ke hisaab se store karta hai taaki zaroorat par sahi tukda dhoondha ja sake (retrieval).
🔀 Flowchart: LangChain ke components
ShopBot banana hai
↓
Models aur prompt templates (dimaag aur sawaal)
↓
Chains: steps order mein jude hue
↓
Memory: conversation state yaad rakhti hai
↓
Tools aur agents: actions aur decisions
↓
Document loaders, splitters, vector stores se retrieval
Trade-off

Abstraction layers behaviour chhupa dete hain aur APIs badalti rehti hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Core parts: models, prompt templates, output parsers, document loaders, retrievers aur vector stores, tools, aur agents (current versions mein LangGraph par bane).
  • Perception matlab input handling: loaders, retrievers aur multimodal inputs. Planning woh agent loop hai jahan model agla step chunta hai.
  • Memory: short-term memory woh conversation state hai jo LangGraph checkpointer save karta hai; long-term memory ek store hai. Purani memory classes deprecated hain. Tool use matlab function calling.
Aur gehra
  • Ise integration layer samjho: prompts, evals aur business logic apne paas rakho, connectors aur plumbing ke liye use karo.
  • Current LangChain agents LangGraph runtime par chalte hain, jo loose agent loops ki jagah state, persistence aur human-in-the-loop deta hai.
105

LangChain agents ke main types kaun se hain?

Q168

Chhota jawab: Classic LangChain agent types hain ReAct (zero-shot), conversational, tool-calling, plan-and-execute aur structured-chat; aaj LangGraph par tool-calling agents standard hain aur baaki legacy hain.

Aasan shabdon mein

LangChain mein agents ke sochne aur tool chunne ke alag tareeke the, jaise driver jo map follow kare, poora route plan kare, ya andaze se chale. Aaj ka default tool-calling agent hai: model structured arguments ke saath tool chunta hai, code use chalata hai, aur loop dohrata hai. Purane types purane code ke liye rakhe gaye hain.

Aise samjhoJaise alag-alag tarah ke driver: koi map dekh kar chalata hai, koi pehle poora route plan karta hai, koi bas phone se instructions leta hai. Kaam ek, style alag.
Pehle yeh samjho'Zero-shot' matlab bina example diye seedha kaam. Multi-input tool matlab jisme ek se zyada cheezein bhejni padti hain (jaise sheher, date, seat). Naya LangChain advice hai ki agents LangGraph se banao, par classic types ka concept interview mein aata hai.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. ReAct / zero-shot agent bina examples ke tools ke descriptions padhkar soch kar tool chunta hai.
  2. Conversational agent mein chat memory judi hoti hai, to wo pichli baatein yaad rakhta hai.
  3. Tool-calling agent mein model saaf format (structured) mein bata deta hai kaunsa tool kaunse inputs ke saath chalana hai. Isliye ye sabse bharosemand hai.
  4. Plan-and-execute mein pehle poora plan banta hai, phir steps ek ek karke chalte hain, jaise yatra ka itinerary pehle banana.
  5. Structured chat un tools ke liye hai jinhe ek se zyada inputs chahiye, jaise flight search mein city, date aur seat.
🔀 Flowchart: LangChain agent type chunna
Agent ka type chunna hai
↓
Tool calls reliable chahiye?
HaanTool-calling agent (structured calls, sabse reliable)
NahiAage dekho
↓
Pehle plan, phir run?
HaanPlan-and-execute
NahiAage dekho
↓
Chat memory chahiye?
HaanConversational agent
NahiReAct ya structured chat (multi-input tools)
↓
Zarurat ke hisaab se agent type
Trade-off

Dynamic loops flexible hain lekin mehnge; plans efficient hain lekin purane ho sakte hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • ReAct: text reasoning se think, act, observe ka loop. Purana aur kamzor, kyunki free text parse karna mushkil hai.
  • Tool-calling agents model ki native function calling use karte hain aur current default hain (create_agent, LangGraph par bana).
  • Plan-and-execute pehle poora plan banata hai, phir steps chalata hai, lambe tasks ke liye achha. Conversational aur structured-chat purane styles hain chat memory aur multi-input tools ke liye.
Aur gehra
  • Reliability ke liye free-text ReAct parse karne ki jagah schemas ke saath native tool-calling prefer karo.
  • Purane AgentType aur AgentExecutor styles legacy hain; current guidance tool-calling agent ya control ke liye explicit LangGraph graph hai. Current docs check karo.
106

LlamaIndex LangChain ke saath kaise integrate hota hai?

Q169

Chhota jawab: LlamaIndex query engine ko LangChain tool ki tarah wrap karo, taaki agent document questions ke liye use call kare.

Aasan shabdon mein

LlamaIndex searchable catalogue banata hai, aur LangChain agent librarian hai jo decide karta hai ki cheezein kab dekhni hain.

Aise samjhoLlamaIndex ek library ki card-catalogue jaisa hai aur LangChain ka agent librarian. Librarian jab zarurat ho tab catalogue se kitaab nikalwa leta hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoLlamaIndex documents ka searchable index banata hai, aur LangChain agent faisla leta hai ki kab search karna hai. 'Wrap' matlab LlamaIndex ke search ko ek tool ka roop dena taaki agent use chala sake. Query engine woh hissa hai jo sawaal leke jawab nikalta hai.
🔀 Flowchart: LlamaIndex + LangChain
Company documents hain jinse jawab chahiye
↓
LlamaIndex unka searchable index banata hai
↓
Uske query engine ko LangChain tool mein wrap karo
↓
Agent ko tool ka description do
↓
Sawaal documents se related hai?
HaanAgent tool call karta hai
NahiAgent seedha jawab deta hai
↓
Agent khud decide karta hai kab index use karna hai
LangChain agent -> Tool: "search_company_docs"
                        |
                  LlamaIndex query engine -> Index of documents
Trade-off

Do frameworks matlab zyada dependencies aur maintain karne ke liye do sets of abstractions.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • LlamaIndex aapke documents ingest, chunk aur index karta hai aur ek query engine deta hai.
  • Us engine ko clear name aur description ke saath tool ki tarah wrap karo.
  • LangChain agent decide karta hai ki use kab call karna hai, doosre tools ke beech.
Aur gehra
  • Tool description routing quality decide karti hai. Corpus describe karo aur bataao kab use karna hai, taaki unnecessary retrieval na ho.
  • Retrieval layer ko alag se evaluate karo: recall, precision aur answers ki faithfulness.
107

LlamaIndex agents ko external data access, structure aur retrieve karne mein kaise help karta hai?

Q170

Chhota jawab: LlamaIndex data load karta hai, use indexes mein structure karta hai, aur query engines aur retrievers se retrieve karta hai.

Aasan shabdon mein

LlamaIndex agent ko aapki files tak pahunchata hai aur unhe organised rakhta hai taaki sahi page mil jaye, jaise achhe se saji library.

Aise samjhoJaise ek achhi library jisme sab kitabein subject ke hisaab se rakhi hon aur ek index card ho. Librarian turant sahi page tak pahunch jata hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoLlamaIndex documents ko chhote tukdon (nodes) mein todta hai aur unka index banata hai. Sawal aane par query engine sahi nodes dhoondh kar un se jawab banata (synthesise) hai. Vector index meaning se, keyword index shabdon se, summary index saar se dhoondhta hai.
🔀 Flowchart: LlamaIndex ka data pipeline
Data: files, databases, APIs
↓
Load: sab data andar lao
↓
Chunk: nodes mein todo
↓
Index: vector, keyword, summary ya graph index
↓
Query engine relevant nodes retrieve karta hai
↓
Answer synthesise karke agent ko milta hai
Trade-off

Chunking aur index choices quality ko bahut affect karte hain aur tuning maangte hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Data connectors PDFs, databases aur APIs ko documents mein load karte hain.
  • Woh unhe nodes (chunks) mein split karta hai, metadata jodta hai aur vector, keyword ya tree jaise indexes banata hai.
  • Retrievers aur query engines relevant pieces fetch karte hain aur answers synthesise karte hain.
Aur gehra
  • Quality chunking, metadata aur reranking ke saath hybrid retrieval par depend karti hai. Retrieval ko generation se alag evaluate karo.
  • Ingestion pipelines plan karo: incremental updates, deduplication aur embedding models badalne par re-indexing.
108

AutoGPT autonomous decision-making kaise achieve karta hai?

Q171

Chhota jawab: AutoGPT loops: goal set karo, subtasks mein todo, tools se act karo, critique karo, repeat karo, memory ke saath.

Aasan shabdon mein

Aap goal dete ho aur woh to-do list banata hai, tasks karta hai aur apna kaam khud check karta hai, jaise intern jo event organise kar raha ho.

Aise samjhoJaise ek intern ko bol do 'event organise karo' aur wo khud list banata hai, phone karta hai, aur apna kaam check karta hai. Par kabhi wo bhatak bhi jata hai aur bill bhi bada bana deta hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoautonomous matlab khud faisle leke kaam karna. AutoGPT bade goal ko chhote kaam (subtasks) mein todta hai, tools chalata hai, aur apna kaam khud check karta hai. Drift matlab agent ka goal se bhatak jana.
🔀 Flowchart: AutoGPT ka loop
User ek goal deta hai
↓
Subtasks banata hai
↓
Tools use karke kaam karta hai
↓
Apne kaam ko khud critique karta hai
↓
Goal poora hua?
HaanRoko aur result do
NahiLoop dobara chalao
↓
Goal autonomous tarike se poora
Trade-off

Loop mein phans sakta hai, drift kar sakta hai aur cost jala sakta hai, isliye production ke liye reliability limited hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Goal milne par LLM agle actions propose karta hai, search ya file writes jaise tools chalata hai, aur results observe karta hai.
  • Woh progress ki memory rakhta hai aur agla step chunne se pehle khud ko critique karta hai.
  • Autonomy ideas explore karne aur open-ended tasks ke liye achha.
Aur gehra
  • Full autonomy mein guardrails nahi hote. Production use mein budgets, step caps, sandboxed tools aur risky actions par human approval chahiye.
  • Failure modes: goal drift, repeated actions, hallucinated progress aur runaway spend.
109

BabyAGI task management kaise karta hai?

Q172

Chhota jawab: BabyAGI loops: ek task execute karo, result se naye tasks banao, queue ko reprioritise karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Woh ek task chalata hai, jo seekha usse naye tasks likhta hai, aur list ko order mein rakhta hai, jaise chef jo orders sambhalta hai.

Aise samjhoJaise kitchen mein ek chef: order bana raha hai, uske baad naye orders likhta hai aur sabse zaroori pehle rakhta hai. Ye teeno kaam ek loop mein chalte hain.
Pehle yeh samjhoQueue matlab kaam ki line. Re-prioritise matlab sabse zaroori kaam ko aage rakhna. Interview mein bolo: 'BabyAGI koi product se zyada ek idea hai jo dikhata hai ki kaam ki line banakar loop mein kaise chalate hain.'
🔀 Flowchart: BabyAGI task queue
Ek goal aur pehla task queue mein
↓
Execute: sabse upar wala task chalao
↓
Create: result se naye tasks banao
↓
Re-prioritise: queue ko dobara order karo
↓
Queue mein tasks bache hain?
HaanLoop dobara chalao
NahiRoko
↓
Task-queue pattern ka concept
Task queue -> Execute top task -> Create new tasks
     ^                                 |
     '------ Re-prioritise <-----------'
Trade-off

Queue bina ant ke badh sakti hai aur objective se drift kar sakti hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Teen roles: execution agent, task creation agent aur prioritisation agent.
  • Results ek vector memory mein store hote hain taaki baad ke tasks context use kar sakein.
  • Loop tab tak chalta hai jab tak queue khali na ho jaye ya limit na lag jaye.
Aur gehra
  • Stop condition aur queue cap chahiye, warna task creation completion se tez badhta hai.
  • LLM se prioritisation noisy hoti hai. Objective ke against scoring aur duplicates hatane par vichar karo.
110

CrewAI multiple agents ke beech collaboration kaise manage karta hai?

Q173

Chhota jawab: CrewAI: role, goal aur backstory wale agents, assigned tasks, jo ek crew process ke saath chalati hai.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agents film crew ki tarah kaam karte hain, har ek ka role aur goal, aur crew unhe saath mein chalati hai. ShopBot mein ek researcher aur ek writer ho sakte hain.

Aise samjhoJaise film ki unit: director, writer, cameraman, sabka alag role hai aur sab milkar ek film banate hain. Crew wo poori unit hai.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Har agent ko ek role (naukri), goal (lakshya) aur backstory (pehchaan) milti hai, jaise team mein har banda alag kaam ka expert.
  2. Har task ka description (kya karna hai) aur expected output (kya milna chahiye) hota hai.
  3. Crew agents ki poori team hai. Wo tasks ko ek process se chalati hai: sequential (ek ke baad ek) ya hierarchical (manager baant-ta hai).
🔀 Flowchart: CrewAI ki teen cheezein
Ek bada kaam, kai agents
↓
Agent: role, goal aur backstory
↓
Task: description aur expected output
↓
Crew tasks ko ek process se chalati hai
↓
Manager se delegation chahiye?
HaanHierarchical process
NahiSequential process
↓
Agents milke tasks poore karte hain
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Setup aasaan hai, lekin low-level control kam aur simple pipeline se zyada LLM calls.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Agents ko role, goal, backstory aur tools se define karo.
  • Tasks ko descriptions aur expected outputs se define karo, aur unhe agents ko assign karo.
  • Ek crew unhe process ke saath chalati hai: sequential ya manager ke saath hierarchical.
Aur gehra
  • Role prompts madad karte hain, lekin quality ke liye clear task outputs aur tasks ke beech context passing zyada matter karti hai.
  • Cost agents aur delegation ke saath badhti hai. Iteration limits set karo aur simple roles ke liye cheaper models use karo.
111

LangChain API calling ko kaise support karta hai?

Q175

Chhota jawab: LangChain functions aur API specs ko schemas ke saath tools ki tarah wrap karta hai, taaki model unhe call kar sake.

Aasan shabdon mein

Yeh ek function ko aisa tool bana deta hai jise agent tap kar sake, jaise phone par app icon. ShopBot is tarah order-status API call kar sakta hai.

Aise samjhoJaise phone mein apps ke icons: tum bas icon dabate ho aur andar ka kaam app sambhalta hai. LangChain bhi function ko ek button jaisa bana deta hai jo agent daba sakta hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoPython ek programming language hai. Function matlab code ka ek chhota kaam. LangChain mein function par ek tag (decorator) lagate hi wo agent ka tool ban jaata hai. Schema tay karta hai ki function ko kaunse inputs milenge.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Decorator ek chhota sa tag hai. Python function par laga do to wo agent ke liye tool ban jaata hai.
  2. Toolkit ready-made tools ka packet hai, jaise Gmail ya SQL database ke liye, apne aap banane ki zaroorat nahi.
  3. OpenAPI spec kisi API ka likha hua manual hai. Isse tools apne aap ban jaate hain.
  4. Typed schema har input ka type tay karta hai (jaise number ya text), to galat input pakda jaata hai.
🔀 Flowchart: LangChain mein API calling
Agent ko ek API call karni hai (jaise order status)
↓
Python function par tool decorator lagao
↓
Ya OpenAPI spec se tool generate karo
↓
Typed schema arguments validate karta hai
↓
Model tool chunta hai aur arguments deta hai
↓
API call chalke result agent ko milta hai
Trade-off

Bahut saare tools model ko confuse karte hain, aur descriptions ki quality bahut matter karti hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
