  • Function ya OpenAPI spec se ek tool ko name, description aur argument schema ke saath define karo.
  • Model ek tool call return karta hai, aur LangChain use chalakar result wapas pass karta hai.
  • Error handling, retries aur output parsing jodo.
Aur gehra
  • Schemas aur descriptions hi asli interface hain. Arguments validate karo, aur errors ko aise form mein handle karo jispar model act kar sake.
  • API calls secure karo: prompt ke bahar rakhe scoped credentials, allow-lists, timeouts aur rate limits.
112

n8n agents ko real world se kaise connect karta hai?

Q180

Chhota jawab: n8n triggers, AI nodes, logic aur action nodes ko visually apps aur APIs se low code mein jodta hai.

Aasan shabdon mein

Yeh switches ki visual chain hai: kuch hota hai, AI decide karta hai, aur ek app kaam karti hai. Heavy coding ki zaroorat nahi.

Aise samjhoJaise ghar mein chain reaction wali switches: darwaza khula to light jali, light jali to AC chala. n8n mein bhi ek cheez doosri ko trigger karti hai aur tum bas drag-drop se jodte ho.
Pehle yeh samjhon8n mein tum boxes (nodes) ko jodte ho. Trigger woh box hai jo workflow shuru karta hai (jaise koi webhook aaya ya tay time ho gaya). AI node model se kaam karwata hai, logic node condition dekhta hai, action node kisi app mein kaam karta hai (jaise email bhejna).
🔀 Flowchart: n8n workflow
Trigger: webhook ya schedule
↓
AI node model se sochwata hai
↓
Logic node: condition poori hui?
HaanAction node: app ya API call karo
NahiDoosri branch ya stop
↓
Result agle app ko bhejo
↓
Kam ya bina code ke real world se connection
Trade-off

Complex logic visually maintain karna mushkil ho jata hai, aur testing code se zyada mushkil hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Triggers flows shuru karte hain: webhooks, schedules ya app events.
  • AI nodes models ya agents call karte hain, logic nodes branch karte hain, aur action nodes apps aur APIs call karte hain.
  • Agents ko email, Slack, CRMs aur databases se jaldi jodne ke liye badhiya.
Aur gehra
  • Credentials ko centrally least privilege ke saath manage karo, aur dev aur prod workflows ko version control ke saath alag rakho.
  • Error workflows, retries aur idempotency jodo, kyunki webhooks duplicate ho sakte hain.
113

Normal LangChain chain ki jagah LangGraph kyun?

S21

Chhota jawab: Seedhi pipelines ke liye plain chain use karo; jab state, branches, loops, retries aur human approval chahiye tab LangGraph use karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Chain A se B tak seedhi train ki patri hai. LangGraph ek junction hai jahan ShopBot route badal sakta hai, ruk sakta hai aur wapas aa sakta hai.

Aise samjhoChain ek seedhi line wali train hai jo A se B tak jaati hai. LangGraph ek railway junction hai jahan raste badal sakte hain, train ruk sakti hai aur wapas bhi aa sakti hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoLangChain ek toolkit hai jisme steps ko ek line mein jodte hain (chain). LangGraph mein steps ko dabbon aur teeron ke naksha (graph) ki tarah jodte hain, isliye beech mein raasta badalna, ruk kar wapas aana aur progress save karna aasaan hota hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Chain ya LangGraph chunna
ShopBot ka agent banana hai
↓
Kya bas simple sequential pipeline hai (step 1, 2, 3)?
Haannormal LangChain chain kaafi hai
Nahistate, branching, loops ya retries chahiye
↓
Kya checkpoints, human approval ya persistence (save) chahiye?
HaanLangGraph (graph-based execution) lo
Nahichain hi theek hai
↓
Simple kaam ke liye chain, complex agent ke liye LangGraph
            START
              |
           Planner
          /       \
      Search       Tool
          \       /
          Validator
              |
             END
Trade-off

Zyada concepts aur setup; simple pipeline ke liye ise use mat karo.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Chain steps ko ek fixed line mein chalati hai. Simple sequential kaam ke liye theek hai, jaise prompt, model, parse.
  • LangGraph steps ko ek graph ki tarah model karta hai jisme shared state hoti hai, to tum branch, loop aur retry kar sakte ho.
  • Ye checkpoints (saved progress) aur human approval pauses support karta hai, jo lambe agents ko chahiye.
Aur gehra
  • Control-flow needs ke hisaab se chuno: cycles, conditional routing, durable pauses, ya failure ke baad resume. Warna chain maintain karna sasta hai.
  • Checkpointing replay aur debugging deti hai, lekin state serialisable aur versioned honi chahiye warna deploy ke baad resume toot jaata hai.
114

Tumhari team LangChain vs plain Python par debate kar rahi hai. Tum kya recommend karoge?

S75

Chhota jawab: Plain Python se shuru karo; framework tabhi lo jab woh seekhne aur maintain karne ke cost se zyada time bachaye.

Aasan shabdon mein

Ghar pe chai ke liye pateela aur chulha kaafi hai. Badi coffee machine tab kharidte ho jab bahut log aate hain. ShopBot ke liye simple code se shuru karo.

Aise samjhoGhar par chai banani ho toh seedha patila aur gas kaafi hai. Full automatic coffee machine tab kharidte hain jab roz 50 log aate hon.
Pehle yeh samjhoframework ready-made toolkit hai, plain Python matlab bina toolkit ke seedha apna code. Interview mein bolo: 'Pehle sabse simple raasta lunga. Framework tab lunga jab wo itna time bachaye jitna use seekhne aur sambhalne mein lagta hai.'
🔀 Flowchart: LangChain ya plain Python
Team debate kar rahi hai: LangChain ya plain Python
↓
Sabse simple cheez se start karo jo kaam kare
↓
Kya framework ke features time zyada bachayenge?
Haantab framework adopt karo
Nahiplain Python hi rakho
↓
Framework tab, jab bachat uski abstraction cost se zyada ho
Trade-off

Frameworks tezi se badalte hain aur behaviour chhupa sakte hain; plain code mein tumhe zyada maintain karna padta hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Plain Python direct hai, debug karna aasan hai aur dependencies kam hain.
  • Framework ready parts deta hai (connectors, memory, graphs) jo needs badhne par time bachate hain.
  • Need se decide karo: agar tum uske sirf kuch features use karte ho, toh framework overhead hai.
Aur gehra
  • Plain code mein prototype banao, phir requirements justify karein toh specific pieces (jaise orchestration) ke liye framework lo.
  • Lock-in, version churn aur abstractions ke through debugging ka dhyan rakho; framework calls ko apne interface ke peeche wrap karo.

MCP: Tools ke liye ek Universal Plug

115

MCP aur vendor function calling ka aapas mein kya relation hai?

Q193

Chhota jawab: Function calling yeh hai ki ek model tools kaise maangta hai; MCP standardise karta hai ki tools vendors ke across kaise package aur discover hote hain.

Aasan shabdon mein

Function calling ek helper se ek kaam karwana hai. MCP woh standard socket hai jisme koi bhi charger fit ho. ShopBot dono saath use karta hai.

Aise samjhoFunction calling ek phone call jaisa hai jisme aap ek bande se kaam karwate ho. MCP woh standard socket hai jisme koi bhi charger lag jaata hai.
Pehle yeh samjhofunction calling matlab model ko bataya jaata hai ki ye tools hain aur wo kisi ko chalane ko bolta hai. MCP wo tools ko alag programs (servers) mein rakhne aur sabke liye ek jaise tareeke se dhoondhne ka standard hai, jaise tool ka ek common packing aur catalog.
🔀 Flowchart: MCP aur function calling
Model ko tools use karne hain
↓
Function calling: ek request mein model tools declare aur call karta hai
↓
MCP upar baithta hai: tools alag servers mein rehte hain
↓
Tools ek baar discover hote hain, alag vendors ke saath chalte hain
↓
MCP function calling replace nahi karta, bas packaging standardise karta hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

MCP ek process boundary aur setup jodta hai; do tools wali ek app ke liye yeh overkill ho sakta hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Function calling: ek request mein aap tools declare karte ho aur model ek ko chalane ke liye kehta hai.
  • MCP tools ko alag servers mein rakhta hai aur clients ko unhe ek hi tarah discover karne deta hai.
  • Woh saath kaam karte hain: MCP tool list deta hai, aur model ki function calling call karne ka decide karti hai.
Aur gehra
  • MCP function calling ko replace nahi karta; client MCP tool definitions ko har vendor ke tool format mein translate karta hai.
  • Fayda vendors ke across portability aur apps ke across reuse hai; cost ek extra hop aur server operation hai.
116

Ek MCP server kya-kya expose kar sakta hai?

Q195

Chhota jawab: Ek server tools (actions), resources (readable data) aur prompts (templates) expose kar sakta hai.

Aasan shabdon mein

Library counter ki tarah: padhne ke liye kitaabein, kaam karne ke liye forms, aur sample letters. Ek MCP server AI ko tools, data aur templates offer karta hai.

Aise samjhoServer ek library counter jaisa hai: yahan se kitaabein padhne ko milti hain, kaam ke forms bharne ko milte hain, aur sample letters bhi mil jaate hain.
🔀 Flowchart: MCP server kya expose karta hai
Ek MCP server client se jud gaya
↓
Server teen cheezein expose kar sakta hai
↓
Tools: kaam karne wale functions (action)
↓
Resources: padhne layak data (files, records)
↓
Prompts: server mein stored templates
↓
Client in teeno ko discover karke use karta hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Tools woh functions hain jo kaam karte hain aur cheezein badal sakte hain.
  • Resources read-only data hain jo URI se identify hote hain, jaise files ya records.
  • Prompts server par rakhe reusable templates hain.
  • Client connection time par sab discover karta hai. Trade-off: zyada exposed items matlab zyada secure karne ko.
Aur gehra
  • Primitive ko control se chuno: tools model-controlled hain, resources aam taur par app-controlled, prompts user-controlled.
  • Exposed surface chhota rakho; har tool description prompt tokens bhi kharch karti hai aur injection risk badhati hai.
117

MCP REST ya gRPC se kaise alag hai?

Q196

Chhota jawab: REST aur gRPC hard-coded developer calls ke liye fit hain; MCP AI ko tools discover karne, descriptions padhne aur JSON-RPC par session rakhne deta hai.

Aasan shabdon mein

REST ek fixed menu hai jo waiter pehle se jaanta hai. MCP andar jakar menu khud padhna aur order karna hai. ShopBot apne tools khud dhundh leta hai.

Aise samjhoREST ya gRPC ek fixed menu card jaisa hai jo waiter ko pehle se pata hota hai. MCP aisa hai jaise aap naye restaurant mein jaake menu khud padho aur phir order do.
Pehle yeh samjhopurane tareeke mein programmer khud likh deta hai ki kaun si call karni hai. MCP mein AI khud server se poochta hai ki tumhare paas kaun se tools hain aur unka matlab padhkar khud chunta hai.
🔀 Flowchart: MCP vs REST ya gRPC
Kisi system se baat karni hai
↓
Kya developer calls pehle se hard-code karta hai?
HaanREST ya gRPC, zyadatar stateless
NahiAI ko tools khud dhundne hain, MCP lo
↓
MCP mein AI tools discover karta hai aur descriptions padhta hai
↓
Session context rakhta hai aur progress updates paata hai
↓
MCP AI ke liye bana hai, JSON-RPC 2.0 par chalta hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

MCP aksar existing REST APIs ko wrap karta hai, replace nahi karta.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • REST aur gRPC: developer hard-code karta hai ki kaun si calls karni hain, aur zyadatar stateless hote hain.
  • MCP: AI server se poochta hai ki kaun se tools hain, unka matlab padhta hai aur ek chunta hai.
  • Yeh sessions aur progress notifications ke saath JSON-RPC 2.0 use karta hai.
Aur gehra
  • Stable contracts wale service to service traffic ke liye REST ya gRPC use karo; MCP ko AI boundary par use karo jahan discovery matter karti hai.
  • MCP descriptions models ke liye likhi jati hain, isliye description ki quality sahi tool choice chalati hai.
118

Resource aur Tool ke beech ki boundary kya hai?

Q199

Chhota jawab: Resource read-only data hai jo app context ke roop mein load kar sakta hai; tool side effects wala action karta hai. Agar chalane se bahar kuch badalta hai, to woh tool hai.

Aasan shabdon mein

Akhbaar padhna resource hai: kuch nahi badalta. ATM se paise nikalna tool hai: balance badalta hai. ShopBot ka order cancel karna tool hai.

Aise samjhoNewspaper padhna resource hai, kitni baar bhi padho kuch nahi badalta. ATM se paise nikalna tool hai, har baar balance badalta hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Resource ya Tool
Ek cheez ko resource ya tool banana hai
↓
Do baar call karne par kya fark padta hai?
Haanfark padta hai (kuch badalta hai): Tool
Nahibas data padhna hai: Resource
↓
Tool: action karta hai (jaise order cancel)
↓
Resource: sirf data deta hai (jaise policy file)
↓
Test: do baar call karne par fark padta hai toh tool
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Mehnga read ya side effects wala read (jaise logging) phir bhi tool ke roop mein behtar ho sakta hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Resource sirf data deta hai, jaise policy file, aur uska koi side effect nahi hota.
  • Tool action karta hai, jaise order cancel karna ya email bhejna.
  • Test: kya chalane se server ke bahar kuch badalta hai (data, paise, messages)? Haan to tool. Do baar call karna test nahi hai, kyunki safe repeatable write bhi tool hi hota hai.
Aur gehra
  • Resources ko aam taur par kam approval chahiye; jo tools write karte hain unhe confirmation aur idempotency keys chahiye.
  • Mutating action ko resource ke peeche rakhna us safety assumption ko todta hai aur security bug hai.
119

MCP mein prompt ka kya role hai?

Q200

Chhota jawab: MCP prompts arguments wale server-stored templates hain, taaki wording consistent rahe aur ek hi jagah update ho.

Aasan shabdon mein

Bank ke printed form ki tarah: layout wahi rehta hai aur aap sirf naam aur amount bharte ho.

Aise samjhoYeh bank ke printed form jaisa hai: format ek hi rehta hai, bas har baar naam aur amount bharna padta hai.
🔀 Flowchart: MCP mein prompt ka role
Server mein prompt template stored hai
↓
Client template ke arguments fill karke fetch karta hai
↓
Server taiyar prompt wapas deta hai
↓
Template ek hi jagah update hota hai
↓
Wording consistent rehti hai sab clients mein
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Users ya clients ko pata hona chahiye ki kaun sa template chunna hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Ek prompt template server par rehta hai.
  • Client arguments bharta hai aur ready prompt fetch karta hai.
  • Template ek baar update karo aur har client ko nayi wording mil jati hai.
Aur gehra
  • Templates ko versioned artifacts ki tarah treat karo, review aur tests ke saath; ek wording change sabhi clients ka behaviour badal sakta hai.
  • Prompts aam taur par user-selected hote hain, isliye woh automatic model choice se zyada slash commands jaise workflows ke liye fit hain.
120

MCP kitna mature hai?

Q204

Chhota jawab: MCP production ke liye kaafi mature hai: Python aur TypeScript SDKs stable hain, adoption wide hai aur governance open hai, par spec date-wise versions mein badalta rehta hai, isliye versions pin karo aur local ke liye stdio, remote ke liye Streamable HTTP use karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Ek nayi train route jo roz chal rahi hai aur bahut yatri le jaati hai, par timetable kabhi kabhi badalta hai. ShopBot ke liye MCP ka core tool calling aaj use karna safe hai. Naye features badal sakte hain, isliye current spec dekho aur SDK version pin karo.

Aise samjhoYeh Indian railway ke naye route jaisa hai: train chal rahi hai aur kaam ki hai, par timetable kabhi-kabhi badalta hai. Safar se pehle schedule dekh lo.
Pehle yeh samjhoMCP naya hai aur badalta rehta hai. Server same computer par ho to stdio, door ho to Streamable HTTP chunte hain (ye dono data bhejne ke raaste hain).
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. SDK ek ready-made code kit hota hai jisse MCP ke saath kaam karna aasaan hota hai. Python aur TypeScript ke kits stable hain, matlab bharose ke saath use ho sakte hain.
  2. Transport matlab data bhejne ka raasta. Apne computer ke local server ke liye stdio (seedhi input-output), door ke server ke liye Streamable HTTP. Purana SSE tareeka ab chhoda ja raha hai (deprecated).
  3. MCP abhi badal raha hai, isliye kisi detail par bharose se kaam karne se pehle latest spec (official document) dekh lo. Purani jaankari galat ho sakti hai.
🔀 Flowchart: MCP kitna mature hai
Question: MCP production mein use ke laayak hai?
↓
Python aur TypeScript SDKs stable hain
↓
Server kahan chal raha hai?
HaanLocal: stdio transport
NahiRemote: Streamable HTTP (purana SSE deprecated)
↓
Protocol badalta rehta hai
↓
Details par bharosa karne se pehle current spec check karo
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Tez progress aur naye features ka matlab hai aapko upgrade ka kaam karna padega.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Core features (tools, resources, prompts) aur Python, TypeScript SDKs stable hain aur vendors mein wide use hote hain.
  • Local server: stdio use karo. Remote server: Streamable HTTP use karo (purana SSE transport deprecated hai).
  • Spec dated versions mein aata hai aur naye features, jaise authorisation ki details, versions ke beech badalte hain.
Aur gehra
  • Protocol aur SDK versions pin karo aur upgrade par contract tests chalao, taaki spec drift jaldi pakda jaye.
  • Remote servers ko real auth (OAuth), TLS, rate limits aur observability chahiye; stdio local process ke trust par chalta hai.
121

VS Code ke liye MCP server kaise banaoge?

Q210

Chhota jawab: Narrow, safe tools banao (run tests, diagnostics, search) aur server ko editor ke MCP config mein register karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Intern ko sirf uske room ki chaabi dena, poori building ki nahi. Editor mein AI ko sirf wahi tools milte hain jo chahiye.

Aise samjhoYeh kisi naye intern ko office ki chaabiyan dene jaisa hai: sirf kaam ke kamre ki chaabi do, poori building ki nahi.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Register karna matlab VS Code (code editor) ki MCP settings mein server ka naam aur chalane ka tareeka likhna. Tabhi editor use dhoondh ke jod pata hai.
  2. Tools wo kaam hain jo model server se karwa sakta hai. Jaise tests chalana (run tests), errors dekhna (get diagnostics), aur code mein dhoondhna (search code).
  3. Tool chhota aur ek hi kaam wala rakho aur khatarnaak kaam (jaise sab files delete karna) na do. Isse model galti kare tab bhi nuksan kam hota hai.
🔀 Flowchart: VS Code ke liye MCP server
Editor mein AI ko tools dene hain
↓
Tools banao: run tests, get diagnostics, search code
↓
Tools ko narrow aur safe rakho
↓
Server ko editor ki MCP configuration mein register karo
↓
Editor ka AI in tools ko use kar sakta hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Run tests, get diagnostics aur search code jaise tools banao.
  • Har tool narrow aur safe rakho.
  • Server ko editor ki MCP configuration mein register karo.
  • Phir editor ka AI un tools ko use kar sakta hai. Trade-off: broad tools handy hain par risky.
Aur gehra
  • File access workspace tak limit karo aur bahar ke paths block karo, traversal rokne ke liye.
  • Jo tools files likhte hain ya commands chalate hain unke liye user confirmation mango.
122

MCP ke future trends kya hain?

Q211

Chhota jawab: Likely trends: server registries aur discovery, standard OAuth authorisation, agent-to-agent use, multimodal tools.

Aasan shabdon mein

Shuruaati UPI jaisa: pehle ek app, phir saare apps ek standard pe. MCP tools ko aasani se dhoondhne aur ek common login ki taraf ja raha hai.

Aise samjhoYeh UPI ke shuruaati dino jaisa hai: pehle ek hi app, phir sab apps ek standard par, aur phir har dukaan par scan karke payment.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Registry ek directory ki tarah hai jahan MCP servers listed hote hain, aur discovery matlab unhe dhoondh paana. Jaise app store mein apps dhoondhna.
  2. Ek AI agent doosre AI agent ke tools ko use kar sake, yaani agents aapas mein baat karein. Ye aage badhne wali disha hai.
  3. OAuth ek standard login tareeka hai jisme password diye bina permission di jaati hai (jaise 'Google se login'). Aage MCP mein sab servers ke liye yahi common tareeka aayega.
  4. Multimodal tools matlab sirf text nahi, balki images, audio jaisi cheezein bhi sambhalna. Tools ki range badhegi.
  5. Auto-wrapping matlab purani REST API (website ki normal service) ko apne aap MCP server mein badal dena. Isse naya server haath se nahi banana padega.
🔀 Flowchart: MCP ke future trends
MCP aage kahan ja raha hai?
↓
Server registries aur discovery
↓
Standard OAuth-based authorisation
↓
Agent-to-agent use aur multimodal tools
↓
REST APIs ka auto-wrapping bhi aayega
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Servers aasani se dhoondhne ke liye Registries.
  • Standard OAuth based authorisation.
  • Agent-to-agent use aur multimodal tools.
  • REST APIs ki auto-wrapping. Ye trends hain, guarantees nahi.
Aur gehra
  • Registries discovery mein help karti hain lekin supply-chain risk badhati hain; signing, vetting aur allow-lists chahiye.
  • Standard OAuth se custom auth hat jaata hai, lekin scopes aur consent UX ko ab bhi design karna padta hai.
123

MCP kaun si problem solve karta hai, aur log ise kyun use karte hain?

S26

Chhota jawab: MCP agents aur tools ke beech ek standard interface deta hai, jo N-by-M custom integrations ki jagah leta hai.

Aasan shabdon mein

Jaise USB-C: har phone ke liye alag charger ki jagah ek port. ShopBot standard se connect hota hai, har tool se alag-alag nahi.

Aise samjhoYeh mobile charger ke USB-C jaisa hai: pehle har phone ka alag charger hota tha, ab ek hi port sabke saath chalta hai.
Pehle yeh samjhomaan lo 5 agents aur 10 systems hain. Bina standard ke 50 alag integrations banane padte. MCP ke saath har ek bas standard se judta hai.
🔀 Flowchart: MCP kaun si problem solve karta hai
Har agent ko har system se alag integrate karna padta tha
↓
Kaam bahut, code duplicate, maintain karna mushkil
↓
MCP ek standard interface deta hai
↓
Tools aur external context ek hi tareeke se jude
↓
Sab agents ek hi interface share karte hain
        AI application
              |
             MCP
     +--------+--------+
  GitHub    Database   Salesforce
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Ek nayi layer jise chalana aur secure karna padta hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Standard ke bina 5 agents aur 10 systems ke liye 50 integrations chahiye.
  • MCP ke saath, har side standard se sirf ek baar connect hoti hai.
  • Isse duplicated code aur maintenance kam hota hai.
Aur gehra
  • Fayda organisational hai: shared tool servers jo ek team ke paas hon aur kai agents reuse karein.
  • Central permissions aur audit possible ho jaate hain, lekin tabhi jab tum sach mein unke through route karo.
124

MCP vs API: kya MCP APIs ko replace karta hai?

S29

Chhota jawab: Nahi: APIs applications ko connect karte hain; MCP ek AI-friendly, discoverable layer hai jo APIs ke upar baith sakti hai.

Aasan shabdon mein

API do jagahon ke beech ki sadak hai. MCP wo signboard hai jise AI padhta hai ye dekhne ke liye ki kya available hai.

Aise samjhoAPI ek sadak jaisi hai jo do jagah jodti hai. MCP us par lagi hui signboard hai jisse AI khud padh ke samajh leta hai ki kahan kya milega.
Pehle yeh samjhoAPI do programs ke aapas mein baat karne ka rasta hai. MCP uske upar ek AI-friendly parat hai jisse AI khud padh ke samajh leta hai ki kya kya kaam available hain.
🔀 Flowchart: MCP vs API
Sawal: kya MCP APIs ko replace karta hai?
↓
APIs applications ko aapas mein connect karte hain
↓
MCP AI apps ko tools use karne ka standard, discoverable tareeka deta hai
↓
MCP existing APIs ke upar AI-friendly layer ban sakta hai
↓
Nahi, replace nahi karta, API ke upar baithta hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • APIs programs ko ek doosre se baat karne dete hain.
  • MCP AI apps ko tools aur resources use karne ka ek standard, discoverable tareeka deta hai.
  • MCP existing APIs ko AI-friendly layer ki tarah wrap kar sakta hai.
  • Normal software clients ke liye API ko rakho.
Aur gehra
  • API system of record aur security boundary rehti hai; MCP ek patla adapter hai.
  • Har endpoint ko one to one map mat karo; uski jagah task-focused tools design karo.
125

Aapki company ke kaun se internal APIs MCP ke through expose karne hain, yeh kaise decide karoge?

S78

Chhota jawab: Read-only, task-focused tools se shuru karo, raw endpoints se nahi; kam expose karo aur wrong-tool rate measure karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Restaurant ready dishes dikhata hai, poori kitchen nahi. AI ko kuch clear tools do, saare 200 API darwaaze nahi.

Aise samjhoRestaurant mein kitchen ke saare gas aur burner customer ko nahi dete. Menu mein sirf ready dishes dikhaate hain.
Pehle yeh samjhoendpoint matlab API ka ek ek alag darwaza. Company mein 200 aise darwaze ho sakte hain, par AI ko sirf kuch chune hue saaf tools dene chahiye. Wrong-tool rate matlab AI kitni baar galat tool chunta hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Kaun se internal APIs expose karein
Company ke kaun se APIs MCP se expose karne hain?
↓
Read-only se shuru karo (search, lookup, status: kam risk)
↓
Kya write tool chahiye?
Haanapprovals, clear descriptions, limits ke saath
Nahiread-only par ruko
↓
Model ke liye design karo: kuch clear tools, 200 raw endpoints nahi
↓
Tool-call success aur wrong-tool rates measure karo
↓
Data se dekh kar tools badhao ya badlo
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Read-only actions se shuru karo, jaise search aur lookup.
  • Raw endpoints expose karne ki jagah chhote, task-focused tools banao.
  • Write tools baad mein approval ke saath add karo.
  • Wrong-tool rate pe nazar rakho: zyada tools matlab zyada galtiyan.
Aur gehra
  • Candidates ko user value, risk aur data sensitivity se rank karo; high value, low risk pehle expose karo.
  • Tools ko tasks ke around design karo (order status dekhna), CRUD ke around nahi, taaki descriptions clear hon aur calls kam hon.
126

stdio ya Streamable HTTP: kaun sa transport chunoge?

S80

Chhota jawab: Local servers ke liye same machine pe stdio; remote ke liye Streamable HTTP, proper auth jaise OAuth ke saath.

Aasan shabdon mein

stdio ghar ke andar intercom hai; Streamable HTTP kisi bhi sheher mein phone call hai.

Aise samjhostdio ghar ke andar intercom jaisa hai. Streamable HTTP phone call jaisa hai jo kisi bhi sheher mein baat kara sakta hai.
Pehle yeh samjhostdio mein server tumhari hi machine par chhota program ban kar chalta hai, isliye alag login ki zaroorat nahi. Streamable HTTP mein server door hota hai, isliye proper login (jaise OAuth) chahiye.
🔀 Flowchart: stdio ya Streamable HTTP
MCP server ke liye transport chunna hai
↓
Kya server user ki apni machine par local chalega?
Haanstdio transport
Nahiremote hai: Streamable HTTP
↓
Purana SSE transport deprecated hai, use mat karo
↓
Local ke liye stdio, remote ke liye Streamable HTTP
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Local simpler hai; remote sharing allow karta hai par zyada security chahiye.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • stdio: server tumhari machine pe chhote program ki tarah chalta hai, isliye alag login nahi chahiye.
  • Streamable HTTP: server remote hai aur use proper login chahiye, jaise OAuth.
  • Choose karo is se ki server kahan chalta hai.
Aur gehra
  • stdio local user ka trust inherit karta hai; remote mein TLS, auth, rate limits, session handling aur multi-tenant isolation add hote hain.
  • Remote servers ko horizontal scaling aur observability chahiye; stdio users ke across scale nahi karta.

Cloud GenAI: AWS Bedrock aur Azure OpenAI

127

Bedrock par model kaise select karte ho?

S31

Chhota jawab: Public leaderboards sirf shortlist banane ke liye use karo, phir candidate models ko apne real examples par test karo aur quality, speed aur cost se chuno.

Aasan shabdon mein

Jaise IPL stats se shortlist banakar, phir apni team ke net practice se cricketer chunna. ShopBot ke liye 100 real customer sawal lo, 3 shortlisted Bedrock models par chalao, aur accuracy, latency aur cost per answer compare karo. Sabse achha fit chuno, top rank nahi.

Aise samjhoYeh naya cricketer team mein lene jaisa hai: IPL ke stats dekhne ke bajay use apni team ke net practice mein khilao.
Pehle yeh samjholeaderboard par model ka number alag tests ka hota hai, tumhare kaam ka nahi. Isliye apne asli sawal lekar har model ko test karo. Interview mein bolo: 'Main public ranking dekh kar nahi, apne asli kaam ke sawalon par models ko test karke chunta hoon.'
🔀 Flowchart: Bedrock par model select karna
Bedrock par kai models available hain
↓
Public leaderboard se mat chuno
↓
Apne real enterprise prompts ka set banao
↓
Har candidate model ko us par benchmark karo
↓
Sabse behtar model apne data par jeeta hua chuno
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Testing mein time aur mehnat lagti hai, par mehnga galat choice bachta hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Public scores doosre tests se aate hain, aapke kaam se nahi, isliye unhe sirf shortlist ke liye use karo.
  • Apne real sawalon ka test set banao, expected answers ke saath.
  • Har candidate model ko us par chalao (Bedrock model evaluation madad kar sakta hai) aur quality, speed, cost compare karo.
Aur gehra
  • Rubric ya judge model se score karo jise human review se check kiya ho, accuracy, safety aur format cover karte hue.
  • Cost per successful task compare karo, price per token nahi.
128

Production mein Bedrock cost ko kaise control karoge?

S33

Chhota jawab: Pehle CloudWatch metrics aur cost tags se naapo ki kaunsa feature sabse zyada kharch kar raha hai, phir model routing, prompt caching, chhote prompts aur non-urgent kaam ke liye batch inference se cost kam karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Jaise bijli ka bill: meter dekho ki AC sabse zyada chal raha hai, phir wahi theek karo. ShopBot mein dekho ki lambi chat history sabse zyada tokens kha rahi hai, use trim karo, aasaan sawalon ke liye sasta model use karo, aur raat ke summaries batch job se kam price par chalao.

Aise samjhoYeh bijli ke bill jaisa hai: pehle meter dekho kaunsa AC zyada chal raha hai, phir usse optimize karo.
Pehle yeh samjhobill tokens ki ginti par banta hai. Pehle CloudWatch se dekho kaun si request kitne tokens kha rahi hai, uske baad sasta model aur caching lagao.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Model routing matlab aasaan sawalon ko sasta chhota model aur mushkil ko bada model dena. Caching matlab pehle diye jawab dobara use karna, aur ye dono tareeke Bedrock ka bill kam karte hain.
🔀 Flowchart: Bedrock cost control
Production mein Bedrock ka bill badh raha hai
↓
Pehle observability: CloudWatch se token consumption track karo
↓
Dekho kaun si request sabse mehengi hai
↓
Model routing lagao (asaan sawal sasta model)
↓
Caching lagao
↓
Kharcha kam, quality wahi
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Sasta model aur chhote prompts quality kam kar sakte hain, isliye tests se check karo.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Cost tokens ke hisaab se badhti hai, isliye CloudWatch invocation metrics aur cost tags se dekho kaunsa feature ya request sabse zyada use karta hai.
  • Aasaan sawal sasta model ko do aur prompts aur outputs chhote karo.
  • Repeated prompt hisson ke liye Bedrock prompt caching aur non-urgent kaam ke liye batch inference use karo.
Aur gehra
  • Cost ko feature, team aur user ke hisaab se tags ya application inference profiles se attribute karo, taaki owners ko apna kharch dikhe.
  • Prompt aur context chhota karo, repeated prefixes aur responses cache karo, aur output length cap karo.
129

Bank ke liye Azure OpenAI ya direct provider API: kaunsa chunoge aur kyun?

S34

Chhota jawab: Bank ke liye main usually Azure OpenAI choose karunga, kyunki isme enterprise identity, private networking, compliance aur governance milta hai, jab tak bank ki apni requirements na dikhayein ki direct API behtar hai.

Aasan shabdon mein

Mall mein security, parking aur rules pehle se ready hote hain; direct khareedna sasta hai par sab kuch khud sambhalna padta hai. Bank ko yeh ready rules chahiye, isliye Azure usual pick hai, bank ki zarooraton check karne ke baad.

Aise samjhoYeh dukaan kharidne jaisa hai: mall (Azure) mein security, parking aur rules ready milte hain, jabki seedhe manufacturer se sasta par khud sab sambhalna padta hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoAzure Microsoft ki cloud hai jisme bank jaisi companies ko security aur rules ke tools ready milte hain. Interview mein bolo: 'Faisla bank ki zarooraton (rules, security, model kahan mile, kharcha) se hoga, pasand se nahi.'
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Bank mein har banda sab kuch nahi dekh sakta. Azure mein managed identity (app ki apni automatic ID) aur role-based access (role ke hisaab se permission) se control milta hai.
  2. Private networking matlab model tak traffic public internet se nahi, bank ke apne private raste se jaata hai, jaise tijori tak alag andar ka darwaza.
  3. Bank ka data kis desh ya region mein process ho aur rules (compliance) follow ho, ye regulator ke liye zaroori hai.
  4. Kaun sa model kahan milta hai aur uska kharcha kitna hai, ye dono dekhne padte hain, kyunki har option mein alag models aur price hote hain.
🔀 Flowchart: Bank: Azure OpenAI ya direct API
Bank ko model chahiye: Azure OpenAI ya direct provider API
↓
Enterprise requirements ke against evaluate karo
↓
Identity (managed identity, RBAC) aur private networking
↓
Kya regional data processing aur compliance poora hota hai?
Haanmodel availability aur cost dekho
Nahius option ko hata do
↓
Faisla compliance, architecture, availability aur cost par
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Azure mein setup zyada aur naye models der se mil sakte hain, lekin regulated kaam ke liye zyada fit hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Azure enterprise identity, private networking, governance aur monitoring integration deta hai, jo bank ko usually chahiye.
  • Direct provider API simple, sasti ho sakti hai aur naye models jaldi mil sakte hain.
  • Pehle bank ki requirements likho: compliance, data residency, identity, networking, model availability aur cost.
Aur gehra
  • Data residency, retention aur training-use terms check karo, saath mein private networking aur customer-managed keys.
  • Model aur feature availability aur version cadence compare karo, kyunki channels ke beech ye alag ho sakte hain.
130

Bedrock Knowledge Bases ya custom RAG pipeline?

S81

Chhota jawab: Speed ke liye managed Knowledge Bases se shuru karo, aur custom RAG tabhi banao jab aisa control chahiye jo wo nahi deta, jaise special chunking, apna reranking, unsupported data sources ya strict data rules.

Aasan shabdon mein

Knowledge Bases ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector store aur retrieval sab sambhalta hai, isliye team kuch dinon me working RAG bana sakti hai. Custom tabhi jao jab evals dikhaen ki quality kam hai aur settings se theek nahi hoti. Pehle tiffin service, aur special dish ghar par tabhi jab zaroorat ho.

Aise samjhoPehle tiffin service lagao, aur agar kuch khaas pasand ho tab khud ghar par pakao.
Pehle yeh samjhomanaged matlab Amazon sab sambhalta hai, tumhe bas use karna hai. Custom matlab tum sab khud banate ho. Interview mein bolo: 'Pehle ready-made se shuru karunga taaki jaldi value dikhe, aur custom tabhi banaunga jahan mujhe zyada control chahiye.'
🔀 Flowchart: Bedrock KB ya custom RAG
RAG chahiye: Bedrock Knowledge Bases ya custom pipeline?
↓
Value prove karne ke liye managed se start karo
↓
Kya kisi jagah zyada control chahiye?
Haansirf wahan custom pipeline banao
Nahimanaged hi rakho
↓
Custom tabhi, jahan control sach mein matter karta hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Managed ka matlab Amazon ingestion, indexing aur retrieval sambhalta hai; aap chunking, embedding model aur vector store options set karte ho.
  • Custom me chunking, hybrid search, reranking, metadata filters aur data flow par control milta hai, par use chalana aur maintain karna padta hai.
  • Managed se shuru karo taaki value jaldi dikhe, aur pehle din se eval set banao.
  • Custom tab jao jab evals me aisa gap dikhe jo settings se na bhare, ya unsupported sources, special parsing ya strict rules hon. Trade-off: custom me engineering time zyada lagta hai.
Aur gehra
  • Pehle version ke liye default managed rakho: kam code, tez launch, S3 aur doosre sources ke saath built-in sync.
  • Data se decide karo: kuch banane se pehle managed setup par eval set (retrieval hit rate, answer quality) chalao.

GenAI System Design

131

Enterprise HR chatbot kaise design karoge?

S37

Chhota jawab: Policies sabke liye RAG se jaati hain; personal data har user ke liye ek authorised HR API se aata hai.

Aasan shabdon mein

Ek HR bot leave rulebook sabke saath share kar sakta hai, lekin tumhari salary sirf tumhe dikhni chahiye. Isliye rules ke liye ShopBot jaisa search theek hai, aur tumhare apne data ke liye ek locked lookup use hota hai.

Aise samjhoYeh HR office jaisa hai: company ki rule book notice board par sabke liye hai, par aapki salary slip sirf aapko ID dikhane par milti hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoauthentication matlab 'tum kaun ho' check karna, authorisation matlab 'tum kya dekh sakte ho'. Plain RAG sabko ek jaisa document search deta hai, isliye personal data usse nahi jaata.
🔀 Flowchart: HR chatbot: policy vs personal data
Employee HR chatbot se sawaal poochta hai
↓
Sawaal company policy ke baare mein hai?
HaanShared knowledge se RAG (document search) chalao
NahiPersonal data hai (salary, leave balance)
↓
Pehle user ki authorisation (permission) check karo
↓
Allowed ho toh HR API se uska apna data lao
↓
LLM policy ya data ko saaf jawab mein likhta hai
↓
Policy RAG se, personal data sirf authorise hone ke baad
                 Employee
                    |
              API Gateway
                    |
        Authentication -> Authorisation
                    |
               Query router
              /            \
      HR policy            Employee data
         |                      |
       RAG DB                 HR API
              \            /
                  LLM
                   |
              Guardrails
                   |
                Answer
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

API path zyada safe hai lekin plain document search se zyada integration kaam chahiye.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Public policies ek RAG index (documents par search) mein rehti hain jise saare employees query kar sakte hain.
  • Personal data jaise salary ya leave balance HR system se API ke through live fetch hota hai.
  • Authentication batata hai tum kaun ho; authorisation decide karta hai tum kya dekh sakte ho, har call par check hota hai.
Aur gehra
  • Identity ko signed session token se lo, prompt se kabhi nahi, taaki user kisi aur ke record ke baare mein na pooch sake.
  • Permissions API layer mein enforce karo, LLM mein nahi; model sirf wahi data format karta hai jo use dekhne ki permission thi.

Production Troubleshooting

132

Token usage achanak double ho jaata hai. Aap kya karoge?

S42

Chhota jawab: Tokens doguna hone ka matlab zyada text andar ya bahar ja raha hai; dhundho kaun sa prompt, user ya loop bada hua.

Aasan shabdon mein

Tokens text ke chhote pieces hain jinke tum paise dete ho. Agar bill double ho gaya, to ShopBot pehle se bahut zyada text bhej ya likh raha hai.

Aise samjhoJaise mobile data achanak khatam ho jaye: kisi app ne chupke se background mein download chalu kar diya. Pehle dekho kaun kha raha hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoagent loop matlab agent baar-baar khud ko ya tool ko call karta hai, aur har round ka text prompt mein jud kar tokens badhata hai. Cap matlab upar ki limit.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Prompt mein badlav ho gaya ho, jaise instructions lambe kar diye, to har request mein tokens (text ke chhote tukde jinka bill banta hai) badh jaate hain.
  2. Agar retrieval pehle se zyada chunks (documents ke tukde) la raha hai, to prompt bhaari ho jaata hai.
  3. Baatcheet ki history har baar saath jaati hai, isliye chat lambi hone par tokens badhte hain.
  4. Tool ka bada output seedha prompt mein paste ho jaye to tokens ek baar mein bahut badh jaate hain.
  5. Agent agar khud ko baar-baar call kare (recursive), to har round mein tokens jodte jaate hain.
  6. Wahi context do baar ya zyada baar bhej diya ho to bina fayde ke tokens bante hain.
🔀 Flowchart: Token usage double: culprit dhoondo
Token usage achanak double ho gaya
↓
Recent prompt changes check karo
↓
Retrieved chunks ya history badh gayi?
HaanChunks kam karo, history trim karo
NahiAage dekho
↓
Tool outputs ya recursive agent calls prompt mein bhar rahe hain?
HaanOutput chhota karo, loop par cap lagao
NahiDuplicated context hatao
↓
Sabse likely culprit: unnecessary context ya agent loop
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Usage ko feature, prompt version, user aur input versus output tokens ke hisaab se todo.
  • Common causes: lamba retrieved context, bada chat history, agent loops, retries, lambe answers.
  • Recent deploys, prompt edits aur traffic changes check karo.
  • Trimming, history summarise karna, caching, output limits aur loop caps se fix karo.
Aur gehra
  • Har request ko feature aur version se tag karo taaki cost minutes mein attribute ho sake.
  • Runaway agent loops aur retry storms dhundho; step caps aur per-request budgets unhe rokte hain.
133

Users shikayat karte hain ki answers bahut lambe hain. Aap kya karoge?

S47

Chhota jawab: Length aur format ke liye ek response contract define karo, use prompt mein aur limits se enforce karo, phir measure karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agar ShopBot bahut bolta hai, to use batao ki answers kitne lambe hone chahiye, jaise waiter ko chhoti portions serve karne ko kehte hain.

Aise samjhoJaise restaurant mein koi kahe thali bahut badi hai, to waiter ko batate hain ki chhoti portion do. Chef ko nahi badalte.
Pehle yeh samjhoresponse contract matlab pehle tay kar lena ki jawab kitna lamba aur kaise format mein hoga, aur code se check karna. Factual context matlab company ke asli documents, jinhe user ki pasand se mix nahi karna.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Structured generation ya output validation matlab jawab ko tay format aur length mein rakhna aur check karna, taaki beech mein faltu lamba text na aaye.
  2. User ki pasand (jaise 'chhota jawab do') ko tathyon (facts) wale context se alag store karo, taaki dono mix na hon.
🔀 Flowchart: Answers lambe hain: response contract
Users kehte hain answers bahut lambe hain
↓
Pehle maano ki zaroori nahi model quality problem ho
↓
Response contract define karo (length aur format)
↓
Structured generation ya output validation se enforce karo
↓
User preferences ko factual context se alag store karo
↓
Jawab chhote aur consistent, facts safe
Answer <= 5 bullets
Each bullet <= 20 words
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Bahut strict limit zaroori detail kaat sakti hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Ek response contract likho: maximum length, structure, tone aur kab detail mein jaana hai.
  • Prompt instructions, examples aur max output token limit se enforce karo.
  • Pehle ek chhota answer do, aur phir expand karne ka option do.
Aur gehra
  • User segments check karo; experts aur novices ko alag depth chahiye, isliye verbosity ko setting ya intent-based banao.
  • Sirf complaints se nahi, automatic length stats aur user feedback se measure karo.
134

GenAI app ke liye monitoring kaise set up karoge? Kya track karoge?

S88

Chhota jawab: Har request pe latency, errors, cost, quality aur safety track karo, traces aur alerts ke saath.

Aasan shabdon mein

ShopBot ki har chat ka record rakho: kitni fast thi, kitna cost hua, aur answer achha tha ya nahi. Phir trouble pe nazar rakho.

Aise samjhoJaise cricket match mein scoreboard, replay aur stats sab hote hain. Har ball ka record rehta hai to pata chal jata hai kahan galti hui.
Pehle yeh samjhotable mein har row ek cheez batati hai jo naapni hai. Groundedness matlab jawab documents par based hai ya nahi. Jailbreak attempts matlab rules todne ki koshish, PII hits matlab private data pakde jaane ke cases.
🔀 Flowchart: GenAI monitoring: trace id journey
User ka sawaal aata hai
↓
Request ko ek trace id milta hai
↓
Har stage log hota hai: router, retriever, tool, LLM
↓
Latency, cost, errors, quality metrics track hote hain
↓
Koi metric limit se bahar hai?
HaanAlert bhejo aur trace kholkar dekho
NahiNormal, monitoring chalti rahe
↓
Question se answer tak poori journey dikhti hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Operational metrics: latency percentiles, error rate, token use, cost per request.
  • Quality metrics: user feedback, groundedness, sampled human ya automated review.
  • Safety metrics: blocked requests, PII hits, refusals.
  • Har step ke liye traces use karo, aur thresholds pe alerts lagao.
Aur gehra
  • Har request ke saath prompt version, model version aur retrieved context log karo taaki koi bhi answer reproduce ho sake.
  • Logs redact ya restrict karo; observability data khud bhi private information leak kar sakta hai.
135

Alag-alag languages ke users kharab quality report karte hain. Tum kya karoge?

S92

Chhota jawab: Har language ki quality measure karo, phir better models, data, prompts aur native review se improve karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

ShopBot English mein shayad badhiya ho par doosri languages mein kamzor. Pehle har language test karo, phir kamzor wali fix karo.

Aise samjhoJaise ek teacher English mein achha padhati hai par Tamil mein kamzor hai. Har bhasha ka alag test lekar dekhna padta hai kahan kami hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoAI kai bhashaon mein barabar achha nahi hota kyunki training data English mein zyada hota hai. Native quality matlab original bhasha mein hi jawab kitna achha hai.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Har language ke liye alag test set banao aur quality alag naapo, taaki pata chale kis language mein dikkat hai.
  2. Dekho ki embedding model aur LLM dono us language ko sach mein samajhte hain ya nahi.
  3. Tokenisation matlab text ko tukdon mein todna. Kuch languages mein zyada tukde bante hain, isliye kharcha aur limit zyada lagti hai.
  4. Translate-then-answer matlab pehle English mein badlo phir jawab do. Ye tabhi karo jab original language mein quality kharab ho, aur dekho ki translation se kya khoya.
🔀 Flowchart: Multilingual quality problem: diagnose
Alag languages ke users kharab quality batate hain
↓
Har language ke test set se quality per language measure karo
↓
Embedding aur model ka multilingual support check karo
↓
Tokenisation cost dekho (kuch languages mein zyada tokens)
↓
Native quality abhi bhi kharab hai?
HaanTranslate-then-answer try karo, loss measure karo
NahiNative hi rakho
↓
Language-wise quality number se dikhti hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Per-language test sets banao aur sirf overall average nahi, scores compare karo.
  • Causes: weaker model support, English-only documents, tokenisation, galat language detection.
  • Fixes: multilingual models, translated knowledge, language-aware prompts aur retrieval.
  • Native speakers se samples review karwao.
Aur gehra
  • Kuch languages ko same text ke liye zyada tokens lagte hain, jisse cost aur latency badhti hai; per language budgets check karo.
  • Multilingual retrieval ko multilingual embeddings ya translation chahiye; cross-language recall test karo.

Speed, Safety, Ethics and Real-World Judgement

136

Ek AI tool cultural ya gender bias dikhata hai. Tum kya karoge?

Q226

Chhota jawab: Groups ke beech bias measure karo, data aur prompts fix karo, guardrails aur human review jodo, aur monitor karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agar AI kuch groups ke saath unfair hai, to pehle dekho problem kitni badi hai, phir fix karo aur results ko logon se review karwao.

Aise samjhoJaise kisi teacher ko pata chale ki wo kuch bachchon ko kam number deti hai. Pehle check karo kitna farak hai, phir marking rules theek karo.
Pehle yeh samjhobias matlab AI ka kisi group ke saath unfair hona. Controlled test matlab do same sawal jisme sirf ek cheez (jaise gender ya naam) alag ho, phir jawab ka farak dekhna. Rebalance matlab data mein sab groups ko barabar jagah dena.
🔀 Flowchart: AI mein bias: measure se fix tak
AI tool cultural ya gender bias dikhata hai
↓
Measure: controlled tests jo sirf group attribute badlein
↓
Source dhoondo: data, prompt ya filters
↓
Jaldi mitigate: prompt rules, re-ranking, sensitive uses mein human review
↓
Root cause: data rebalance, fine-tune, process badlo
↓
Affected communities aur external auditors ko involve karo
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Aise test cases banao jo gender ya culture badalte hain aur outputs compare karo.
  • Sources fix karo: unbalanced data, biased examples, prompts aur retrieval content.
  • Sensitive uses ke liye guardrails aur human review jodo.
  • Dobara test karo aur monitor karo, kyunki changes ke baad bias wapas aa sakta hai.
Aur gehra
  • Use case ke hisaab se fairness metrics define karo; koi ek universal measure nahi hota.
  • Model ka bias poori tarah nahi hat sakta; limits document karo aur oversight ke bina high-stakes automation se bacho.
137

Ek client campaign ke liye AI image generators chahta hai lekin copyright ki chinta hai. Aap kya karoge?

Q227

Chhota jawab: Licensed ya indemnified tools use karo, provenance document karo, human review rakho, aur legal ko involve karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

AI images kisi aur ke kaam jaisi lag sakti hain. Safe rehne ke liye clear usage rights wale tools use karo aur result ko kisi insaan se check karwao.

Aise samjhoJaise kisi ka gaana apni shaadi ke video mein bina permission lagana risky hai. Licensed music use karo to koi dikkat nahi.
Pehle yeh samjholicensed content matlab jiski permission li gayi hai. Indemnity matlab provider nuksaan ki zimmedari leta hai. Legal review matlab release se pehle vakeel se check.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Khatre ye hain: AI ka output kisi maujooda kaam jaisa lag sakta hai, model licence ke bina images par train hua ho sakta hai, galti se kisi ka logo aa sakta hai, aur ye saaf nahi ki image ka malik kaun hai.
  2. Aise providers lo jo licensed content par train karte hain aur indemnity dete hain, matlab agar case ho to wo nuksaan ki zimmedari lete hain.
  3. Prompt mein jeevit artists ka naam mat likho, kyunki isse unki style ki copy ban sakti hai.
  4. Reverse-image-search se dekho ki result kisi maujooda image se milta to nahi, aur release se pehle vakeel (legal) se review karwao.
🔀 Flowchart: AI images aur copyright: safe raasta
Client AI image campaign chahta hai, copyright ki chinta
↓
Risks: existing work jaisa output, unlicensed training, logos, ownership
↓
Provider licensed content par train karta hai aur indemnity deta hai?
HaanUs provider ko use karo
NahiDoosra provider dhoondo
↓
Living artists ke naam wale prompts avoid karo
↓
Output ko reverse-image-search karo
↓
Legal review ke baad hi campaign mein lagao
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Aise generators chuno jo licensed data pe trained hon ya legal protection dete hon.
  • Aise prompts se bacho jo kisi named artist, brand ya character ko copy karte hain.
  • Prompts, tools aur licences ka record rakho.
  • Publish karne se pehle legal aur brand teams se review karwao.
Aur gehra
  • AI outputs aur ownership ka kanoon desh ke hisaab se alag hai aur badal raha hai; legal advice lo, assume mat karo.
  • Contract terms matter karti hain: indemnity, commercial use rights aur vendor aapke inputs ke saath kya karta hai.
138

Non-technical customer ya boss ko GenAI failure kaise explain karoge?

S93

Chhota jawab: Honest aur seedhe raho: kya hua, kaun affect hua, tumne kya fix kiya, aur aage kaise rokoge.

Aasan shabdon mein

Apne boss ko simple words mein batao ki ShopBot ke saath kya galat hua, kaise fix hua, aur agli baar kya rokega.

Aise samjhoJaise train late hone par station master seedha bolta hai: kya hua, kab chalegi, aur aage se kya badlenge. Technical details nahi sunata.
Pehle yeh samjhoboss ko technical shabd nahi chahiye, unhe chaar baatein chahiye: kya hua, kitna asar, abhi kya kiya, aage kaise rokoge. Live hona matlab change asli system mein chalu hona.
🔀 Flowchart: Boss ko GenAI failure samjhana
GenAI se failure hua, boss ya customer ko batana hai
↓
Say what happened: seedha, bina blame ya jargon
↓
Say the impact: kaun affect hua aur kitna
↓
Say what you did: immediate fix
↓
Say how you will prevent it: ek concrete change (naya check ya test)
↓
Date do ki prevention kab live hoga
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Bina jargon ke batao kya hua, aur impact ki zimmedari lo.
  • Cause ek simple sentence mein samjhao, jaise AI ne guess kiya.
  • Fix aur jo checks add hue unka description do.
  • Blame se bacho aur over-promise mat karo.
Aur gehra
  • Impact aur customer ko kya action lena hai pehle batao, phir cause, phir prevention; executives ko decisions chahiye, detail nahi.
  • Yeh claim mat karo ki failure dobara nahi ho sakta; batao risk kaise kam hua aur kaise monitor hota hai.
139

Hiring team resumes screen karne ke liye LLM chahti hai. Tumhari concerns kya hain?

S94

Chhota jawab: Main concerns hain bias, rejection ke clear reasons na hona, hiring law aur privacy, isliye LLM ko sirf assist ke liye use karo aur human hi decide kare.

Aasan shabdon mein

Resume screen karne wala AI purani hiring ki unfairness copy kar sakta hai aur hamesha bata nahi sakta ki kisi ko reject kyun kiya. Example: wo career gap ya kisi college ke naam wale resumes ko neeche rank kar sakta hai. Isliye final decision insaan ka hona chahiye.

Aise samjhoJaise koi teacher bina batayein sirf naam dekh kar number de. Isliye AI ko sirf madad ke liye rakho, final decision insaan ka.
Pehle yeh samjhomatched resumes matlab do same resume jisme sirf naam ya gender alag ho. Agar AI ka score badle to bias hai. Appeal matlab rejected candidate faisle ko chunauti de sake.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Bias matlab model ka kisi ke prati jhukaav, jo wo training data se seekh leta hai. Aise resumes se test karo jo sirf gender, naam ya college mein alag hon, aur dekho ki result badalta hai ya nahi.
  2. Explainability matlab kaaran bata paana, aur appeal matlab faisle ko chunauti dena. Candidates aur auditors ko reasons chahiye ho sakte hain.
  3. Automatic hiring faislon par kanoon har desh mein alag hote hain, isliye apne desh ke niyam dekhne padte hain.
  4. Model ko madad ke liye use karo, jaise resume ka summary ya skills match karna, aur kisi ko reject karne ka faisla insaan hi kare.
🔀 Flowchart: Resume screening LLM: concerns
Hiring team resumes ke liye LLM chahti hai
↓
Bias test: sirf gender, name ya college alag wale matched resumes
↓
Explainability aur appeals: reasons dene ki ability check karo
↓
Country ke legal rules automated hiring allow karte hain?
HaanAllowed shartein follow karo
NahiAutomated decision mat lo
↓
LLM ko summaries aur skills matching ke liye use karo
↓
Logon ko reject karne ka faisla humans ka
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Bias: wo purane hiring data ki unfairness copy kar sakta hai, aur name, college ya postcode jaise proxies se bhi.
  • Explainability: candidates aur auditors ko rejection ke reasons chahiye ho sakte hain.
  • Law aur privacy: hiring AI regulated hai (jaise EU AI Act ise high-risk maanta hai, aur New York City mein bias audits zaroori hain). Resumes personal data hain.
  • AI ko assist ke liye use karo, final decision human ka, aur group-wise bias tests regularly chalao.
Aur gehra
  • Ise high-risk use maano. Banane se pehle local hiring aur data protection rules check karo.
  • Bias test karo: groups ke beech pass rates compare karo, aur proxy features hatao ya check karo.
140

Tumhara teammate confidential company data public chatbot mein paste kar deta hai. Tumhara approach kya hoga?

S95

Chhota jawab: Shaanti se respond karo: exposure contain karo, policy check karo, educate karo, aur approved safe alternative do.

Aasan shabdon mein

Teammate ko daantna mat. Samjhao ki paste kiya data company se bahar ja sakta hai, aur ek safe tool dikhao jo woh use kar sake.

Aise samjhoJaise koi dost office ki file cyber cafe ke computer par chhod aaye. Daanne se behtar hai ki office mein hi ek safe computer de do.
Pehle yeh samjhopublic chatbot mein daala data company ke control mein nahi rehta, aur wo store ya training mein use ho sakta hai. Isliye sahi kaam ke liye company ka approved tool do.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Teammate ko sharminda mat karo. Use samjhao ki public tool ki terms ke hisaab se data store ya use ho sakta hai, isliye risk hai.
  2. Use ek approved vikalp do, jaise company ka internal ya enterprise assistant, taaki wo kaam bhi kar sake aur data bhi safe rahe.
  3. Ek saaf data-handling policy banao jo bataye kya allowed hai aur kya nahi.
  4. Technical controls lagao: DLP (data leak rokne wala tool), redaction (sensitive hissa chhupana), aur approved tools ki list.
🔀 Flowchart: Teammate ne data public chatbot mein daala
Teammate ne confidential data public chatbot mein paste kiya
↓
Sharminda mat karo, risk samjhao (tool ki terms ke hisaab se data store ho sakta hai)
↓
Approved alternative do (internal ya enterprise assistant)
↓
Clear data-handling policy: kya allowed, kya nahi
↓
Technical controls: DLP, redaction, approved tool lists
↓
Safe tool unsafe se use karna aasan ho
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Shaant raho aur pata karo kaun sa data share hua.
  • Policy ke mutabik zaroori ho toh security ko report karo.
  • Risk samjhao: public tools inputs store ya reuse kar sakte hain.
  • Approved internal tool ya safe workflow offer karo.
Aur gehra
  • Data class aur kisi regulatory duty ko assess karo; thresholds meet hon toh security aur legal ko escalate karo.
  • Data hatane ki koshish karo ya vendor deletion options use karo, yeh jaante hue ki deletion guaranteed nahi ho sakta.

Whiteboard Patterns and Last-Night Revision

141

Advanced RAG pattern samjhao: yeh kya hai aur kab use karoge?

W2

Chhota jawab: Advanced RAG accuracy badhane ke liye query rewriting, hybrid search aur re-ranking add karta hai. Tab use karo jab basic RAG galat ya kamzor evidence uthata hai aur tests mein retrieval gaps dikhte hain.

Aasan shabdon mein

Advanced RAG me extra steps jode jaate hain, jaise question ko dobara likhna aur mile hue pages ko sort karna, taaki ShopBot best pages chune. Ise tab use karo jab basic RAG galat ya kharab order ke pages deta hai, jaise user ka question vague hai aur sahi policy page paanchve number par aata hai.

Aise samjhoJaise open-book exam mein pehle index se chapter dhoondhna, phir un chapters mein se best page chunna, phir likhna.
Pehle yeh samjhoquery rewrite matlab user ke dhundhle sawal ko saaf likhna. Re-ranking matlab mile hue chunks ko dobara best se worst ke order mein lagana.
🔀 Flowchart: Advanced RAG: behtar retrieval
Customer ka vague sawaal aata hai
↓
Query rewrite karke saaf karo
↓
Hybrid retrieval se kai chunks lao
↓
Re-ranking se sabse relevant upar lao
↓
Chunks sawaal ka jawab dete hain?
HaanLLM unse jawab likhta hai
NahiDobara retrieval ya query badlo
↓
Zyada sahi, grounded jawab
Query -> Rewrite -> Hybrid retrieval -> Reranker
      -> Context compression -> LLM
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Har step latency aur cost badhata hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Query rewriting search se pehle question ko clarify karta hai.
  • Hybrid retrieval candidates ko widen karta hai; re-ranker unhe relevance se reorder karta hai.
  • Context compression sirf useful text rakhta hai.
Aur gehra
  • Steps tabhi add karo jab evals retrieval gaps dikhayein; complexity ka maintenance cost hota hai.
  • Re-rankers precision badhate hain par har query pe latency add karte hain; candidate counts cap karo.
142

Secure agent pattern samjhao: yeh kya hai aur kab use karoge?

W4

Chhota jawab: Secure agent: least privilege, risky actions ke liye approval, input aur output checks, full audit logs. Hamesha use karo jab agent private data padh sakta ho ya asli actions le sakta ho.

Aasan shabdon mein

Bank cashier ki tarah, jiska apna alag counter hota hai, agent ko sirf zaroori permissions milti hain aur bade actions ke liye approval lagta hai. Ise tab use karo jab agent private data padh sakta ho ya real actions le sakta ho, jaise refund dena.

Aise samjhoJaise bank mein cashier sirf apna counter chalata hai, badi rakam par manager ka sign lagta hai, aur har lenden register mein likha jata hai.
Pehle yeh samjhohar step ek suraksha parat hai. Login check, chhupe instructions se bachav, sirf zaroori tools, risky kaam par insaan ki approval, aur har kaam ka record (audit log).
🔀 Flowchart: Secure agent: guardrails ke saath
User agent se request karta hai
↓
Authentication aur authorisation check
↓
Input par prompt-injection defence
↓
Agent sirf scoped tools use karta hai
↓
Action risky hai?
HaanHuman approval maango
NahiAction chalao
↓
Output validation aur audit log
↓
Safe response user ko
Agent -> Tool gateway -> AuthZ -> Policy -> Tool
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Har tool ko narrow, scoped permissions do.
  • Risky ya irreversible actions ke liye human approval maango.
  • Injection aur sensitive data ke liye inputs aur outputs check karo.
  • Har action log karo.
Aur gehra
  • Saare retrieved ya user content ko untrusted maano; usme prompt injection ho sakta hai.
  • Authorisation code mein enforce karo aur short-lived credentials use karo.
143

Multi-agent pattern samjhao: yeh kya hai aur kab use karoge?

W6

Chhota jawab: Multi-agent: ek coordinator kaam ko specialist agents mein baantta hai. Isse tabhi use karo jab ek agent kaafi na ho: alag skills, permissions, parallel kaam ya context limits.

Aasan shabdon mein

Shaadi ka kaam logon me baantne ki tarah, ek coordinator har chhote AI ko role deta hai, jaise research ya writing. Ise tab hi use karo jab ek agent kaafi na ho, jaise research aur refund approval ke liye alag permissions chahiye.

Aise samjhoJaise shaadi ka kaam: ek decoration dekhta hai, ek khana, ek mehmaan. Sab ko coordinate karne wala ek manager hota hai.
Pehle yeh samjhocoordinator wo agent hai jo kaam baantta hai, specialist agent sirf ek hisse ka expert hota hai. Refund case matlab paise wapas karne ki request.
🔀 Flowchart: Multi-agent: kaam baantna
Bada kaam aata hai (jaise refund case)
↓
Coordinator (lead agent) kaam ko hisson mein todta hai
↓
Har specialist agent apna hissa karta hai (policy, order, payment)
↓
Coordinator sab results jodta hai
↓
Sab hisse theek hain?
HaanFinal jawab banao
NahiJo hissa galat hai use dobara karao
↓
Teamwork se complex kaam poora
Supervisor
  |-- Researcher
  |-- Analyst
  |-- Executor
  '-- Reviewer
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Better focus, par zyada cost, latency aur debugging mushkil.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Coordinator (orchestrator) subtasks specialist agents ko assign karta hai.
  • Har agent ka apna prompt, tools aur scope hota hai.
  • Results combine hoke final answer banta hai.
Aur gehra
  • Single agent se shuru karo; aur tabhi add karo jab measured benefits dikhein.
  • Failure modes: miscommunication, loops, duplicated work aur compounding errors.
144

Human in the loop pattern samjhao: yeh kya hai aur kab use karoge?

W7

Chhota jawab: Human in the loop: AI taiyaar karta hai, aur insaan risky ya important actions approve karta hai. Tab use karo jab action mehnga ho, palatna mushkil ho ya regulated ho.

Aasan shabdon mein

Us cheque ki tarah jiska paisa bank officer ke sign ke baad hi milta hai, ShopBot kuch risky karne se pehle kisi insaan se poochta hai. Ise tab use karo jab action mehnga, undo karna mushkil ya regulated ho, jaise ek tay amount se zyada ka refund.

Aise samjhoJaise cheque machine se print hota hai par bank manager sign karta hai tab paisa jata hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoAI sirf propose karta hai, yaani prastaav deta hai. Insaan reviewer approve kare tab hi risky kaam execute (chalu) hota hai. Approval gate ek darwaze jaisa hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Human in the loop: approval gate
Agent ek action propose karta hai (jaise refund)
↓
Action risky ya paise se juda hai?
HaanHuman reviewer ko bhejo
NahiSeedha chalao
↓
Human approve karta hai?
HaanAction execute hota hai
NahiAction roko aur feedback lo
↓
Decision log karo
↓
Risky kaam par insaan ka final haath
Agent -> Risk check -> Human approval -> Action
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Safer hai, par slower aur human time lagta hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Define karo kin actions ko approval chahiye, jaise limit se upar refunds.
  • Reviewer ko context aur proposed action clearly dikhao.
  • Record karo kisne approve kiya aur kab.
Aur gehra
  • Approval triggers risk aur confidence se choose karo taaki review fatigue na ho, jo rubber stamping ki taraf le jaati hai.
  • Approvals efficient banao: clear summaries, one-click edit aur timeouts.
145

Production LLM pattern samjhao: yeh kya hai aur kab use karoge?

W8

Chhota jawab: Production LLM matlab poora system: model ke aas-paas security, monitoring, cost control, testing aur rollout. Asli users app par nirbhar hone se pehle use karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Ghar par khana banana aur restaurant chalana alag baat hai. Live ShopBot ko sirf model nahi, safety, monitoring aur cost control bhi chahiye. Ise tab use karo jab real users app par depend karne wale hon, ek checklist ki tarah ki kya kya hona chahiye.

Aise samjhoJaise ghar mein khana bana lena aur restaurant chalana alag baat hai. Restaurant mein safai, stock, bill aur staff sab sambhalna padta hai.
Pehle yeh samjhogateway darwaza hai jahan pehle login, limit aur safety check hote hain. Phir jawab bhejne se pehle bhi check hota hai, aur har step ka record rakha jata hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Production LLM app ka request path
User ki request gateway par aati hai
↓
Auth, rate limit, input safety check
↓
Cache mein jawab hai?
HaanCached jawab do
NahiRAG aur LLM chalao
↓
Output validation aur safety filter
↓
Trace, logs aur metrics store hote hain
↓
Jawab user ko, monitoring ke saath
API -> Router -> Cache -> LLM -> Guardrail -> Validator
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Har safety layer kaam aur thodi latency badhati hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Components: gateway, guardrails, retrieval, model calls, logging aur evaluation.
  • Cost aur latency controls: caching, routing aur limits.
  • Release process: versioned prompts, tests aur rollback.
Aur gehra
  • Launch se pehle quality, latency, cost aur safety ke SLOs define karo.
  • Prompts, models aur data ko version karo taaki incidents reproduce ho sakein.
146

Multi-model routing pattern samjhao: yeh kya hai aur kab use karoge?

W9

Chhota jawab: Har request ko sabse chhote model pe route karo jo use handle kar sake; zaroorat par hi escalate karo. Tab use karo jab traffic mein aasan aur mushkil requests mile hon aur cost ya speed ka matlab ho.

Aasan shabdon mein

Hospital ki tarah, jahan general doctor simple cases dekhta hai aur specialist mushkil cases, ShopBot easy questions chhote sasta model ko bhejta hai. Ise tab use karo jab traffic me easy aur hard dono requests hon, jaise order status ke sawal aur complex complaint letters.

Aise samjhoJaise hospital mein zukam ke liye general doctor aur dil ke liye specialist. Har patient ko seedha bade doctor ke paas nahi bhejte.
Pehle yeh samjhoprovider wo company hai jo AI model deti hai. Router tay karta hai request kisko jaye. Fallback matlab ek fail ho to doosra chalaye.
🔀 Flowchart: Multi-model routing: sahi model chuno
Request router ke paas aati hai
↓
Request easy hai?
HaanChhota, sasta, fast model
NahiBada, strong model
↓
Chuna model fail ya slow hai?
HaanDoosre provider par fallback
NahiJawab lo
↓
Quality, latency, cost, availability track karo
↓
Cost kam, vendor lock-in kam
Query -> Model router
          |-- Cheap / fast
          |-- Balanced
          '-- Powerful
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Badi bachat, par routing errors quality ko hurt kar sakti hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Router request ko task ya difficulty se classify karta hai.
  • Simple requests chhote model ko jaati hain; hard wali bade model ko.
  • Fallback escalate karta hai agar chhota model confident na ho.
Aur gehra
  • Router ko khud evaluate karo: weak model ko galat routing chupke se quality loss hai.
  • Cost per task aur quality per route track karo, aur data se thresholds tune karo.
147

Hybrid retrieval pattern samjhao: yeh kya hai aur kab use karoge?

W10

Chhota jawab: Hybrid retrieval exact terms ke liye keyword search aur meaning ke liye vector search ko combine karta hai. Tab use karo jab users meaning se bhi aur exact words, codes ya names se bhi search karte hon.

Aasan shabdon mein

Book dhundhne ke liye aap exact naam ya topic se search kar sakte ho. ShopBot dono use karta hai, to exact codes aur milte julte ideas dono mil jaate hain. Ise tab use karo jab users dono tareeke se search karte hon, jaise product code SKU-4471 aur loose sawal jaise warm winter jacket.

Aise samjhoJaise library mein kitab dhoondhna: ek tareeka naam se (exact), dusra topic se (matlab). Dono milake sahi kitab milti hai.
Pehle yeh samjho'order ID 4821' jaisi exact cheez keyword search se milti hai, kyunki wo wahi shabd dhoondhta hai. Vector search matlab ke hisaab se milata hai. Dono ke results jod kar best upar laate hain.
🔀 Flowchart: Hybrid retrieval: vector plus keyword
Sawaal aata hai: order ID 4821 ka status
↓
Vector search meaning se milte chunks lata hai
↓
Keyword search exact words (jaise ID) se chunks lata hai
↓
Dono ke results merge karo
↓
Re-ranking se best chunks upar
↓
Meaning aur exact match dono pakde gaye
Query -> BM25 + Vector -> Fusion -> Reranker
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Better recall, par do indexes maintain karne padte hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • BM25 jaisa keyword search exact terms, ids aur names ke liye achha hai.
  • Vector search alag words hone par bhi meaning match karta hai.
  • Results merge hote hain, jaise rank fusion se, phir aksar re-rank hote hain.
Aur gehra
  • Hybrid product codes, acronyms aur rare terms mein help karta hai jahan embeddings kamzor hain.
  • Weights ko apne eval set pe tune karo, default pe nahi.
148

Real-time plus RAG pattern samjhao: yeh kya hai aur kab use karoge?

W12

Chhota jawab: Real-time plus RAG indexed documents ko question ke time fetch kiye gaye live data ke saath combine karta hai. Tab use karo jab answers ko documents ke saath taaza facts bhi chahiye, jaise prices ya order status.

Aasan shabdon mein

Us exam ki tarah jisme aapke paas book aur aaj ka akhbaar dono hon, ShopBot stored documents ke saath live facts, jaise current prices, use karta hai. Ise tab use karo jab answers ko documents ke saath fresh facts bhi chahiye, jaise return policy aur current order status.

Aise samjhoJaise exam mein kitab ke saath aaj ka akhbaar bhi dekhne ko mile. Purani jaankari aur taaza khabar dono saath.
Pehle yeh samjhopolicy jaisi purani jaankari documents (RAG) mein hoti hai. Order status jaisi badalti jaankari live API ya database se aati hai. Dono jod kar jawab banta hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Real-time data plus RAG
User poochta hai: mera order abhi kahan hai?
↓
Jawab live data mein hai (order status)?
HaanReal-time API ya database call karo
NahiPolicy documents se RAG
↓
Live result aur RAG chunks dono jodo
↓
LLM dono se jawab likhta hai
↓
Taaza data aur policy ka jawab ek saath
Question |-- RAG  -> static knowledge
         '-- API  -> real-time data
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Fresh answers, par extra latency aur live sources pe dependency.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Documents index se usual tareeke se retrieve hote hain.
  • Live data request time pe tools ya APIs se aata hai.
  • Dono answer ke liye prompt mein daale jaate hain.
Aur gehra
  • Volatile facts ke liye live APIs prefer karo; jo data minutes mein stale ho jaye use kabhi index mat karo.
  • Live source down ho toh timeouts aur fallbacks lagao, aur batao ki data outdated ho sakta hai.
149

Pehle kaun se questions master karein? (priority list)

G6

Chhota jawab: Pehle basics aur sabse common questions master karo, phir advanced design aur scenario topics.

Aasan shabdon mein

Exam se pehle important questions pehle padhte hain. Basics aur aksar puche jaane wale topics se shuru karo.

Aise samjhoJaise exam se pehle important questions pehle padhte hain, aur kam important baad mein. Time kam ho to bhi marks bach jate hain.
Pehle yeh samjhotable mein 'Where' column batata hai ki us topic ka card kahan hai (jaise S50 ya Ch 7). Top matlab sabse pehle padho, High matlab uske baad.
🔀 Flowchart: Kaun se questions pehle padhein
Interview mein limited time hai
↓
Pehle core concepts: LLM, RAG, agents ki basics
↓
Phir design questions: request ka raasta
↓
Production aur scenario questions aate hain?
HaanDiagnose, fix aur safety ke jawab practice karo
NahiPehle basics pakki karo
↓
Rapid-fire one-liners yaad karo
↓
Zaroori pehle, baaki baad mein
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Core concepts se shuru karo: LLMs, prompts, RAG, agents.
  • Phir aksar puche jaane wale topics cover karo, jaise evaluation aur hallucination.
  • Uske baad system design aur scenarios practise karo.
  • Weak areas dobara dekho aur zor se bolkar practise karo.
Aur gehra
  • Interview frequency aur jis role ko target kar rahe ho uske hisaab se prioritise karo.
  • Breadth se zyada depth matter karti hai: trade-offs, failure modes aur measurement samjha sako.

Level 3: Advanced

Design decisions, failure modes, scale aur security.

Prompts, Hallucination aur Attacks

150

LLMs "Who was the CEO of Company X in 2015?" jaise question par fail kyun hote hain?

Q87

Chhota jawab: LLMs text patterns store karte hain, dated timelines nahi, isliye historical aur recent facts dhundhle ho jaate hain.

Aasan shabdon mein

Model text ke patterns yaad rakhta hai, calendar nahi. Naye articles zyada common hain, isliye wo 2015 ke CEO ki jagah aaj ke CEO ka naam le sakta hai.

Aise samjhoYe us student jaisa hai jisne puri library padhi hai par har kitab ki tareekh yaad nahi. Use purane aur naye news mix ho jate hain, isliye 2015 ka CEO galat bata deta hai.
Pehle yeh samjhotraining cutoff matlab model ka seekhna ek tareekh par ruk gaya. 'Year restate' matlab model pehle saal apne shabdon mein dobara likhe, taaki wohi saal dhyan mein rahe. Interview answer: time wale sawalon ke liye date wala data do, sirf bada model kaafi nahi.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Model ka knowledge purana aur time-mix ho sakta hai, isliye RAG se dated documents lao aur prompt mein date bhi do. Phir model sahi saal ke document se jawab dega.
  2. Doosra tareeka knowledge graph hai, jisme har fact ke saath start aur end date hoti hai. Jaise CEO X, 2012 se 2016 tak, to 2015 ka sawaal seedha solve ho jaata hai.
  3. Model ko bolo pehle saal dobara likhe, phir jawab de. Isse woh sahi time par dhyaan deta hai, jaise student sawaal dobara padh ke likhe.
🔀 Flowchart: Purane saal ka sawal kyun fail
Sawal: '2015 mein Company X ka CEO kaun tha?'
↓
Model text patterns rakhta hai, dated timeline nahi
↓
Naye articles zyada hain, isliye latest wala favour hota hai
↓
Kya dated documents uplabdh hain?
HaanRAG se date ke saath do
Nahiknowledge graph banao (start/end dates)
↓
Model se pehle year restate karwao, phir answer
↓
Time-aware data se sahi jawab, bada model nahi
Trade-off

Ab retrieval quality answer quality ko limit karti hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Training data mein recent mentions bahut zyada hote hain, isliye latest state learned pattern pe haavi hoti hai.
  • Model ka ek knowledge cutoff bhi hota hai aur wo baad ki ghatnaon ko nahi jaan sakta.
Architect notes
  • Time-sensitive sawalon ko effective dates wala source of truth chahiye, jaise structured database ya dated documents.
  • Sawal ka date context retrieval aur prompts mein pass karo, aur answer mein source aur date maango.
  • Temporal sawalon ko alag slice ki tarah evaluate karo; aggregate accuracy in failures ko chhupa deti hai.
  • High-stakes facts ke liye citation checks ya human review zaroori karo.
151

Users role-play se tumhare bot ko jailbreak karte hain ("pretend you are an evil AI"). Aap kya karoge?

S58

Chhota jawab: Role-play jailbreaks: input aur output moderation ki layers lagao, least privilege rakho aur adversarial testing karo. Sirf prompts se kaam nahi chalta.

Aasan shabdon mein

Koi forbidden request ko kahani mein lapet deta hai aur ShopBot maan jaata hai. Isliye extra guards chahiye jo check karein ki kya pucha ja raha hai aur bot kya bol raha hai.

Aise samjhoYe us chor jaisa hai jo guard se bolta hai 'main film shooting ka actor hoon, gate kholo'. Guard ko role-play se nahi, ID aur rules se chalna chahiye.
Pehle yeh samjhoinput classifier user ke message ko jaanchta hai, output classifier model ke jawab ko. Blast radius chhota rakhna matlab agar bot bahak bhi jaye to uske haath mein khatarnak tools ya data na ho. Defence in depth matlab kai parat ki suraksha.
🔀 Flowchart: Role-play jailbreak se bachav
User forbidden request ko story mein lapet deta hai
↓
Attack ko classify karo: role-play, encoding, multi-turn, injected doc
↓
Layers lagao: input classifier, strong system policy, output classifier
↓
Known jailbreaks ki library se red-team tests chalao
↓
Kya model phir bhi bahak gaya?
Haanblast radius chhota rakho
Nahimonitoring jaari rakho
↓
Bot bahke bhi dangerous tools ya data tak nahi pahunchta
Input -> Safety filter -> LLM -> Output filter -> User
                           |
                  least-privilege tools only
Trade-off

Strict filters legitimate users ko bhi block kar sakte hain, isliye false positives ke liye tune karo.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Jailbreaks stories, role-play ya encoded text use karke rules ke around nikalte hain.
  • Layers mein defend karo: input classifier, strong system prompt, output moderation aur limited tool access.
Architect notes
  • Maan lo koi ek layer nahi tikegi; model-level safety, alag moderation models, rate limits aur abuse detection sab combine karo.
  • Sensitive capabilities ko authorisation ke peeche rakho taaki successful jailbreak se bhi real harm na ho.
  • Attack success rate aur false-refusal rate dono saath track karo, aur top incidents regularly review karo.
  • Repeat offenders ko log aur flag karo, privacy-aware retention ke saath, aur incident response path rakho.
152

Jab koi labelled data na ho tab LLM application ko kaise evaluate karte ho?

S59

Chhota jawab: Labels nahi hain: haath se chhota gold set banao, usi pe calibrated rubric ya LLM judges use karo, aur live feedback bhi lo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Answer key nahi hai toh khud chhota sa bana lo. ShopBot ke liye 50 questions likho achhe answers ke saath aur unse check karo.

Aise samjhoYe nayi dukaan kholne jaisa hai jahan pehle din koi record nahi hota. Pehle chhota hisaab khud haath se check karte ho, phir roz ke asli grahkon se seekhte ho.
Pehle yeh samjhobina answer key ke bhi test shuru ho sakta hai. Kuch sawal chuno, kisi expert se jawab likhwao, aur LLM-as-judge se rubric par score dilwao. LLM judge ko lamba jawab aur apna style pasand aata hai, isliye uske scores ko insaani rating se match karte hain (calibrate).
🔀 Flowchart: Bina labels ke evaluation
Naya project, koi ground truth nahi
↓
Users, logs ya experts se 50 se 100 realistic sawal lo
↓
Reference answers: expert likhe ya documents use karo
↓
Kya expert time kam hai?
HaanLLM-as-judge rubric se score, humans se spot-check
Nahiexpert answers use karo
↓
Thumbs up/down, escalation aur re-ask rate track karo
↓
Har production failure test set mein jodkar set badhao
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

LLM judges sasta hai par biased hota hai, isliye samples ke liye humans ko loop mein rakho.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Shuru mein real ya realistic inputs se ek chhota, varied set haath se label karo.
  • Rubrics use karo, jaise correct, grounded, polite, aur scoring scale karne ke liye LLM judge lagao.
Architect notes
  • Chhote gold set ke liye subject-matter experts se bootstrap karo, phir humans se review karwa ke synthetic variations se expand karo.
  • Judges ko position, verbosity aur self-preference bias ke liye calibrate karo; human labels ke saath agreement report karo.
