Chhota jawab: Document-level permissions retrieval mein enforce karo, LLM ke kuch dekhne se pehle; prompts pe kabhi rely mat karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Search ne dekha hi nahi ki kaun pooch raha hai, isliye ek junior ko salary files dikh gayi. Bot kuch bhi padhe, usse pehle permissions check karo.

Aise samjhoYeh aisa hai jaise bank clerk se koi bhi account ki detail pooch le. Tijori ki chaabi pehle hi check honi chahiye, baad mein nahi.
Pehle yeh samjhoaccess metadata matlab har chunk par likha ho ki kaun dekh sakta hai. Interview line ka matlab: kaun kya dekh sakta hai ye jaanch retriever (jo documents laata hai) karta hai, prompt mein 'kisi ko mat batana' likhna kaafi nahi hota.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Har chunk ke saath access metadata rakho, yaani kis group ko ye dekhne ki ijazat hai. Jaise office ki file par 'sirf HR' likha ho.
  2. Filter retrieval se pehle lagao, generation ke baad nahi. Agar model ne confidential text dekh liya to wo jawab mein leak kar sakta hai.
  3. Alag-alag groups ke users se test karo, taaki pakda jaye ki koi galat cheez dekh to nahi raha.
  4. Har retrieval ka log rakho taaki audit mein pata chale kisne kya dekha.
🔀 Flowchart: Confidential answer leak: access control
Junior employee salaries puchta hai, bot confidential doc dikhata hai
↓
Retrieval layer ne permissions ignore ki
↓
Har chunk ke saath access metadata store karo
↓
Retrieval se pehle filter karo, generation ke baad nahi
↓
Kya user ko is chunk ka access hai?
HaanChunk search mein shamil karo
NahiChunk hata do
↓
Alag-alag groups ke users ke saath test karo
↓
User ko sirf apna allowed data milta hai
User -> Authenticate -> Get user's groups
     -> Search with filter: allowed_groups contains user's groups
     -> Only permitted chunks reach the LLM
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Permission sync aur filtering complexity aur thodi latency badhate hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Har chunk pe ACLs ya role tags ko metadata ki tarah store karo.
  • Query time pe user ki identity se filter karo.
Architect notes
  • Source system se permissions sync karo aur changes jaldi handle karo; stale ACLs matlab leak.
  • Vector query ke andar pre-filtering prefer karo; post-filtering counts se leak kar sakta hai aur bahut kam results chhod sakta hai.
  • Cross-role red-team queries se test karo aur leakage ko release blocker banao.
  • Compliance ke liye audit logs rakho ki kisne kya retrieve kiya.
  • Highly sensitive tenants ke liye alag indexes consider karo.
188

Chhote budget mein 50 million documents par RAG kaise design karoge?

S68

Chhota jawab: Tiering, compression, quantisation, hybrid filtering aur caching se cost kam karo; recall loss measure karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Documents bahut hain aur paisa kam, toh popular items paas rakho aur purana stock godown mein. Sab kuch ke liye full price mat do.

Aise samjhoYeh chhoti dukaan mein sabse zyada bikne wala saaman counter par rakhne jaisa hai aur purana godown mein. Sab kuch front mein rakhoge to dukaan bhar jayegi aur kharcha badhega.
Pehle yeh samjho50 million matlab 5 crore documents. Hot data tez par mehnga storage mein, cold data sasta storage mein. Approximate search andaze se paas wale dhoondhti hai, thodi sateekta ghat kar kaafi tez. Interview line ka matlab: main thodi sateekta (recall) dekar bada kharcha bachata hoon, aur asli sawalon par naap leta hoon ki nuksan kitna hua.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Data ko tier karo: taaza aur baar-baar use hone wala (hot) tez index mein, aur purana kam use hone wala (cold) sasti storage mein. Jaise dukaan mein roz bikne wala maal counter par, baaki godown mein.
  2. Vectors ko compress karo (quantisation, yaani numbers ko chhota karna) aur approximate search use karo jo thoda andaza lagakar tez dhoondhta hai. HNSW aur IVF with product quantisation aise hi tareeke hain.
  3. Pehle metadata se filter karke search ka daayra chhota kar do, taaki kam data mein dhoondhna pade.
  4. Two-stage retrieval: pehle sasta aur broad search, phir kuch hi candidates par tez, sateek re-ranker. Isse paisa bachta hai.
  5. Lazily embed karo: pehle sirf summaries index karo, aur poori details tab embed karo jab zaroorat pade. Isse shuru ka kharcha kam hota hai.
🔀 Flowchart: 50 million docs, chhota budget
50 million documents, full precision store bahut costly
↓
Data tier karo: hot fast index mein, cold sasti storage mein
↓
Vectors compress karo (quantisation), approximate search (HNSW ya IVF)
↓
Pehle metadata se filter karo, search space chhota
↓
Two-stage retrieval: sasta broad search, phir kuch best re-rank
↓
Kam cost mein kaam karne wala RAG
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Compression aur approximate search se thoda recall kho jaata hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Data ko tier karo: hot memory mein, cold sasti disk storage pe.
  • Vectors ko quantisation ya chhote dimensions se compress karo.
Architect notes
  • Storage estimate karo: documents times chunks times dimensions times bytes; yahi design drive karta hai.
  • Disk-based approximate indexes aur product quantisation memory kam karte hain; apni queries pe recall loss validate karo.
  • Lazily embed karo ya sirf valuable content; duplicates aur low-value text skip karo.
  • Hot queries cache karo aur easy ones ke liye sasta model use karo.
  • Review mein cost per query aur recall saath track karo.

Agents: Answer dene se Kaam karne tak

189

Agent images, audio aur tables (multimodal) par reasoning kaise karta hai?

Q140

Chhota jawab: Har modality ko tokens mein encode karo jo model padh sake, saath mein reason karo, phir us par act karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Ek multimodal agent photo dekh sakta hai, voice note sun sakta hai aur table padh sakta hai, phir answer deta hai. ShopBot tuti hui shoe ki photo aur receipt ek saath padh sakta hai.

Aise samjhoYeh aisa hai jaise ek insaan aankh se dekhta hai, kaan se sunta hai aur sab milakar samajhta hai. Agent bhi alag-alag input ko ek hi bhasha mein badalke samajhta hai.
Pehle yeh samjhomodel asal mein number samajhta hai. Photo ya awaaz ko pehle numbers mein badalte hain (encode), phir text ke saath milakar model ko dete hain. OCR matlab photo ke andar ke akshar padhna. Invoice matlab bill.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Example: invoice ki photo se agent total padhta hai, aur phir payment ya accounting API (doosre software se baat karne ka raasta) call karta hai. Yani photo ko samajh kar asli kaam karta hai.
  2. Nikaale gaye values ko check karo, kyunki OCR aur vision galat padh sakte hain. Jaise 8 ko 3 padh liya to paisa galat jayega.
🔀 Flowchart: Multimodal agent ka flow
Input aaya: invoice ki image, audio ya table
↓
Har type ko encode karo (model samajh sake wala form)
↓
Text ke saath combine karke model ko do
↓
Model sab par reason karke total jaisi values nikalta hai
↓
Extracted values check ho gayi? (OCR/vision galat ho sakte)
HaanPayment ya accounting API call karo
NahiDobara padho ya human se confirm karo
↓
Sahi values par safe action
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Har image ya audio clip ke zyada tokens matlab zyada cost aur latency, aur perception errors andar aa sakti hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Har input (image, audio, table) ek encoder se guzarta hai jo use tokens ya embeddings mein badalta hai jo model samajhta hai.
  • Model mixed tokens par ek hi context mein reason karta hai, phir action ke liye tools call karta hai, jaise refund.
Architect notes
  • Native multimodal models aur pipelines (OCR, speech-to-text, phir LLM) mein se chuno. Pipelines sasti aur debuggable hain; native models zyada context rakhte hain.
  • Failure modes: charts mein numbers galat padhna, image ke hallucinated details, transcription errors jo chupchaap plans mein failti hain.
  • Cost control karo images resize karke, tables ko structured text mein extract karke, aur sirf relevant crops ya audio segments bhejkar.
  • Privacy: faces, voices aur documents sensitive hain. Logging se pehle redact karo aur retention limits set karo.
  • Har modality ko labelled sets se evaluate karo, phir end to end task success. Review mein pucho ki perception errors kahan verify hoti hain.
190

Agent performance kaise measure karte hain?

Q142

Chhota jawab: Outcome, trajectory, cost aur latency, sab ek saath measure karo, sirf final answer nahi.

Aasan shabdon mein

Hum sirf yeh nahi dekhte ki answer sahi hai ya nahi. Yeh bhi dekhte hain ki kitne steps liye aur kitna time aur paisa laga. ShopBot agar 20 faltu calls ke baad sahi answer de, toh woh achha nahi hai.

Aise samjhoYeh exam mein sirf final marks nahi, steps aur time dekhne jaisa hai. Teacher dekhti hai ki sawal kaise hal kiya.
Pehle yeh samjho'Production' matlab asli users ke liye chalta system. Wahan seedha agent ko kaam karne dena risky hai, isliye pehle shadow mode mein sirf dekhte hain ki wo kya karta. Tool-call accuracy matlab agent ne sahi tool sahi input ke saath chalaya ya nahi.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Success rate matlab kitne tasks sahi poore hue. Step efficiency matlab kaam kam steps mein hua ya faltu chakkar lage.
  2. Tool-call precision matlab agent ne sahi tool, sahi inputs ke saath chalaya ya nahi. Jaise sahi dawai ka sahi dose dena.
  3. Ek kaam mein kitna time (latency) aur kitna paisa (cost) laga. Dono kam hon to agent kaam ka hai.
  4. Hallucination rate matlab kitni baar agent ne galat cheez banayi. Human satisfaction matlab asli log kitne khush hain.
  5. Agent ne raaste mein kya kya kiya (trajectory) wo bhi dekho, sirf antim jawab nahi. Jaise exam mein sirf answer nahi, working bhi check karte hain, kyunki galat tareeke se sahi answer lucky ho sakta hai.
  6. Benchmark matlab fixed test set par score. LLM-as-judge matlab doosra model jawab ko grade karta hai. Shadow mode matlab agent asli kaam ke saath chalta hai par kuch karta nahi, bas humans se compare hota hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Agent ko kaise measure karein
Agent ko test tasks do (ShopBot ke refund queries)
↓
Poori trajectory (har step) record karo
↓
Success rate, step efficiency, tool-call accuracy naapo
↓
Latency, cost aur hallucination rate dekho
↓
Production mein seedha act karna safe hai?
HaanBenchmarks aur LLM-as-judge se score karo
NahiShadow mode: humans ke saath chalao, bina act kiye
↓
Sirf final answer nahi, poori trajectory ka score
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Outcome metrics: task success rate aur answer correctness, ek labelled test set ke against.
  • Trajectory metrics: sahi tool chuna ya nahi, arguments valid hain ya nahi, kitne steps, loops, aur errors se recovery.
Architect notes
  • Real traffic se ek golden dataset banao, jisme hard aur adversarial cases bhi hon, aur har prompt, model ya tool change par ise regression gate ki tarah chalao.
  • Offline evals ko online monitoring se alag rakho: sampled production traces, user feedback, escalation rate aur drift alerts.
  • LLM judges biased aur noisy hote hain. Unhe calibrate karo, pairwise comparison use karo aur ek human-reviewed slice rakho.
  • Cost per successful task report karo, per call nahi, taaki failures ka daam bhi count ho.
  • Review mein metric tree dikhao aur woh threshold bhi jo release ko block karta hai.
191

Medical Q&A ke liye LLM agent design karo. Kaun se components aur considerations?

Q144

Chhota jawab: Medical agent: grounded answers, strict privacy, clinicians ko escalation, audit logs, aur koi diagnosis claim nahi.

Aasan shabdon mein

Medical agent safe hona chahiye, patient details private rakhe aur risky sawal doctor ko pass kare. Woh clinic ke timings bata sakta hai, lekin treatment decide nahi kar sakta.

Aise samjhoYeh hospital ki reception jaisa hai: woh jaankari de sakti hai, lekin ilaaj nahi kar sakti. Sahi doctor ko call karna uska kaam hai.
Pehle yeh samjhomedical mein galat jawab se insaan ko nuksaan ho sakta hai. Isliye agent sirf jaankari de, bimari ka naam batana (diagnose) ya dawai ki matra (dosage) batana doctor ka kaam hai. 'Escalate' matlab mushkil ya risky sawal ko insaan expert ko bhej dena.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Medical data bahut private hota hai, isliye access control chahiye. Audit log matlab kisne kab kya dekha uska record, taaki baad mein jaanch ho sake.
  2. Medical jaankari badalti rehti hai, isliye sources ko regular update karo. Doctors se review karwao taaki galat salah na jaaye.
  3. Agar agent ko jawab par bharosa kam hai ya sawal khatarnaak hai, to khud na bataye, kisi insaan (doctor) ko de de. Jaise junior nurse mushkil case senior doctor ko bhejti hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Medical Q&A agent ka request path
User ka medical sawaal aaya
↓
Privacy controls lagao, audit log mein record karo
↓
Trusted medical sources se answer dhundo
↓
Sawaal risky ya confidence low hai?
HaanHuman expert ko escalate karo
NahiSources ke saath answer do
↓
Sources ko regular update karo aur expert review karwao
↓
Safe, traceable medical answer
Question -> Safety gate (refuse diagnosis / emergencies)
         -> RAG over trusted sources (guidelines, PubMed)
         -> Medical-tuned LLM -> Confidence + citations
         -> "Consult a doctor" disclaimer -> Answer
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Strict guardrails harm kam karte hain, lekin agent kam helpful aur slow ho jata hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Core parts: vetted medical sources se retrieval with citations, ek safety classifier, ek escalation path aur ek audit log.
  • Privacy: patient data minimise aur redact karo, encrypt karo aur access control karo, jahan lagu ho wahan HIPAA ya GDPR jaise rules follow karte hue.
Architect notes
  • Scope tight rakho: information aur triage support, diagnosis nahi. Risk tiers define karo, aur high tier ke liye automatic human handoff rakho.
  • Har claim ko versioned, clinician-approved sources par ground karo. Faithfulness aur citation accuracy measure karo, aur bina citation wale medical claims block karo.
  • Data governance: logging se pehle PHI redaction, data residency, consent, retention limits aur role-based access.
  • Emergencies, prompt injection aur unsafe advice ke liye red-team karo. Sabse zyada urgent cases ka recall track karo.
  • Clinical aur legal sign-off lo, pehle shadow mode chalao, aur clinician review ke saath drift monitor karo.
192

Un patterns ko kaise evaluate karoge jahan agents khud reflect, critique ya rerun karte hain?

Q146

Chhota jawab: Reflection loop ko single pass se compare karke evaluate karo: har extra round se quality kitni badhi, aur uske badle cost aur latency kitni badhi.

Aasan shabdon mein

Self-checking agent ko judge karne ke liye wahi test questions reflection loop ke saath aur bina uske chalao. Agar answers clearly better nahi hue, to extra rereads sirf time aur paisa waste karte hain, jaise exam answer ko paanch baar padhna bina fayde ke.

Aise samjhoYeh exam ke baad apni copy khud check karne jaisa hai. Galti pakad lo to achha, lekin bar bar check karoge to time kharab hoga.
Pehle yeh samjhoek hi baar mein jawab banake chhodne ki jagah agent apna kaam dobara jaanch sakta hai (reflect), koi doosra agent use check kar sakta hai (critique), ya kaam kai baar chalaya ja sakta hai (rerun). Har baar chalane par model call hota hai, isliye time aur paisa lagta hai.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Reflexion mein agent fail hone par sochta hai kya galat hua aur ek seekh likh leta hai, taaki agli baar na dohraye. Jaise exam ke baad galtiyon ki copy banana.
  2. Critic agent doosra agent hai jo pehle agent ka kaam check karke galtiyan batata hai, jaise teacher ka copy check karna.
  3. Tree of Thoughts mein ek hi raasta nahi, kai soch ke raaste (branches) try karte hain aur sabse acha chunte hain, jaise shatranj mein kai chaalein socha jaata hai.
  4. Self-consistency mein wahi sawal kai baar chalate hain aur jo jawab sabse zyada baar aaye wahi lete hain, jaise sab dosto se poochh kar majority ki baat maanna.
🔀 Flowchart: Reflect, critique, rerun patterns
Agent ne ek answer banaya, quality pakki nahi
↓
Pehle fail hua aur lesson lena hai?
HaanReflexion: failure par reflect karo, lesson store karo
NahiDoosra tarika chuno
↓
Critic agent: doosra agent pehle ka kaam review karta hai
↓
Tree of Thoughts: kai reasoning branches explore karo
↓
Self-consistency: kai baar chalao, majority answer lo
↓
Zyada reliable final answer
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Har round tokens aur latency badhata hai, aur self-review wahi galti ko aur pakka kar sakta hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Same labelled test set par reflection ko single pass se compare karo, aur har extra round se quality gain naapo.
  • Cost track karo: extra tokens, latency, aur loop kitni baar max rounds tak pahunchta hai ya converge nahi karta.
Architect notes
  • External signal ke bina self-judgement kamzor hota hai, kyunki wahi model wahi blind spots share karta hai. Tool-based ya independent verification ko prefer karo.
  • Failure modes: endless loops, critic bias, quality oscillation aur cost blow-ups. Budgets aur best-so-far fallback use karo.
  • Reflection ko selectively lagao, jaise low-confidence ya high-stakes outputs par, taaki latency bachi rahe.
  • Har extra round ka uplift cost ke against measure karo. Jab marginal gain chhota ho jaye toh ruk jao.
  • Review mein ablation dikhao jo prove kare ki loop single pass se behtar hai.
193

Agents ke beech tasks route karne aur authority delegate karne ki strategies kya hain?

Q147

Chhota jawab: Router intent ke hisaab se specialist chunta hai; delegation hierarchical, peer-to-peer ya blackboard ho sakti hai.

Aasan shabdon mein

Router har kaam ko sahi specialist ke paas bhejta hai, jaise call-centre ka front desk. ShopBot refund ke sawal billing agent ko bhejta hai.

Aise samjhoYeh railway station ke announcer jaisa hai jo har passenger ko sahi platform par bhejta hai. Kaun kis ka kaam dekhega yeh pehle se tay hota hai.
Pehle yeh samjho'Route' matlab task ko sahi agent ke paas bhejna. 'Intent' matlab user kya chahta hai, 'capability' matlab kaun sa agent kya kar sakta hai. Delegation ke teen tareeke: hierarchical (ek manager baantta hai), peer-to-peer (sab barabar, seedhe baat karte hain), shared blackboard (ek saanjha board jispar sab likhte-padhte hain).
🔀 Flowchart: Task routing aur delegation
ShopBot ko naya task mila
↓
Router intent ya capability dekhta hai
↓
Task sahi specialist agent ke paas bheja
↓
Task bada aur kai hisson ka hai?
HaanManager workers ko delegate karta hai (hierarchical)
NahiSpecialist seedha kaam karta hai
↓
Peer-to-peer ya shared blackboard se bhi delegation ho sakta hai
↓
Sahi agent ko sahi authority
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Central router simple hai lekin bottleneck ban sakta hai; decentralised designs flexible hain lekin debug karna mushkil.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Routing: rules, embeddings ya LLM se intent ya capability classify karo, phir agent ya tool chuno.
  • Delegation styles: hierarchical (manager aur workers), peer-to-peer, ya shared blackboard jise baaki agents padhte aur likhte hain.
Architect notes
  • Routing ko measurable banao: chuna gaya route log karo, labelled set par misroute rate track karo aur fallback ya clarify path rakho.
  • Pehle cheap classifiers use karo aur bada model sirf ambiguous cases ke liye, taaki latency aur cost bache.
  • Delegation mein limited authority pass karo: scoped tokens aur context, kabhi poore user credentials nahi.
  • Failure modes: agents ke beech ping-pong, overlapping capabilities, aur handoff par context lost hona. Hops cap karo aur traces use karo.
  • Review mein topology ko team size, coupling aur audit needs se justify karo.
194

Specialised agents shared task par coordinate kaise karte hain?

Q148

Chhota jawab: Specialists ko clear roles, shared protocol, shared state aur ek supervisor ke saath coordinate karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Alag skills wale agents ko roles aur ek boss chahiye, jaise party ke liye caterer, decorator aur music. ShopBot ke order, payment aur delivery agents har ek ek hissa sambhalte hain.

Aise samjhoYeh shaadi ke kaam mein catering, decoration aur music ke alag log jaisa hai. Ek manager sabko jodta hai taaki kaam na takraye.
Pehle yeh samjhohar agent ko pata ho ki wo kya lega (input) aur kya dega (output). Baat karne ke tareeke: message queue (messages ki line), shared state (saanjha notebook) ya events (signal). Supervisor ek manager agent hai jo jhagda ya bar-bar-ghoomne wale loop ko roke.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Har agent ka kaam aur uska input/output pehle se tay ho, jaise factory mein har worker ka station tay hota hai.
  2. Agents ek doosre se message queue (line mein messages), shared state (saanjha notebook) ya events (ghanti jaisa signal) ke zariye baat karte hain.
  3. Supervisor ek manager agent hai jo jhagde sulajhata hai aur agents ko bar bar ghoomne (loop) se rokta hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Agents ka coordination
Ek shared task, kai specialised agents
↓
Har agent ka clear role aur inputs/outputs tay karo
↓
Message queue, shared state ya events se baat karwao
↓
Conflict ya loop ban raha hai?
HaanSupervisor conflict resolve karke loop rokta hai
NahiAgents apna kaam jaari rakhte hain
↓
Task milke poora
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Zyada agents matlab zyada coordination overhead, tokens aur failure points.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Har agent ke roles aur outputs define karo, aur ek supervisor rakho jo assign kare, collect kare aur conflicts resolve kare.
  • Free-form chat ki jagah structured messages ya shared state se communicate karo, taaki ambiguity kam ho.
Architect notes
  • Agents ke beech typed contracts (schemas) prefer karo, taaki outputs validate hon aur errors boundary par hi dikh jayein.
  • Shared state ko dhyaan se handle karo: conflicting writes se bachne ke liye locks ya versioning, aur idempotent actions.
  • Cost aur loops ko budgets, max turns aur final answer ke ek hi owner se control karo.
  • Har message ko correlation IDs ke saath trace karo. End-to-end success, handoff failures aur per-agent contribution measure karo.
  • Review mein poocho ki kya ek single agent yeh kaam kar leta.
195

Retry, fallback aur error handling se tool calls ko reliable kaise banate ho?

Q149

Chhota jawab: Transient errors ko backoff ke saath retry karo, alternatives par fall back karo, outputs validate karo, aur clearly fail karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Tools kabhi kabhi fail hote hain, toh agent dobara try karta hai, doosra rasta leta hai ya clear error dikhata hai. Agar delivery-status service down hai, toh ShopBot imaandari se bata deta hai.

Aise samjhoYeh train miss hone par bus pakadne jaisa hai. Pehle dobara try karo, nahi to doosra raasta lo, aur sabko batao kya hua.
Pehle yeh samjhotool call kabhi-kabhi kuch der ke liye fail hoti hai. Timeout matlab intezaar ka time khatam, 429 matlab bahut zyada requests, 503 matlab service busy. Ye temporary errors hain, to kuch der ruk ke dobara try (retry) karo. Exponential backoff matlab har retry se pehle pehle se zyada ruko (1 sec, phir 2, phir 4). Jitter matlab thoda random farq, taaki sab ek saath dobara na tutein. Partial answer matlab jitna ban gaya utna adhura jawab.
🔀 Flowchart: Tool call ko reliable banana
Tool call ek error ke saath fail hua
↓
Error temporary hai? (timeout, 429, 503)
HaanRetry karo: exponential backoff + jitter
NahiRetry mat karo, seedha fallback
↓
Retries ke baad bhi fail?
HaanFallback: alternate tool, cache, partial answer ya human
NahiNormal result use karo
↓
Har failure inputs ke saath log karo
↓
Reliable tool use aur aasan debugging
Call tool -> ok? -- yes --> continue
              | no
          temporary? -- yes --> retry with backoff
              | no
          fallback / ask human
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Retries latency badhate hain aur side effects duplicate kar sakte hain, jab tak actions idempotent na ho.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Sirf transient errors (timeouts, 429, 5xx) retry karo, exponential backoff with jitter aur max attempt count ke saath.
  • Fallbacks: backup tool, cached data ya degraded answer. Baar baar fail hone wali services ke liye circuit breaker use karo.
Architect notes
  • Write actions ko idempotency keys se idempotent banao, warna retries se double-charge ya double-send ho sakta hai.
  • Errors classify karo: retry, arguments repair, fallback ya escalate. 4xx validation errors ko andhadhund retry mat karo.
  • Har task par timeouts aur total budgets set karo, taaki retries latency aur cost limits se bahar na jayein.
  • Har tool ka error rate, retry rate aur fallback usage monitor karo, aur circuit breaker trips par alert lagao.
  • Review mein har tool ke liye failure matrix dikhao, chuni hui response ke saath.
196

Short-term vs long-term memory kaise implement aur manage karte ho?

Q150

Chhota jawab: Short-term context window hai; long-term ek external store hai jo zaroorat par retrieve hota hai, pruning ke saath.

Aasan shabdon mein

Short-term memory current chat hai, jaise phone ki RAM. Long-term memory saved storage hai. ShopBot is chat ko yaad rakhta hai, aur baad mein saved notes se aapka usual size.

Aise samjhoYeh mobile ke RAM aur storage jaisa hai. RAM mein abhi ka kaam chalta hai, storage mein purani cheezein save rehti hain.
Pehle yeh samjhoshort-term memory abhi ki baatchit ki hoti hai, aur chhoti hoti hai. Jab wo bahut lambi ho jaye (overflow), to purani baatein trim ya summarise karte hain, yani sirf aakhri kuch baatein (sliding window) rakhte hain aur baaki ka chhota saar. Long-term memory database mein key facts (jaise 'user ko shakkar nahi chahiye') likhkar rakhi jaati hai, jise baad ki baatchit mein dhoondh kar use karte hain.
🔀 Flowchart: Short-term vs long-term memory
ShopBot ko user ki baat yaad rakhni hai
↓
Sirf abhi ki conversation ke liye?
HaanShort-term: context window mein rakho
NahiLong-term: database ya vector store mein save karo
↓
Short-term memory lambi ho to summarise ya trim karo
↓
Long-term mein purani aur duplicate cheezein saaf karo
↓
Zarurat par relevant memory retrieve karke context mein daalo
↓
Agent ko sahi yaad, sahi waqt par
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Zyada memory se personalisation badhta hai, lekin retrieval noise, cost aur privacy risk bhi badhta hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Short-term: context window mein recent messages, jo bharne par trim ya summarise hote hain.
  • Long-term: facts aur past episodes ek vector ya key-value store mein, jo zaroorat par relevance se retrieve hote hain.
Architect notes
  • Memory writes ko ek governed pipeline ki tarah treat karo: extract, deduplicate, importance score, aur expire. Unbounded stores retrieval kharab kar dete hain.
  • Privacy: sirf zaroori cheez store karo, users ko memories dekhne aur delete karne do, aur user ya tenant ke hisaab se isolate karo.
  • Retrieval failures stale ya galat facts ki tarah dikhte hain. Memory retrieval ka recall aur precision evaluate karo, sirf final answers nahi.
  • Summaries mein detail kho jati hai, isliye key facts verbatim rakho aur source se link karo.
  • Review mein retention policy batao aur yeh bhi ki conflicts kaise resolve hote hain.
197

Multi-agent system design karne mein sabse mushkil parts kaun se hain?

Q151

Chhota jawab: Sabse mushkil parts: coordination, shared state, error propagation, cost, debugging aur agents ke beech security.

Aasan shabdon mein

Bahut saare agents saath mein ek doosre ko confuse kar sakte hain, jaise ek kitchen mein bahut saare cooks. ShopBot ke agents shayad sab ek hi order refund karne lag jayein.

Aise samjhoYeh ek kitchen mein bahut saare cook jaisa hai. Agar koordination nahi to ek hi cheez do baar banti hai ya koi kaam chhut jata hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoOverhead matlab kaam ke saath lagne wala extra bojh, jaise agents ke beech message bhejne mein lagne wala time aur paisa.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Shared state matlab sab agents ek hi data use karte hain. Do agents ek saath badlein to race condition hoti hai, jaise do log ek saath ek hi seat book kar lein.
  2. Do agents alag alag faisla le lein to system confuse ho jaata hai, jaise ek ne order confirm kiya aur doosre ne cancel.
  3. Deadlock matlab agent A, B ka wait kare aur B, A ka, dono atak jaate hain, jaise do gaadiyan tang gali mein aamne saamne.
  4. Agents ke beech zyada baat chit se time aur paisa dono badhte hain.
  5. Kai agents mein galti kahan hui pata karna mushkil hai, isliye traces (har step ka record) chahiye.
  6. Kai agents kai model calls karte hain, to bill tezi se badh sakta hai, isliye kharch par control chahiye.
🔀 Flowchart: Multi-agent ki mushkilein
Kai agents ek saath chal rahe hain
↓
Shared state par race condition ban sakti hai
↓
Agents ke decisions aapas mein conflict karte hain
↓
Ek doosre ka wait karke deadlock ho sakta hai
↓
Communication se cost aur overhead badhta hai
↓
Traces aur cost control se debug aur sambhaalo
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Coordination: unclear roles, duplicated work, conflicting actions aur endless back-and-forth.
  • Errors agents ke beech travel karte hain, aur ek galat output agla agent ka trusted input ban jata hai.
Architect notes
  • Ek agent se shuru karo aur tabhi split karo jab context, tools ya permissions justify karein. Kai systems workflows ki tarah simple ho jate hain.
  • Typed handoffs, clear ownership wali shared state, aur hop aur budget limits use karo taaki loops bounded rahein.
  • Security: agents ek doosre mein instructions inject kar sakte hain. Inter-agent messages validate karo aur har agent ki permissions scope karo.
  • Observability zaroori hai: agents ke across distributed traces, aur failed runs ka replay.
  • Single-agent baseline ke against measure karo, taaki prove ho ki extra complexity ka fayda hai.
198

Do agents ne ek hi last conference room book kar diya. Aap kya karoge?

Q155

Chhota jawab: Yeh race condition hai: locks ya atomic check-and-book se fix karo, saath mein idempotency aur clear conflict reply.

Aasan shabdon mein

Do agents ne ek hi time par room ko free dekha aur dono ne book kar liya. Fix yeh hai ki room lock karo, ya check aur book ek hi step mein karo.

Aise samjhoYe aisa hai jaise do dost ek hi waqt par last railway ticket dekhein aur dono book kar dein. Seat ek hi hai, to ek ko seat nahi milti.
Pehle yeh samjhooptimistic locking matlab maan kar chalo ki jhagda nahi hoga, aur save karte waqt version number dekho; badla hua ho to dobara try karo. Pessimistic locking (mutex) matlab pehle hi taala laga do, doosre ko intezaar karna padega. Central booking queue matlab saari booking requests ek line mein ek-ek karke hoti hain.
🔀 Flowchart: Do bookings ek room par
Agent A aur Agent B ne ek saath room check kiya
↓
Dono ko 'available' dikha (race condition)
↓
Dono ne book kar diya, double booking
↓
Fix: booking ke time lock ya atomic check lagao
↓
Room abhi bhi free hai?
HaanPehle wale ko booking confirm
NahiDoosre ko room taken bataya, alternate do
↓
Ek room, ek hi booking
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Locks waiting badhate hain aur timeouts chahiye, taaki crashed agent room ko hamesha ke liye block na kare.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Cause: check-then-act, jisme check aur booking ke beech gap hai, ek race condition.
  • Fix: booking system mein check-and-book ko atomic banao, ya pehle lock ya reservation lo.
Architect notes
  • Guarantee system of record mein rakho: unique constraints, transactions ya compare-and-set, agent prompts mein nahi.
  • Version numbers ke saath optimistic concurrency use karo, aur idempotency keys taaki retries double book na karein.
  • Expiry wale lock leases deadlocks se bachate hain jab koi agent mar jata hai. Failure paths mein locks release karo.
  • Concurrent simulations se test karo aur double-booking aur conflict rates track karo.
  • Review mein kaho ki jo database ko enforce karna hai, woh agents chat se coordinate nahi kar sakte.
199

"Mere boss ko ek gusse wala email bhejo." Kya agent ko ye karna chahiye?

Q157

Chhota jawab: Haan, woh angry email likh sakta hai, lekin user draft dekh kar confirm na kare tab tak send nahi karna chahiye, aur ek calmer version bhi offer karna chahiye.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agent gusse wali email likh sakta hai lekin use turant send nahi karna chahiye. Ek achhe dost ki tarah woh kehta hai, 'Pehle isse thoda calm bana dete hain.'

Aise samjhoJaise ek achha dost tumhe gusse mein message bhejne se pehle rokta hai aur kehta hai: 'Ruk, main isse thoda professional bana deta hoon.' Faisla tumhara, par wo aankh band nahi karta.
Pehle yeh samjhoagent ko user ki madad karni hai par dusron ko nuksaan nahi pahunchana. Audit trail matlab sab kaam ka record. 'Laparwah nahi' matlab agent bina soche-samjhe aankh band karke na kare; risk bataye. Agar dhamki ya harassment ho to seedha mana (hard block).
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Agent user ko bataye ki gusse wala email nuksaan kar sakta hai, aur uski jagah shaant lekin saaf, professional draft offer kare.
  2. Dhamki, harassment ya kanooni risk wale emails ko bilkul rok do (hard block), koi chhoot nahi.
  3. Audit trail matlab sab kaam ka record rakho, taaki baad mein pata chale kya hua.
  4. Aakhri faisla user ka hai, par agent bina soche samjhe aankh band karke na kare, use risk dikhana chahiye.
🔀 Flowchart: Gusse wala email: kya karein
User ne kaha: boss ko gusse wala email bhejo
↓
Harassment, threat ya legal risk hai?
HaanHard block: mana karo
NahiAage badho
↓
Risk ke baare mein warn karo
↓
Firm, professional draft offer karo
↓
Audit trail mein record rakho
↓
User decide karta hai, agent laparwah nahi
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

User ki autonomy ka respect versus aisa action rokna jiska baad mein pachtawa ho aur jo wapas na ho sake.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Draft likhna theek hai, lekin irreversible message bhejne ke liye explicit confirmation chahiye.
  • Draft dikhao, risky wording batao, aur softer version offer karo, final choice user par chhodte hue.
Architect notes
  • Drafting ko sending se alag rakho: sending ek high-impact tool call hai jo human approval se gated hona chahiye.
  • Policy: lawful content ke liye autonomy ka respect karo, threats aur harassment ke liye safety filters lagao, aur confirmation log karo.
  • Sends ke liye delay ya undo window sochho, jo ek cheap, reversible control hai.
  • Reviewed sample mein confirmation rates, user regret signals aur policy violations measure karo.
  • Review mein ise least surprise ki tarah frame karo: jo kaha gaya woh karo, lekin ambiguous emotion par kabhi irreversibly nahi.
200

Agent 15 seconds leta hai. Business ko 2 seconds se kam chahiye. Aap kya karoge?

Q158

Chhota jawab: Pehle profile karo, phir steps kaato: parallelise, cache, chhote models, stream, aur kaam critical path se hatao.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agent 15 seconds leta hai aur hamein 2 chahiye. Ek ki jagah do cooks ki tarah, independent steps ek saath karo aur unneeded steps skip karo.

Aise samjhoJaise dhaba mein ek hi aadmi roti bhi sekta hai, sabzi bhi banata hai. Do aadmi alag-alag kaam parallel karein aur ready cheezein pehle se rakhein to order jaldi aa jata hai.
Pehle yeh samjho15 second ka time kai model calls aur tools ka sum hota hai. Pehle dekho kaun sa step sabse zyada time kha raha hai, phir usi ko tez karo: chhota model, ek saath (parallel) chalna, cache, aur jawab ko stream karna.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Aasaan steps ke liye chhota, tez model lagao. Bada model sirf mushkil kaam ke liye.
  2. Jo tools ek doosre par depend nahi karte unhe ek saath chalao, jaise teen dukaano par teen log ek saath bhejna.
  3. Cache matlab pichla jawab yaad rakhna. Wahi tool result dobara chahiye to dobara na mangao.
  4. ReAct matlab agent sochta hai phir tool chalata hai, har baar. Jo kaam pehle se pata hai uske liye fixed steps ka workflow bana do, to sochne ke steps bach jaate hain.
  5. Streaming matlab pura jawab ruk kar nahi, jitna ban gaya utna turant dikhana. User ko lagta hai jaldi hai.
🔀 Flowchart: 15 second se 2 second
Agent 15 second leta hai, target 2 second
↓
Dekho kaun se steps time kha rahe hain
↓
Step aasan hai?
HaanChhota model use karo
NahiBada model rakho
↓
Independent tools parallel chalao, repeated results cache karo
↓
Known tasks ke liye fixed workflow, ReAct steps kam karo
↓
Partial output stream karo
↓
User ko jaldi jawab
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Faster options quality kam kar sakte hain, isliye har change ke baad accuracy check karo.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Trace profile karke dekho time kahan ja raha hai: model calls, tools ya retrieval.
  • Independent tool calls parallel chalao, repeated results cache karo aur prompt trim karo.
Architect notes
  • 2 seconds ko har stage ka budget maano, aur average nahi, p95 latency measure karo. Sequential LLM calls aam taur par main cost hoti hain.
  • LLM hops ki sankhya kam karo: kuch ko rules ya ek structured call se replace karo, prompt caching aur speculative steps use karo.
  • Non-essential kaam (logging, memory writes, enrichment) ko critical path se hatao aur asynchronously karo.
  • Agar target pahunch se bahar hai, toh experience redesign karo: turant acknowledge karo aur background mein complete karo.
  • Review mein before aur after latency waterfall dikhao, saath mein accuracy regression check.
201

1,000 interactions ke baad responses repetitive ho jaate hain. Aap kya karoge?

Q159

Chhota jawab: Memory saturation: entries deduplicate, consolidate, score aur expire karo, aur retrieval ko diversify karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Memory ek hi cheez ki copies se bhar gayi, jaise notebook jisme ek hi answer 50 baar likha ho. Use saaf karke sirf useful entries rakhni chahiye.

Aise samjhoJaise ek student ki copy mein ek hi answer 50 baar likha ho. Jab bhi page kholo wahi dikhta hai, naya kuch yaad nahi aata.
Pehle yeh samjhomemory mein lagbhag ek jaisi entries (near-duplicates) jama hoti jaati hain. Phir search mein wahi baar baar upar aati hain, to jawab repetitive lagte hain. Isse 'saturation' kehte hain. Fix: duplicates ko hatao ya jodo (prune/merge), alag-alag memories uthao (MMR), aur purani memories ko expiry do.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Memory mein jo baatein dohrai hui ya milti julti hain unhe hata do ya ek mein jod do, taaki ek jaisa hi na nikle.
  2. MMR (Maximal Marginal Relevance) matlab aisi memories chuno jo relevant bhi hon aur ek doosre se alag bhi. Isse jawab mein variety aati hai.
  3. Purani memories ki expiry date rakho, taaki wo auto hat jayein, jaise purane dahi ki expiry.
🔀 Flowchart: Memory saturation ka fix
1,000 interactions ke baad jawab repetitive
↓
Memory store near-duplicates se bhar gaya
↓
Retrieval baar-baar wahi wale uthata hai
↓
Duplicates ko prune aur merge karo
↓
Memory purani ho gayi hai?
HaanExpiry lagake hata do
NahiRakho
↓
Diverse retrieval (MMR) use karo
↓
Alag-alag aur taaza jawab
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Aggressive pruning rare lekin important facts delete kar sakti hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Cause: store mein bahut saare near-duplicates hain, isliye har baar wahi retrieve hote hain.
  • Fix: write par deduplicate karo, similar items ko summaries mein merge karo, aur stale ko expire karo.
Architect notes
  • Write-time gating jodo: existing memories se similarity check, phir insert ki jagah update karo.
  • Importance, recency aur usage score karo, aur scheduled consolidation jobs chalao, deleted items restore karne ka tarika rakhte hue.
  • Repetition prompt ya low temperature se bhi aa sakti hai. Memory off karke test karke check karo.
  • Store size, duplicate ratio, retrieval diversity aur outputs par repetition metric ko time ke saath monitor karo.
  • Review mein memory lifecycle dikhao: write, merge, decay aur delete, aur request par privacy deletion.
202

Planner, Executor aur Critic: Critic hamesha reject karta hai, koi progress nahi. Aap kya karoge?

Q163

Chhota jawab: Critic ko explicit pass criteria, round cap aur arbiter do, taaki loop khatam ho.

Aasan shabdon mein

Checker har baar no bolta hai, jaise strict teacher jo har copy fail kar de, isliye kuch aage nahi badhta. Hamein clear marking rules aur tries ki limit chahiye.

Aise samjhoEk strict teacher jo har baar copy cut kar de aur kabhi pass na kare. Isliye marking ka clear scheme chahiye aur ek limit ki 3 baar ke baad kaam accept ya principal ko escalate.
Pehle yeh samjhoPlanner plan banata hai, Executor kaam karta hai, Critic check karta hai. Agar Critic kabhi khush nahi hota to kaam aage nahi badhta. Fix: Critic ko marks wali list (rubric) do aur limit rakho ki itne rounds ke baad ya to accept karo ya kisi insaan ko bhej do.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Revision limit matlab maximum kitni baar kaam dobara ho sakta hai. Uske baad loop band.
  2. Critic ko sirf pasand nahi pasand na kehne do. Use scoring rubric (marks ki list) do, jaise teacher marking scheme se copy check karta hai.
  3. Har round mein kaam behtar hua ya nahi ye dekho, taaki pata chale mehnat ka fayda hai.
  4. Score threshold (minimum marks) par kar jaaye to good enough maan lo, ya kisi insaan ko de do.
🔀 Flowchart: Critic ka reject loop
Planner aur Executor ne kaam kiya, Critic ne reject kiya
↓
Phir wahi rounds, koi progress nahi
↓
Critic ko vague pasand ki jagah scoring rubric do
↓
Revision limit set karo, rounds ke beech progress track karo
↓
Score threshold ke upar hai?
HaanGood enough: accept karo
NahiLimit ke baad human ko escalate karo
↓
Loop band, kaam aage
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Lenient critic errors nikalne deta hai; strict wala atak jata hai, isliye examples par tune karo.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Cause: vague ya impossible criteria, ya aisa critic prompt jo galtiyan dhundhne ki taraf biased hai.
  • Fix: measurable pass conditions wala rubric do, aur aisi critique jo specific, fixable issues list kare.
Architect notes
  • Critic ko human-labelled achhe aur bure outputs ke against calibrate karo aur uska rejection rate, false-reject rate aur round counts track karo.
  • Opinion-based critique ki jagah objective checks (tests, schema, citations) prefer karo, kyunki models se problems dhundhne ko kaho toh woh over-criticise karte hain.
  • N rounds ke baad arbiter ya human escalation jodo, aur critic se kaho ki bataye pass hone ke liye kya chahiye.
  • Check karo ki planner ko feedback usable form mein mil raha hai, warna wahi output dobara generate hota rahega.
  • Review mein exit conditions aur cost cap dikhao.
203

20-call wala task paisa kharch karne ke baad call 15 par fail ho jata hai. Retry, roll back, ya give up?

Q164

Chhota jawab: Idempotency aur side effects se decide karo: checkpoint se resume karo, completed steps ko compensate karo, ya escalate karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Step 15 par fail ho gaya jab paisa kharch ho chuka tha, jaise online payment ho gaya lekin order fail. Hum progress save karte hain, phir retry, undo ya stop karte hain.

Aise samjhoJaise online shopping mein payment cut ho gaya par order fail ho gaya. Pehle dekho transaction ka kya hua, phir ya dobara try karo ya refund lo.
Pehle yeh samjhoTemporary error (jaise network ruk gaya) retry se theek ho sakta hai. Business error (jaise 'paisa kam hai') baar-baar try karne se theek nahi hota. Checkpoint matlab save point, taaki 15 se aage chalein. Compensating action matlab ho chuke kaam ko palatne wala kaam (jaise refund). Roll back matlab peeche palat dena, give up matlab chhod dena.
🔀 Flowchart: Call 15 par fail: retry ya rollback
20-call task call 15 par fail hua, paisa kharch ho chuka
↓
Error temporary hai?
HaanRetry karo
NahiBusiness error: retry mat karo
↓
Checkpoint se step 15 se resume karo
↓
Task finish ho sakta hai?
HaanResume karke poora karo
NahiCompensating actions se completed steps undo karo
↓
User ko batao kya hua aur kya nahi
↓
Na adhura kaam, na chhupa nuksan
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Har step ke baad checkpoint save karo taaki restart ki jagah call 15 se resume kar sako.
  • Retry karo agar error transient hai aur steps repeat karne ke liye safe (idempotent) hain.
Architect notes
  • Workflow ko saga ki tarah model karo: har step ka ek compensating action ho, aur state persist ho taaki recovery deterministic rahe.
  • Idempotency keys retry par duplicate charges rokte hain. Errors classify karo: transient, repair se fixable ya permanent.
  • Har task par spend cap karo aur steps ko aise order karo ki costly irreversible wale cheap checks ke baad aakhir mein aayein.
  • Audit aur finance reconciliation ke liye sab kuch log karo. Partial-failure rate aur recovery success measure karo.
  • Review mein decision tree dikhao aur yeh bhi ki manual-intervention case mein kise notify kiya jata hai.
204

Agent B ko Agent A ka customer data chahiye lekin access nahi hai. Aap kya karoge?

Q165

Chhota jawab: Owner agent ya broker ke through route karo, scoped, audited, least-privilege access ke saath.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agent B ko data chahiye lekin permission nahi hai. Hostel ki chaabi ki tarah, B owner se maangta hai, aur owner decide karta hai kya share karna hai.

Aise samjhoJaise hostel ki chaabi seedhe kisi ko nahi dete. Warden ke paas request jaati hai, wo kuch der ka pass deta hai aur register mein likh leta hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoAgent B ko Agent A ka password nahi dena chahiye. Wo ek authorisation service se permission maangta hai. Service dekhti hai ki policy (rules) mein allowed hai ya nahi, aur allowed ho to chhote time ka token deti hai jo jaldi expire ho jaata hai.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Agent B seedhe password ya key le kar nahi, ek authorisation service se permission maange, jo tay karti hai access dena hai ya nahi.
  2. Least privilege matlab sirf utna access jitna zaroori ho. Short-lived token matlab chhote time ki chaabi jo jaldi expire ho jaati hai.
  3. Har access ka record rakho, taaki baad mein pata chale kisne kya dekha.
🔀 Flowchart: Agent B ko data access
Agent B ko Agent A ka customer data chahiye
↓
B authorisation service se request karta hai (credentials share nahi)
↓
Policy ke hisaab se allowed hai?
HaanLeast privilege: short-lived token do
NahiAccess deny karo
↓
Har access ka audit log rakho
↓
Safe, traceable data sharing
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Zyada checks latency badhate hain, lekin data leaks rokte hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Credentials copy mat karo aur agents ke beech raw data seedha share mat karo.
  • B ek specific data piece A ya ek data service ke through maangta hai jo policy check karti hai.
Architect notes
  • Authorization ko data layer par enforce karo jisme end user ki identity propagate ho (on-behalf-of), agent prompt par nahi.
  • Least privilege aur purpose limitation lagao: field-level filtering, PII masking aur short token expiry.
  • Har cross-agent access ko who, what aur why ke saath audit karo. Unusual patterns par alert lagao.
  • Confused-deputy attacks se savdhan raho, jahan low-privilege agent high-privilege agent ko bahka deta hai. Sirf identity nahi, requests bhi validate karo.
  • Review mein trust boundaries aur data-flow diagram dikhao.
205

"Pichle saal ke mere saare emails delete karo." User ka matlab archive tha. Aap kya karoge?

Q166

Chhota jawab: Destructive actions confirm karo, reversible wale prefer karo, aur delete versus archive clarify karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

User ne delete bola lekin matlab archive tha, aur delete undo nahi hota. Agent ko pehle poochna chahiye, jaise kabaad mein kitaabein bechne se pehle check karna.

Aise samjhoJaise koi kehta hai 'ye kitabein hata do' aur tum sab raddi mein bech do, jabki wo bas almari mein rakhwana chahta tha. Pehle poocho aur kuch din dustbin ki jagah ek dabba rakho.
Pehle yeh samjhodelete matlab hamesha ke liye mitana, archive matlab hata ke surakshit rakh dena. User ke shabd se matlab alag ho sakta hai. Isliye pehle intent poochho, kitne emails prabhavit honge dikhao (scope), aur soft delete rakho taaki galti hone par wapas mil sake.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Destructive action (jo wapas na ho) mein user ka asli maksad poochho. Delete aur archive alag cheezein hain.
  2. Karne se pehle dikhao kitna prabhavit hoga, jaise 1,243 emails, taaki user ko andaza ho.
  3. Haan ya confirm saaf shabdon mein maango.
  4. Soft delete matlab cheez asli mein nahi mitti, bas hide hoti hai, aur kuch time tak wapas mil sakti hai (undo window), jaise recycle bin.
🔀 Flowchart: Delete ya archive: confirm karo
User: pichle saal ke saare emails delete karo
↓
Intent clarify karo: delete ya archive?
↓
Scope dikhao: 1,243 emails
↓
User ne explicit confirm kiya?
HaanSoft delete karo, undo window ke saath
NahiKuch mat karo
↓
Irreversible action jitna zyada, confirmation utna zyada
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Confirmation prompts friction badhate hain, isliye unhe destructive ya bulk actions ke liye hi rakho.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Delete ko high-risk maano kyunki woh irreversible hai.
  • Specifics ke saath confirm karo: '2025 ki 4,200 emails permanently delete karni hain, ya archive?'
Architect notes
  • Tools ko reversibility aur blast radius se classify karo. Bulk aur irreversible actions ke liye explicit confirmation chahiye, saath mein dry-run previews jo count dikhayein.
  • Retention period ke saath soft delete implement karo taaki galtiyan recoverable hon, aur bulk operations ko rate-limit karo.
  • Limits ko tool layer mein permissions aur caps se enforce karo, prompt mein nahi.
  • Destructive-action incidents aur confirmation overrides measure karo, aur restores ke liye audit trail rakho.
  • Review mein kaho ki ambiguity plus irreversibility ka matlab hai poocho.
206

Agent ke paas get_customer, update_customer aur delete_customer hain aur wo galti se delete chun leta hai. Aap kya karoge?

S18

Chhota jawab: Descriptions par bharosa mat karo: permissions, confirmations aur role limits ko model ke bahar ek layer mein enforce karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agent ne galti se delete chun liya. Achhi descriptions madad karti hain, lekin humein ek lock bhi chahiye, jaise ATM jo account band karne se pehle extra checks poochta hai.

Aise samjhoJaise ATM mein 'withdraw' aur 'close account' ke buttons paas-paas hon. Bank 'close account' par OTP aur confirm maangta hai, sirf button dabane se kaam nahi hota.
Pehle yeh samjhosirf tool ka naam ya description achha likhne se model kabhi-kabhi galti kar sakta hai. Isliye model ke upar ek alag permission layer rakho jo delete jaise khatarnaak tool ko chalne se pehle confirmation ya insaan ki approval maange. Interview mein bolo: 'Khatarnaak kaam ke liye main model ki samajh par bharosa nahi karunga, ek alag permission check rakhunga.'
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Tools ke inputs aur kaam ko saaf likho (schema), taaki model galti se delete na chun le.
  2. Delete jaise na-palatne-wale kaam ko alag category mein rakho, extra savdhani ke saath.
  3. Aise kaam se pehle user ki confirmation ya kisi insaan ki approval lo.
🔀 Flowchart: Delete tool ki safety
Agent ke paas get, update, delete customer tools hain
↓
Agent ne galti se delete chun liya
↓
Better descriptions help karti hain, kaafi nahi
↓
Tool destructive hai?
HaanConfirmation ya human approval maango
NahiPermission layer se seedha allow
↓
Explicit tool schemas rakho
↓
Model ke judgement par bharosa nahi, permission layer
Agent -> Tool selection -> Permission check
      -> Risk classification -> Human approval -> Tool
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Strict permissions risk kam karte hain lekin jayaz kaam bhi rok sakte hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Names aur descriptions behtar karo taaki tools saaf alag dikhein.
  • Ek permission layer add karo: agent ko sirf wahi tools dikhte hain jo uske role ko allowed hain.
Architect notes
  • Code mein least privilege lagao: scoped credentials, per-role tool allow-lists, aur zarurat na ho to delete rights nahi.
  • Soft delete, dry-run aur undo windows ko prefer karo, aur destructive calls par rate limits lagao.
  • Arguments ko server-side validate karo. Model ka choice sirf ek suggestion hai, aur decision backend ko lena chahiye.
  • Saari calls ka audit-log rakho aur adversarial prompts aur injection attempts se test karo. Blocked-action rates track karo.
  • Review mein kaho ki safety architecture se enforce hoti hai, prompt wording se nahi.
207

Agent baar-baar expensive API calls karta hai. Aap kya karoge?

S19

Chhota jawab: API spend ko caching, budgets, rate limits, batching aur sasti alternatives se control karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agent ek paid service ko baar-baar call karta rehta hai, jaise taxi ka meter chalta rehta hai. Budget set karo aur jo results pehle se fetch ho chuke hain unhe reuse karo.

Aise samjhoJaise taxi mein meter chalta rehta hai. Isliye tum pehle budget tay karte ho aur baar-baar wahi route puchne ki jagah ek baar ka jawab yaad rakhte ho.
Pehle yeh samjhokuch APIs har call par paise leti hain. Isliye wahi call baar-baar na ho: cache se jawab do, rate limit lagao, aur ek task ke liye maximum calls ya paisa tay karo. Idempotency key ek unique ID hai jisse wahi call dobara aaye to system use ek hi baar maane.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Idempotency key ek unique pehchaan hai. Wahi request dobara aaye to system use ek hi baar karta hai, jaise ek hi payment do baar nahi kat-ta.
  2. Caching matlab pichla result yaad rakhna. Rate limiting matlab ek time mein sirf limited calls.
  3. Ek kaam par maximum kitne calls aur kitna kharch ho sakta hai, ye limit lagao.
  4. Duplicate detection matlab wahi call baar baar ho to pakad kar rok do.
🔀 Flowchart: Expensive API calls rokna
Agent baar-baar expensive API call karta hai
↓
Wahi call pehle ho chuki hai?
HaanCache se jawab do (idempotency key se repeat ka asar nahi)
NahiAage badho
↓
Rate limit aur duplicate detection lagao
↓
Per task max calls ya budget cross hua?
HaanTask rok do
NahiJaari rakho
↓
Agent ka budget kabhi unlimited nahi
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Caching purana data de sakti hai, aur tight budgets tasks ko adhoora chhod sakte hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Identical calls ko cache karo aur ek session ke andar results reuse karo.
  • Per-task aur per-user budgets set karo, aur hard stop ke saath rate limits lagao.
Architect notes
  • Har tool ke hisaab se per task cost instrument karo, aur anomalies par alert lagao. Jo measure nahi karte use control nahi kar sakte.
  • Cost-aware planner add karo: calls se pehle cost estimate karo aur ek threshold ke upar approval maango.
  • Circuit breakers aur loop detection runaway calls ko rokte hain. Quotas gateway par set karo, prompts mein nahi.
  • Vendor ke saath batch ya cached endpoints negotiate karo, aur low-value requests ke liye sasta fallback socho.
  • Review mein cost per successful task aur spend cap ka behaviour dikhao.
208

Agent ka plan galat hai. Aap kya karoge?

S20

Chhota jawab: Plan, act, observe, re-plan, replans par limits ke saath aur human ko fallback ke saath.

Aasan shabdon mein

Galat plan ka matlab end nahi hai. Jaise cricket captain Plan B par switch karta hai, agent har step ke baad results check karta hai aur adjust karta hai.

Aise samjhoJaise cricket mein Plan A fail ho jaye to captain field badal deta hai. Par agar wo har ball par plan badalta rahe to match hi nahi chalega.
Pehle yeh samjho'single-shot' matlab sirf ek hi baar plan banana. Asli kaam mein plan loop hota hai: plan, kaam, result dekho, phir zarurat par naya plan. 'Bound' matlab limit, warna agent hamesha plan badalta hi rahega.
🔀 Flowchart: Galat plan ko fix karna
Agent ne ek plan banaya
↓
Pehla step chalaya
↓
Result observe karo
↓
Plan ab bhi sahi chal raha hai?
HaanAgla step chalao
NahiRe-plan karo
↓
Planning single-shot nahi, loop hai
Plan -> Action -> Observation -> Evaluate -> Re-plan
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Baar-baar re-planning adaptability badhati hai lekin zyada time aur tokens leti hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Ek baar plan karke aankh band karke mat chalao. Har step ke baad result dekho aur expectation se compare karo.
  • Agar alag ho, to naye information ke saath bache hue steps ko re-plan karo.
Architect notes
  • Plans ko explicit, structured aur inspectable banao taaki steps validate kar sako, preconditions check kar sako aur changes log kar sako.
  • Re-plan triggers: tool errors, unexpected output ya failed check. Har chhote step ke baad re-plan mat karo.
  • Budgets aur max replan count rakho, phir trace ke saath human ko escalate karo.
  • Plan success, replan rate aur cost per task measure karo, aur failed plans ko prompt ya tool fixes ke liye review karo.
  • Review mein dikhao ki plan drift ko original goal badalne se kaise roka jaata hai.
209

Tumhara agent tests mein chalta hai lekin production mein 30% tasks lose karta hai. Kaaran kaise dhundhoge?

S72

Chhota jawab: Test aur production traffic compare karo, failures trace karo, unhe categorise karo, aur apne evals mein daalo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Practice mein full marks aaye par asli exam mein fail ho raha hai. Real users alag cheezein poochte hain, isliye real failures dekhte hain.

Aise samjhoJaise ghar par practice mein tum 100 mein se 100 maarte ho par match mein tension aur alag pitch par chook jaate ho. Dekhna padta hai asli match mein kya alag tha.
Pehle yeh samjho30% matlab 100 mein se 30 kaam fail ho rahe hain. Trace matlab har step ka record (plan, kaunsa tool, kaunse inputs, kya result, kitne tokens). Outage matlab koi service band thi. Flaky API matlab jo kabhi chalti kabhi nahi. Sabse badi category theek karo, phir fail hue kaam dobara chalake (replay) dekho ki theek hua ya nahi.
🔀 Flowchart: Production failure ka kaaran
Tests mein theek, production mein 30% tasks fail
↓
Har step trace karo: plan, tool, arguments, result, tokens
↓
Failures ko label karo: planning, wrong tool, bad arguments, outage
↓
Ek category sabse badi hai?
HaanUsko fix karo (jaise vague descriptions)
NahiAur data se traces dekho
↓
Fix ke baad failed traces dobara replay karo
↓
Confirm hua ki failure kam hua
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Zyada logging debugging mein help karti hai par privacy aur storage concerns badhati hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Production traces collect karo aur failed tasks ko cause se tag karo: wrong tool, bad retrieval, timeout ya bad input.
  • Real inputs ko test set se compare karo taaki missing cases mil sakein, jaise typos ya lambi chats.
Architect notes
  • Distribution shift, tool ya API variance, latency timeouts, context length aur rate limits pe shak karo jo tests ne exercise nahi kiye.
  • Sampled traces se failure taxonomy banao aur frequency times impact se rank karo, taaki kuch fix karne se pehle 30% ka attribution ho jaye.
  • Failed production runs ko staging mein replay karo, model aur tool versions pin karke.
  • Online monitoring aur feedback loop lagao: naye failures regression tests ban jaate hain.
  • Review mein causes ka Pareto chart aur har fix ka expected gain dikhao.
210

Ek long-running agent task (30 minutes) beech mein crash ho jata hai. Resume kaise karoge?

S74

Chhota jawab: Har step ke baad state persist karo idempotent actions ke saath, taaki crash ke baad checkpoint se resume ho.

Aasan shabdon mein

Video game ke save point ki tarah, agent progress save karta hai taaki crash ke baad wahi se continue kare jahan ruka tha, shuru se nahi.

Aise samjhoJaise video game mein save point hota hai. Console band ho jaye to bhi wahi level se khelte ho, poora game nahi dobara khelna padta.
Pehle yeh samjhoDurable state matlab progress aisi jagah (database) save ho jo crash ke baad bhi bachi rahe. Isse restart par last save point se shuru kar sakte hain. Interview mein bolo: 'Lambe kaam ke liye progress database mein save karo, warna har crash par kaam shuru se karna padega.'
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Har step ke baad progress (state aur checkpoints) database mein save karo, memory mein nahi, kyunki crash par memory ud jaati hai. Jaise game mein save point.
  2. Idempotent matlab kaam dobara chalane par bhi asar ek hi baar ho. Isse resume par email do baar nahi jaayegi ya paisa do baar nahi katega.
  3. Aise workflow engine ya graph runtime lo jo state ko khud save aur wapas la sake.
  4. User ko dikhao kaam kahan tak pahuncha aur cancel karne ka option do.
🔀 Flowchart: Crash ke baad resume
30 minute ka agent task beech mein crash hua
↓
Har step ke baad state database mein save thi (memory mein nahi)
↓
Restart par last checkpoint se load karo
↓
Idempotent tool calls: side effects repeat nahi hote
↓
User ko progress dikhao, cancel ka option do
↓
Task bina restart ke aage badhta hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Checkpointing se storage aur har step pe thoda overhead badhta hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Har step ke baad checkpoint save karo: plan, completed steps, results aur pending work.
  • Restart pe last checkpoint load karo aur agle step se continue karo.
Architect notes
  • In-memory state ki jagah durable store ya workflow engine use karo (jaise durable execution), clear step state machine ke saath.
  • Idempotency keys aur action se pehle intent record karne se 'kar diya' aur 'save kiya' ke beech ka crash handle hota hai.
  • Resume pe stale state ka plan rakho: jo external facts badal sakte hain unhe dobara check karo, aur maximum age set karo.
  • Crashed runs detect karne ke liye heartbeat aur timeouts lagao, aur resume failures pe alert karo.
  • Resume success rate aur wasted work measure karo. Review mein failure injection tests dikhao.

Frameworks: AI Apps ke liye LEGO Sets

211

CrewAI tasks aur workflows ke through role-based collaboration ko kaise structure karta hai?

Q174

Chhota jawab: Tasks owner, order, context aur output tay karte hain; process (sequential ya hierarchical) tay karta hai ki coordination kaun kare, aur CrewAI Flows crews ke upar code-controlled workflows jodte hain.

Aasan shabdon mein

Kaam relay race ki tarah bantta hai: ek agent khatam kare toh uska result agle ko jata hai. Ek manager bhi tasks baant sakta hai.

Aise samjhoJaise assembly line ya relay race: ek ka kaam khatam hota hai to wo doosre ko baton deta hai. Kabhi ek captain bhi hota hai jo kaam baant deta hai.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Task dependency matlab ek task ko doosre ka result chahiye, jaise pehle research phir uska summary likhna.
  2. Sequential matlab line se. Hierarchical matlab ek manager agent kaam doosron ko delegate karta hai (saupta hai).
  3. Memory agents ko baat yaad rakhne deti hai, aur defined output format se result hamesha tay shakal mein aata hai.
🔀 Flowchart: CrewAI workflow structure
Role-based team ka plan
↓
Task A pehle chalta hai
↓
Task B, task A ka output use karta hai (dependency)
↓
Manager agent delegate kare?
HaanHierarchical process
NahiSequential process
↓
Memory types aur output format tay karo
↓
Saaf, order mein collaboration
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Sequential predictable hai; hierarchical flexible hai lekin cost aur unpredictability badhata hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Har task ka ek owner agent, expected output, aur pichle tasks se optional context hota hai.
  • Sequential process tasks ko order mein chalata hai aur outputs aage deta hai. Hierarchical process mein ek manager agent delegate aur review karta hai.
Architect notes
  • Task outputs ko structured (schemas) banao taaki downstream tasks ko reliable input mile, aur steps ke beech validate karo.
  • Manager agents galat delegate kar sakte hain ya loop mein phans sakte hain. Iterations cap karo aur delegation decisions log karo.
  • Jahan tasks independent hain wahan parallel tasks use karo, latency kam karne ke liye, aur final step mein merge karo.
  • Per-task success, handoff errors aur cost per workflow measure karo.
  • Review mein poocho ki kya fixed pipeline kaafi hota, kyunki use test karna aasaan hai.
212

Production mein agent performance ko optimise kaise karoge?

Q176

Chhota jawab: Production mein caching, parallel calls, easy steps ke liye chhote models, aur tracing-led tuning se optimise karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agent ko fast, cheap aur correct banao, jaise kitchen jahan pyaaz pehle se kati hui hai aur do chefs hain. ShopBot purane answers reuse kar sakta hai.

Aise samjhoJaise kitchen mein pehle se kata hua pyaaz, do chef ek saath, aur chhoti cheezein chhoti kadhai mein. Order jaldi nikalta hai aur gas kam lagti hai.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Jo jawab aur prompts baar baar aate hain unhe cache karo, taaki dobara model na chalana pade.
  2. Prompt mein sirf kaam ki baat rakho, kyunki zyada text se kharch aur time dono badhte hain.
  3. Jo tool calls ek doosre par depend nahi karte unhe ek saath chalao.
  4. Model routing matlab aasaan kaam chhote sasta model ko, mushkil kaam bade model ko.
  5. Tool descriptions saaf hon to agent galat tool nahi chunta aur time bachta hai.
  6. Streaming matlab jawab ban-ta jaaye aur dikhta jaaye, to user ko intezaar kam lagta hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Production agent optimise karna
Production agent dheema ya mehnga hai
↓
Results aur prompts cache karo
↓
Context chhota rakho
↓
Step aasan hai?
HaanModel routing: chhota model
NahiBada model
↓
Independent tool calls parallel chalao, streaming do
↓
Tez, sasta, sahi tool chunne wala agent
Trade-off

Har optimisation quality kam kar sakti hai, isliye evals chalate raho.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Prompts aur results cache karo, aur context ko jitna zaroori ho utna trim karo.
  • Independent calls parallel chalao aur output jaldi stream karo.
Architect notes
  • Traces se shuru karo: sabse slow aur costly steps dhundo, phir unhe optimise karo, andaze se nahi.
  • LLM hops kam karo, non-urgent kaam ke liye batch ya async use karo, aur stable prefixes ke liye prompt caching lagao.
  • Budgets, timeouts aur fallbacks set karo, aur averages ke saath p95 aur p99 latency bhi dekho.
  • Har change par regression evals se quality guard karo, aur cost per successful task track karo.
  • Review mein har change ke before aur after numbers dikhao.
213

LangGraph, LangChain ko graph-based workflows ke liye kaise extend karta hai?

Q178

Chhota jawab: LangGraph agents ko stateful graphs ki tarah model karta hai, jisme loops, branches, checkpoints aur human-in-the-loop pauses hote hain.

Aasan shabdon mein

Aap agent ko metro map ki tarah draw karte ho: stations steps hain aur lines paths. Woh loop kar sakta hai, branch kar sakta hai aur human ka wait kar sakta hai.

Aise samjhoJaise metro ka map: stations nodes hain aur lines edges. Tum kisi station par ruk sakte ho, doosri line le sakte ho, aur circle line mein ghoom bhi sakte ho.
Pehle yeh samjhoGraph matlab dots (nodes) aur unhe jodti lines (edges). Har node ek step hai. Edge batati hai ki ab kahan jana hai. Isse loop aur branches banana aasan hota hai.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Persisted state matlab agent kahan tak pahuncha ye save hota hai. Checkpoint ek save point hai jahan se kaam dobara shuru ho sakta hai.
  2. Cycle matlab graph mein wapas pichle step par ja sakte hain (retry). Conditional edge matlab agla step condition par depend karta hai, jaise result sahi to aage, nahi to wapas.
  3. Human-in-the-loop matlab beech mein kaam rukta hai aur insaan approve karta hai, phir aage badhta hai.
  4. Multi-agent orchestration matlab kai agents ko ek graph mein jodna aur unka coordination sambhalna.
🔀 Flowchart: LangGraph ka graph
Agent ko graph ki tarah describe karo
↓
Nodes steps hain, edges transitions hain
↓
Condition poori hui?
HaanConditional edge se agle node par
NahiCycle: pichle node par wapas loop
↓
State save hoti hai (checkpoints)
↓
Zarurat par human ke liye pause
↓
Branch, loop aur multi-agent workflow
            START
              |
           Planner
          /       \
      Search      Tool
          \       /
          Validator
              |
             END
Trade-off

Zyada control aur structure, lekin simple agent loop se zyada design ka kaam.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Nodes functions ya LLM steps hain, aur edges transitions hain, conditional wale bhi.
  • Ek shared state object graph mein flow karta hai aur har node use update karta hai.
Architect notes
  • Explicit graphs control flow ko testable aur auditable banate hain, jo production aur regulated flows ke liye fit hai.
  • Persistence se crashes ke baad resume, time travel debugging aur human approvals possible hote hain. Durable checkpoint store chuno.
  • State growth, state schema ke version migrations aur kabhi khatam na hone wale cycles par nazar rakho. Recursion limits jodo.
  • Per node trace karo aur node-level latency, error rate aur path frequency measure karo.
  • Review mein graph dikhao aur yeh bhi ki humans kahan intervene karte hain.
214

Haystack modular, production-ready RAG ko kaise support karta hai?

Q179

Chhota jawab: Haystack RAG ko typed pipelines mein swappable components se banata hai, jo production aur testing ke liye fit hai.

Aasan shabdon mein

Yeh parts ki assembly line hai: store, retriever, prompt builder, generator. Ek part swap kar sakte ho bina sab dobara banaye.

Aise samjhoJaise ek assembly line jisme har machine alag hai: ek kaatti hai, ek rangta hai, ek pack karti hai. Kisi ko badalna ho to baaki line nahi todni padti.
Pehle yeh samjhoDocument store woh jagah hai jahan documents rakhe hain. Retriever sahi tukde dhoondhta hai. Prompt builder sawal aur tukde jodta hai. Generator (model) jawab likhta hai. Har part alag hai, isliye kisi ko badalna aasan hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Haystack pipeline
User ka sawaal aaya
↓
Retriever document store se chunks lata hai
↓
Prompt builder sawaal aur chunks jodta hai
↓
Generator jawab likhta hai
↓
Swappable components se production-ready RAG
Trade-off

Quick frameworks se zyada explicit setup, lekin zyada clear aur evaluate karna aasaan.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Document stores, retrievers, rankers, prompt builders aur generators jaise components ek pipeline mein jude hote hain.
  • Har component ke typed inputs aur outputs hote hain, isliye connections check hote hain.
Architect notes
  • Modularity se aap retrievers, rerankers ya models ko A/B test kar sakte ho aur har component ko uske apne metrics se evaluate kar sakte ho.
  • Production ko chahiye: hybrid retrieval, reranking, caching, monitoring aur index freshness processes.
  • Serialisable pipelines versioning aur reproducibility support karti hain. Component versions pin karo.
  • Bottlenecks dhundhne ke liye har component ka retrieval recall, answer faithfulness aur latency evaluate karo.
  • Review mein dikhao ki vector store ya LLM badle toh swap path kya hai.
215

LangChain, CrewAI aur AutoGPT ko compare karo: kaun sa project kis ke liye suit karta hai?

Q181

Chhota jawab: General apps aur integrations ke liye LangChain, role-based teams ke liye CrewAI, autonomy experiments ke liye AutoGPT.

Aasan shabdon mein

Cycle, bike aur car ki tarah: sab chalte hain, lekin road ke hisaab se chunte ho. LangChain general-purpose hai, CrewAI teams ke liye hai, AutoGPT experimental hai.

Aise samjhoJaise cycle, bike aur car: sab chalte hain par chhoti gali, highway aur family trip ke liye alag-alag chunte ho. Pehle raasta dekho phir gaadi chuno.
Pehle yeh samjhoLangChain ek flexible toolbox hai, CrewAI roles wali team banata hai, AutoGPT khud goal pe chalne wala experiment hai. Production LLM app matlab asli users ke liye chalne wali app.
🔀 Flowchart: Framework comparison: kaun kis ke liye
Project ki zarurat dekho
↓
Chhota goal, autonomous experiment?
HaanAutoGPT jaisa autonomous loop
NahiAage dekho
↓
Role-based agents ki team chahiye?
HaanCrewAI
NahiAage dekho
↓
Tools, chains, memory ka flexible toolbox?
HaanLangChain
NahiZarurat dobara tay karo
↓
Project ke hisaab se framework chuno
Trade-off

Zyada autonomy matlab kam predictability aur zyada cost.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • LangChain: integrations, chains aur agents ka broad toolkit, zyadatar apps ke liye achha.
  • CrewAI: tasks ke saath role-based multi-agent teams, team jaise workflows ke liye achha.
Architect notes
  • Control aur reliability needs se decide karo. Production aam taur par free autonomy ki jagah explicit workflows ya graphs ko favour karta hai.
  • Maturity, community, observability, deployment story aur lock-in check karo, aur dobara check karte raho kyunki yeh projects tez badalte hain.
  • Do options ka same eval set par prototype banao aur success, cost aur latency compare karo.
  • Business logic aur prompts ko apne interfaces ke peeche portable rakho.
  • Review mein criteria batao aur yeh bhi ki haarne wala kyun haara.
216

Vendor API apna response format badal deta hai aur agent toot jaata hai. Aap kya karoge?

Q182

Chhota jawab: Vendor formats ko adapter ke peeche isolate karo, schemas se validate karo, version karo, aur contract drift par alert lagao.

Aasan shabdon mein

Bahar ki service ne apna data format badal diya, jaise school form badal de, toh purana kaam nahi karta. Hum ek translator aur checks jodte hain.

Aise samjhoJaise school ne fee form ka naya format nikaal diya aur purana form ab kaam nahi karta. Isliye pehle form check karte ho aur roz ek test form bhar ke dekhte ho.
Pehle yeh samjhoVendor wo company hai jiski API tum use karte ho. Response mein 'keys' matlab data ke naam wale hisse (jaise 'price'). Vendor key ka naam badal de to tumhara code ulajh jaata hai.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Schema (Pydantic) ek template hai jo batata hai response kaisa dikhna chahiye. Check karo ki response match karta hai, aur doosre naam wali keys bhi sweekar karo, taaki chhote badlav se na toote.
  2. API version pin karo matlab ek tay version par hi raho, taaki vendor chupke se badle to bhi purana format mile.
  3. Contract test matlab roz ek chhota test jo dekhe ki API ka format abhi bhi waisa hi hai ya nahi. Jaise roz subah machine chalu hai ya nahi dekhna.
  4. Jab tool errors badhne lagein to turant alert aaye, taaki jaldi pata chale ki kuch toota hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Vendor API format badla
Vendor API ne response format badal diya
↓
Agent toot gaya kyunki output alag tha
↓
Responses ko schema (Pydantic) se validate karo
↓
Naya key alag naam se aaya?
HaanAlternate keys accept karo
NahiError raise karo
↓
API versions pin karo, daily contract tests chalao
↓
Tool errors badhne par alert
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Adapters maintain karne ke liye code badhate hain, lekin nuksaan ko contain karte hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Vendor API aur agent ke beech adapter layer rakho, taaki sirf adapter badle.
  • Responses ko schema se validate karo aur match na hone par clearly fail karo.
Architect notes
  • Vendor output ko untrusted input ki tarah treat karo: strict parsing, extra fields ke liye tolerant, aur missing wale ke liye clear errors.
  • Scheduled contract tests aur canary calls chalao taaki users se pehle drift pata chale, aur parse failures par alert lagao.
  • Agent ko structured errors return karo taaki woh gracefully degrade kare, fallback ya human handoff ke saath.
  • Parse-failure rate aur detect aur fix karne ka time track karo. Vendor changelogs subscribe karo.
  • Review mein adapter boundary aur rollback plan dikhao.
217

Tumhari 15-step chain 30 seconds leti hai; rival ki 5 seconds. Aap kya karoge?

Q183

Chhota jawab: Chain trace karo, slow steps dhundo, phir parallelise, merge, cache karo, prompts chhote karo aur faster models use karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Aapka system 30 seconds leta hai aur rival 5, jaise ek dhaba chai ke liye 10 steps use kare aur doosra 3. Slow steps dhundo aur kaato.

Aise samjhoJaise do dhaba ek hi chai banate hain par ek 10 steps mein aur doosra 3 mein. Pehle dekho kahan time ja raha hai, phir wo hissa tez karo.
Pehle yeh samjhoChain matlab 15 steps ek ke baad ek. Rival matlab muqabla karne wala. Aksar slow hone ki wajah framework nahi, balki kuch dheeme model calls ya steps hote hain. Pehle naapo (profile) kaun sa step sabse zyada time le raha hai. Classification matlab input ko kisi category mein daalna, jaise 'refund' ya 'complaint'.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Profile karna matlab naapna ki time asal mein kahan lag raha hai, jaise delivery mein dekhna ki der traffic se hai ya packing se. Aksar slow hone ki wajah tumhara apna code ya model calls hoti hain, framework (LangChain jaisa ready-made toolkit) nahi.
  2. Jo steps ek dusre ke result par depend nahi karte, unhe ek saath chalao, jaise 3 dukaan se saaman ek saath mangwana, ek-ek karke nahi. Isse total time kaafi kam ho jaata hai.
  3. Cache matlab pehle diya gaya jawab yaad rakhna taaki wahi kaam dobara na karna pade. Aasaan steps (jaise simple classification) ke liye chhota, sasta aur tez model kaafi hota hai, bade model ki zaroorat nahi.
🔀 Flowchart: 15-step chain ko tez karna
15-step chain 30 second leti hai, rival 5 second
↓
Pehle profile karo: kaun sa step dheema hai
↓
Framework shayad hi asli wajah hota hai
↓
Steps ek doosre par depend nahi karte?
HaanParallel chalao
NahiOrder mein chalao
↓
Cache karo, simple steps ke liye chhote models
↓
Time kam, quality wahi
Trade-off

Kam steps accuracy kam kar sakte hain, isliye har change ke baad quality check karo.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • 15 steps mein se har ek ko trace karo aur uska time measure karo.
  • Jo steps ek call ban sakte hain unhe merge karo, independent wale parallel chalao aur unneeded drop karo.
Architect notes
  • Latency zyadatar sequential LLM hops ki hoti hai, isliye sabse bada fayda hop count kam karne mein hai. 15-step chain over-decomposition dikhati hai.
  • Jahan possible ho LLM steps ko deterministic code se replace karo. Structured outputs, prompt caching aur streaming use karo.
  • Rival ke task scope se compare karo, ho sakta hai woh kam kaam karta ho. Speed ki race se pehle quality bar match karo.
  • Step ke hisaab se p50 aur p95 aur end-to-end success rate measure karo, taaki speed gains regressions ko na chhupayein.
  • Review mein latency waterfall aur har stage ka target present karo.
218

Ek LlamaIndex RAG system ko 1,000 concurrent users serve karne hain. Aap kya karoge?

Q184

Chhota jawab: RAG ko async serving, caching, batching, scalable vector store aur load tests se scale karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Chai ke thele par achanak bheed aa gayi. Aapko zyada counters aur ek queue chahiye, saath mein popular sawalon ke ready-made answers.

Aise samjhoJaise ek chhoti chai ki tapri par achanak mela lag jaye. Tum zyada counter kholte ho, line sambhalne wala rakhte ho, aur common chai pehle se bana ke rakhte ho.
Pehle yeh samjho'Concurrent' matlab ek hi samay par. 1,000 log ek saath aayein to ek machine nahi sambhal paati. Isliye kai copies (replicas) banate hain aur load balancer unmein bheed baantta hai.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Managed vector database ek ready-made service hoti hai jo embeddings (text ke number-form) ko store aur search karti hai, aur khud scale ho jaati hai. Tumhe server khud sambhalne ki jhanjhat nahi hoti.
  2. Replicas matlab app ki kai copies, aur load balancer ek traffic police ki tarah har request ko kisi ek copy par bhejta hai. Isse 1,000 users ek hi machine par nahi tootte.
  3. Semantic cache mein milte-julte sawalon ka purana jawab dobara de diya jaata hai, jaise do log 'refund kaise milega' alag shabdon mein puchein. Isse LLM call bachti hai aur jawab tez milta hai.
  4. Streaming matlab jawab poora banne ka wait kiye bina shabd-shabd karke dikhana. User ko turant kuch dikhta hai, isliye system tez mehsoos hota hai.
🔀 Flowchart: 1,000 users ke liye RAG
LlamaIndex RAG ko 1,000 concurrent users chahiye
↓
Load balancer request ko replicas mein baantta hai
↓
Managed vector database search sambhalta hai
↓
Milta-julta sawaal pehle aaya?
HaanSemantic cache se turant jawab
NahiRetrieve karke generate karo
↓
Responses stream karo
↓
Bheed mein bhi tez jawab
Trade-off

Caching aur replicas mein paisa lagta hai, aur caching purane answers de sakti hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
