Model output ko ajnabi ke quote ki tarah padhta hai, order nahi
DATA  !=  INSTRUCTION
Tool output never becomes system-level instructions.
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Tool output data hai, instructions nahi.
  • Ye attack indirect prompt injection hai: hacker ek web page mein commands chhupa deta hai.
Architect notes
  • Defence in depth: koi ek filter kaam nahi karta, isliye isolation, least privilege aur human confirmation ko combine karo.
  • Untrusted content padhne ke baad agent kya kar sakta hai ye limit karo, jaise ek hi flow mein secrets aur external send nahi.
  • System prompt ya secrets ko aisi jagah kabhi mat rakho jahan output unhe expose kar sake.
  • Leakage ke liye outputs monitor karo aur injection attempts log karo.
  • Injection test suite se test karo aur attack success rate track karo.
254

Ek third-party MCP server broad permissions maangta hai. Kya aap use install karoge?

S79

Chhota jawab: Nahi, broad permissions ke saath nahi: publisher aur source vet karo, narrow scopes maango, aur sirf sandbox mein minimum access aur monitoring ke saath install karo, warna mana kar do.

Aasan shabdon mein

Jaise anjaan plumber ko ghar ki saari chaabiyan dena: jawab no hai. Pehle dekho wo kaun hai, phir sirf zaroori kamre ki chaabi do, ya use hire hi mat karo. ShopBot ke liye, third-party server jo full file aur email access maange use mana karo, par wahi tool read-only version mein sandbox mein theek hai.

Aise samjhoYeh kisi anjaan plumber ko ghar ki saari chaabiyan dene jaisa hai. Pehle uski details dekho, sirf zaroori kamre mein jaane do, aur kaam ke dauraan nazar rakho.
Pehle yeh samjhoMCP server ke paas tumhara data aa sakta hai, isliye uska code kisi bhi anjaan software jaisa risky hai. Interview mein bolo: 'Server ke paas mere data ki pahunch hai, isliye bahari software ki tarah pehle uski jaanch karni chahiye, ki kisne banaya aur kya maang raha hai.'
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Third-party matlab kisi bahari vyakti ka banaya hua. Jaise kisi anjaan ka software install karna, pehle dekho ki kisne banaya, code kya hai aur wo kya permissions maang raha hai.
  2. Sandbox ek band dabba hai jisme server chalta hai aur sirf zaroori permissions milti hain. Secrets (passwords, keys) tak uski pahunch mat do, taaki wo unhe chura na sake.
  3. Version pin karo taaki chupchaap update na aaye. Tool poisoning matlab tool ke description mein chhupe hue hukm jo model ko bahkate hain, isliye descriptions ke badlav par nazar rakho.
  4. Sensitive data ke liye apni hi company ke servers ko tarjeeh do kyunki unpar tumhara control aur bharosa hota hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Third-party MCP server install karna
Third-party MCP server broad permissions maangta hai
↓
Ise third-party code ki tarah maano: source, publisher, scopes review karo
↓
Kya maange gaye scopes zaroorat se zyada hain?
Haanmat install karo ya scopes kam karo
Nahisandbox mein minimum permissions se chalao
↓
Version pin karo, tool descriptions ke changes dekho (tool poisoning)
↓
Sensitive data ke liye apni organisation ke servers prefer karo
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Server aapke data tak pahunch sakta hai, isliye uska code kisi bhi bahari software jitna risky hai.
  • Dekho kisne banaya, source padho, aur poocho ki broad permissions kyun chahiye.
Architect notes
  • Source, dependencies aur update path review karo; version pin karo aur jahan ho wahan signatures verify karo.
  • Broad permission request red flag hai; narrow scopes maango ya mana karo.
  • Tool descriptions mein injected instructions (tool poisoning) ho sakte hain aur install ke baad badal bhi sakte hain, isliye unhe review karo aur har update par dobara check karo.
  • Network aur file access isolate karo, aur approved servers ki allow-list rakho.
  • Calls aur data egress monitor karo, aur ise jaldi disable karne ka tareeka rakho.

Cloud GenAI: AWS Bedrock aur Azure OpenAI

255

AWS Bedrock par private GenAI application kaise design karoge?

S30

Chhota jawab: Bedrock ko private VPC endpoints se use karo, documents ko encrypted S3 mein rakho, access IAM roles se control karo, aur Guardrails, logging aur Knowledge Base jodo, taaki data aur traffic company ke control mein rahe.

Aasan shabdon mein

Jaise kiraye ki building mein bank ki branch: bank ka apna locker, guard aur CCTV hota hai. Private ShopBot jaise app mein: app aapke VPC ke andar chalta hai, private endpoint se Bedrock ko call karta hai, aapke S3 bucket se documents padhta hai jo aapki KMS key se encrypted hain, aur har call log hoti hai. Bedrock aapke prompts aur data se apne base models train nahi karta.

Aise samjhoYeh bank ki branch jaisa hai: building (Bedrock) kiraye ki hai, par locker, guard, CCTV aur chaabiyan bank apni rakhta hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoBedrock Amazon ki cloud service hai jahan AI models mil jaate hain. Uske saath S3 (file storage), CloudWatch (monitoring), IAM (kaun kya kar sakta hai), KMS (encryption keys) aur Secrets Manager (passwords) company apne control mein rakhti hai. Interview mein bolo: 'AI model Bedrock se lunga, par login, data aur monitoring ke niyam company ke apne rakhunga.'
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. S3 documents rakhne ki storage hai, CloudWatch logs aur metrics (system ki sehat ke numbers) dikhata hai, IAM ye tay karta hai ki kaun kya kar sakta hai, KMS encryption keys sambhalta hai, aur Secrets Manager passwords surakshit rakhta hai. Ye sab milke private application banate hain.
  2. Least privilege matlab har role (jaise app ya developer) ko sirf wahi permissions jo uske kaam ke liye zaroori ho. Isse galti ya hack ka nuksan seemit rehta hai.
  3. Encrypt matlab data ko aise coded form mein badalna ki chori ho jaye to bhi koi padh na sake. Rest matlab jab data stored hai, transit matlab jab network par chal raha hai, dono jagah zaroori hai.
🔀 Flowchart: AWS Bedrock par private GenAI app
Enterprise ko AWS par private GenAI app chahiye
↓
App Bedrock ke around banao
↓
S3 mein documents, CloudWatch mein logs aur metrics
↓
IAM har role ke liye least privilege
↓
KMS aur Secrets Manager: data at rest aur in transit encrypt
↓
Identity, data access aur monitoring company ke control mein
User -> API Gateway -> Auth -> Application (Lambda / ECS)
                                   |
                              Bedrock
                  +----------------+----------------+
          Foundation model     Knowledge base     Guardrails
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Public API se zyada setup aur cost.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • App ko apne VPC mein chalao aur Bedrock tak VPC endpoint (PrivateLink) se pahuncho, taaki traffic public internet par na jaye.
  • Documents S3 mein KMS keys se encrypted rakho; RAG ke liye Knowledge Base use karo aur secrets Secrets Manager mein rakho.
Architect notes
  • VPC endpoints use karo, stores par public access nahi, aur per-user identity rakho taaki retrieval document permissions maane.
  • Customer-managed keys se at rest aur in transit encrypt karo; prompts aur logs ki retention tay karo.
  • Shuru se Guardrails, audit logging (CloudTrail, invocation logs) aur cost alerts lagao.
  • Quotas aur multi-region fallback plan karo, aur dekho ki backup region mein model available hai.
  • Compliance review ke liye data flow aur residency document karo.
256

Ek support bot abusive, unsafe ya sensitive content nahi dena chahiye. Guardrails kaise use karoge?

S32

Chhota jawab: Guardrails input aur output ko harmful content, denied topics aur PII ke liye filter karte hain, lekin app security ki jagah nahi lete.

Aasan shabdon mein

Jaise gate guard jo andar aane wale aur bahar jaane wale logon ko check karta hai. ShopBot ka filter question aur answer dono check karta hai.

Aise samjhoYeh school ke gate guard aur teacher dono jaisa hai: andar aate aur bahar jaate dono waqt check karte hain. Lekin principal ke rules phir bhi alag se chalte hain.
Pehle yeh samjhoguardrails ek safety filter hain jo bot ko galat cheez bolne se rokte hain. Par ye app ki apni security (kaun kya dekh sakta hai) ki jagah nahi lete, dono saath chahiye. Guardrails app security ke poorak hain.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Guardrails safety ke rules hote hain. User ke sawal (input) aur bot ke jawab (output) dono ko check karo ki usme harmful content, mana kiye gaye topics ya PII (personal info, jaise phone ya Aadhaar number) to nahi.
  2. Application-level authorisation matlab app khud tay kare ki kaun user kya dekh sakta hai, sirf model ke bharose nahi. PII controls se private jaankari ka leak rokte hain.
🔀 Flowchart: Support bot guardrails
ShopBot ko abusive ya unsafe content nahi dena
↓
User input par filter: harmful content, denied topics, PII
↓
Model ka output bhi usi tarah filter karo
↓
Kya filter ne kuch pakda?
Haanblock karo ya safe jawab do
Nahijawab user ko jaata hai
↓
Application-level authorisation aur PII controls alag se add karo
Input -> Guardrail -> Model -> Guardrail -> Output
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • User input ko harmful content, denied topics aur PII ke liye filter karo.
  • Model ke output ko bhi isi tarah filter karo.
Architect notes
  • Guardrails risk kam karte hain lekin probabilistic hain; high-risk cases ke liye authorisation, grounding aur human review ke saath combine karo.
  • Real traffic samples se thresholds tune karo, false blocks aur missed content ke beech balance rakhte hue.
  • Ye har call par latency aur cost add karte hain; dono measure karo.
  • Blocked cases ko review aur policy updates ke liye log karo, PII redact karke.
  • Adversarial prompts se regularly test karo.
257

Traffic achanak 20 guna badh gaya aur rate limits hit ho rahi hain. Aap kya karoge?

S35

Chhota jawab: Retry storm se bacho: jitter ke saath backoff, queues, quotas, caching, fallback models aur capacity requests.

Aasan shabdon mein

Ticket counter par achanak bheed ho aur sab ek saath dhakka dein to halat aur bigadti hai. Isliye tokens do aur zyada counters kholo.

Aise samjhoYeh railway ticket counter par achanak bheed ka scene hai: sab ek saath dhakka dein toh line aur jam hoti hai, isliye token system aur alag counter lagate hain.
Pehle yeh samjhorate limit matlab service ek time par limit se zyada requests nahi leti. Traffic 20 guna ho to limit khatam ho jaati hai. Agar sab ek saath dobara try karein to halat aur kharab ho, isliye thodi-thodi der baad, alag-alag time par try karte hain.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Exponential backoff matlab fail hone par har baar pehle se zyada der ruk kar retry karna, aur jitter matlab thoda random wait taaki sab ek saath na tootein.
  2. Requests ko line (queue) mein lagao aur ek saath chalne wali requests ki limit rakho, jaise bank counter par token system.
  3. Caching matlab pehle diya hua jawab yaad rakhna, taaki same sawal par model dobara call na karna pade.
  4. Agar ek model ya region full ho jaye, to dusra model ya doosri deployment (alag copy) ya region use karo.
  5. Agar load hamesha zyada rehta hai, to pehle se capacity book (reserve) kar lo, jaise monthly pass sasta padta hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Traffic 20 guna, rate limits
Traffic achanak 20 guna badha, rate limits hit ho rahi hain
↓
Retry storm mat banao (sab ek saath retry karenge)
↓
Jitter ke saath exponential backoff
↓
Request queue aur concurrency control, caching
↓
Kya load steady aur high hai?
Haanreserved capacity lo
Nahifallback model, second deployment ya region
↓
System stable rehta hai, users ko jawab milte hain
Requests -> Queue -> Rate limiter -> Azure OpenAI
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Rate limit ek time window mein requests ko cap karta hai.
  • Agar sab ek saath retry karein to halat aur kharab hoti hai.
Architect notes
  • Traffic ko prioritise karo: critical flows ko bachao aur low-priority kaam ko shed ya delay karo.
  • Client-side rate limiters aur queues use karo taaki errors ka reaction dene ki jagah tum quota ke andar raho.
  • Higher quotas jaldi maango aur load ko regions ya deployments mein failao.
  • Gracefully degrade karo: chhote answers ya sasta model.
  • Throttle rate aur queue depth monitor karo, aur launches se pehle load test karo.
258

Azure OpenAI calls time out ho rahi hain. Aap kya karoge?

S36

Chhota jawab: Pehle cause dhundho (size, network, latency, throttling), use fix karo, phir backoff ke saath bounded retries use karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Lift ka button baar-baar mat dabao. Pehle check karo ki bijli gayi to nahi.

Aise samjhoYeh lift mein ruk jaane par bar bar button dabane jaisa hai. Pehle dekho power gaya hai ya kuch aur dikkat hai.
Pehle yeh samjhotimeout matlab jawab bahut der se aaya. Pehle wajah dhoondho (prompt bahut bada, network slow, ya service ne speed rok di), wajah theek karo, aur tab hi seemit baar retry karo.
🔀 Flowchart: Azure OpenAI timeouts
Azure OpenAI calls time out ho rahi hain
↓
Andhadhund retry mat karo
↓
Pata lagao kyun: processing, network, model latency, bada token size ya throttling
↓
Cause fix karo: prompt chhota, stream, jahan justified timeout badhao
↓
Phir bounded retries exponential backoff ke saath
↓
Timeouts cause fix karke safely handle hote hain
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Aankh band karke retry mat karo.
  • Cause dhundho: processing, network, model latency, bada token size ya throttling.
Architect notes
  • Streaming perceived latency behtar karti hai aur lambe outputs par timeouts se bachati hai.
  • Non-idempotent calls par retries kaam ya cost double kar sakti hain; jahan ho sake idempotency use karo.
  • Har call type ke liye timeouts set karo aur ek fallback region ya model add karo.
  • Network, queue aur generation time ko alag karne ke liye tracing use karo.
  • p95 latency aur timeout rate par alert lagao.
259

Ek cloud region mein model endpoint down ho gaya. Available kaise rahoge?

S82

Chhota jawab: Router ke peeche do regions ya providers mein chalao, health checks, automatic failover aur tested drills ke saath.

Aasan shabdon mein

Ghar ke inverter ki tarah: bijli jaaye toh backup turant start ho jaata hai, aur kabhi kabhi use test bhi karte ho.

Aise samjhoYeh ghar mein inverter jaisa hai: bijli jaate hi turant backup chalu ho jaata hai, aur use time-time par test bhi karte hain.
Pehle yeh samjhoregion cloud company ka ek ilaka hai jahan uske computers rakhe hain. Ek region band ho jaye to doosre region ke computers se kaam chalta rahe, isi ko failover kehte hain.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Router ek traffic police jaisa hai jo request sahi jagah bhejta hai. Do regions ya do providers mein model rakho, to ek band hone par dusra chalta rahe.
  2. Health check matlab baar-baar dekhna ki service zinda hai ya nahi. Kharab mile to automatic failover (apne aap dusre par switch) ho jaata hai.
  3. Portable matlab prompts aur tool schemas (tool ke input ka format) kisi bhi provider par bina badlav chal jayein, warna switch mushkil hoga.
  4. Failover sirf kagaz par ho to kaam nahi karta, isliye usse regularly try karo. Backup model ka jawab bhi itna achha hona chahiye jitna zaroori ho.
  5. Agar backup se kaam kamzor chal raha ho, to users ko saaf bata do, taaki wo hairaan na hon.
🔀 Flowchart: Region down hone par availability
Ek region mein model endpoint down ho gaya
↓
Router ke peeche do regions ya do providers
↓
Kya health check fail hua?
Haanautomatic failover dusre region par
Nahinormal traffic chalta rahe
↓
Fallback model ki quality bar check karo, users ko degraded mode batao
↓
Prompts aur tool schemas portable rakho
↓
Failover ko regularly test karo
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Extra cost aur complexity.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Region cloud company ke computers ka ek area hota hai.
  • Router ke peeche do regions ya providers rakho.
Architect notes
  • Backup region mein model availability aur quotas check karo; jis failover target mein capacity nahi woh plan nahi hai.
  • Alag model pe failover quality aur behaviour badal sakta hai, isliye evals se test karo.
  • Data residency rules ka dhyan rakho, kyunki failover regions cross kar sakta hai.
  • Game-day drills chalao aur recovery time aur error budget measure karo.
  • Sensible health check thresholds se flapping se bacho.
260

GenAI traffic ko public internet se door kaise rakhoge?

S83

Chhota jawab: Private endpoints use karo, stores pe public access nahi, aur egress allow-lists lagao taaki GenAI traffic internet se door rahe.

Aasan shabdon mein

Office ke andar private lane ki tarah: public road pe jaane ki zaroorat nahi, aur gate se sirf approved log guzarte hain.

Aise samjhoYeh office ke andar ki private gali jaisa hai: public sadak par nikalne ki zaroorat nahi, aur gate par sirf approved logon ko jaane dete hain.
Pehle yeh samjhopublic internet sabke liye khula raasta hai. Company ke AI data ko isse door rakhne ke liye private raste aur approved jagah ki list use karte hain.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Private endpoint ya private link matlab model service tak seedha andar ka raasta, jisme internet ke logon ki entry nahi.
  2. Vector database (jahan documents ke meaning-numbers rakhe jaate hain) aur document store ko public mat kholo, warna koi bhi bahar se data dekh sakta hai.
  3. Egress rules matlab app bahar kahan jaa sakta hai uski list. Sirf approved services tak jaane do, taaki data galat jagah leak na ho.
  4. Customer-managed keys matlab encryption ki chaabi aapke paas ho, provider ke paas nahi, jaise locker ki chaabi aap khud rakhte ho.
  5. Kisne kab kya access kiya uska record (log) rakho, taaki baad mein audit mein check ho sake.
🔀 Flowchart: GenAI traffic public internet se door
GenAI traffic public internet par nahi jaana chahiye
↓
Model service ke liye private endpoints ya private links
↓
Vector database ya document store par public access nahi
↓
Egress rules: app sirf approved services tak pahunche
↓
Customer-managed keys se encrypt karo
↓
Audit ke liye access log hota hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Zyada network setup aur debugging mushkil.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Model service ke liye private endpoints ya links use karo.
  • Vector database aur document store ko public access mat do.
Architect notes
  • Egress allow-lists data exfiltration limit karti hain agar koi agent ya tool compromise ho jaye.
  • DNS, logging aur telemetry paths bhi cover karo, kyunki woh data leak kar sakte hain.
  • Network controls ko identity aur encryption ke saath combine karo; sirf network kaafi nahi.
  • Network flow logs se verify karo ki kuch bhi private path se bahar nahi ja raha.
  • Connectivity changes staging mein test karo, kyunki private routing chupke se toot jaati hai.

GenAI System Design

261

10 million requests per day ke liye customer support GenAI system kaise design karoge?

S38

Chhota jawab: Repeated answers ko cache karo, aasan queries ko chhote models par route karo, aur bade model ko mushkil cases ke liye rakho.

Aasan shabdon mein

Zyadatar customers wahi cheezein poochte hain, jaise mera order kahan hai. ShopBot answers yaad rakhta hai aur mehnga AI sirf unusual questions ke liye call karta hai.

Aise samjhoYeh railway enquiry jaisa hai: Delhi ki train kab hai jaise sawal ka jawab board par likha hai. Staff sirf khaas problems par lagta hai.
Pehle yeh samjho10 million matlab 1 crore. p99 latency ka sahi matlab: 100 mein se 99 requests is time se pehle ho jaati hain, sirf sabse slow 1 isse zyada leti hai. Throughput matlab ek second mein kitni requests nipti.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Asynchronous matlab user ko turant wait na karwana, kaam peeche se chalta rahe. Cache matlab purane jawab yaad rakhna, isse kharcha aur load kam hota hai.
  2. Support mein log aksar wahi sawal poochte hain, jaise 'order kahan hai'. To cache aur FAQ ke ready answers se bahut requests bina model ke nipat jaati hain.
  3. p99 latency wo time hai jisse 100 mein se 99 requests jaldi poori hoti hain. Sirf sabse slow 1 request isse zyada leti hai. Saath mein har query ka kharcha, ek second mein kitni requests aur kitni errors, ye sab dekhte raho.
🔀 Flowchart: 10 million requests: bade model se bachao
10 million requests per day aati hain
↓
Jawab cache ya FAQ answer mein hai?
HaanSeedha cached answer do, model call nahi
NahiAage badho
↓
Request easy hai (lagbhag 80 percent)?
HaanChhota ya sasta model use karo
NahiBade model ko call karo (asynchronous jahan ho sake)
↓
p99 latency, cost per query, throughput, error rate monitor karo
↓
Easy 80 percent ke liye bada model nahi chalta, cost aur speed theek
Users -> CDN / API gateway -> Load balancer -> Query router
                                          +-- Cache
                                          +-- FAQ RAG
                                          +-- Agent -> Tools / APIs -> LLM
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Aggressive caching paisa bachati hai lekin purane ya thode galat answers return kar sakti hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Layered flow: pehle exact aur semantic cache, phir FAQ retrieval, phir ek chhota model, phir ek bada model.
  • p99 latency ka matlab hai 99 percent requests us time ke andar poori ho jaati hain; throughput hai per second handle hui requests.
Architect notes
  • Roughly 10 million a day ka average lagbhag 115 requests per second hota hai, lekin peak ke liye design karo jo kai guna zyada hota hai.
  • Cost-per-resolved-ticket ka target set karo; intent aur confidence se route karo, human agent ko fallback ke saath.
  • Policy changes par cache invalidation main risk hai; knowledge base se jude TTLs aur version keys add karo.
  • Multi-provider failover aur rate-limit protection do; load mein cached ya canned replies par gracefully degrade karo.
  • Cache hit rate, escalation rate, resolution quality aur har tier ka p99 measure karo; inhe review dashboard ki tarah present karo.
262

Financial AI agent kaise design karoge?

S39

Chhota jawab: LLM sirf propose karta hai; deterministic code aur human approval kisi bhi financial action ko execute karte hain.

Aasan shabdon mein

AI ek adviser ki tarah hai jo payment suggest karta hai. Button ek insaan ya strict rule dabaye, taaki AI akele kabhi paisa move na kar sake.

Aise samjhoYeh bank ke financial adviser jaisa hai: woh salah deta hai, par paise nikalne ka button sirf manager ki approval ke baad dabta hai.
Pehle yeh samjhodeterministic system matlab fixed rules wala normal code jo har baar same faisla karta hai. Escalate matlab kaam insaan ko bhej dena.
🔀 Flowchart: Financial agent: LLM sirf salah deta hai
User financial action maangta hai (jaise paisa transfer)
↓
LLM request samajhkar decision ka suggestion deta hai
↓
Deterministic system (fixed rules wala code) authorisation check karta hai
↓
Business rules aur permission pass hue?
HaanRules wala system action execute karta hai
NahiAction reject ya human ko escalate
↓
LLM kabhi directly financial action execute nahi karta
User -> LLM agent -> Action proposal -> Policy engine
     -> Risk engine -> Human approval -> Transaction API
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Approvals delay aur cost badhate hain lekin mehengi galti ke chance ko bahut kam karte hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • System ko advice layer (LLM) aur execution layer (limits wala rule-based code) mein baanto.
  • Ek threshold ke upar Human-in-the-loop approval chahiye; chhote safe actions automate ho sakte hain.
Architect notes
  • Agent ko scoped, short-lived credentials do; model ke paas kabhi aisi keys nahi hoti jo seedha paisa move kar sakein.
  • Amounts, accounts aur limits ko code mein allow-lists ke against validate karo; model ke banaye numbers par kabhi bharosa mat karo.
  • Documents ya emails ke through prompt injection ko main threat maano; untrusted content ko instructions se alag rakho.
  • Regulators ke liye immutable logs rakho, aur har executed step ki explainability aur rollback plan karo.
  • Wrong-proposal rate, approval overrides aur near misses measure karo; live jaane se pehle shadow mode mein chalao.
263

Ek platform par 10 companies ke liye multi-tenant RAG kaise design karoge?

S40

Chhota jawab: Har chunk tenant_id rakhta hai aur har retrieval tenant filter enforce karti hai, taaki companies kabhi mix na hon.

Aasan shabdon mein

Ek platform das companies ko serve karta hai, jaise ShopBot das dukaano ke liye kaam kar raha ho. Har dukaan ke documents tag hote hain, aur search sirf apna tag dekh sakta hai.

Aise samjhoYeh ek apartment building jaisa hai jisme 10 families rehti hain: har ek ke flat par alag taala hai, aur guard ka kehna kaafi nahi, taala hona zaroori hai.
Pehle yeh samjhotenant_id batata hai chunk kis company ka hai, document_id kaunsa document, access_level kaun dekh sakta hai, department kaunsa vibhag. Data layer matlab database jahan filter lagta hai, taaki model tak galat chunk pahunche hi nahi.
🔀 Flowchart: Multi-tenant RAG: tenant isolation
10 companies (tenants) ek platform share karti hain
↓
Har chunk ke saath tenant_id, document_id, access_level, department
↓
User ka sawaal aata hai, uski tenant pehchani jaati hai
↓
Retrieval mein tenant filter har baar enforce hota hai
↓
Sirf us tenant ke chunks model tak jaate hain
↓
Model behke tab bhi doosri company ka data nahi dikhta
Query -> tenant_id -> Metadata filter -> Vector search
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Alag stores sabse achha isolate karte hain lekin zyada cost; shared stores sasti hain lekin sahi filters par depend karti hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Har chunk par metadata ke roop mein tenant_id, document id, access level aur department store karo.
  • Tenant filter vector query ke andar lagao, ranking se pehle, results aane ke baad nahi.
Architect notes
  • Tenant ko server-side authenticated token se nikalo, user input ya prompt se kabhi nahi.
  • Cross-tenant leakage sabse badi failure hai; automated tests add karo jo tenant A ban kar tenant B ke facts query karein.
  • Caches, logs, embeddings aur fine-tuning data ko bhi per tenant isolate karo, sirf vector index ko nahi.
  • Noisy-neighbour risk ke liye per-tenant rate limits aur quotas chahiye; bade ya regulated tenants dedicated infrastructure justify kar sakte hain.
  • Leak-test pass rate aur per-tenant cost report karo; compliance ke liye per-tenant deletion offer karo.
264

CTO poochta hai: "Hum GenAI use hi kyun karein?"

S49

Chhota jawab: Business problem se shuru karo, simpler options compare karo, aur GenAI wahin apnao jahan wo saaf jeetta hai.

Aasan shabdon mein

AI kharidne se pehle poochho kaun si problem dard de rahi hai. Agar ShopBot support wait time kam kar sakta hai aur plain rules nahi kar sakte, to GenAI use karo.

Aise samjhoYeh doctor jaisa hai: pehle bimari samajhta hai, phir dawai deta hai. Sab marizon ko seedha bada operation nahi karta.
Pehle yeh samjhoCTO company ka sabse bada technology afsar hai. ROI matlab kharche ke badle kitna faayda mila. Unstructured language matlab free-form text, jaise emails, jo fixed khaanon mein nahi hota.
🔀 Flowchart: CTO: GenAI kyun? Sochne ka tareeka
CTO poochta hai: GenAI kyun use karein?
↓
Pehle business problem, cost, accuracy, human effort, risk aur ROI dekho
↓
Kya rule, API ya workflow reliably solve kar sakta hai?
HaanWahi simple solution chuno, LLM nahi
NahiTab GenAI ke baare mein socho
↓
GenAI wala sabse simple architecture chuno jo problem solve kare
↓
Business problem se shuru, LLM se nahi
Trade-off

Powerful aur flexible hai, lekin error, cost, privacy aur governance ka kaam saath laata hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Pehle problem aur ek measurable goal batao, jaise cost per ticket ya response time.
  • Simpler options se compare karo: rules, search, classic machine learning ya behtar process.
Architect notes
  • Ise ek decision ki tarah frame karo, jisme baseline, pilot aur success metrics hon, technology push ki tarah nahi.
  • Total cost gino: tokens, evaluation, guardrails, people review aur maintenance, sirf model price nahi.
  • Risks ko seedha address karo: hallucination, data privacy, vendor lock-in aur compliance, har ek ke mitigations ke saath.
  • Ek chhota, reversible pilot propose karo jisme kill criterion ho, phir measured value par scale karo.
  • Saaf kaho ki ise kahan use nahi karna: exact calculations, bina review ke high-stakes decisions.
265

Final boss: millions of users ke liye enterprise-scale agentic RAG platform kaise design karoge?

S50

Chhota jawab: Gateway, routing, RAG, MCP ke through tools, guardrails, approvals aur observability ko layer karo, evaluation hamesha chalta rahe.

Aasan shabdon mein

Socho ShopBot karodon shoppers ke liye hai. Use ek front door, safe tools, risky actions ke liye human check, aur sab kuch dekhne ke liye dashboard chahiye.

Aise samjhoYeh ek chhoti dukaan nahi, poora shopping mall chalane jaisa hai. Sirf best seller (model) kaafi nahi, security guard, billing, CCTV aur stock check sab chahiye.
Pehle yeh samjhointerview line ka matlab hai ki LLM sirf ek hissa hai, poore system ko surakshit, monitor aur test bhi karna padta hai. Probabilistic matlab andaze wale model, deterministic matlab fixed rule wala code. MCP layer wahi standard tool-connection hai jo pehle padha.

Safety: injection defence, PII detection, output validation, human approval

Secure, observable, evaluated distributed system

             +----------+----------+

Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Zyada layers safety aur flexibility dete hain lekin latency, cost aur operating complexity bhi badhate hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Gateway auth, rate limits aur kai LLM providers ke beech routing fallback ke saath handle karta hai.
  • Agentic RAG agent ko decide karne deta hai ki kab retrieve karna hai aur kab MCP ke through tools call karne hain.
Architect notes
  • Control plane (policy, config, evals) ko data plane (requests) se alag karo, taaki redeploy kiye bina policy badal sako.
  • Tenant isolation, least-privilege tool access aur PII redaction non-negotiable hain; saari tool calls ka audit karo.
  • Caching, model routing, token budgets aur streaming se cost aur latency control karo; har tier ke liye SLOs set karo.
  • Golden sets par continuous evaluation aur online sampling model ya prompt changes ke baad chupke regressions se bachate hain.
  • Canary se roll out karo, kill switch rakho, aur provider outage failover plan karo; har layer ko uske failure mode se defend karo.
266

Pull requests ke liye AI code-review assistant kaise design karoge?

S84

Chhota jawab: Review bot ko context ke saath diffs pe comment karna chahiye, low-noise rehna chahiye, aur khud kabhi merge nahi karna chahiye.

Aasan shabdon mein

Pull request programmer ka code badalne ka proposal hota hai. AI change padhta hai aur helpful comments chhodta hai, jaise ek quick first reviewer.

Aise samjhoJaise school mein teacher pehle spelling-check machine chalati hai, phir khud copy check karke sirf zaroori remarks likhti hai. Har line par laal pen nahi chalati.
Pehle yeh samjhoprogrammers code mein badlav karke dusron se check karwate hain, yahi pull request hai. Merge matlab us badlav ko asli code mein jod dena. Acceptance rate matlab kitne comments developers ne sach mein maane.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Model ko poora repo mat do, sirf badla hua code (diff) aur usse jude files do. Isse jawab sahi aur sasta aata hai.
  2. Linter (style/galti check karne wala tool) aur tests pehle chalao, ye pakke checks hain. LLM unke upar samajh wali raay deta hai.
  3. Bahut zyada comments aaye to developers sabko ignore kar dete hain, isliye comments kam aur kaam ke rakho.
  4. AI ko khud code merge mat karne do. Insaan final faisla le.
  5. Kitne comments developers ne maane (acceptance rate) wo sabse kaam ka number hai, kyunki wahi batata hai ki assistant sach mein madad kar raha hai.
🔀 Flowchart: AI code-review assistant ka flow
Naya pull request (code badlav ki request) aata hai
↓
Pehle linters aur tests chalao
↓
LLM ko diff plus related files do, poora repo nahi
↓
LLM judgement ke comments likhta hai, volume limited
↓
Comments acceptable hain?
HaanAcceptance rate metric mein track karo
NahiPrompt aur comment limit sudharo
↓
Human merge karta hai, kabhi auto-merge nahi
PR opened -> Webhook -> Fetch diff + changed files + repo context
          -> Static analysis + tests (deterministic)
          -> LLM review (with rules, style guide, retrieved code)
          -> Filter low-confidence comments -> Post comments
          -> Collect developer feedback (accept / dismiss)
Trade-off

Zyada comments zyada bugs dhundte hain par noise bhi banate hain jise log ignore karne lagte hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Diff ke saath relevant aas-paas ki files, tests aur team style rules ko context ki tarah feed karo.
  • Linters aur static analysis ko LLM ke saath combine karo; LLM explain aur prioritise karta hai.
Architect notes
  • Context selection mushkil hissa hai: bade diffs limits cross kar dete hain, isliye file ke hisaab se chunk karo aur related code retrieve karo.
  • Precision track karo: kitne comments accept ya resolve hue; bahut false alarms adoption maar dete hain.
  • Code aur secrets ko sensitive maano: private deployment ya strict data policy, aur source ko bina zaroorat kabhi log mat karo.
  • Code comments ya PR text se prompt injection ke khilaaf defend karo; read-only permissions ke saath chalao.
  • Known bugs wale historical PRs pe evaluate karo; catch rate, noise rate aur time saved report karo.
267

Scanned invoices padhne wali invoice-processing pipeline kaise design karoge?

S85

Chhota jawab: OCR aur vision LLM combine karo, extracted fields ko rules se validate karo, aur low confidence humans ko route karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Scanned bills sirf pictures hain. System text padhta hai, amount aur date nikaalta hai, aur save karne se pehle check karta hai ki woh sensible hain.

Aise samjhoJaise shop ka accountant bills se entry karta hai: machine jaldi data bharti hai, phir total ka hisaab check hota hai, aur dhundhla bill malik ko dikhaya jata hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoscanned invoice ek photo jaisa hota hai, jisse text nikalna padta hai. Confidence matlab model ko apne padhne par kitna bharosa hai. 'Corrections se seekhna' matlab insaan ke sudhaar ko future ke liye test data ya instructions banana.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Structured output matlab model ka jawab ek tay form (schema) mein aaye, jaise invoice number, date, amount alag-alag khaano mein.
  2. Deterministic checks matlab fixed rule wali jaanch, jaise total sahi jodna aur same invoice do baar na aana. Ye galtiyan model se zyada pakki pakadti hai.
  3. Jahan model ko bharosa kam ho (low confidence), wahan insaan check kare, aur uske sudhaar se system sudharta jaye.
  4. Har field kitna sahi nikla aur kitne invoice bina insaani madad ke seedhe paas hue (straight-through rate), ye naapte raho.
🔀 Flowchart: Invoice pipeline: scan se payment tak
Scanned invoice aata hai
↓
Model schema ke saath structured output nikalta hai
↓
Deterministic checks: arithmetic aur duplicate invoice
↓
Confidence aur checks theek hain?
HaanSeedha aage badhao (straight-through)
NahiHuman review karta hai
↓
Human ki corrections se system seekhta hai
↓
Field-level accuracy aur straight-through rate measure hota hai
Upload -> OCR / vision extraction -> LLM maps to a fixed schema
       -> Validation rules (totals add up, vendor exists, dates valid)
       -> Confidence score -> High: auto-post to ERP
                           -> Low: human review queue
Trade-off

LLMs messy layouts achhe handle karte hain par simple, uniform invoices ke liye template OCR se zyada costly hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • OCR image ko text mein badalta hai; vision model ya LLM use total aur date jaise fields se map karta hai.
  • Fixed output schema use karo taaki results structured aur check karne mein aasan hon.
Architect notes
  • Har field ke liye confidence scores add karo aur low-confidence documents ko human review queue mein bhejo.
  • Failure modes: bad scans, handwriting, multi-page tables, aur model ka value invent kar dena; rules inme se bahut kuch pakad lete hain.
  • Money fields ko exact checks aur duplicate-invoice detection chahiye; model ko akele payment approve mat karne do.
  • Invoices mein personal aur bank data hota hai, isliye access, retention aur vendor data-use terms control karo.
  • Labelled sample pe field-level accuracy, straight-through rate aur correction rate measure karo.
268

SQL databases par natural-language "chat with your data" assistant kaise design karoge?

S86

Chhota jawab: Schema se SQL generate karo, limits ke saath read-only chalao, validate karo, aur result explain karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

User normal words mein sawaal poochta hai aur AI uske liye database lookup likhta hai. Main chinta yeh hai ki woh woh cheezein na padhe ya badle jo use nahi karna chahiye.

Aise samjhoJaise library ka clerk tumhe sirf dekhne deta hai, kitab par pen nahi chalane deta. Aur tum sirf wahi shelf dekh sakte ho jiski tumhe permission hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoproduction primary matlab wo asli live database jisme company ka real data hai. Isliye model ki likhi SQL wahan write access ke saath kabhi mat chalao, warna galti se asli data badal sakta hai.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Model ko poora database mat dikhao, sirf kaam ke tables aur columns ka matlab batao. Isse wo kam bhatakta hai.
  2. Read-only access matlab sirf padh sakta hai, badal ya delete nahi. Row permissions matlab har user sirf apni allowed rows dekhe, jaise bank mein sirf apna account.
  3. Jo SQL (database ko poochne ki bhasha) bani wo user ko dikhao, taaki wo check kar sake ki sahi poocha gaya.
  4. Kuch sawal aur unki sahi SQL ki jodi bana kar assistant ko test karo ki wo sahi jawab deta hai ya nahi.
🔀 Flowchart: Chat with your data: safe SQL flow
User natural language mein sawaal poochta hai
↓
Model ko sirf relevant schema aur column descriptions do
↓
Model SQL query likhta hai
↓
Query read-only access aur per-user row permissions ke saath chalti hai
↓
User ko SQL dikhao taaki woh verify kar sake
↓
Jawab milta hai, evaluation question aur correct-SQL pairs se
Question -> Schema retrieval (relevant tables and columns)
         -> LLM writes SQL -> Validator (read-only, allowed tables, row limit)
         -> Run on a read replica -> Result -> LLM explains + shows the SQL
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Flexible questions possible hain, par galat SQL plausible lekin incorrect answers return kar sakta hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Model ko schema, column meanings aur kuch example queries do (text-to-SQL).
  • Queries ko read-only user, row limits aur timeouts ke saath chalao.
Architect notes
  • Row-level aur column-level security database mein enforce karo, prompt mein nahi; user ki identity flow hoti rehni chahiye.
  • Semantic layer ya curated views names aur metrics ki ambiguity kam karte hain, aur accuracy badhate hain.
  • Expensive queries aur injection se guard karo; generated SQL dikhao taaki users verify kar sakein.
  • Verified answers wale question set pe evaluate karo, execution accuracy measure karo, text similarity nahi.
  • Audit aur cost ke liye queries log karo; results model tak pahunchne se pehle sensitive columns mask karo.
269

Customer calls ke liye voice assistant kaise design karoge?

S87

Chhota jawab: Voice ko low end-to-end latency chahiye: streaming speech to text, LLM aur speech wapas, barge-in ke saath.

Aasan shabdon mein

Phone call pe slow reply awkward lagta hai. Assistant ko jaldi sunna, sochna aur bolna hoga, asli insaan ki tarah.

Aise samjhoJaise phone par dost ek second chup rahe to lagta hai line kat gayi. Isliye bolna jaldi shuru karna zaroori hai, poora sochne ka wait nahi.
Pehle yeh samjhovoice assistant ke teen step hote hain: bolna text mein badalna, LLM jawab likhe, text wapas awaaz banna. Stream karna matlab har step tukdon mein turant aage bhejna.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Phone par ek second se zyada chuppi kharab lagti hai, isliye speed sabse bada constraint hai. Streaming matlab pura jawab banne ka wait na karke tukdon mein turant chalana.
  2. Barge-in matlab user beech mein bol pade to assistant ruk kar sun le, jaise insaan baat karte waqt karte hain.
  3. Number ya address jaisi zaroori baatein dobara bol kar confirm karo, taaki galat sunne se nuksaan na ho.
  4. Kabhi bhi user ko insaan se baat karne ka raasta do, kyunki assistant har baat nahi sambhal sakta.
🔀 Flowchart: Voice assistant: pipeline aur latency
Customer bolta hai
↓
Speech text mein badalti hai, har stage stream hota hai
↓
LLM jawab banata hai, text wapas awaaz mein
↓
Pause lagbhag 1 second se zyada hai?
HaanStage ko aur stream karo, latency kam karo
NahiCustomer ko achha lagta hai
↓
Sensitive detail ya user atak gaya?
HaanRepeat karke confirm karo ya human ko do
NahiBarge-in (beech mein bolna) handle karo
↓
Smooth baat, human tak raasta hamesha khula
Caller -> Speech-to-text (streaming) -> Dialogue manager + LLM
       -> Tools (account lookup, booking) -> Text-to-speech -> Caller
                       |
               Escalate to a human agent when unsure
Trade-off

Faster models sasta aur tez hain par hard requests pe kam accurate ho sakte hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Pipeline: speech-to-text, phir LLM, phir text-to-speech, sab streaming taaki har step jaldi shuru ho.
  • Barge-in caller ko interrupt karne deta hai aur assistant bolna band kar deta hai.
Architect notes
  • Har stage ke liye latency budget rakho; log lagbhag ek second se zyada delay notice karte hain, isliye time to first audio track karo.
  • Noisy lines, accents aur galat suni gayi numbers ko handle karo, key details jaise order ids ko zor se confirm karke.
  • Jab confidence low ho ya caller naraz ho, transcript ke saath human agent ko clean handoff do.
  • Recordings sensitive hain: consent, card data ki redaction aur retention limits zaroori hain.
  • Latency percentiles, word error rate, task completion aur handoff rate measure karo.

Production Troubleshooting

270

Latency achanak badh jaati hai. Aap kya karoge?

S41

Chhota jawab: Latency ko p50, p95 aur p99 mein todo taaki pata chale kaun sa badha, phir dekho kya change hua, slow step trace karo, aur wahi cause fix karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Average speed kuch bahut slow ShopBot answers ko chhupa deti hai. Typical, slow aur sabse slow cases alag alag dekho, phir check karo us din kya change hua. Jaise agar sirf sabse slow 1 percent slow hue, to koi ek slow tool ya queue dhundho.

Aise samjhoJaise railway mein average delay theek ho sakta hai par kuch trains 5 ghante late hon. Dono ka kaaran alag hota hai, isliye alag-alag dekhna padta hai.
Pehle yeh samjhotelemetry matlab har component ka naapa hua time. Isse pata chalta hai kaunsa hissa slow hai. Interview line ka matlab: naape bina sudharna andhere mein teer chalana hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Latency achanak badhi: kya karein
Latency achanak badh gayi
↓
p50, p95, p99 alag-alag dekho
↓
Sirf p99 (sabse dheemi requests) kharab hai?
HaanKuch khaas requests ya queue ki problem dhoondo
NahiSabhi requests slow: common component dhoondo
↓
Component-level telemetry se dekho kahan time ja raha hai
↓
Cause pakadkar fix karo, andaaze se nahi
Total latency = Network + Retrieval + Reranking
              + LLM + Tool calls + Post-processing
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • p50 typical request hai; p95 aur p99 slow tail hain.
  • Agar p50 badhe, to general slowdown suspect karo jaise model, network ya code change. Agar sirf p99 badhe, to queues, cold starts, retries, lambe prompts ya ek slow tool suspect karo.
Architect notes
  • Pehle dekho kya badla: deploy, traffic mix, prompt length, provider status; timeline se correlate karo.
  • Tail latency aksar retries aur timeouts ke stack hone se aati hai; queue depth aur saturation check karo.
  • Cause confirm karne ke baad timeouts, hedged requests, caching, streaming aur load shedding se mitigate karo.
  • Averages par nahi, per route aur per tenant percentiles par alert lagao.
  • Review mein fix kaam kiya iske saboot ke taur par before aur after percentile charts dikhao.
271

Vector database ka CPU 90% par hai. Aap kya karoge?

S43

Chhota jawab: Pehle workload pehchano: query rate, filters, index type aur top-k, phir scale karne se pehle tune karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agar kitchen busy hai, to doosra banane se pehle check karo kyon. Search database ke liye bhi yahi: dhundho kaun si cheez power kha rahi hai.

Aise samjhoJaise canteen mein bheed hai to naya kitchen banane se pehle dekho ki sab ek hi counter par kyon khade hain. Shayad line ka tarika badalna kaafi ho.
Pehle yeh samjhoCPU 90 percent matlab machine ka dimaag lagbhag poora vyast hai. Scale up matlab bada machine kharidna, par pehle dekho kaam ka tarika (workload) theek ho sakta hai ya nahi.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Dekho ki zyada padhne (read) ka kaam hai ya likhne (write) ka, kyunki dono ka load alag tarah ka hota hai.
  2. Index (search ko tez karne ka dhancha) ka type aur settings CPU ka use badal dete hain.
  3. Ek saath bahut queries aayein to CPU full ho jaata hai, jaise ek counter par bahut bheed.
  4. Zyada filtering (jaise sirf is category ke documents) search ko bhaari bana deti hai.
  5. Shard aur partition matlab data ko kai hisson mein baantna. Galat baantne se ek machine par load pad jaata hai.
  6. Vector dimension matlab har document ke numbers ki lambai. Jitni zyada, utna zyada compute.
  7. Caching se wahi query dobara aane par database tak jaana nahi padta, CPU bachta hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Vector DB CPU 90%: pehle workload
Vector database ka CPU 90 percent par hai
↓
Hardware badhane se pehle workload dekho
↓
Read versus write pattern aur query concurrency
↓
Index type, filtering, shard strategy, vector dimension
↓
Caching se load kam ho sakta hai?
HaanCache lagao
NahiIndex ya shard badlo
↓
Root cause theek karo, phir hi hardware badhao
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Faster approximate search kuch recall kho sakta hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Queries per second, vector size, top-k, filters aur index settings dekho.
  • Traffic spike, bad query pattern ya background re-index check karo.
Architect notes
  • Kharch karne se pehle profile karo: read load, write ya ingestion load aur compaction ko alag karo.
  • Replicas reads scale karte hain; sharding data size scale karti hai; har ek consistency aur cost ke considerations laata hai.
  • Memory aur quantisation ke choices compute kam kar sakte hain lekin test set par recall checks chahiye.
  • Rate limits aur backpressure se protect karo taaki ek tenant ise saturate na kar sake.
  • Latency, recall aur CPU ko saath track karo; jo fix recall ko nuksaan pahunchaye wo regression hai.
272

Agent ka success rate 95% se 70% par gir jaata hai. Aap kya karoge?

S44

Chhota jawab: Failures ko traces se cause, version aur time ke hisaab se segment karo; sabse badi category fix karo, phir re-test karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

95 se 70 percent par girne ka matlab kuch specific toota hai. Ek number ko ghoorne ki jagah failed ShopBot chats ko reasons mein sort karo.

Aise samjhoJaise class ka result 95 se 70 ho gaya to sirf average dekhna kaafi nahi. Dekho kis subject ya kis section ke bachche fail hue.
Pehle yeh samjhosession matlab ek user ki ek poori baat-cheet ya kaam. Trace us session ka step by step record hai, jise dekhkar failure ki category (retrieval, tool, prompt ya model) pata chalti hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Agent success 95% se 70%: breakdown
Agent ka success rate 95 se 70 percent ho gaya
↓
Success ko ek number mat maano, use todo
↓
Failed sessions ko traces se nikalo
↓
Failures ko categories mein baanto (retrieval, tool, prompt, model)
↓
Ek category sabse zyada hai?
HaanUs category ka cause fix karo
NahiHar category ko alag dekho
↓
Fix ke baad success dobara measure karo
Agent failure
 |-- Planning
 |-- Tool selection
 |-- Tool execution
 |-- State
 |-- Validation
 '-- Final response
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Jo badla uske saath compare karo: model, prompt, tools, data ya traffic mix.
  • Failed sessions ko categorise karo: wrong tool, tool error, bad retrieval, loop, refusal.
Architect notes
  • Success ko saaf define karo aur check karo ki metric khud nahi badla, jaise naya judge ya naya user mix.
  • Tenant, intent, language aur version se slice karo taaki pata chale gir kahan concentrate hai.
  • Investigate karte waqt suspected change ko rollback karo; fast rollback slow diagnosis se behtar hai.
  • Har failure category se regression tests add karo taaki wo chupke se wapas na aa sake.
  • Ek chhote post-incident review mein root cause, blast radius aur prevention report karo.
273

Ek tool API reliable nahi hai. Aap kya karoge?

S45

Chhota jawab: Unreliable tools ko timeouts, backoff ke saath retries, circuit breakers aur fallbacks se wrap karo; tool ko LLM se alag judge karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agar courier aksar late hai, to courier fix karo, dukaan nahi. ShopBot ke case mein order-lookup service fail ho rahi ho sakti hai, AI nahi.

Aise samjhoJaise courier wala kabhi-kabhi late aata hai to hum dukaan ko nahi, courier ko theek karte hain. Aur ek backup courier rakhte hain.
Pehle yeh samjhotimeout matlab zyada der intezaar nahi, retry matlab dobara koshish, fallback matlab doosra raasta. Tool API ek bahari service hai jise agent call karta hai, jaise order status.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Timeout matlab ek had ke baad intezaar chhod dena, aur retry matlab dobara koshish karna, taaki agent atak kar na reh jaye.
  2. Circuit breaker matlab bar-bar fail hone par us tool ko call karna band karna. Fallback matlab koi doosra raasta ya simple jawab tayar rakhna.
  3. Idempotency matlab ek hi request do baar chali jaye to bhi asar ek hi baar ho, jaise payment do baar na kate.
  4. Observability matlab logs aur metrics se dekh paana ki tool kab aur kyun fail hua.
🔀 Flowchart: Unreliable tool API: bachao
Ek tool API kabhi kabhi fail hoti hai
↓
Pehle pakka karo ki tool ki problem hai, LLM ki nahi
↓
Timeout lagao aur retry karo
↓
Baar-baar fail ho raha hai?
HaanCircuit breaker call rokta hai, fallback do
NahiNormal chalne do
↓
Idempotency: retry se kaam do baar na ho
↓
Observability se tool ki health dikhti rehti hai
Agent -> Tool gateway -> Circuit breaker -> External API
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Tool success rate aur latency ko model quality se alag measure karo.
  • Timeouts, backoff ke saath retries aur ek circuit breaker use karo jo fail ho rahi service ko call karna band kar de.
Architect notes
  • Write calls ko keys ke saath idempotent banao, warna retry se order ya payment duplicate ho sakta hai.
  • Structured errors return karo taaki agent decide kar sake, aur retries cap karo taaki loops tokens na jalayein.
  • Contract tests chalao aur dependency ko uske apne SLO aur alerts ke saath monitor karo.
  • Model ko kabhi failed call ko successful dikhane mat do; failure user ko saaf dikhao.
  • Tool ko bulkhead ya isolate karo taaki uski slowness shared workers ko khatam na kar de.
274

Production mein hallucination achanak badh jaata hai. Aap kya karoge?

S46

Chhota jawab: Pehle list karo kya badla, phir golden set se compare karo taaki nayi hallucinations ka cause mile.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agar answers achanak galat hone lagein, to pehle poochho kal kya badla. Phir ShopBot ko aise questions ke set par check karo jinke correct answers pata hain.

Aise samjhoJaise kal tak theek chalti ghadi achanak galat time dikhaye to pehle yaad karo kal kya badla: battery, strap ya time setting.
Pehle yeh samjhogolden set sahi jawabon ki list hai jisse naye version ki quality compare hoti hai. Revert matlab badlav wapas lena. Stale documents purane ho chuke documents hain.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Embedding model (jo text ko meaning-numbers mein badalta hai) badal gaya to purane aur naye numbers ka match bigad sakta hai, aur galat documents milne lagte hain.
  2. Documents badal gaye ya purane (stale) ho gaye ho, to model purani ya galat baat batata hai.
  3. Retrieval threshold (kitna match hone par document lena) badla ho ya reranker (jo results ko dobara sahi order deta hai) hata diya ho, to kharab documents aa jaate hain.
  4. Prompt ya model badalne se bhi jawab ka tareeka badal sakta hai, isliye ye bhi check karo.
🔀 Flowchart: Hallucination badha: kaise dhoondein
Production mein hallucination achanak badh gaya
↓
Recent changes compare karo, phir golden set se
↓
Embedding model badla?
HaanRetrieval quality dobara check karo
NahiAage dekho
↓
Documents stale hain ya threshold ya reranker badla?
HaanData update karo, retrieval setting wapas karo
NahiPrompt ya model change check karo
↓
Jo change cause nikla use revert ya fix karo
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Recent changes compare karo: prompt, model version, retrieval data, chunking, traffic.
  • Golden set (verified answers wale questions) chalao aur dekho kaun se fail hote hain.
Architect notes
  • Har answer ke saath retrieved context log karke retrieval failure ko generation failure se alag karo.
  • Provider-side model updates behaviour shift kar sakte hain; versions pin karo aur change notices par evals dobara chalao.
  • Groundedness checks add karo aur high-risk topics mein support missing ho to abstain karo.
  • Sirf test-set rate nahi, asli rate estimate karne ke liye production answers ko human review ke liye sample karo.
  • Pehle rollback karo, phir root-cause; impact ke baare mein imaandaari se communicate karo.
275

LLM response mein personal data (PII) reveal kar deta hai. Aap kya karoge?

S48

Chhota jawab: Pehle contain karo, phir leak path dhundho, redaction aur access controls add karo, aur dobara na ho iske liye test karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agar ShopBot kisi customer ki private details repeat kar de, to leak roko, dhundho data kahan se ghusa, aur pakka karo ki wo dobara bahar na aa sake.

Aise samjhoJaise bank ka clerk customer ka PIN kisi se baat karte waqt bol de. Behtar hai ki PIN uske paas pahunche hi nahi jab tak zaroorat na ho.
Pehle yeh samjhomodel ko wahi data do jo kaam ke liye zaroori ho. Interview line ka matlab: private data model ko bhejo hi mat jab tak sach mein zaroorat na ho, to wo leak bhi nahi hoga.
🔀 Flowchart: LLM ne PII reveal kiya: rokthaam
LLM response mein personal data (PII) aa gaya
↓
Kya model ko yeh data bhejna zaroori tha?
HaanData tabhi bhejo jab zaroorat ho
NahiData context se hata do
↓
Output mein PII detection aur redaction (chhupana) lagao
↓
Incident log karo aur cause dhoondo
↓
Sensitive data model context mein tab tak nahi jab tak zaroorat na ho
Input -> PII detection -> Authorisation -> LLM
      -> PII detection -> Output
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Contain karo: feature ya path disable karo, aur investigation ke liye logs preserve karo.
  • Source dhundho: retrieved documents, training data, logs, ya aisa prompt jisme private data tha.
Architect notes
  • Ise ek security incident ki tarah treat karo, owners, timeline aur jahan zaroori ho legal ya privacy involvement ke saath.
  • Access ko retrieval par enforce karo taaki model wo data kabhi na dekhe jo user ko dekhna allowed nahi.
  • Output scanners ko allow-lists ke saath layer karo; koi ek filter complete nahi hota, isliye red-team prompts se test karo.
  • Data retention, logging aur vendor terms review karo; jahan ho sake exposed data delete karo.
  • Leak-test pass rate track karo aur use release gate mein shamil karo.
276

Naya prompt ya model production mein safely kaise roll out karoge?

S89

Chhota jawab: Gradually roll out karo: offline evals, shadow, canary, A/B, monitor, aur instant rollback ke saath.

Aasan shabdon mein

Naya prompt pehle kuch ShopBot users pe try karo. Chal gaya toh zyada logon ko do. Nahi chala toh jaldi wapas switch karo.

Aise samjhoJaise naya menu pehle ek table par test hota hai, pasand aaye to poore restaurant mein lagta hai. Sabko ek saath kuch naya nahi khilate.
Pehle yeh samjhooffline test matlab live users ke bina pehle test, shadow mode matlab chupke se live traffic par chalana, canary matlab bahut chhote group par. Interview line ka matlab: naya prompt kabhi sabko ek saath nahi, pehle thoda, phir badhao.
🔀 Flowchart: Naya prompt safely roll out
Naya prompt ya model ready hai
↓
Offline test: golden set chalao, current se compare karo
↓
Shadow mode: live traffic par chalao, users ko dikhao nahi
↓
Canary: 1 se 5 percent users par metrics dekho
↓
Metrics theek hain?
HaanDheere dheere ramp up karo
NahiRollback switch se purane version par jao
↓
Koi prompt change ek saath sabko nahi jata
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Kisi user ke dekhne se pehle golden set pe offline test karo.
  • Shadow mode naye version ko chupke se chalata hai; canary real traffic ka chhota percent bhejta hai.
Architect notes
  • Launch se pehle success aur stop criteria define karo taaki decisions feel se na liye jaayein.
  • Feature flags aur per-segment rollout use karo; risky tenants ya languages aakhir mein jaayein.
  • Sirf headline score nahi, guardrail metrics jaise safety aur refusals bhi dekho.
  • Model versions pin karo; provider updates bhi changes hain aur unhe wahi process chahiye.
  • Review trail ke liye experiment aur outcome record karo.
277

Ek user shikayat karta hai: "Bot ne kal mujhe galat answer diya." Tum investigate kaise karoge?

S90

Chhota jawab: Logs se reproduce karo: exact request, versions aur context dhundo, phir cause classify karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Complaint check karne ke liye records mein woh ShopBot chat dhundo, dekho use kya bataya gaya aur usne kya bola, aur samjho kya galat hua.

Aise samjhoJaise train late hone par railway CCTV aur register dekh kar pata lagata hai ki kya hua. Record nahi hoga to bas andaza lagega.
Pehle yeh samjhoconversation id us baat-cheet ki pehchan hai. Replay matlab wahi input dobara chalana. Regression set purane failures ki list hai jo dobara na ho, isliye is case ko usme jodo.
🔀 Flowchart: Galat answer ki shikayat: investigate
User: bot ne kal galat answer diya
↓
User, time, conversation id se poora trace nikalo
↓
Same prompt, context, model version ke saath replay karo
↓
Retrieved evidence galat ya missing tha?
HaanRetrieval ya data theek karo
NahiDekho ki evidence ignore hua ya tool galat tha
↓
Cause fix karo
↓
Is case ko regression set mein add karo
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Conversation ko id aur time se locate karo; same prompt aur model version se replay karo.
  • Us turn ke retrieved documents aur tool outputs inspect karo.
Architect notes
  • Iske liye logging pehle se design honi chahiye: trace ids, versions aur context, retention aur access limits ke saath store.
  • Non-determinism ka matlab replay alag ho sakta hai; original output aur settings store karo.
  • Privacy ka khayal rakho: logs kaun padh sakta hai restrict karo aur sensitive content redact karo.
  • User ko honestly respond karo aur recurring causes track karo taaki systemic issues mil sakein.
  • Root cause tak ka time aur complaints ka woh hissa measure karo jo regression tests ban gaya.
278

Ek abusive user ki wajah se cost mein spike aaye to kaise handle karoge?

S91

Chhota jawab: Per-user rate limits, budgets, identity checks aur alerts use karo; abuse ko automatically block karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Agar ek insaan ShopBot ko nonstop use kare aur bill jump ho jaye, toh per-person limit lagao aur usage unusual lage toh alert lo.

Aise samjhoJaise hotel ke buffet mein ek aadmi poora khana pack karne lage. Isliye per person limit hoti hai aur entry par pehchaan dekhi jati hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoabusive user matlab jo system ka galat fayda utha raha hai. Authenticate matlab login zaroori, anonymous matlab bina pehchan ke.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Rate limit matlab ek time mein kitni requests, aur token budget matlab kitne tokens use kar sakte ho. Har user aur har tenant (company) ke liye alag limit lagao.
  2. Jawab ki lambai aur agent kitne steps le sakta hai, uski upar-seema (cap) rakho, taaki kharcha control mein rahe.
  3. Agar kisi ka use achanak ajeeb ho jaye to alert aaye, taaki jaldi pata chale.
  4. Har request par login (authenticate) maango aur bina pehchan ke zyada use rok do.
  5. Logs dekho ki koi bahut lamba text bhar raha hai (prompt-stuffing) ya automatic tarike se data kheench raha hai (scraping).
🔀 Flowchart: Abusive user se cost spike: rokna
Ek abusive user se cost spike aaya
↓
Unusual usage par alert aata hai
↓
Logs mein prompt-stuffing ya scraping review karo
↓
User authenticated hai?
HaanPer-user rate limit aur token budget lagao
NahiAnonymous heavy use block karo
↓
Output length aur agent steps par cap lagao
↓
Cost control mein, genuine users par asar nahi
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Login ya API keys zaroori karo taaki usage ek identity se bandha rahe.
  • Har user ke liye rate limits aur daily token ya cost budgets lagao.
Architect notes
  • Limits ko plan ke hisaab se tier karo; hard caps aur soft warnings rakho taaki real heavy users ko nuksan na ho.
  • Anomaly rules se scraping, automated loops ya stolen keys jaise patterns detect karo.
  • Prompt-based abuse se bachao jo expensive tool ya agent loops trigger karta hai; step caps use karo.
  • Global circuit breaker lagao taaki total spend budget se upar na jaye.
  • Cost per user distribution aur false-block rate measure karo.

Speed, Safety, Ethics and Real-World Judgement

279

Quantisation, continuous batching aur KV cache se inference ko tez aur sasta kaise banate ho?

Q222

Chhota jawab: Inference cost ko quantisation, continuous batching, KV cache aur chhote ya cached kaam se kam karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

ShopBot ko tez aur sasta banane ka matlab: model ke andar chhote numbers use karna, kai questions ek saath handle karna, aur jo kaam ho chuka use yaad rakhna.

Aise samjhoJaise tiffin service: dabba halka karo (quantisation), ek gaadi mein kai logon ka tiffin lo (batching), aur roz same sabzi ek baar pehle hi bana lo (cache).
Pehle yeh samjhobit number store karne ka naap hai. 32-bit se 8-bit karna matlab har number kam jagah leta hai, jaise 3.14159 ko 3.14 likhna: thoda kam sahi par bahut halka.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Quantisation matlab model ke numbers (weights) ko kam bits mein rakhna, jaise 32-bit ki jagah 8-bit. Model chhota aur tez hota hai, bas accuracy thodi kam ho sakti hai.
  2. Continuous batching matlab ek GPU par kai users ke kaam saath chalana, aur jaise hi ek khatam ho, uski jagah nayi request daal dena, jaise restaurant mein khali table turant bhar jaye.
  3. KV-cache matlab model ne pehle jo hisaab kiya wo yaad rakhna. Lamba system prompt har baar same ho to wahi hisaab dobara nahi karna padta.
  4. vLLM aur TensorRT-LLM aise tools hain jo model ko tez aur sasta serve karne ke liye bane hain, interview mein inka naam lena kaafi hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Inference tez aur sasta: teen tareeke
LLM inference (jawab banana) dheema aur mehnga hai
↓
Quantisation: weights 32-bit se 8-bit, chhota aur fast
↓
Continuous batching: ek GPU par kai users, request khatam toh nayi slot
↓
KV-cache reuse: lamba system prompt ka kaam dobara nahi
↓
Serving tools: vLLM, TensorRT-LLM
↓
Kam cost mein zyada requests, thoda accuracy cost
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Quantisation se quality thodi gir sakti hai; bade batches single-request latency badha sakte hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Quantisation weights ko kam bits mein store karta hai, memory bachata hai aur serving tez karta hai.
  • Continuous batching chalte hue batch mein nayi requests jodta hai taaki GPU busy rahe.
Architect notes
  • Quantisation se pehle aur baad mein apne tasks pe quality measure karo; rules of thumb evals ki jagah nahi le sakte.
  • Batching throughput aur cost sudharta hai lekin time to first token pe asar daalta hai; apne latency target ke hisaab se tune karo.
  • Lambe contexts mein KV cache bahut memory leta hai; isse concurrency limit hoti hai, isliye context length manage karo.
  • Prompt caching, chhote models, chhote outputs, speculative decoding aur routing ke baare mein bhi socho.
  • Pehle aur baad mein cost per request, tokens per second aur p95 latency report karo.
280

Reliability ke liye design kaise karte ho?

Q223

Chhota jawab: Failure ke liye design karo: timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, fallbacks, redundancy aur graceful degradation.

Aasan shabdon mein

Ghar ke circuit breaker jaisa, system chhote failures pe retry karta hai aur toote hue hisse ko call karna band kar deta hai. Phir bhi ShopBot ek simple tareeke se jawab deta hai.

Aise samjhoJaise ghar mein MCB hota hai: kuch kharab ho to bijli kat deta hai taaki aag na lage, aur thodi der baad dobara try karte hain.
Pehle yeh samjhoShopBot is guide ka example online shop ka chatbot hai. Exponential backoff matlab har retry se pehle pichhle se zyada wait. Jitter matlab wait mein thoda random jodna taaki sab ek saath na tootein.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Temporary fail hone par dobara koshish karo, har baar thoda zyada wait karke (exponential backoff) aur thoda random wait jod kar (jitter), taaki sab ek saath na tootein.
  2. Circuit breaker bijli ke fuse jaisa hai. Service baar-baar fail ho to usse call karna rok do, aur thodi der baad ek test request bhej kar dekho ki theek hui ya nahi.
  3. Prometheus (metrics jama karne wala tool) aur Grafana (unko graph mein dikhane wala tool) se dekho: kitna slow (latency), kitni requests (traffic), kitni galtiyan (errors), aur system kitna bhar gaya (saturation).
🔀 Flowchart: Reliability: retry aur circuit breaker
ShopBot ki ek service kabhi fail ho jaati hai
↓
Temporary failure par exponential backoff aur jitter ke saath retry karo
↓
Baar-baar failure aa raha hai?
HaanCircuit breaker call band karta hai
NahiRetry se kaam ban gaya
↓
Thodi der baad service ko dobara test karo
↓
Prometheus aur Grafana se latency, traffic, errors, saturation dekho
↓
Failure se poora system nahi girta
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Redundancy aur fallbacks se cost aur complexity badhti hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Backoff ke saath Retries chhote glitches handle karte hain; circuit breakers failing service ko calls rok dete hain.
  • Fallbacks jodo: backup provider, chhota model, cached answer ya human handoff.
Architect notes
  • SLOs aur error budgets define karo; reliability ka kaam measured failure modes ko target kare.
  • Retries outages ko amplify kar sakte hain; jitter, limits aur idempotency use karo.
  • Multi-provider fallback ke liye prompt compatibility testing aur barabar safety behaviour chahiye.
  • Fail hone ke bajay gracefully degrade karo: pehle optional features band karo, core answers chalu rakho.
  • Failure drills se practise karo aur availability aur recovery time track karo.
281

Agent ki response latency kaise kam karte ho?

Q224

Chhota jawab: Pehle measure karo ki time kahan ja raha hai, phir steps kam karo, parallelise karo, stream karo, cache karo aur chhote models use karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

ShopBot slow hai to dhoondho ki kaun sa step sabse lamba hai, jaise kitchen mein slow cook ko dhoondhna, aur usi hisse ko tez karo.

Aise samjhoJaise kitchen mein dal aur sabzi ek saath chadhate hain, ek ke baad ek nahi. Aur jo cheez pehle bani hai use dobara nahi banate.
Pehle yeh samjhoindependent tool calls matlab jinka result ek doosre par depend nahi karta, jaise do alag jagah se data lana. Unhe ek saath chalao to total time kam hota hai.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Andaza mat lagao, pehle naapo ki time kis step mein ja raha hai, phir wahi sudharo.
  2. Jo tool calls ek doosre par depend nahi karte, unhe ek saath chalao, aur async code (jo intezaar karte waqt kuch aur kaam kar de) use karo.
  3. Streaming matlab jawab ban-te hi dikhana shuru kar dena. Cache matlab purane results yaad rakhna, taaki dobara na banana pade.
  4. Aasan steps ke liye chhota model kaafi hai aur wo tez bhi hota hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Agent latency kam karne ke steps
Agent ka response slow hai
↓
Pehle measure karo ki time kahan ja raha hai
↓
Tool calls ek doosre par depend nahi karte?
HaanParallel aur async chalao
NahiOrder mein chalne do
↓
Output stream karo aur results cache karo
↓
Simple steps ke liye chhote models use karo
↓
User ko jaldi jawab milta hai
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Har step trace karo: model calls, retrieval aur tools.
  • Independent tool calls ko parallelise karo aur bekaar LLM round trips kam karo.
Architect notes
  • Agents mein latency aksar sequential model calls ki ginti hoti hai; steps kam karna har step ko tez karne se behtar hai.
  • Time to first token ko total time se alag track karo; perceived speed matter karti hai.
  • Speculative ya early actions se cost waste aur side effects ka risk hai; unhe safe reads tak rakho.
  • Worst case bound karne ke liye per-step timeouts aur step cap set karo.
  • Har workflow ka p50 aur p95 report karo, aur dhyan rakho ki quality na gire.
282

Agent ki robustness kaise test karte ho?

Q225

Chhota jawab: Robustness ko typos, empty input, load, lambe input aur adversarial prompts se test karo, phir regressions add karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Car ko kharab sadakon pe test karne jaisa, ShopBot ko spelling mistakes, khali messages, bhaari bheed aur tricky sawalon se try karo.

Aise samjhoJaise nayi gaadi ka test: kharab sadak, bhaari load, tez baarish. Sirf smooth road par chalake nahi dekhte.
Pehle yeh samjhorobustness matlab agent ka kharab ya ajeeb input par bhi sahi chalna. Chaaron tareeke alag-alag tarah ki mushkil situation banate hain.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Input perturbation matlab input ko thoda bigaad kar test karna, jaise spelling galti, ajeeb format ya extra spaces, aur dekhna ki agent tab bhi theek chalta hai.
  2. Boundary cases matlab kinaare wale case, jaise khali input, sabse lamba input, ya wo language jo support nahi hoti.
  3. Stress test matlab bahut zyada load daal kar dekhna ki agent tikta hai ya nahi.
  4. Adversarial test matlab jaanbujh kar agent ko behkaane ki koshish, jaise injection (chhupe hue instructions) aur jailbreak (rules todne ki chaal).
🔀 Flowchart: Agent robustness testing ke 4 tareeke
Agent ko kharab inputs se jhelna sikhana hai
↓
Input perturbation: typos, ajeeb formats, extra spaces
↓
Boundary cases: empty input, max length, unsupported language
↓
Stress test: heavy load mein chalao
↓
Adversarial test: injection aur jailbreak attempts
↓
Jo fail ho woh fix karke dobara test karo
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Input tests: typos, empty, bahut lamba, mixed languages, ajeeb formats.
  • Load tests: bahut saare users ek saath, latency aur errors dekhne ke liye.
Architect notes
  • Tool failures, timeouts aur bad tool output bhi include karo, kyunki agents aksar wahin tootte hain.
  • Tests ko CI mein automatically chalao taaki har prompt ya model change check ho.
  • Category aur severity ke hisaab se pass rate measure karo; unsafe actions release blockers hain.
  • Fuzz aur mutation-style tests aise cases dhoondhte hain jo insaan nahi sochte; human red teamers bhi rakho.
  • Safe failure behaviour check karo: galat confident jawab ke bajay clear refusal ya escalation.
283

Ek stock trading agent design karo. Kaun se modules chahiye?

Q229

Chhota jawab: Trading agent ke modules: data, signals, risk limits, deterministic execution, paper trading aur audit.

Aasan shabdon mein

Trading AI ko data, ideas, safety limits aur orders lagane ke liye alag hisse chahiye. Pehle nakli paise se practise karo.

Aise samjhoJaise cricket ka naya khiladi pehle net practice, phir practice match, phir real match khelta hai. Seedha final mein nahi utarta.
Pehle yeh samjhomodules matlab system ke hisse: data tools (asli prices), LLM (salah), backtest aur paper-trade (safe test), aur regulations check. Asli paisa lagane se pehle safe test zaroor hone chahiye.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Pehle purane data par test (backtest), phir nakli paise se chalao (paper-trade), aur asli paisa lagane se pehle niyam (regulations) check karo. Ye ek ek karke safe tareeka hai.
  2. Share ke numbers ke liye LLM ki yaaddasht par bharosa mat karo, wo galat bol sakta hai. Data tools se asli numbers lo.
🔀 Flowchart: Stock trading agent: modules aur safety
Stock trading agent design karna hai
↓
Data tools se prices lao, LLM ki memory par bharosa nahi
↓
LLM analysis aur suggestion deta hai
↓
Pehle backtest (purane data par) karo
↓
Phir paper-trade (nakli paise se) karo
↓
Regulations check ho gaye?
HaanTabhi real paisa lagao
NahiReal trading roko
↓
Numbers tools se, LLM sirf salah
Data (prices, filings, news) -> Reasoning (thesis + confidence)
   -> Action (orders) -> Safety (limits, stop-loss, kill switch, human approval)
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Zyada automation ka matlab tez action, lekin kuch galat hua to bada nuksan.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Modules: market data, research ya signal, risk engine, order execution, monitoring.
  • LLM news summarise kar sakta hai ya ideas suggest kar sakta hai; numbers trusted data se aate hain.
Architect notes
  • Hard limits code mein rakho: position size, loss limits, kill switch; LLM unhe override nahi kar sakta.
  • Backtests overfitting aur lookahead bias se gumraah kar sakte hain; out of sample validate karo.
  • Kai markets mein regulation, audit trails aur har order ki explainability zaroori hai.
  • Data feed errors aur latency handle karo; stale prices ek classic failure hain.
  • Risk-adjusted return, drawdown aur slippage measure karo, aur ek human supervisor rakho.
284

Agents mein hallucination ko kaise solve karte ho?

Q230

Chhota jawab: Answers ko trusted sources par ground karo, citations zaroori rakho, checks se verify karo, aur jab checks fail ho ya source na mile to human ko hand over karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

ShopBot ko making things up se rokne ke liye use sirf real return-policy documents se answer karne do, source dikhao, aur kuch match na ho to "mujhe nahi pata" bolne do. Example: kisi rare item ka document nahi hai to wo guess nahi karega, escalate karega.

Aise samjhoJaise student ko open-book exam mein kitab dekhne do aur har jawab ke saath page number likhwao. Andaze se likhna band ho jata hai.
Pehle yeh samjhogrounding matlab jawab ko asli documents se jodna. Threshold matlab minimum bharose ki limit. Isse neeche score ho to jawab nahi, insaan ko bhejo.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. RAG (pehle sahi documents dhoondh kar jawab dena) se jawab asli source se jura rehta hai, ise grounding kehte hain.
  2. Jawab ki har baat (claim) ko alag-alag fact-check karo.
  3. Confidence score matlab model kitna pakka hai. Agar score threshold se kam ho to baat insaan ko bhej do.
  4. Constrained generation matlab jawab ko tay options ya format mein rakhna, aur self-consistency matlab kai baar poochh kar dekhna ki jawab same aata hai ya nahi.
  5. Jahan galti ka nuksaan bada ho, wahan insaan jaanch kar hi aage jaaye.
🔀 Flowchart: Agent hallucination ke layers
Agent ne galat baat banayi (hallucination)
↓
Grounding: RAG se sahi documents do
↓
Claim by claim fact-check karo
↓
Confidence threshold se upar hai?
HaanJawab do
NahiHuman ko escalate karo
↓
Constrained generation aur self-consistency lagao
↓
High-stakes output par human review
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • RAG se grounding agent ko real source text deti hai.
  • Citations zaroori karo aur check karo ki har claim retrieved text se supported hai.
Architect notes
  • RAG se ground karo, aur model ko bolo ki sirf context se answer de aur context khali ho to refuse kare.
  • Verifier step lagao: rules ya LLM judge check kare ki har claim cited chunk se supported hai.
  • Numbers, IDs aur policies ke liye tools aur structured outputs use karo, taaki model yaad se na bole.
  • Golden set par groundedness aur hallucination rate track karo, aur production traffic sample karo.
  • Low-evidence ya high-risk answers human ko route karo. Self-reported confidence unreliable hai, isliye evidence signals use karo.
285

Agent ko 0 se 1 tak banane ki methodology kya hai?

Q231

Chhota jawab: Agent banane ke liye problem define karo, simple se shuru karo, tools jodo, evaluate karo, phir dhyan se scale karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Ghar banane jaisa: pehle plan, phir ek chhota hissa banao, test karo, phir aur jodo. ShopBot ko ek simple kaam se shuru karo.

Aise samjhoJaise ghar banana: pehle naksha, phir neev, phir deewarein, aur har stage par check. Seedha chhat daalne nahi lagte.
Pehle yeh samjho0 se 1 matlab bilkul shuruat se pehla kaam karne wala agent. Success metric matlab kaise pata chalega ki kaam sahi hai. Load test matlab bahut users ek saath daal kar dekhna.
🔀 Flowchart: Agent 0 se 1: build methodology
Problem aur success metrics define karo
↓
Tools aur guardrails scope karo
↓
Knowledge base taiyaar karo
↓
Sabse simple prototype banao
↓
Test set par evaluate karo, phir harden karo (errors, safety, monitoring, load tests)
↓
Quality aur safety theek hain?
HaanUsers ke chhote hisse ko release karo
NahiWapas improve karo
↓
Feedback se iterate karte raho
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Task aur success metrics clearly define karo.
  • Poore agent se pehle simple prompt ya workflow se shuru karo.
Architect notes
  • Wo sabse simple design chuno jo kaam kare; autonomy cost, latency aur risk badhati hai.
  • Eval set jaldi banao; wahi baad ke har decision ko drive karta hai.
  • Tools ko least privilege aur step caps se constrain karo; risky actions ke liye human approval plan karo.
  • Stages mein ship karo: internal pilot, limited users, phir wider, monitoring aur rollback ke saath.
  • Ownership, maintenance aur cost tracking plan karo, kyunki agents ko ongoing tuning chahiye.
286

System 1,000 users par chalta hai. 10,000 par latency 500 ms se 5 s ho jaati hai. Top bottlenecks kya hain?

Q232

Chhota jawab: Pehla saturated resource dhoondho: LLM provider limits, queues, vector DB, tools ya app concurrency.

Aasan shabdon mein

Jab ShopBot 1,000 se 10,000 users pe jaata hai, to kuch traffic jam ban jaata hai. Dhoondho ki kaun sa hissa jam hai.

Aise samjhoJaise shaadi mein 100 mehmaan ho to ek counter chal jata hai, 1000 aayein to line lagti hai. Dekhna padta hai kaun sa counter bheed mein atka.
Pehle yeh samjhoms matlab millisecond, 500 ms aadha second hai, aur 5 s paanch second, yaani 10 guna slow. Bottleneck wo jagah hai jahan sabse zyada atakta hai. Throughput matlab ek second mein kitna kaam.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. LLM provider ki rate limit (ek time mein kitni requests) pehla bottleneck hai. Queue lagao, cache karo, aur doosra provider backup rakho.
  2. Vector database ek saath itni queries na jhel paye to scale karo (zyada machines), cache karo, aur approximate search (kareeb ka jaldi wala match) use karo.
  3. App server thak jaye to auto-scale (load ke saath machines apne aap badhna), async code aur load balancer (bheed baantne wala) use karo.
  4. Pehle trace (request ka poora raasta) dekh kar pakka karo ki asli dikkat kahan hai, phir sudharo.
🔀 Flowchart: 1,000 se 10,000 users: bottleneck
10,000 users par latency 500 ms se 5 s ho gayi
↓
Pehle trace karke confirm karo kahan atak raha hai
↓
LLM provider rate limit hit ho raha hai?
HaanQueue, caching, fallback provider
NahiAage dekho
↓
Vector database throughput kam hai?
HaanScale karo, cache karo, approximate search
NahiApp server dekho
↓
App server: auto-scale, async code, load balancer
↓
Bottleneck fix karke dobara load test karo
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Provider rate limits aur queueing delays check karo.
  • Vector database load, connection pools, database aur tool services check karo.
Architect notes
