  • Bottleneck dhoondhne ke liye anda_dhanda nahi, traces aur saturation metrics (queue depth, CPU, connections) use karo.
  • Das guna jump ke saath das guna latency badhna queueing dikhata hai; system apni capacity knee ke paar hai.
  • Provider quotas aksar hidden cap hote hain; higher limits aur multi-provider routing arrange karo.
  • Backpressure aur load shedding peaks mein core path ki raksha karte hain.
  • Launch se pehle expected peak pe load tests chalao, aur bade changes ke baad dohrao.
287

Provider A 2 guna tez hai lekin 3 guna mehnga, B slow hai lekin sasta. Din bhar traffic 10 guna badalta hai. Hybrid routing kaise design karoge?

Q233

Chhota jawab: Default mein cheap B use karo, sirf latency-critical traffic fast A ko do (spend cap ke saath), aur ek slow, rate-limited ya down ho to dusre par failover karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Decision: ShopBot ka zyada kaam B karega, jaise batch jobs, summaries aur background tasks. A sirf live chat ke liye, jahan user wait kar raha hai. Daily peak mein B slow ho ya limit hit kare to overflow ka ek capped hissa A ko jayega.

Aise samjhoJaise Rajdhani aur sadharan train mein se chunna: jaldi ho to Rajdhani, aaram se jaana ho to sasti train. Dono ka mix use karte hain.
Pehle yeh samjhoprovider A tez par mehnga, B slow par sasta. Premium user wo hai jo zyada paise deta hai aur jaldi jawab chahta hai. Off-peak matlab kam traffic ka time.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Premium users aur achanak traffic badhne par tez provider use karo, kyunki wahan der nahi lagni chahiye.
  2. Raat ya kam traffic wale time aur batch jobs (jo turant nahi chahiye) sasta provider handle kare, isse paisa bachta hai.
  3. Agar tez provider fail ho jaye to sasta provider backup ban kar kaam sambhal le.
  4. Routing ke rules config file mein rakho, taaki code dobara deploy kiye bina badal sako.
🔀 Flowchart: Hybrid routing: tez ya sasta provider
Request aati hai, traffic din bhar 10 guna badalta hai
↓
Premium user ya traffic spike hai?
HaanTez provider A (mehnga) ko bhejo
NahiOff-peak ya batch job hai
↓
Off-peak aur batch jobs sasta provider B ko do
↓
Chuna hua provider fail hua?
HaanDoosre provider par fallback
NahiNormal jawab do
↓
Rules config mein rakho, redeploy ke bina badlo
↓
Speed aur cost ka balance
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Do providers ka matlab double testing, alag answer style aur do rate limits.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Step 1: latency target set karo (jaise reply 2 second se kam). B pehle se meet karta hai to us traffic ke liye A ki zarurat nahi.
  • Step 2: har request ko interactive ya background tag karo. Interactive A ko, background B ko.
Architect notes
  • Pehle measure karo: apne real prompts par dono ka p95 latency aur cost per request. 2x speed ka fayda 3x cost ke layak sirf user-facing steps mein hai.
  • Router rules: interactive aur latency-critical A ko. Batch, async aur simple requests B ko. B par jahan possible ho batch APIs use karo.
  • Peak handling: B base capacity hai. Overflow A ko budget cap aur alert ke saath. Caching se dono ka load kam karo.
  • Reliability: timeouts, retries aur circuit breakers, har provider dusre ka fallback. Har provider ki rate limits aur quotas check karo.
  • Dono ke liye ek prompt set aur ek eval suite rakho, aur model update par re-run karo taaki quality barabar rahe.
288

Agent ke hallucination se $10,000 ka nuksaan hua. CEO kehta hai "hallucinations band kar do". Aap kya karoge?

Q234

Chhota jawab: Koi switch nahi hai; grounding, verification, limits, human approval aur monitoring se risk kam karo.

Aasan shabdon mein

Honest raho: AI ko kabhi cheezein banane se rok nahi sakte. Lekin checks jod sakte hain taaki ek galti bada nuksan na kare.

Aise samjhoJaise bank ka calculator kabhi-kabhi galti kare to manager kehta hai ki bade lenden par officer ka sign zaroori. Galti ka switch nahi, check ka system hota hai.
Pehle yeh samjho$10,000 ka nuksaan matlab lagbhag 8 lakh rupaye ke aaspaas. 'Outputs ko database ki values tak restrict' matlab agent sirf wahi number bole jo asli record mein likha ho, apni taraf se nahi.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Agent ka jawab sirf database mein maujood values tak seemit karo, taaki wo apni taraf se number na bana sake.
  2. Paise wale faisle par insaan ki approval lo.
  3. Jawab ko asli records se match kar ke verify karo.
  4. Har faisle ka log rakho, taaki baad mein pata chale kya aur kyun hua.
🔀 Flowchart: $10,000 loss: CEO ko plan do
Hallucination se $10,000 ka nuksaan hua
↓
CEO: hallucinations band karo. Honestly batao koi switch nahi hai
↓
Outputs ko database ki values tak restrict karo
↓
Answers ko records ke against verify karo
↓
Paise ka decision hai?
HaanHuman approval zaroori
NahiVerified answer do
↓
Har decision log karo
↓
Koi unverified number customer tak nahi pahunchega
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Samjhao ki hallucination current models ke kaam karne ke tareeke ki property hai.
  • Ise kam karo: grounded answers, citations, verification aur abstain karna.
Architect notes
  • Errors khatam karne se hatkar risk manage karne ki soch rakho: expected loss barabar error rate guna impact.
  • Impact ko structurally cap karo: spending limits, reversible actions, thresholds ke upar approvals.
  • Post-incident analysis karo, regression tests jodo aur improved metrics CEO ko report karo.
  • Risk management ke hisse ke roop mein insurance, contracts aur disclosure ke baare mein socho.
  • Message calm aur honest rakho; fix ka overpromise karna galat jawab hai.
289

Ek regulated industry har decision ke liye explainability maangti hai. LLMs explainable nahi hain. Aap kya karoge?

Q235

Chhota jawab: Decision rules ya interpretable model se lo, LLM ko sirf cited evidence ke saath draft aur summary ke liye use karo, aur logs aur human review rakho.

Aasan shabdon mein

Har decision ka clear reason chahiye to simple rule ya scorecard decide kare, aur AI sirf facts se explanation likhne mein help kare. Example: loan decline hua kyunki income set limit se kam hai, aur LLM wahi simple words mein likhta hai. LLM ka khud ke baare mein explanation asli reason na ho sakta hai, isliye use proof mat banao.

Aise samjhoJaise judge faisla deta hai aur clerk use aam bhasha mein likhta hai. Faisle ka asli aadhaar kanoon hai, clerk sirf samjhata hai.
Pehle yeh samjhoregulated industry (jaise bank) mein niyam kehte hain ki har faisle ka kaaran batao. Isliye faisla samajh aane wale model se karwao aur LLM sirf us kaaran ko simple bhasha mein likhe.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Faisla ek explainable model (jaise gradient boosting, jiska SHAP se pata chalta hai ki kis input ne kitna asar dala) se karwao.
  2. LLM sirf us faisle ko saaf bhasha mein samjhaye, faisla khud na kare.
  3. Reasoning ke steps aur inputs ka log rakho, taaki baad mein audit ho sake.
  4. Jahan lage, GDPR Article 22 (automatic faisle par rok) aur EU AI Act jaise niyam ka hawala do.
🔀 Flowchart: Regulated industry: explainability
Regulator har decision ki explanation maangta hai
↓
LLM explainable nahi, isliye decision usse mat karwao
↓
Explainable model (gradient boosting plus SHAP) decision leta hai
↓
LLM sirf plain-language explanation likhta hai
↓
Reasoning steps aur inputs log karo
↓
GDPR Article 22 aur EU AI Act jaise rules ka reference do
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Decision rules, decision tree ya scorecard se lo jise inspect kiya ja sake.
  • LLM ko summaries aur drafting ke liye use karo, cited evidence ke saath, decider ki tarah nahi.
Architect notes
  • System ko split karo: deterministic ya interpretable decision layer, aur language tasks ke liye LLM layer.
  • LLM chain-of-thought ya self-explanation ko official reason mat maano. Ye output ke asli reason se alag ho sakte hain.
  • Audit trail store karo: input, retrieved evidence, rule fired, versions aur reviewer.
  • Decision layer par bias aur accuracy tests chalao, aur regulation se map karo (jaise EU AI Act high-risk rules).
  • Adverse decisions ke liye human review aur appeal path rakho.
290

AI assistant galat medical advice deta hai aur user ko nuksaan hota hai. Liable kaun hai?

Q236

Chhota jawab: Koi ek answer nahi hai: liability country, contracts aur kisne kya kiya us par depend karti hai, lekin jo company assistant deploy karti hai wahi aksar sabse pehle responsible thehrayi jaati hai.

Aasan shabdon mein

Medical AI galat advice de to jo company use patients ko offer karti hai wahi aksar sabse pehle blame hoti hai, jaise galat dawai dene wali dukaan. Model vendor ka bhi hissa ho sakta hai, contract aur local law ke hisaab se. Sirf disclaimer se responsibility khatam nahi hoti. Ye legal advice nahi hai, lawyer se poochho.

Aise samjhoJaise dawai ki dukaan par galat dawai dene se dukandar ki zimmedari banti hai. Isliye wo sirf wahi bechta hai jisme wo expert hai, aur risky case doctor ko bhejta hai.
Pehle yeh samjholiable matlab kanooni zimmedar. Aam taur par jo company AI ko users ke saamne laati hai, pehle usse hi poocha jaata hai. Isliye scope seemit karo aur risky sawal doctor ko bhejo.
Ek ek point aasan shabdon mein
  1. Assistant ka kaam seemit rakho aur use bimari batane (diagnosis) aur dawa ki matra (dosage) batane se mana karo.
  2. Disclaimer (chetavni) lagao, aur khatarnak sawal insaan expert ko bhej do.
  3. Audit logs rakho aur medical experts ke saath red-teaming karo, matlab jaanbujh kar galti nikaalne ki koshish karo.
  4. Launch se pehle legal counsel (kanooni salahkar) se salah lo, kyunki zimmedari ka sawal kanoon se tay hota hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Galat medical advice: risk kam karo
AI ne galat medical advice di, user ko nuksaan
↓
Deploy karne wali company ya developer aam taur par pehla target
↓
Scope limit karo, diagnosis aur dosage se mana karo
↓
Query risky hai?
HaanHuman expert ko escalate karo
NahiDisclaimer ke saath jawab do
↓
Audit logs aur medical experts ke saath red-teaming
↓
Launch se pehle legal counsel lo
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Responsibility deployer, developer ya vendor par aa sakti hai, law aur contracts ke hisaab se. Courts case by case decide karte hain.
  • Risk kam karo: AI kya bol sakta hai wo limit karo, diagnosis avoid karo, aur clear warnings do. Warnings madad karti hain par duty of care khatam nahi karti.
Architect notes
  • Liability ko shared maano: deployer (duty of care), vendor (contract, warranties) aur clinician agar usne rely kiya.
  • Contracts use karo: indemnity, limits of liability aur model vendor ke saath clear use terms.
  • Regulation check karo: medical-purpose AI regulated medical device ho sakta hai (jaise FDA rules ya EU MDR aur AI Act).
  • Engineering controls: scope limits, grounded sources, emergencies ke liye refusal aur escalation, human sign-off, full audit logs.
  • Launch se pehle legal counsel aur insurance lo, aur incident process plan karo.

Whiteboard Patterns and Last-Night Revision

291

Multi-tenant RAG pattern samjhao: yeh kya hai aur kab use karoge?

W11

Chhota jawab: Multi-tenant RAG ek hi system se bahut customers ko serve karta hai, strict data isolation ke saath. Tab use karo jab ek platform kai customers ko serve kare aur unka data kabhi na mile.

Aasan shabdon mein

Apartment building ki tarah, jahan har family ka alag ghar hota hai, ek ShopBot platform har company ka data alag rakhta hai. Ise tab use karo jab ek platform kai customers ko serve kare aur unka data kabhi mix na ho, jaise kai shops ke liye SaaS support bot.

Aise samjhoJaise ek apartment building mein sab ka ghar alag aur chaabi alag. Ek ka saaman doosre ko nahi dikhta.
Pehle yeh samjhotenant matlab ek company jo is shared system ko use karti hai. Login se pata chalta hai user kis company ka hai, aur wahi tenant_id filter se doosri companies ka data bahar rehta hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Multi-tenant RAG: filter har retrieval mein
Company A ke user ka sawaal
↓
Authentication se tenant_id pata chalta hai
↓
Retrieval mein tenant_id filter lagta hai
↓
Sirf Company A ke chunks milte hain
↓
LLM unhi chunks se jawab banata hai
↓
Doosri companies ka data kabhi nahi dikhta
User -> Tenant ID -> Authorisation -> Metadata filter -> Retriever
Architecture ki tasveer
Trade-off

Stronger isolation mein zyada cost lagta hai.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Har chunk ek tenant id rakhta hai; queries hamesha uspe filter karti hain.
  • Isolation filter, namespace ya alag index se ho sakta hai.
Architect notes
  • Tenant identity server-side derive karo aur cross-tenant leakage ke liye continuously test karo.
  • Caches, logs aur embeddings ko bhi isolate karo.
  • Noisy neighbours rokne ke liye per-tenant quotas lagao.
  • Regulated tenants ko dedicated stores ya regions chahiye ho sakte hain.
  • Per-tenant deletion aur audit support karo.
292

Evaluation loop pattern samjhao: yeh kya hai aur kab use karoge?

W13

Chhota jawab: Evaluation loop: fixed set pe baar baar test karo, weak spots dhundo, fix karo, aur dobara test karo. Hamesha use karo: har change ke pehle aur baad.

Aasan shabdon mein

School tests ki tarah, ShopBot ko kai sawalon par baar baar check kiya jaata hai aur kamzor topics sudhaare jaate hain. Ise hamesha use karo, har prompt, model ya data change se pehle aur baad me, jaise yeh confirm karne ke liye ki naye prompt ne refund answers kharab nahi kiye.

Aise samjhoJaise school mein unit test hote hain: dekhte hain kya samajh nahi aaya, wo padhte hain, phir agla test.
Pehle yeh samjhoretrieval quality matlab sahi chunks mile ya nahi, answer quality matlab jawab sahi bana ya nahi. Dono alag naapte hain taaki pata chale galti kahan hai.
🔀 Flowchart: Evaluation loop: measure aur sudharo
Golden set (sahi jawabon ki list) banao
↓
Naya version us par chalao
↓
Retrieval aur answer quality alag se score karo
↓
Score pichle version se behtar hai?
HaanRelease karo
NahiFailures dekho aur fix karo
↓
Naye failures ko golden set mein jodo
↓
Quality lagatar sudharti rehti hai
Golden dataset -> Retrieval eval -> Generation eval
  -> Regression tests -> Production -> Feedback -> (back to dataset)
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Expected answers ke saath questions ka golden set banao.
  • Retrieval aur answer quality ko automatically aur human spot checks se score karo.
Architect notes
  • Evals prompt ya model changes se chupke regressions ke khilaaf main safeguard hain.
  • LLM judges useful hain par biased; unhe human labels ke against calibrate karo.
  • Set ko production ke real failures se updated rakho.
  • Releases ko quality aur safety thresholds pe gate karo.
  • Test set pe overfitting se savdhaan raho.
293

Agent observability pattern samjhao: yeh kya hai aur kab use karoge?

W14

Chhota jawab: Agent observability: har step, tool call, latency aur cost ko trace ki tarah record karo taaki behaviour inspect ho sake. Jab agents real users ko serve karein tab use karo, debugging aur cost control ke liye.

Aasan shabdon mein

Cricket ke ball-by-ball replay ki tarah, ShopBot ke steps record hote hain taaki dikhe ki galti kahan hui. Ise tab use karo jab agents real users ke liye chalein, jaise yeh pata karne ke liye ki ek chat me 20 seconds aur bahut tokens kyun lage.

Aise samjhoJaise cricket ka replay aur ball-by-ball commentary. Galti hui to dekh sakte ho kahan aur kyon.
Pehle yeh samjhoobservability matlab system ke andar kya ho raha hai wo dekh paana. Har request ko ek trace id milta hai, jisse uske saare steps ek saath dikhte hain.
🔀 Flowchart: Agent observability: har step trace
Agent ko request aati hai
↓
Request ko trace id milta hai
↓
Har step log: LLM call, tool call, retrieval
↓
Latency, tokens, cost aur errors record hote hain
↓
Kuch galat hua?
HaanTrace kholkar fail hua step dhoondo
NahiDashboard mein normal dikhta hai
↓
Poori journey saaf dikhti hai
Request -> Trace ID -> Planner -> Tool 1 -> Tool 2 -> LLM -> Answer
Trade-off

Detailed logs debugging mein help karte hain par storage aur privacy concerns badhate hain.

Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Har step record karo: prompt, tool call, result, latency aur tokens.
  • Steps ko ek request ke liye ek trace mein jodo.
Architect notes
  • Traces mein sensitive data redact karo aur access restrict karo.
  • Issues reproduce karne ke liye prompt, model aur tools ke versions store karo.
  • Loops, high cost aur tool error rates pe alert karo.
  • Evaluation aur feedback ke liye traces sample karo.
  • OpenTelemetry jaise standard formats tooling aasan banate hain.
294

Enterprise GenAI map pattern samjhao: yeh kya hai aur kab use karoge?

W15

Chhota jawab: Enterprise GenAI map: data, models, tools, security, monitoring aur governance ek hi view mein. Tab use karo jab company-wide GenAI platform plan ya review kar rahe ho.

Aasan shabdon mein

City map ki tarah, jisme roads, hospitals aur offices dikhte hain, yeh dikhata hai ki badi company me ShopBot jaise AI ko kaun kaun se parts chahiye. Ise tab use karo jab company-wide GenAI platform plan ya review karna ho, taaki missing parts dikhein jaise monitoring na hona ya data ka owner na hona.

Aise samjhoJaise shehar ka naksha jisme road, hospital, school aur bijli sab dikhte hain. Naksha dekh kar samajh aata hai sab kaise jude hain.
Pehle yeh samjhogovernance matlab niyam aur zimmedari ka dhancha, access control matlab kaun kya dekh sakta hai. Distributed system matlab kai hisse milkar ek system, jaise shehar ka naksha.
🔀 Flowchart: Enterprise GenAI map: sab parts
User request gateway par aati hai
↓
Security: authentication, access control
↓
Router: simple ko RAG, complex ko agent
↓
Model aur tools layer (LLM, MCP tools)
↓
Safety, human approval aur evaluation
↓
Observability: trace, metrics, logs
↓
Poora system ek distributed system hai
GenAI application
 |-- Security   : IAM, PII, AuthZ
 |-- Data       : RAG, vector search
 |-- Models     : routing, cost, latency
 |-- Agents     : MCP, tools, HITL
 '-- Governance : evaluation, audit, monitoring
Architecture ki tasveer
Aur detail
Kaise kaam karta hai
  • Layers: data, models, retrieval, tools, applications.
  • Cross-cutting: security, monitoring, evaluation aur cost control.
Architect notes
  • Platform thinking: shared gateway, evals aur guardrails teams ke beech duplicated effort kam karte hain.
  • Governance practical honi chahiye: risk tiers aur proportionate review.
  • Vendor change ke liye plan rakho; abstraction layers se tight lock-in se bacho.
  • Data ownership aur lineage define karo.
  • Platform adoption, cost aur incident metrics track karo.

A se Z glossary

Note ke andar kisi bhi dotted word par tap karo, uska matlab dikhega. Saare terms ek list mein.

TermMatlab
32-bit / 8-bitBit matlab number store karne ki jagah ka naap. Kam bit matlab number kam jagah leta hai aur thoda kam sahi hota hai, jaise 3.14159 ko 3.14 likhna.
429 / 503429 ka matlab bahut zyada requests bhej di, thoda ruko. 503 ka matlab service abhi busy ya down hai. Dono aksar kuch der baad theek ho jaate hain, isliye dobara try karna theek hai.
7B / 70B (parameters)7B ka matlab 7 billion (700 crore) aur 70B ka matlab 70 billion parameters, yaani model ke andar ke seekhe hue numbers. Zyada number matlab bada, mehnga model.
AbstainAbstain matlab jawab dene se mana kar dena jab pakka na ho. Jaise exam mein andaza lagane ki jagah 'mujhe nahi pata' likhna.
AbstractionAbstraction matlab ek upar ki parat jo andar ki mushkil baatein chhupa deti hai, jaise car chalane ke liye engine samajhna nahi padta. Fayda: kaam aasaan. Nuksan: andar kya ho raha hai dikhta nahi aur seekhne ka extra kharcha lagta hai.
Accuracy, F1, RMSEYeh predictive AI ko naapne ke numbers hain. Accuracy matlab kitne sahi. F1 sahi pakadne aur galat alarm ka santulan. RMSE number wale predictions mein kitna fark hai.
AcronymAcronym matlab lamba naam ka chhota roop, jaise MI matlab myocardial infarction (heart attack). Alag naam ek hi cheez ke ho sakte hain.
AdapterAdapter LoRA se bana chhota add-on hai jo base model par laga dete hain. Jaise phone ka cover: phone wahi, cover badal do to look badal jaye.
Adversarial testAdversarial matlab jaanbujh kar dushman ki tarah system ko behkaane ki koshish karna, taaki kamzori pehle pata chale.
AgentAisa AI jo goal lekar khud plan banata, tools chalata, result dekhta aur kaam poora hone tak loop chalata hai.
Anonymised dataAnonymised matlab data se naam, phone number jaisi pehchaan hata dena, taaki kisi asli insaan se jod kar na dekha ja sake.
APIDo programs ke beech baat karne ka tareeka. Restaurant ke waiter jaisa: aap order dete ho, kitchen se cheez aati hai.
Approximate searchApproximate search mein har item se match karne ki jagah andaze se sabse paas wale dhoondhte hain. Thodi sateekta jaati hai par bahut tez ho jata hai.
Arbitrator agentArbitrator ek alag judge agent hota hai jo do agents ke jhagde mein pehle se tay rule se faisla karta hai, jaise cricket mein third umpire.
Arguments / parametersTool ko chalane ke liye jo jaankari deni padti hai use arguments ya parameters kehte hain. Jaise order-status tool ko order number dena padta hai.
AsyncEk kaam ke intezaar mein doosra kaam shuru kar dena, wait mein time waste nahi.
Async / blocking / backgroundAsync matlab ek kaam chalte hue baaki kaam ruke nahi, jaise kapde washing machine mein chalte rehte hain aur tum chai bana lete ho. Blocking matlab us kaam ke khatam hone tak khade intezaar karna.
asyncio.gatherasyncio.gather Python ka tareeka hai jisse kai kaam ek saath chalte hain. Migrate matlab ek system se doosre par shift hona, jaise purane ghar se naye ghar.
AttentionAttention matlab model ka yeh tay karna ki kisi word ko samajhne ke liye baaki kin words par zyada dhyan dena hai. Jaise padhte waqt 'it' ka matlab pichle noun se jodna.
Attention headHead matlab attention ka ek alag nazariya. Kai heads ek saath chalte hain, jaise ek vaakya ko alag-alag log padhein: koi grammar dekhe, koi matlab.
Audit logKisne, kab, kya kiya, iska sthayi record. Baad mein jaanch ke kaam aata hai.
Audit trailAudit trail matlab har kaam ka likha hua record, taaki baad mein jaanch ho sake ki kisne kya kiya.
AuthAuth matlab authentication aur authorisation: kaun login kar raha hai aur use kya karne ki ijazat hai.
AuthenticationAuthentication matlab yeh pakka karna ki aap wahi ho jo aap kehte ho, jaise phone ka PIN ya OTP daalna.
Authentication / authorisation / scopesAuthentication matlab pehchaan check karna ki tum kaun ho. Authorisation matlab tumhe kya karne ki ijazat hai. Scope matlab permission ki seema, sirf utni jitni kaam ke liye zaroori.
Authorisation serviceAuthenticate matlab pakka karna ki banda wahi hai jo wo kehta hai. Authorisation matlab tay karna ki use kya karne ki ijaazat hai. Ye kaam ek alag service karti hai, jaise gate par guard.
Authoritative sourceAuthoritative source wo hai jo sabse official aur bharosemand maana jaye, jaise company ki official policy, na ki kisi ka forwarded message.
Auto-scaleAuto-scale matlab bheed badhne par machines apne aap badh jaana aur kam hone par ghat jaana, jaise bheed mein bank mein extra counter khulna.
AutoGenAise agents jo aapas mein baat karke kaam karte hain, group chat jaisa.
AutoGPT / BabyAGIKhud-ba-khud kaam karne wale agents ke shuruaati experiments.
AutonomousAutonomous matlab apne aap faisle leke kaam karna, bina har step par insaan ke bole.
AWS BedrockAmazon ka managed service jisme kai foundation models, knowledge bases aur guardrails milte hain.
Azure OpenAIMicrosoft Azure par OpenAI models, enterprise security aur networking ke saath.
BackstoryBackstory matlab agent ka chhota parichay (wo kaun hai, kis mein expert hai) jo use sahi andaaz mein kaam karne mein madad karta hai.
BacktestBacktest matlab apni strategy ko purane asli data par chalakar dekhna ki tab kaisi chalti. Jaise cricket match ka purana video dekhkar sochna ki hum kaise khelte.
Batch APIBatch API mein bahut saare kaam ek saath bhej dete ho aur jawab baad mein (kuch ghanton mein) milta hai, badle mein sasta padta hai. Jinhe turant nahi chahiye, unke liye.
Batch job / off-peakBatch job wo kaam hai jo turant nahi chahiye aur ek saath baad mein chalaya ja sakta hai. Off-peak matlab kam traffic wala time, jaise raat.
Bedrock Knowledge BasesBedrock Knowledge Bases ek ready-made service hai jo documents ko store karke AI ke jawab ke liye dhoondhne ka kaam khud sambhalti hai, tumhe RAG khud nahi banana padta.
BenchmarkBenchmark matlab kai options ko ek hi test par chalakar score compare karna. Jaise do bikes ko same road par chalakar mileage naapna.
BiasModel ka kisi group ke saath anuchit tareeke se alag behave karna.
BioBERT / Legal-BERTBioBERT medical text par aur Legal-BERT kanooni text par train hue models ke naam hain, jo apne field ki bhasha achhe se samajhte hain.
BisectBisect matlab kai changes mein se galat wala dhoondhne ke liye ek-ek (ya aadhe-aadhe) change wapas karke dekhna ki problem kab jaati hai.
Blast radiusBlast radius matlab kuch galat hone par kitna nuksan phail sakta hai. Permissions kam rakhne se yeh chhota rehta hai.
Blob / sampling / pushBlob matlab image jaisa bina text wala badi file ka data. Sampling mein server khud AI nahi chalata, wo client ke AI se text likhwata hai. Push matlab bina maange khud bhej dena.
Blue-greenBlue-green matlab purana system (blue) chalta rahe aur naya (green) uske bagal mein taiyaar ho. Test sahi nikle to users ko naye par bhej dete hain.
BM25Keyword search ka classic algorithm: jin documents mein query ke exact words zyada aur khaas hain unhe upar rakhta hai.
BoilerplateBoilerplate wo rutine text hai jo har page par repeat hota hai, jaise footer, disclaimer ya company ka naam. Isme kaam ki jaankari nahi hoti.
BootstrapBootstrap matlab bahut chhote se shuru karke dheere dheere cheez khadi karna. Yahan matlab 50 sawal se test set shuru karna.
BottleneckBottleneck wo ek jagah hai jahan sabse zyada time lagta hai aur poora kaam ruk jata hai, jaise bottle ki patli gardan jahan se paani dheere nikalta hai.
Business intelligenceBusiness intelligence matlab company ke data se sales, kharch jaise sawalon ke jawab nikalna taaki sahi faisle le sakein.
Bytes / chunked upload / size limitBytes matlab file ka asli data. Message ki size limit hoti hai, jaise SMS mein lambi film nahi bhej sakte. Chunked upload mein badi file ko chhote tukdon mein baant ke bhejte hain.
CachePehle se nikale hue jawab ko yaad rakhna taaki dobara wahi kaam na karna pade.
Cache expiry / invalidateExpire ya invalidate matlab purana saved jawab hata dena jab woh purana ya galat ho jaye. Jaise dukaan mein expiry date nikal gayi cheez shelf se hatana.
CalibrateCalibrate matlab kisi naap ko sahi cheez se milana taaki woh theek bole. Jaise nayi ghadi ko sahi time se match karna.
Canary rolloutNaya version pehle sirf 1 se 5% users ko dena, sab theek rahe to badhana.
CascadeCascade matlab ek ke baad ek backup. Pehla tareeka fail ho to doosra, phir teesra, jaise pani ki tanki khatam ho to bucket.
Catastrophic forgettingNaya seekhte waqt purana seekha hua bhool jaana.
CDNContent ko users ke paas ke servers se dena, taaki tez load ho.
ChainChain matlab kai steps ek ke baad ek jude hue, jaise assembly line mein ek machine ka output doosri ko jata hai.
Chain (LangChain)Chain matlab steps ki ek seedhi line: pehle kaam 1, phir 2, phir 3, bina rukawat ke. Jaise assembly line.
Chain-of-thoughtChain-of-thought matlab model se bolna ki jawab dene se pehle step by step soche aur likhe. Jaise maths mein sirf answer nahi, poora hisaab likhna, isse galti kam hoti hai.
ChatbotAisa program jisse aap chat karke sawal puchte ho aur woh jawab deta hai.
CheckpointKaam ke beech save kiya hua progress, taaki fail hone par wahin se dobara shuru ho.
Child processChild process ek chhota program hai jo doosre program ke andar se shuru hota hai aur usi computer par chalta hai.
Chunk / chunkingBade document ko chhote tukdon mein todna, jaise kitaab ko index cards mein.
ChurnChurn matlab customer ka service chhod kar chale jana. Churn prediction se pehle se pata lagate hain ki kaun jaane wala hai.
Circuit breakerBaar-baar fail hoti service ko kuch der ke liye call karna band kar dena, taaki sab kuch na ruke. Ghar ke MCB jaisa.
CitationJawab ke saath yeh batana ki jankari kis document se aayi.
ClassifierClassifier ek chhota AI hai jo cheez ko pehle se tay groups mein se ek mein daalta hai, jaise email spam hai ya nahi, ya ticket kis department ka hai.
ClauseClause contract ya policy ka ek chhota niyam ya shart wala hissa hota hai, jaise 'late payment par 2 percent fine'.
Client / ServerClient = jo maangta hai (aapka app). Server = jo jawab deta hai (doosri machine par chalta program).
CloudKisi aur company ke data centers ke computers jo aap internet se kiraye par use karte ho.
CloudWatchAWS ka monitoring aur logs ka tool.
ClusterCluster matlab milti-julti cheezon ka samooh. Jaise ek topic ke saare articles ek saath rakhna.
Compensating actionKaam beech mein fail ho to pehle ho chuke kadmon ko undo karne wale kaam.
ComplianceKanoon aur company rules ka paalan.
ConcurrencyConcurrency matlab ek hi samay par kitne log ya requests saath mein kaam kara rahe hain, jaise ek counter par ek saath khade log.
Concurrent usersConcurrent users matlab ek hi samay par system chalane wale kai log.
ConfidenceConfidence matlab model ko apne jawab par kitna bharosa hai, jaise 'main 90 percent pakka hoon'. Kam confidence par insaan se check karwana safe hota hai.
Config / redeployConfig ek settings file hai jise badalne se behaviour badal jaata hai, code dobara likhe bina. Redeploy matlab code ko dobara live karna.
Connection poolConnection pool pehle se khule hue database connections ka set hai jo baar-baar use hota hai. Har baar naya connection kholna dheema hota hai, jaise taxi stand par taxiyaan khadi rehti hain.
Constrained generationConstrained generation matlab model ko sirf tay options ya format mein jawab dene par majboor karna, jaise MCQ mein sirf A B C D.
ContainerContainer ek band dabba hai jisme program apne sab saaman ke saath alag chalta hai. Bahar ke system se bilkul alag rehta hai, isliye kuch bigde to nuksan dabbe tak hi.
Context compressionContext compression matlab model ko bhejne se pehle text ko chhota karna, sirf kaam ki baatein rakhna, jaise lambe notes ka summary bana dena.
Context windowModel ek baar mein kitne tokens dekh sakta hai, uski limit. Uski 'desk' ka size.
Continuous batchingKai users ki requests ko ek saath GPU par chalana.
Contract testContract test ek chhota roz chalne wala test hai jo dekhta hai ki bahar ki API ka format abhi bhi waisa hi hai jaisa hamne maana tha.
CredentialsCredentials matlab password, API key jaisi chaabiyan jo login ya access ke liye lagti hain. Inhe prompt mein nahi, surakshit jagah rakhte hain.
CrewAIRole-based agents ki 'team' banane ka framework.
CritiqueCritique matlab kisi ke kaam ki khoobi-kamiyan batana. Critic agent wo hai jo doosre agent ka kaam check karta hai.
CRMCustomer Relationship Management: customers ka data aur history.
Cross-encoderAisa model jo question aur ek document ko saath padhkar score deta hai ki woh kitna relevant hai. Re-ranker mein use hota hai.
CycleCycle matlab graph mein wapas pichle step par laut jana, jaise circle line par ghoomna. Isse retry ho paata hai.
Data extractionExtraction matlab lambe text se kaam ki cheezein (naam, date, amount) nikalna. Isme har baar same sahi answer chahiye, creativity nahi.
Data migrationMigration matlab poora data ek system se doosre mein shift karna, jaise ghar badalte waqt saara saaman naye ghar le jaana. Ye sirf ek setting badalna nahi hota.
Data residencyData residency matlab data kis desh ya jagah ke servers par rakha aur process hota hai. Kai niyam kehte hain ki customer ka data desh ke bahar nahi jaana chahiye.
Data tier (hot/cold)Tier matlab data ko darje mein baantna. Roz kaam aane wala (hot) tez aur mehnga jagah par, purana kam kaam aane wala (cold) sasti jagah par.
DatasetExamples ya data ka collection, jiski madad se model sikhta ya test hota hai.
DeadlockDo cheezein ek-doosre ka intezaar karti hain aur dono hamesha ke liye atak jaati hain.
Decompose / sub-questionDecompose matlab ek bade sawal ko chhote chhote sawalon mein todna, jaise bada kaam chhote tasks mein baantna.
DecoratorDecorator ek chhota tag hai jo function ke upar laga dete hain, aur function ko naya kaam ya pehchaan mil jaati hai (jaise ise tool bana dena).
DeduplicateDeduplicate matlab ek jaise repeat tukde hata dena, jaise phone mein ek hi photo ki 5 copies delete karke ek rakhna.
Defence in depthDefence in depth matlab ek hi suraksha par bharosa nahi, kai parat lagana. Jaise ghar mein gate, taala aur guard teeno.
DelegateDelegate matlab apna kaam kisi aur ko saupna, jaise manager workers ko kaam baantta hai.
Denied topicsDenied topics wo vishay hain jin par bot ko jawab dene se mana kiya gaya hai, jaise gambling ya dawai ki salah.
DependencyDependency wo doosri service ya part hai jis par tumhara system chalne ke liye nirbhar hai, jaise search ya model API.
Dependency scanningDependency scanning matlab jo bahari libraries code use karta hai unme pehle se pata security kamiyan hain ya nahi, yeh check karna.
DeployBanaye hue software ko asli users ke liye chalu karna.
Deprecated / specDeprecated matlab abhi chal raha hai par ab use mat karo, kyunki aage hata diya jayega. Spec ek official document hai jisme likha hota hai sab kuch kaise kaam karta hai.
Destructive / irreversibleDestructive ya irreversible kaam matlab jo ek baar ho gaya to wapas nahi ho sakta, jaise file hamesha ke liye delete.
DeterministicDeterministic matlab har baar bilkul same steps aur same result, koi andaza nahi, jaise calculator ya fixed recipe.
DiagnosticsDiagnostics matlab code mein mile errors aur warnings ki list, jaise editor mein laal line jo galti batati hai.
DiffDiff matlab do versions ke beech ka fark, yaani kya badla. Jaise do copy ke beech ka antar dekhna.
DiluteDilute matlab kamzor ho jana. Chat badi hone par shuru ke rules ka asar pani mein ghule doodh jaisa halka ho jata hai.
DisclaimerDisclaimer matlab chetavni ya saaf likhna ki yeh salah sirf jaankari hai, professional ki jagah nahi, jaise dawai ke packet par 'doctor se poochho'.
Distributed systemDistributed system matlab kai machines aur hisse jo milkar ek system ki tarah kaam karte hain, jaise kai dukaanein jo ek brand ke naam se chalti hain.
DLPData Loss Prevention: sensitive data ko bahar jaane se rokne wale tools.
DomainDomain matlab kaam ka khaas kshetra, jaise medicine, law ya banking. Har domain ke apne khaas shabd hote hain.
Domain embeddingsDomain embeddings kisi khaas field (medicine, law) ke text par bane embeddings hain, jo us field ke shabdon ka sahi matlab samajhte hain. General embeddings aisa nahi kar paate.
Double bookingDouble booking matlab ek hi cheez (room ya seat) do logon ko de dena.
DriftDrift matlab agent apne asli goal se dheere-dheere bhatak jana.
Duplicates / deduplicateDuplicates matlab ek jaisi repeat hui cheezein. Deduplicate karna matlab unhe hata dena taaki jagah aur paisa na barbaad ho.
Durable state / persistenceDurable state matlab progress ko aisi jagah save karna jo crash ya band hone par bhi na mite, jaise database. RAM mein rakhi cheez band hone par ud jaati hai.
EmbeddingText ke matlab ko numbers ki list mein badalna, taaki computer 'milte-julte matlab' dhoondh sake.
EncodeEncode matlab kisi cheez ko aise number-form mein badalna jo computer ya model samajh sake. Jaise Morse code mein akshar ko beep mein badalte hain.
Encoding trickEncoding trick matlab galat request ko code ya ulte-seedhe format mein chhupana taaki filter use pakad na paye.
Encrypt at rest / in transitEncrypt matlab data ko coded bana dena taaki chori ho to bhi koi padh na sake. At rest matlab jab data stored hai, in transit matlab jab network par chal raha hai. Customer-managed keys matlab chaabi tumhari apni, provider ki nahi.
EndpointKisi service ka woh address jahan request bheji jati hai.
EnforceRule ko zabardasti lagu karna, sirf request karna nahi.
EntailmentEntailment check dekhta hai ki ek line se doosri baat sach mein nikalti hai ya nahi. Jaise 'Ram ke paas 2 seb hain' se 'Ram ke paas seb hain' nikalta hai.
EntityEntity matlab koi pehchaan wali cheez, jaise insaan ka naam, company ya jagah.
ERPCompany ka accounting, orders aur inventory sambhalne ka system.
EscalateEscalate matlab mushkil ya risky kaam ko bade, zyada jaankar insaan ya level ko saunp dena. Jaise bot se customer care wale insaan ko call transfer.
Escalation rateThumbs up ya down user ka like ya dislike hai. Escalation rate matlab kitne cases insaan ko gaye. Sampled human review matlab kuch jawab chun kar insaan se check karwana. Loop stops matlab agent ka loop limit par roka jana.
EvaluationNaap-tol: system kitna sahi chal raha hai, numbers se.
EventEvent matlab koi hui ghatna jo doosron ko signal deti hai, jaise darwaze ki ghanti bajna aur andar wale ka uthna.
ExpiryExpiry matlab ek tay samay ke baad cheez apne aap hat jana ya bekaar ho jana, jaise dawai ki expiry date.
ExplainabilityExplainability matlab model ne faisla kyun liya, yeh insaan ko samajh aane layak batana.
Exponential backoffRetry ke beech ka wait har baar double karna (1s, 2s, 4s...) taaki server par bojh na pade.
Expose karnaExpose karna matlab kisi cheez ko dusron ke use ke liye dikhana ya uplabdh karana, jaise dukaan ka shutter upar karna taaki customer andar aa sake.
Failover / degraded modeFailover matlab ek jagah kharab ho to apne aap doosri jagah switch ho jana. Degraded mode matlab thoda kamzor par chalta hua. Health check baar-baar dekhta hai ki service zinda hai ya nahi.
Faithfulness / groundednessAnswer sirf diye gaye documents par based hai ya model ne apni taraf se joda.
FallbackPlan A fail ho to backup rasta.
Feed-forward layerFeed-forward layer attention ke baad ka ek chhota processing step hai jo har word ke numbers ko alag se aur sochkar badalta hai. Attention words ko jodta hai, yeh har word ko gehra samajhta hai.
Few-shotFew-shot matlab prompt mein 2 se 5 solved examples dikhana taaki model wahi pattern pakad le. Jaise teacher pehle solved sawal dikhata hai, phir tum khud karte ho.
Fine-tuningPehle se trained model ko apne data par thoda aur train karna, taaki uska style ya skill badal jaye.
First tokenFirst token matlab model ka jawab ka sabse pehla shabd. Ye jaldi aaye to user ko lagta hai system tez hai.
FlakyFlaky matlab jo kabhi chalta hai kabhi nahi, bharose layak nahi.
ForecastForecast matlab aane wale dino ka mausam ka andaza.
FrameworkReady-made kit jo ek type ka software jaldi banane mein madad karta hai.
FraudFraud matlab dhokhe se paisa ya cheez haasil karna.
Freeze / frozenFreeze karna matlab model ke original numbers ko lock kar dena taaki training mein badle nahi. Sirf naye jode hue chhote hisse seekhte hain.
FreshnessFreshness matlab jaankari kitni taaza hai, yaani system ke paas sabse naya data hai ya nahi.
Full precisionFull precision matlab numbers ko poori detail ke saath store karna. Isme jagah aur paisa zyada lagta hai, jaise 10 digit tak ka decimal likhna.
Function callingModel text mein likhta hai 'yeh tool is argument ke saath chalao', aur aapka code use asal mein chalata hai.
GatewayGateway ek darwaza hai jisse hokar saari requests guzarti hain. Jaise society ka main gate, jahan guard sabki entry check karta hai.
GDPR / EU AI ActEurope ke data aur AI par kanoon.
Golden datasetSawalon aur sahi jawabon ka hand-checked set jisse har badlav ko test kiya jata hai.
GPUGraphics chip jo AI ke bhaari calculations parallel mein karta hai.
Gradient boostingTabular data ke liye ek powerful ML model, explain karna aasaan.
GraphRAGRAG jisme documents ke entities aur unke rishte (graph) bhi use hote hain, multi-hop sawalon ke liye.
Ground truth / labelled dataGround truth woh sahi jawab hai jisse hum model ke jawab ko match karte hain. Labelled data matlab aisa data jisme har sawal ke saath uska sahi jawab pehle se likha ho, jaise answer key.
GroundingGrounding matlab jawab ko diye gaye documents se jodkar rakhna, taaki model apni taraf se kuch na bole.
GuardrailRules ya filters jo unsafe input ya output ko rokte hain. Bowling lane ke bumper jaise.
HallucinationModel confident tone mein galat ya banaya hua jawab de deta hai.
Hand-off / downstreamHand-off matlab ek program ka output dusre program ko dena. Downstream matlab woh agla code jo is output ko use karta hai.
Handshake / initializeHandshake matlab do programs ka pehli baar milte hi ek dusre ko batana ki main kaun hoon aur kya kar sakta hoon, jaise naye bande se haath milakar naam batana. Protocol version matlab dono kaun se niyam-version par baat karenge.
Hard blockHard block matlab ek pakka rok jisse koi chhoot nahi milti, chahe user kitna bhi kahe.
HardenHarden matlab system ko mazboot banana taaki galtiyon, attacks aur zyada load mein bhi tike.
HashHash ek unique fingerprint jaisa chhota code hota hai jo kisi document ke text se banta hai. Text ek akshar bhi badle to hash badal jata hai, isliye pata chal jata hai ki file badli ya nahi.
HaystackModular search aur RAG pipelines ka framework.
HierarchicalHierarchical matlab upar-neeche ka dhancha: ek manager hota hai jo kaam baantta hai aur workers kaam karte hain.
HNSWVector search ko tez karne wali index technique. Exact nahi, lekin bahut tez approximate search.
Host / MCP server / MCP clientHost woh app hai jo user use karta hai (jaise coding editor). MCP client host ke andar ka hissa hai jo server se baat karta hai. MCP server alag program hai jo tools aur data deta hai aur asli kaam karta hai.
Hot / warm / cold storageData ko kitna zaroori hai us hisaab se rakhna: hot matlab roz kaam aane wala, tez aur mehenga storage; warm matlab kabhi-kabhi kaam aane wala; cold matlab bahut purana, sasta aur dheema storage. Jaise table par roz ke kapde, almari mein season ke, godown mein purane.
Human-in-the-loopZaroori kadam par insaan ki approval le kar hi aage badhna.
Hybrid searchKeyword search (exact words) aur vector search (matlab) dono ko mila dena.
HyDEPehle model se ek kaalpanik jawab likhwana, phir us jawab se search karna. Kai baar behtar results milte hain.
HyperparameterHyperparameter wo setting hai jo hum khud tay karte hain (jaise chunk size), model apne aap nahi seekhta. Alag values try karke sabse achhi chuni jaati hai.
IAMIdentity and Access Management: kaun kya kar sakta hai uske rules (AWS mein).
IDE / code editorIDE ya code editor wo software hai jisme programmer code likhta hai, jaise Word mein letter likhte hain. VS Code ek mashhoor editor hai.
IdempotencyWahi kaam dobara karne par bhi nuksaan ya double effect na ho. Ek payment do baar nahi katna chahiye.
Ignore all previous instructionsIs English line ka matlab: pehle ke saare nirdesh bhool jao. Hacker aise hukm web page ya tool ke result mein chhupa dete hain taaki AI apne asli rules bhool jaye.
Incremental updateIncremental matlab poora kaam dobara karne ki jagah sirf naye ya badle hue hisse par kaam karna.
IndemnityIndemnity matlab agar koi kanooni nuksaan ho to company use bhar degi, jaise insurance ka bharosa.
IndexData ki tayyar ki hui suchi (book ke peeche wali index jaisi), jisse search turant ho jaye.
InferenceTrained model se asli jawab nikalna (training ke baad ka 'exam time').
IngestionIngestion matlab documents ko system mein daalna aur search ke liye taiyaar karna, jaise library mein nayi kitab aane par use shelf tak pahunchana.
Input perturbationInput perturbation matlab input ko thoda bigaadna, jaise spelling galti ya extra space daalna, aur dekhna ki system phir bhi sahi chalta hai.
InterfaceInterface ek tay raasta hai jisse app model se baat karti hai. Model badal bhi jaye, raasta wahi rahe to baaki code ko fark nahi padta.
InvoiceInvoice matlab bill, jisme likha hota hai kya kharida aur kitna paisa dena hai.
IsolationEk user ya ek kaam ka data aur access doosre se alag rakhna.
IVF / product quantisationYe vector search ko tez aur halka banane ke tareeke hain. IVF vectors ko groups mein baant deta hai aur sirf paas wale groups mein dhoondhta hai. Product quantisation vectors ko chhota karke jagah bachata hai.
JailbreakModel ko uske safety rules todne ke liye bahlana.
JitterWait time mein thoda random jod dena, taaki sab clients ek saath retry na karein.
JSONData likhne ka simple format: {"naam": "Riya", "umar": 20}. Programs aur AI ke beech data bhejne ke kaam aata hai.
JSON Schema / ZodJSON Schema ek naksha hai jo batata hai ki input kaisa hona chahiye (kaun si field, kis type ki). Zod aur Pydantic aise code tools hain jo input ko is naksha se check karte hain. Galat hone par invalid-params error wapas jaata hai.
JSON-RPCChhoti JSON messages se doosre program ka function chalwane ka protocol. MCP isi par bana hai.
Key-value storeKey-value store ek simple yaad ki jagah hai jahan naam (key) ke saamne uski value likhi hoti hai, jaise phonebook mein naam aur number.
Keyword searchExact words match karne wali search. 'parcel' likha hai to sirf 'parcel' dhoondhegi.
KMSKey Management Service: encryption keys ko safe rakhne ki cloud service.
Knob / driftKnob matlab setting ka ghumane wala button jaise temperature. Drift matlab jawab ka dheere dheere asli raaste se hat jana.
Knowledge base (KB)Knowledge base (KB) woh documents ka collection hai jisse bot jawab deta hai, jaise FAQs, policies aur manuals.
Knowledge graphCheezon (entities) aur unke rishton ka nakshaa, jaise 'Company A ne Startup B ko kharida'.
KV cacheModel ke beech ke calculations ka saved hissa, taaki dobara na karna pade.
Labelled dataLabelled data matlab wo data jisme har sawal ke saath uska sahi jawab pehle se likha ho, jisse system ko jaanch sakein.
LangChainLLM apps banane ka popular toolbox: models, prompts, tools, memory ke ready-made blocks.
LangGraphAgents ko graph (nodes aur edges) ki tarah banane ka framework, loops aur human approval ke saath.
LangSmithLangSmith LangChain/LangGraph banane walon ka tool hai jo agent ke har step ka record (trace) dikhata hai, taaki debug aasan ho.
LatencyRequest bhejne se jawab milne tak ka time.
Layout-aware PDF toolsYe aise tools hain jo PDF page ka naksha samajhte hain, yaani kaun sa hissa text, table ya photo hai. pdfplumber, Camelot aur Unstructured tables nikalne ke popular tools hain. LayoutLM ek model hai jo page ka layout padhna seekha hai.
Lazy embeddingLazy embedding matlab sab kuch pehle hi embed na karke, sirf tab karna jab uski zaroorat pade. Isse shuru ka kharcha bachta hai.
Leaderboard / benchmarkLeaderboard public ranking list hai jisme models ko standard tests par number milte hain. Benchmark karna matlab kisi cheez ko ek jaise test par naapna aur tulna karna.
Least privilegeKisi ko sirf utni hi permission do jitni kaam ke liye zaroori hai.
Lexical matchingLexical matching matlab exact shabd ka milan. Meaning search se alag hai, jahan alag shabd par same matlab bhi match ho jata hai.
LiableLiable matlab kanoon ke hisaab se zimmedar, yaani nuksaan ki bharpai ka jawabdeh.
LinterLinter ek chhota automatic tool hai jo code ki galtiyan aur style ki dikkatein turant pakad leta hai, jaise word processor ki spelling check.
Llama, Mistral, GPT, Claude, GeminiYeh alag-alag companies ke LLMs ke naam hain. Llama aur Mistral open models hain, GPT, Claude aur Gemini closed (API wale) models hain.
LlamaIndexApne documents ko index karke search/RAG banane ka framework.
LLMBahut saare text se train hua AI model jo agla word predict karke likhta hai. Ek super autocomplete samjho.
LLM-as-judgeEk model se doosre model ke answers ko rubric par score karwana.
Load balancerAane wali requests ko kai servers mein barabar baantna.
Loader / splitterDocument loader PDF ya file ko padh kar andar laata hai. Splitter use chhote tukdon (chunks) mein todta hai.
LockLock matlab ek cheez par ek waqt mein ek hi ko haath lagane dena, jaise washroom ka latch. Atomic check matlab dekhna aur book karna ek hi jhatke mein ho, beech mein koi na ghuse.
LogsSystem ne kya kiya, uska likha hua record.
LoopWahi kaam baar-baar dohrana jab tak kaam poora na ho ya rukne ki shart na mile.
Loose couplingLoose coupling matlab do hisse aapas mein halke se jude hain, ek ko badlo to doosre ko chhedna nahi padta, jaise phone badlo par charger wahi chalta hai.
LoRAFine-tuning ka sasta tareeka: bade model ko freeze karke sirf chhote add-on weights train karte hain.
Lost in the middleLambe text mein model shuru aur aakhir ko achhe se padhta hai par beech ko kam dhyan deta hai. Ise lost in the middle kehte hain.
Managed identity / RBACManaged identity matlab app ki apni automatic ID jo cloud khud sambhalta hai, password ki zaroorat nahi. RBAC matlab role ke hisaab se permission, jaise manager ko zyada aur clerk ko kam.
Map-reduceMap-reduce matlab bade kaam ko chhote tukdon mein baant kar alag-alag karna (map), phir unke nateeje jodkar ek karna (reduce). Jaise 10 log alag-alag chapter ka summary banayein, phir ek insaan milake final banaye.
MatrixMatrix numbers ka rows aur columns wala grid hai, jaise Excel ki sheet. Model ke weights aise hi grids mein rakhe hote hain.
MCPModel Context Protocol: AI apps ko tools se jodne ka ek standard 'plug', USB port jaisa.
MergeMerge matlab do cheezon ko jodkar ek bana dena, jaise do notebooks ke notes ek mein likhna.
Message queueMessage queue matlab messages ki line. Ek bhejta hai, doosra apni baari par uthata hai, jaise bank ki token line.
MetadataData ke baare mein data: kisne likha, kab, kaun sa version, kaun access kar sakta hai.
MetricMetric ek naap ka number hai jisse kaam ki quality dekhte hain, jaise accuracy 90% ya jawab ka time 2 second.
Millisecond (ms)Millisecond ek second ka hazaarwa hissa hai. 500 ms matlab aadha second.
MitigateMitigate matlab nuksaan ya risk ko jaldi kam karna, jaise baadh aane par pehle sandbags lagana.
MMRMaximal Marginal Relevance: relevant bhi ho aur ek-doosre se alag bhi, taaki same cheez repeat na ho.
Model abstraction layerAbstraction layer matlab app aur model ke beech ek beech ki parat jo model badalne par bhi baaki code ko na badalna pade. Jaise plug socket: device badlo, wiring wahi.
Model aliasAlias ek nickname hai jaise 'latest', jo company jab chahe naye model par point kar deti hai. Isliye tumhara code nahi badla phir bhi model badal sakta hai.
Model providerProvider wo company hai jo model chalati hai aur API deti hai, jaise OpenAI ya Anthropic. Wo kabhi-kabhi bina bataye model update kar sakti hai.
Model routingRouting matlab har sawal ko sahi model ke paas bhejna: aasan sawal sasta chhota model, mushkil wala bada mehnga model. Jaise chhote kaam ke liye auto, lambe safar ke liye taxi.
Model routingModel routing matlab har request ko dekh kar tay karna ki kaunsa model use ho. Aasan sawal chhote sasta model ko, mushkil bade ko, jaise hospital mein reception tay karta hai kaunsa doctor.
ModularModular matlab system ko alag-alag hisson mein banana, jaise Lego ke blocks. Ek block badalna ya theek karna aasan hota hai, poora system nahi girta.
MRRMean Reciprocal Rank: pehla sahi jawab average kitni upar position par aata hai.
Multi-agentKai agents jo alag-alag role mein milkar ek kaam karte hain.
Multi-channel retrievalChannel matlab ek source jaise vector search, SQL, web ya API. Multi-channel matlab ek se zyada sources se dhoondhna.
Multi-hopAisa sawal jiska jawab kai documents ya kadmon ko jodkar milta hai.
Multi-tenant / tenantEk hi platform ko kai companies (tenants) use karti hain, aur har ka data alag rehna chahiye.
Multi-turn attackMulti-turn attack matlab ek hi baar mein nahi, kai messages mein dheere dheere bot ko galat taraf le jana.
MultilingualMultilingual matlab kai bhashaon mein, jaise Hindi, English aur Hinglish mix.
MultimodalMultimodal matlab sirf text nahi, photo, audio aur table jaise kai tarah ke data ko samajhna.
MySQL / PostgreSQL / BigQueryYe teeno databases hain, yaani badi organised jagah jahan company ka data tables mein store hota hai. MySQL aur PostgreSQL bahut common hain, BigQuery Google ka bahut bade data ke liye hai.
N-by-M integrationMaan lo 3 apps aur 4 tools hain. Har app ko har tool se alag jodna ho to 3 x 4 = 12 connections banenge. Ek common standard ho to har app aur har tool bas standard se judta hai, yaani 3 + 4 = 7. Isse kaam bahut kam ho jaata hai.
n8nDrag-and-drop automation tool, bina ya kam code ke workflows.
Namespace / prefixNamespace ya prefix naam ke aage ek tag lagana hai taaki do ek jaise naam alag dikhein, jaise Rahul Sharma aur Rahul Verma.
NDCGRanking quality ka score jo upar ke sahi results ko zyada number deta hai.
NegationNegation matlab 'nahi' wala sawal, jaise 'kaun eligible NAHI hai'. Search aam taur par sirf topic pakadti hai, 'nahi' ka matlab nahi.
NegotiateNegotiate matlab aapas mein baat karke ek tay ho jaana, jaise do log meeting ka time tay karte hain.
No-codeNo-code matlab bina code likhe, drag-and-drop se kaam banana.
Node / edgeGraph mein node ek step hota hai (jaise metro station) aur edge ek step se doosre step tak ka raasta (line). Conditional edge matlab raasta condition dekh kar chuna jaata hai.
NoiseNoise matlab faltu ya bekaar text jo kaam ka nahi hai. Jitna zyada noise, model ko sahi baat dhoondhna utna mushkil.
NormalisationNormalisation matlab alag-alag tareeke se likhe data ko ek hi style mein laana, jaise 05/06 aur 5 June dono ko ek jaisa likhna.
NormaliseNormalise matlab alag-alag tareeke se likhi cheezein ko ek jaisa bana dena, jaise extra spaces hata kar sab same format karna.
Notification (MCP)Notification ek chhota message hota hai jise bhejne wale ko jawab nahi chahiye, bas khabar dena hai, jaise SMS 'tumhara parcel pahunch gaya'. Request ke saath ek id hoti hai taaki jawab us se match ho sake, jaise token number.
OAuthPassword diye bina kisi app ko limited access dene ka standard tareeka.
ObservabilitySystem ke andar kya ho raha hai woh logs, metrics aur traces se dekh paana.
OCRImage ya scanned page se text padhna.
OntologyKisi domain ke shabdon aur unke rishton ki official suchi.
Open standard / protocolProtocol matlab baat-cheet ke common niyam jisse do alag programs ek dusre ko samajh sakein, jaise phone call ke liye sab ek hi number system maante hain. Open standard matlab ye niyam sabke liye khule hain, kisi ek company ki jaagir nahi.
Open vs closed modelOpen model ke weights (seekhe hue numbers) download karke apne servers par chala sakte ho. Closed model sirf company ki API se milta hai, andar ka kuch dikhta nahi. Jaise recipe book kharidna vs restaurant se khana mangwana.
OpenAPI specOpenAPI spec kisi API ka likha hua manual hai jisme saari calls aur unke inputs-outputs likhe hote hain. Isse tool apne aap ban sakte hain.
OpenAPI specOpenAPI spec ek API ka likha hua manual hota hai jisme likha hota hai ki kaun se kaam kiye ja sakte hain aur kya bhejna hai. Jaise restaurant ka menu card, jisse pata chalta hai kya order kar sakte ho.
Optimistic lockingVersion number se check: 'jab tumne padha tha tab se kuch badla to nahi?'. Badla ho to dobara try.
Orchestrator / supervisorManager jo kai agents ya steps ko coordinate karta hai.
Out-of-scope questionOut-of-scope ya unanswerable sawal wo hain jinka jawab documents mein hai hi nahi. Achha system aise mein 'mujhe nahi pata' bolta hai.
OutageOutage matlab koi service kuch der ke liye band ya down ho jana.
Output filtering / ratelimitingInput validation aane wale data ko check karta hai. Output filtering bahar jaane wale jawab ko check karta hai. Rate limiting matlab ek second mein kitni requests allowed hain uski seema.
Output validationOutput validation matlab model ka jawab bhejne se pehle check karna ki wo format aur rules ke mutabik hai ya nahi.
OverfittingModel training data ratta maar leta hai aur naye data par fail hota hai.
OverlapOverlap matlab ek chunk ka aakhri hissa agle chunk ke shuru mein dobara rakhna, taaki kisi vaakya ke beech se katne par baat adhoori na rahe.
OverrideOverride matlab naye ko purane ki jagah dena, jaise naya phone number purana number hata kar save karna.
p50 / p95 / p99Latency ke percentile: p99 matlab 99% requests is time se tez huin, sirf 1% dheemi.
Paper tradingPaper trading matlab nakli paise se live market mein trade karna, bina asli paisa lagaye. Jaise Monopoly ke notes.
ParallelKai kaam ek hi samay par saath-saath.
Parameterised SQLParameterised SQL mein user ka input query ke text mein jodne ke bajay alag se diya jata hai, taaki koi input ko command bana kar database na tode. String concatenation (text jodna) isi ka risky tareeka hai.
Parent-child chunkingIsme document ko chhote tukdon (child) mein todte hain jo search ke liye hote hain, aur har child ke upar ek bada tukda (parent) hota hai. Search child se hoti hai, par model ko poora parent diya jata hai taaki context poora mile.
ParserParser woh code hai jo model ke text ko padhkar use data mein todta hai. Woh fixed format maangta hai, ek bracket bhi galat ho to tut jata hai.
Parsing / post-processingParsing matlab text ko fixed rules se padhkar uske hisse nikalna. Post-processing matlab model ka jawab aane ke baad uspar kiya gaya extra kaam, jaise format theek karna.
PartitionPartition matlab data ko hisson mein baantna, jaise school mein har class ka alag register. Search sirf ek hisse mein chalti hai isliye tez hoti hai.
Path traversal / SQL injectionYe hacker ke tareeke hain: path traversal mein ../ likhkar doosre folders ki files khol lete hain, SQL injection mein input mein chhupa kharab database command daalte hain. Isliye har input ko check karte hain.
Peer-to-peerPeer-to-peer matlab sab barabar ke hain, koi boss nahi, aur wo seedhe ek doosre se baat karte hain, jaise dost aapas mein.
Percent overlap10 se 15 percent overlap matlab agle chunk mein pichle chunk ka lagbhag 10 se 15 percent hissa dobara aana.
PerceptionAgent mein perception wo hissa hai jo bahar ki cheezein receive karta hai, jaise user ka text, photo ya data. Insaan ke liye aankh aur kaan jaisa.
Pessimistic locking / mutexPehle lock lo, kaam karo, phir lock chhodo. Doosre ko wait karna padta hai.
PIIPersonally Identifiable Information: naam, phone, Aadhaar, email jaisi nijee jaankari.
Pin versionPin karna matlab ek exact version fix kar dena (jaise 'model-2025-03') taaki woh khud badal na jaye. Jaise kitab ka ek hi edition tay kar lena.
Pin versionVersion pin karna matlab ek tay version par hi atke rehna, taaki chupchaap update se kuch na bigde.
PipelineKadmon ki line: ek step ka output agle step ka input. Jaise assembly line.
PlannerAgent ka hissa jo bade goal ko chhote steps mein todta hai.
Positional encodingWords ke order ki jaankari numbers mein jodna, kyunki Transformer sab ek saath dekhta hai.
Pre-trained modelPre-trained matlab pehle se bahut saare data par train ho chuka model. Hum use zero se nahi, bana-banaya lekar thoda aur sikhate hain.
PrecisionPrecision matlab jo documents mile, unme se kitne sach mein kaam ke the. 10 mile aur 8 kaam ke the to precision acha hai.
Precision@KTop K results mein se kitne sach mein kaam ke the.
Private cloud endpointPrivate cloud endpoint matlab closed model ko tumhari apni company ke cloud account ke andar alag, band raaste se chalana, taaki data public internet par na ghoome. Jaise sabke liye khule bazaar ki jagah apna private gate.
ProductionWoh asli system jo sach mein users use kar rahe hain, testing wala nahi.
Profile / profilingProfile karna matlab naapna ki time ya paisa asal mein kis step mein ja raha hai, taaki wahi hissa theek karein.
Prometheus / GrafanaPrometheus numbers (metrics) jama karta hai aur Grafana unhe graph aur dashboard mein dikhata hai. Jaise scoreboard ka data aur screen.
PromptModel ko diye gaye instructions aur question. Ek intern ko diya gaya brief jaisa.
Prompt injectionAttacker text mein chhupe instructions daalta hai jo model ko galat kaam karne par majboor kar dein.
Prompt templatePrompt template ek bhara-hua form hai jisme kuch jagah khaali hoti hain (jaise user ka naam, sawal) jo har baar naye se bhari jaati hain.
Prompt-stuffingPrompt-stuffing matlab prompt mein jaanbujh kar bahut lamba text bhar dena, jisse bill bahut badh jaye.
PrototypePrototype matlab chhota pehla kaam karne wala namoona, jaise ghar banane se pehle ka model.
Prune / mergePrune matlab faltu ya duplicate cheez chhaant dena, jaise paudhe ki sookhi daliyan. Merge matlab milti-julti cheezon ko jodkar ek bana dena.
Pull requestPull request ek code badlav ki arzi hai jise team ke log review karke manzoor karte hain, tabhi woh main code mein jaata hai.
PydanticPython library jo data ko define kiye gaye format se validate karti hai.
PythonPython ek popular programming language hai jisme developers code likhte hain.
QLoRALoRA plus compressed base model, taaki ek hi GPU par bada model tune ho sake.
Quality barQuality bar woh minimum score hai jise model ko paar karna hai, jaise 'kam se kam 90% sahi'.
QuantisationModel ke numbers ko kam bits mein store karna (jaise 32-bit se 8-bit). Chhota aur tez, thodi accuracy ka cost.
QuerySawal ya search ka text jo system ko diya jata hai, jaise 'parcel late kyun aaya?'.
Query decompositionDecomposition matlab bade sawal ko chhote sawalon mein todna, har ek ka jawab alag dhoondhna aur phir jodna.
Query driftQuery drift matlab waqt ke saath users ke sawal ka badal jana. System purane sawalon ke liye test hua tha, naye sawalon par kamzor pad sakta hai.
Query engineQuery engine woh hissa hai jo sawal leta hai, index mein se sahi tukde dhoondhta hai aur unse jawab banata hai.
Query expansionUser ke sawal ko kai tareekon se dobara likhna, taaki alag shabdon wale documents bhi mil jayein.
Queue / workersQueue matlab kaam ki line. Workers wo helpers hain jo line se kaam uthakar saath-saath karte hain, jaise bank mein kai counter.
Race conditionDo processes ek saath ek hi cheez badalte hain aur nateeja galat nikalta hai.
RAGRetrieval-Augmented Generation: pehle documents dhoondho, phir unhi ke basis par jawab likho. Open-book exam jaisa.
RAG-FusionEk sawal ke kai versions banao, sab ke liye search karo, aur results ko RRF se jodo.
Ramp upRamp up matlab dheere dheere zyada logon tak badhana, jaise pehle 5 phir 25 phir 100 percent users.
RankingResults ko 'kaun sabse kaam ka' ke hisaab se order mein lagana.
Rate limitEk time mein kitni requests allowed hain uski seema.
Re-ask / escalation rateRe-ask rate: kitne users ne wahi sawal dobara poochha (matlab pehla jawab kaam nahi aaya). Escalation rate: kitni chats insaan ke paas gayi. Dono kharab quality ke sanket hain.
Re-embedRe-embed matlab saare documents ko dobara naye model se numbers (embeddings) mein badalna.
Re-rankerSearch se mile top results ko ek zyada dhyaan se padhne wala model dobara order karta hai, best wale upar.
ReActReason + Act: soch (Thought), kaam (Action), result dekhna (Observation), phir repeat.
Read-only user / row limitRead-only user sirf padh sakta hai, kuch badal ya mita nahi sakta. Row limit matlab ek baar mein max kitni rows (table ki lines) wapas aayengi.
Real-time dataReal-time data matlab abhi ke abhi ka data, jaise aaj ka mausam ya share ka bhaav, jo model ke purane yaad mein nahi hota.
RecallRecall matlab jitne sahi documents mil sakte the, unme se kitne mile. Jaise 10 sahi the aur 9 mile to recall acha hai.
Recall@KTop K results mein sahi document kitni baar aaya. Kitna 'miss' nahi hua.
Red-teamingJaan-bujhkar system par attack karke kamzoriyan dhoondhna.
RedactionRedaction matlab sensitive hissa kaala karke ya hata kar chhupana, jaise document mein naam par kaali patti.
ReflexionAgent apni galti par soch ke seekh likh leta hai aur agli baar use karta hai.
RefusalRefusal matlab model ka saaf mana karna, jaise 'yeh main nahi bata sakta'. Isse galat request ka jawab nahi jata.
Region / quota / deploymentRegion cloud company ke data centers ka bhougolik ilaka hai, jaise Mumbai ya Virginia. Quota matlab kitna use allowed hai uski seema. Deployment matlab model ki ek chalti hui copy.
Registry / discoveryRegistry ek directory hai jahan servers ki list rehti hai, jaise app store. Discovery matlab unhe dhoondh paana.
Regression testPurane test dobara chalana taaki naya badlav kuch purana na tod de.
RegularisationRegularisation matlab model ko zyada ratta lagane se rokne ki koi rukavat. Jaise student ko sirf utne hi notes rakhne dena ki woh sirf mukhya baatein yaad rakhe, har line nahi.
Regulated industryRegulated industry wo kshetra hai jahan sarkari niyam kaduey hote hain, jaise bank ya dawai. Regulator niyam lagu karne wali sarkari sanstha hai.
RegulatorRegulator woh sarkari ya official sanstha hai jo dekhti hai ki company niyam maan rahi hai ya nahi. Jaise bank ke liye RBI.
Rephrasing / query variationRephrasing matlab wahi sawal doosre shabdon mein likhna, jaise 'kaise bhejun' ko 'bhejne ka tareeka kya hai' likhna.
ReplayReplay matlab purane fail hue kaam ko dobara chalake dekhna ki ab theek hota hai ya nahi.
ReplayReplay matlab wahi input dobara chalakar dekhna ki pehle kya hua tha, jaise match ka video dobara chalana.
ReplicaReplica matlab app ki ek jaisi kai copies jo saath chalti hain taaki bheed baant sake.
Repo (repository)Repo matlab ek project ke saare code files ka ek jagah ka folder, jise ek bada store room samjho.
ReproducibleReproducible matlab same input par wahi result dobara aa sake. Tabhi galti dhoondhna aur theek karna aasan hota hai.
Reserved capacityReserved capacity matlab pehle se paise dekar kuch capacity apne liye book kar lena, jaise monthly bus pass.
Response contractResponse contract matlab pehle se tay kar lena ki jawab kitna lamba aur kis format mein hoga. Jaise form mein har khaane ki limit.
REST / gRPC / statelessREST aur gRPC programs ke aapas mein baat karne ke purane, popular tareeke hain jisme programmer ko pehle se pata hota hai kaun si call karni hai. Stateless matlab server pichli call yaad nahi rakhta, har baar naye sire se shuru, jaise vending machine jo pichla customer bhool jaati hai.
RetrievalSawal ke liye sahi documents ya tukde dhoondh kar nikalna. Library mein se sahi page nikalne jaisa.
RetryRetry matlab fail hone par wahi kaam dobara try karna. Yahan galti ka message batakar model se dobara likhwana.
Retry storm / throttlingRetry storm tab hota hai jab hazaaron clients fail hone par ek saath dobara koshish karte hain aur server aur dab jaata hai. Throttling matlab server jaan-boojhkar speed kam kar deta hai ya requests rok deta hai.
Reverse image searchReverse image search matlab kisi image ko upload karke dhoondhna ki wo internet par pehle se kahin hai ya nahi.
RNNRNN purane tarah ka AI model hai jo text ko ek-ek word karke, line mein padhta hai. Isliye lambe text mein shuru ki baatein bhool jata tha aur slow tha. Transformer ne isse behtar kiya.
ROIReturn on Investment: kharche ke mukable kitna fayda hua.
Roll backRoll back matlab naya change wapas lekar purane chalte version par laut jana. Jaise app update kharab nikla to purana version wapas daalna.
RolloutRollout matlab nayi cheez ko dheere dheere users tak le jana, pehle thode logon ko, phir sabko.
Root causeRoot cause matlab problem ki asli jad, sirf upar ka lakshan nahi. Jaise bukhar dawai se utarna aur bukhar ka kaaran dhoondhna alag baat hai.
RouterAisa hissa jo har request ko sahi jagah (sahi model, sahi agent) bhejta hai.
RoutingRouting matlab har task ko dekh kar sahi specialist ya sahi raaste par bhejna, jaise station announcer sahi platform batata hai.
RRFAlag-alag search lists ko jodne ka tareeka: jo document kai lists mein upar hota hai uska score zyada.
Rubber stampRubber stamp matlab bina padhe sirf sign kar dena. Agar approver ko poori detail na mile to approval sirf naam ka reh jaata hai.
RubricRubric marks dene ki checklist hai, jaise 'sahi hai? source se hai? poora hai?'. Har cheez par pass ya fail ya number diya jata hai, taaki checking sabke liye same rahe.
Rules engineRules engine ek normal code hai jo pehle se likhe rules (limit, eligibility) se check karta hai, AI ke andaze se nahi. Isliye uska faisla pakka hota hai.
S3 / Secrets ManagerS3 Amazon ki cloud storage hai jahan files rakhte hain. Secrets Manager Amazon ki service hai jo passwords aur keys surakshit rakhti hai.
SamplingSampling matlab model ka probability list se ek word chunna, bilkul sabse upar wala nahi bhi. Jaise lucky draw jisme zyada chance wale ko zyada, par kabhi aur ka bhi number aa sakta hai. Isliye jawab badal sakte hain.
SandboxAlag, band jagah jahan code chalao taaki kuch bigde to baaki system safe rahe.
SanitiseSanitise matlab data ko saaf karna, yaani usme se khatarnak ya chhupe hue hisse hata dena, jaise sabzi dho kar khana.
SaturationSaturation matlab jagah itni bhar jana ki naya kuch aa na sake. Near-duplicate matlab lagbhag same cheez jo thode alag shabdon mein likhi ho.
ScaleZyada users ya zyada data ko sambhalne ki kshamta badhana.
SchemaData ka 'form' kaisa hona chahiye uska blueprint: kaun se fields hain aur kis type ke.
Scoped toolsScoped tools matlab agent ko sirf wahi tools dena jo uske kaam ke liye zaroori hain, jaise cashier ko sirf apne counter ki chaabi.
ScrapingScraping matlab kisi program se automatic tarike se bahut saara data kheench lena, jaise bot jo poori website ka text copy kar le.
SDKKisi service ko code se use karne ka ready-made library.
Secrets / keysSecrets matlab password, API key jaisi gupt cheezein jinse system khulta hai. Inhe prompt ya code mein khula nahi chhodte.
Self-attentionHar word dekhta hai ki baaki kaun se words uske liye important hain.
Self-consistencySame sawal kai baar chalao aur jo jawab zyada baar aaye wahi lo.
Self-hostedSelf-hosted matlab model ko apne (ya kiraye ke) servers par khud chalana, kisi company ki API ke bajay. Control zyada milta hai, par server sambhalne ki mehnat bhi tumhari.
Self-RAGModel khud decide karta hai ki retrieve karna hai ya nahi, aur mile hue ko khud check karta hai.
SemanticWords ke nahi, matlab ke hisaab se.
Semantic cacheMilte-julte sawalon par bhi stored jawab dena, sirf exact same words par nahi.
Sentence-window / parent-childSentence-window mein ek sentence match karke uske aas-paas ke sentences bhi lete hain. Parent-child mein chhote tukde se search karke uska bada parent tukda dete hain. Dono se context poora milta hai.
Sequence lengthSequence length matlab model ko ek baar mein diye gaye text ki lambai (tokens mein). Text double karne par attention ka kaam lagbhag 4 guna ho jata hai, isliye lamba text mehnga padta hai.
SessionSession matlab user ke saath ek baar ki baatcheet, shuru se band hone tak. Naya session naye sire se shuru hota hai.
Set differenceSet difference matlab ek list mein se doosri list ke naam hata dena. Jaise saare students ki list se pass hone walon ko hata do to fail hone wale bachte hain.
SFTSFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning) matlab model ko sawal aur sahi jawab ke examples dikhakar train karna, yaani fine-tuning ka common tareeka.
Shadow modeNaya system asli traffic par chalta hai lekin uske answers users ko nahi dikhte, sirf compare hote hain.
SHAPTechnique jo batati hai ki model ke decision mein kaun si feature kitni important thi.
Shard / partitionShard ya partition matlab bade data ko kai hisson mein baant kar alag machines par rakhna, jaise ek bade register ko kai almariyon mein baantna.
Shared blackboardShared blackboard matlab ek saanjha board jispar sab agents apna kaam aur jaankari likhte aur padhte hain, jaise class ka board.
Side effectSide effect matlab kaam ka bahar dikhne wala asar, jaise email bhej dena ya paisa kaat lena. Dobara chalane par ye do baar nahi hone chahiye.
Sliding windowSliding window mein sirf haal ki kuch baatein yaad rakhi jaati hain aur purani hatti jaati hain, jaise notebook ke sirf aakhri 2 page saamne rakhna.
Soft deleteData asal mein mitane ki jagah 'deleted' ka mark lagana, taaki undo ho sake.
SoftmaxScores ko aise probabilities mein badalna jinka total 1 ho.
Spot-checkSpot-check matlab sab kuch nahi, bas kuch random cheezein haath se dekh lena ki sahi hai ya nahi. Jaise teacher poori copy ke bajay kuch sawal jaanch le.
SQLDatabase se data maangne ki language, jaise 'SELECT * FROM orders'.
SSEServer-Sent Events: purana streaming tareeka, ab MCP mein deprecated.
StakeholderStakeholder woh insaan hai jiska project mein fayda ya dilchaspi ho, jaise manager, client ya product owner.
StaleStale matlab baasi ya purana ho chuka. Jaise kal ka akhbaar aaj ke liye stale hai.
STAR formatSTAR matlab apni kahani batane ka tareeka: Situation (halaat), Task (kaam), Action (tumne kya kiya), Result (kya nateeja nikla).
StateAb tak ki yaad: kaam kahan tak pahuncha, kya ho chuka.
StatefulStateful matlab system pichli baat ya progress yaad rakhta hai, jaise dukaandaar jise aapka purana hisaab pata hai.
Static analysis toolsStatic analysis tool code ko chalaye bina padhkar khatarnak pattern pakadta hai, jaise spell-check lekin security ke liye. Bandit, Semgrep, CodeQL aise tools ke naam hain.
stdioProgram ke input-output se baat karna. Local MCP servers isse chalte hain.
Straight-through rateStraight-through rate matlab kitne kaam bina kisi insaan ke haath lage seedhe poore ho gaye. Jaise 100 mein se 90 bills apne aap paas hue to rate 90 percent.
Streamable HTTPRemote MCP servers se internet par baat karne ka transport.
StreamingJawab ke words aate hi dikhana, poora bante tak intezaar nahi. Speed jaisa lagta hai.
Stress testStress test matlab system par bahut zyada load daal kar dekhna ki kahan tak sambhalta hai, jaise pul par bhaari trucks chalakar check karna.
Structured outputStructured output matlab provider ki woh setting jisme model ko ek tay format (jaise JSON) mein hi jawab dena padta hai, free text nahi.
Structured output / generationStructured output matlab model ka jawab ek tay form mein aana, jaise table ke alag-alag khaane.
Subclass / patch / fork / pin / upstreamLibrary kisi aur ka bana hua ready code hota hai. Patch matlab us code mein chhota fix lagana, subclass matlab uski class ko extend karke bug wala hissa badalna, fork matlab poori library ki apni copy bana lena, pin matlab ek purana chalta version fix karna taaki update se kuch na toote, aur upstream matlab library ka original project jahan fix bhejte hain.
Subscribe / event-drivenSubscribe matlab kisi cheez ki khabar apne aap pane ke liye naam likhwana, jaise YouTube channel subscribe. Event-driven matlab kuch badalne par hi khabar aana, baar-baar poochna nahi.
SubtaskSubtask matlab bade kaam ka ek chhota hissa.
Summarise / trimSummarise matlab lambi baat ko chhota karke likhna. Trim matlab purana hissa kaat dena, taaki jagah bache.
SupersededSuperseded matlab 'naye se badal diya gaya'. Jaise purana price list jab naya aa jaye to purana superseded ho jata hai.
Supervisor agentSupervisor ek manager agent hai jo baaki agents ko dekhta hai, jhagde sulajhata hai aur kaam ko track par rakhta hai.
SynonymSynonym matlab same matlab wale alag shabd, jaise 'car' aur 'gaadi'.
SynthesiseSynthesise matlab mile hue tukdon ko jodkar ek saaf jawab bana dena.
System promptChhupe hue standing rules jo poori chat mein model follow karta hai, jaise 'tum ek polite support agent ho'.
TelemetryTelemetry matlab system ke har hisse se aati naapne wali jaankari, jaise har step mein kitna time laga. Jaise car ka speedometer aur fuel meter.
TemperatureRandomness ka knob. 0 ke paas = lagbhag har baar same answer, upar = zyada creative aur alag answers.
Template / argumentsTemplate ek bana-banaya format hai jisme khaali jagah hoti hai, jaise printed form. Arguments wo cheezein hain jo us khaali jagah mein bharte hain, jaise naam aur amount.
Test setTest set sawalon ki wo list hai jisse system ko jaancha jata hai, jaise exam ka question paper.
Text-to-SQLModel sawal padhkar khud SQL query likhta hai, jo phir database par chalti hai.
Third-partyThird-party matlab koi bahari company ya vyakti jisne cheez banayi, tumne ya tumhari company ne nahi.
ThresholdWoh seema jiske paar karne par koi action hota hai, jaise 'score 0.8 se upar ho to hi dikhao'.
ThroughputEk second mein kitni requests system sambhal sakta hai.
Ticket triageTicket matlab customer ki shikayat ki entry. Triage matlab unhe dekh kar sahi team ya priority mein bhejna, jaise hospital mein emergency pehle.
TimeoutTimeout matlab ek tay time tak jawab ka intezaar karna, aur us time mein jawab na aaye to intezaar band karke aage badh jana.
TimestampTimestamp matlab kis tareekh aur time par cheez save hui, yeh likha hua note.
TokenText ka chhota tukda (word ya word ka hissa). Model words nahi, tokens padhta hai aur bill bhi tokens par banta hai.
Token consumptionToken consumption matlab kitne tokens (text ki ginti) kharch hue, isi par bill banta hai. Model routing matlab sawal ki mushkil dekh kar sasta ya mehenga model chunna.
TokenisationTokenisation matlab text ko chhote tukdon (tokens) mein todna. Kuch languages ke shabd zyada tukdon mein tootte hain, isliye unka kharcha zyada hota hai.
ToolEk function jo agent chala sakta hai: search, email bhejna, database query, calculator.
Tool poisoningTool ke description mein chhupe instructions jo model ko bahkate hain.
ToolkitToolkit matlab ready-made tools ka packet, jaise Gmail ya SQL ke liye bane bane tools.
Top-KTop-K matlab search se sabse achhe K results lena, jaise top 5 matlab sabse paas ke 5 chunks. K ek number hai jo hum tay karte hain.
Top-pSirf un tokens mein se chunna jinki milkar probability p tak pahunchti hai. Randomness control karne ka doosra tareeka.
TraceEk request ke poore safar ka step-by-step record.
TracingTracing matlab har step ka likha hua record rakhna ki kya aaya, kya gaya, taaki galti kahan hui dhoondh sakein, jaise courier ka tracking.
Traffic switchTraffic switch matlab users ke requests ko purane system se naye system par bhejna shuru karna.
Training cutoffTraining cutoff woh tareekh hai jahan tak ka data model ne seekha. Uske baad ki cheezein use pata nahi hoti.
TrajectoryTrajectory matlab agent ne shuru se ant tak jo jo steps liye unka poora raasta, jaise exam mein poori working.
TranscriptTranscript kisi call ya meeting ki likhi hui poori baatcheet hai.
TransformerWo neural network design jo saare words ko ek saath dekhta hai. Aaj ke LLMs ki buniyaad.
Transient vs permanent failureTransient failure thodi der ki problem hai jo dobara try karne par theek ho sakti hai (jaise network slow). Permanent failure mein galti hi pakki hai (jaise galat input), dobara try karne se kuch nahi badlega.
TransportTransport matlab data ek jagah se doosri jagah bhejne ka raasta ya tareeka, jaise parcel bhejne ke liye train ya courier.
Tree of ThoughtsEk hi soch ki jagah kai alag raaste explore karna, phir best chunna.
TuningModel ko ek khaas kaam ya style ke liye thoda aur sikhana, taaki woh us kaam mein behtar ho.
TurnTurn matlab chat mein ek baar bolna: user ka ek message ya bot ka ek jawab. 30 turns matlab 30 baar ki aamne-saamne baat.
Typed schemaTyped schema har input ka type tay karta hai (number, text, date), taaki galat type ka input pakda jaye.
Unit test / mock / CIUnit test chhote hisse ko akele check karta hai. Mock nakli tool hota hai jo asli ki jagah lagta hai taaki result hamesha ek jaisa aaye. CI ek automatic system hai jo har code change par ye tests khud chala deta hai.
Untrusted / trust levelUntrusted matlab jis par bharosa nahi kar sakte, jaise ajnabi ki chitthi. Trust level ek hisaab hai ki kis source ki baat kitni maanni hai. Supply-chain review matlab bahar se aaye code ya tool ko ghar mein laane se pehle jaanchna ki wo kahan se aaya.
Untrusted dataUntrusted data wo text hai jis par aankh band karke bharosa nahi kiya ja sakta, jaise kisi anjaan ki bheji hui file. Model ko bataya jata hai ki ise sirf jaankari samjho, hukm nahi.
URIURI ek cheez ka unique pata hota hai, jaise ghar ka address ya website ka link. Isse pata chalta hai file ya data kahan rakha hai.
UXUX matlab user ko screen par use karte waqt kaisa lagta hai, yaani button, layout aur flow kitna aasan hai.
ValidateCheck karna ki cheez sahi shape, sahi values ya sahi format mein hai.
Variance (stability)Variance matlab jawab ka baar-baar badalna. Kam variance matlab har baar same jawab (stable). Yeh sirf consistency batata hai, jawab sahi hai ya nahi yeh nahi.
Vector databaseAisa database jo embeddings store karta hai aur 'sabse milta-julta matlab' tezi se dhoondhta hai.
Vector searchExact words ki jagah matlab ke hisaab se dhoondhna. 'phone ki battery' aur 'mobile ki charging' ko milta-julta maanega.
Vector storeVector store woh jagah hai jahan text ke tukde unke meaning-numbers (embeddings) ke saath rakhe jaate hain, taaki matlab se dhoondh sakein.
Vendor / providerVendor ya provider woh company hai jo model ya service deti hai, jaise OpenAI, Google ya Anthropic. Tum unki service use karte ho aur unki shartein maanni padti hain.
Vendor lock-inVendor lock-in matlab ek hi company ke product par itna nirbhar ho jana ki badalna bahut mushkil ho jaye. Jaise ek hi mobile company ke charger par atak jana.
Version control / tracingVersion karna matlab har badlav ki alag numbered copy rakhna taaki purana wapas la sako. Tracing matlab har step ka record rakhna ki kya hua.
Vision-language modelYe aisa AI model hai jo text ke saath tasveer bhi dekh aur samajh sakta hai, jaise screenshot ya chart padhna.
vLLM / TensorRT-LLMLLMs ko tez aur sasta serve karne ke software.
WebhookKuch hone par doosra system automatically aapke URL ko khabar bhejta hai.
WeightsModel ke andar band lakhon-karodon numbers jo uska 'sikha hua gyaan' hote hain.
WorkflowKaam ke pehle se tay kadam, ek fixed order mein.
Workflow engine / graph runtimeWorkflow engine ya graph runtime ek software hai jo steps ko sahi order mein chalata hai aur beech mein progress khud save kar leta hai.
WorkloadWorkload matlab system par aane wala kaam ka bojh aur uska tarika, jaise kitni aur kaisi requests aa rahi hain.
Zero-shotZero-shot matlab model ko sirf instruction dena, koi solved example nahi dikhana. Jaise naye intern ko seedha bolna 'yeh report banao', bina pichli report dikhaye.

Koi note nahi mila.
